papers.title: ATSplat: Compact Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Adaptive Token Expansion
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) achieves high-quality novel-view synthesis by optimizing freely placed primitives in 3D and adaptively densifying them in under-reconstructed regions. However, this scene-adaptive capacity allocation is largely lost in existing feed-forward 3DGS methods, which commonly regress Gaussians at input pixels and lift them along camera rays. Such pixel-aligned formulations make the number and placement of primitives depend on image resolution and input viewpoints rather than scene complexity, resulting in dense and often redundant Gaussian sets. We present ATSplat, a feed-forward 3DGS framework that restores the adaptive allocation capability of 3DGS optimization through Adaptive 3D Tokens. ATSplat first lifts coarse patch-level depth and camera cues into sparse 3D anchor tokens, forming a compact scaffold of the scene. Each token is then regressed into local Gaussians with learnable 3D offsets, decoupling primitive placement from input image grids. An Adaptive Token Expansion module predicts a token-level uncertainty score, supervised by rendering error maps, and selectively expands high-uncertainty tokens through learnable expansion layers. This sparse-to-adaptive formulation enables ATSplat to concentrate primitives in challenging regions while maintaining a compact representation. Experiments on two representative datasets, RealEstate10K and DL3DV, show that ATSplat achieves state-of-the-art rendering quality while reducing the number of Gaussians by more than $5.7\times$ compared with dense feed-forward 3DGS methods. From 12 input images at $512 \times 960$ resolution, ATSplat completes reconstruction in less than a second using a single commercial GPU, and renders high-quality novel views at 1136 FPS ($512 \times 960$) with only 311K Gaussians.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ATSplat，一种前馈式 3D 高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）框架，通过自适应 3D Token 恢复 3DGS 优化中的自适应容量分配能力。该方法首先将粗略的块级深度和相机线索提升为稀疏的 3D 锚点 Token，形成紧凑的场景骨架，再由每个 Token 回归出局部高斯，并通过自适应 Token 扩展模块预测不确定性分数，选择性地扩展高不确定性 Token。在 RealEstate10K 和 DL3DV 数据集上，ATSplat 在减少高斯数量 5.7 倍以上的同时实现了最先进的渲染质量，从 12 张 512×960 图像可在单 GPU 上于 1 秒内完成重建，并以 1136 FPS 渲染高质量新视图，仅需 311K 高斯。
Motivation: 现有前馈式 3DGS 方法通常基于像素对齐回归高斯，使得基元数量和位置依赖图像分辨率和输入视角而非场景复杂度，导致密集且冗余的高斯基元集合，丧失了 3DGS 优化中的场景自适应容量分配能力。
Method: 提出 ATSplat，首先从输入图像中提升粗粒度块级深度和相机线索得到稀疏 3D 锚点 Token；每个 Token 通过可学习的 3D 偏移回归出局部高斯；自适应 Token 扩展模块预测 Token 级不确定性分数（由渲染误差图监督），并通过可学习扩展层选择性地扩展高不确定性 Token。
Result: 在 RealEstate10K 和 DL3DV 数据集上，ATSplat 在减少高斯数量 5.7 倍以上的同时实现了最先进的渲染质量。从 12 张 512×960 图像在单 GPU 上重建用时少于 1 秒，渲染速度为 1136 FPS，仅使用 311K 高斯。
Conclusion: ATSplat 通过稀疏到自适应的 Token 机制恢复了前馈式 3DGS 的自适应基元分配能力，在保持紧凑表示的同时在挑战区域集中基元，实现了高质量和高效的新视图合成。

papers.title: Lipschitzian SLLNs for random functions
papers.abstract_en: We prove strong laws of large numbers for locally Lipschitz functions in the Lipschitz pseudometric. Our results hold under either a topological or a model-theoretic condition, with the latter encompassing functions jointly definable in o-minimal structures but extending substantially beyond this class. Applications include uniform convergence of limiting and Clarke subdifferentials and finite-sample identification of solutions. Consequently, we identify broad classes of functions for which the failure phenomena revealed by our previous negative results [Tian and Royset, arXiv:2511.16568, 2025] do not occur.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明了局部利普希茨函数在利普希茨伪度量下的强大数律（SLLNs）。结果在拓扑或模型论条件下成立，后者涵盖o-minimal结构中联合可定义函数但远超此类。应用包括Clarke次微分的均匀收敛以及有限样本解的识别，从而识别了之前负结果不会发生失败现象的广泛函数类。
Motivation: 现有强大数律通常假设可测性或凸性，而对于局部利普希茨函数在利普希茨度量下的收敛性研究不足，且之前的工作揭示了某些失败现象。
Method: 利用拓扑条件和模型论条件（特别是o-minimal结构），建立局部利普希茨函数在利普希茨伪度量下的强大数律。
Result: 证明了在两种条件下强大数律成立，并应用于Clarke次微分的均匀收敛和有限样本解的识别，明确了之前负结果中失败现象不会发生的函数类。
Conclusion: 本文识别的广泛函数类保证了利普希茨伪度量下的强大数律，为随机优化和统计中的非光滑分析提供了理论基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SoftReason: A Fully Differentiable Neuro-Soft-Symbolic Deductive Reasoning Architecture over High-Dimensional Perceptual Data
papers.abstract_en: In many reasoning problems, the premises are not observed as discrete symbols, but must be inferred from high-dimensional inputs. Further, the predicate vocabulary, argument structure, and trusted evidence are supplied by a Knowledge Graph (KG), or rule definitions. Classical neuro-symbolic pipelines have a discrete interface between perception and deduction. We present a neuro-soft-symbolic architecture for differentiable deductive reasoning over latent perceptual facts and knowledge-provided predicates. SoftReason removes the gradient gap by representing the deductive state as a local soft interpretation tensor over candidate constants and predicates. Perception proposes probabilistic base facts, KG triples enter as high-confidence soft evidence, and every query anchor, predicate choice, and closure update remains differentiable. Our core innovation is a learned differentiable lift of the immediate-consequence operator. It uses predicate-definition embeddings and latent composition channels to form soft body-predicate mixtures, aggregate over all possible witnesses, propose query-conditioned head facts, and update the interpretation through a monotone probabilistic OR. We instantiate the framework on Knowledge-aware Visual Question Answering (KVQA), and demonstrates how SoftReason supports end-to-end perceptual grounding, KG evidence injection, and differentiable deductive closure in one trainable architecture.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of Machine Learning Research vol 284:1-2, 2026 20th Conference on Neurosymbolic Learning and Reasoning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SoftReason，一种完全可微分的神经软符号演绎推理架构，用于处理高维感知数据中的推理问题。该架构通过将演绎状态表示为局部软解释张量，并设计可微分的立即后承算子，实现了感知、知识图谱证据注入和演绎闭包的全可微端到端训练。在知识感知视觉问答（KVQA）任务上验证了该方法的有效性。
Motivation: 经典神经符号推理管道在感知与演绎之间存在离散接口，导致梯度无法跨阶段传播，限制了端到端学习。
Method: SoftReason将演绎状态表示为关于候选常量和谓词的局部软解释张量，使用谓词定义嵌入和潜在组合通道形成软体谓词混合，通过单调概率OR更新解释。核心创新是可微分的立即后承算子提升，使查询锚点、谓词选择和闭包更新保持可微。
Result: 在知识感知视觉问答（KVQA）任务上，SoftReason实现了端到端可微分推理，支持感知基础、知识图谱证据注入和演绎闭包。
Conclusion: 该框架表明通过软表示和可微分算子，可以消除神经符号系统中感知与演绎的梯度鸿沟，为复杂推理任务的端到端学习提供新途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Miniature Humanoid Tele-Loco-Manipulation Using Virtual Reality and Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Full-sized humanoid robot capabilities have grown exponentially in recent years, aiming towards general-purpose deployment in human environments. A popular control method used by manufacturers utilizes Virtual Reality for upper-body teleoperation and Reinforcement Learning for lower-body balance and locomotion control. As a result, a single remote operator can see, manipulate, and navigate about a real, distant physical environment. This powerful control stack is often relegated to expensive full-sized robots, many of which are inaccessible to the research community. Miniature humanoids are more prevalent, but employ less biomimicry in their design (e.g. fewer sensors, Degrees of Freedom, etc) and lack similar developments. This paper describes a compliant full-body telepresence control stack developed from the ground up for miniature humanoids. Framework experimentation on ROBOTIS OP3 hardware showcases walking at speeds up to 0.45 m/s independent of arm motions. Tele-loco-manipulation is demonstrated via a cube relocation experiment with an expert human operator. On average, the teleoperated system moved 2 different 40 g cubes within 10 mins, walking a total distance of 5 m. Overall, the developed system shows potential for miniature humanoid tele-loco-manipulation.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Accepted manuscript. Published in the 2025 IEEE-RAS 24th International Conference on Humanoid Robots (Humanoids), pp. 1233-1240
papers.journal_ref: 2025 IEEE-RAS 24th International Conference on Humanoid Robots (Humanoids), pp. 1233-1240 (2025)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对微型人形机器人开发了一套完整的全身遥操作控制栈，结合虚拟现实（VR）上身遥操作与强化学习（RL）下身平衡与行走控制。在ROBOTIS OP3硬件上实现了0.45 m/s的行走速度（独立于手臂运动），并通过立方体重定位实验验证了遥操作能力：10分钟内移动2个40g立方体，行走总距离5米。
Motivation: 全尺寸人形机器人的遥操作控制栈昂贵且难以获取，而微型人形机器人虽更普及但缺乏类似的全身体感控制方案，限制了其在远程操作与移动操作（tele-loco-manipulation）中的应用。
Method: 从零构建兼容微型人形机器人的全身遥操作框架：使用VR头盔和手柄实现上身远程控制，训练RL策略负责下身平衡与行走，使行走与手臂运动解耦。
Result: 在ROBOTIS OP3上行走速度达0.45 m/s且不依赖手臂运动；专家操作下，系统在10分钟内移动2个40g立方体，行走总距离5米。
Conclusion: 该工作证明微型人形机器人可借助VR+RL实现有效的全身远程操作与操作，为低成本研究平台提供了可行方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PercepCap: Video Captioner with Structured Spatio-Temporal Perception
papers.abstract_en: Video captioning requires fine-grained spatio-temporal understanding of videos, including spatial perception of where objects are located and temporal perception of when events occur. Existing MLLMs usually generate captions directly from video inputs without exposing the perceptual evidence behind descriptions. As a result, mistakes in spatiotemporal perception are only observed in the final caption, making it difficult to identify the underlying perceptual errors directly. To address these issues, we present PercepCap, a perception-aware video captioning framework that makes perceptual evidence explicit before producing the final caption. Specifically, PercepCap follows a perceive-describe generation chain, where the model first produces a spatiotemporal perception trace comprising object trajectories and temporal events, and then generates the final caption conditioned on the perceived evidence. To support this, we design a two-stage training strategy. Perceive-then-Describe Supervised Fine-tuning adapts the model from caption-only generation to the proposed perceive-describe chain, while Perception-Grounded Reinforcement Learning optimizes perception trace and caption quality with joint rewards over perception chain and the final caption. To support our two-stage training, we introduce Caption-Anchored Perception Data Construction. This pipeline builds the SFT and RL training data by first generating a caption-only description, extracting the objects and events it mentions, and grounding them back in the video with boxes and timestamps. This yields caption-aligned perception data that provides solid training ground truth, ensuring that the explicit perception trace and final caption refer to the same objects and events. Across direct caption and caption-to-QA evaluation, PercepCap consistently improves upon the Qwen3-VL baseline and demonstrates leading caption quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PercepCap，一种感知感知的视频字幕框架，通过显式生成时空感知痕迹（对象轨迹和时间事件）再生成最终字幕，以提高视频字幕的细粒度时空理解。采用两阶段训练：先进行感知-描述有监督微调，再使用感知基础强化学习联合优化。实验表明，PercepCap 在直接字幕和字幕问答评估上均优于 Qwen3-VL 基线。
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型通常直接从视频输入生成字幕，缺乏对描述背后感知证据的显式暴露，导致时空感知错误难以定位。
Method: 提出 PercepCap，遵循感知-描述生成链：先产生包含对象轨迹和时间事件的时空感知痕迹，再基于该痕迹生成字幕。训练分为两阶段：感知-描述有监督微调（适应感知-描述链）和感知基础强化学习（联合优化感知痕迹和字幕质量）。还设计了字幕锚定感知数据构建流程，以生成与字幕对齐的感知训练数据。
Result: 在直接字幕和字幕问答评估上，PercepCap 持续改进 Qwen3-VL 基线，并展示出领先的字幕质量。
Conclusion: PercepCap 通过显式感知痕迹提高了视频字幕的可解释性和准确性，但摘要未提及对极端天气或降水预报等领域的适用性。

papers.title: Persian Pixel: A large-scale synthetic OCR dataset for Persian language
papers.abstract_en: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) for Persian remains substantially less mature than for Latin-script languages despite Persian being spoken by more than 110 million people across multiple countries. This gap arises from two fundamental challenges: the intrinsic complexity of the Perso-Arabic writing system and the limited availability of large-scale, high-quality annotated datasets. Persian script exhibits obligatory cursive connectivity, context-dependent glyph shaping, extensive ligatures, diacritic placement, and stylistic variation across writing forms such as Naskh and Nastaliq, all of which significantly complicate text recognition. At the same time, the high cost and labor-intensive nature of manual annotation have created a persistent data bottleneck, limiting the development of robust OCR systems and slowing progress in Persian document digitization.In this paper, we introduce Persian Pixel, a comprehensive synthetic OCR dataset specifically designed to address these challenges. Comprising over 343,000 high-fidelity image text pairs, the dataset spans sentence, paragraph, and full-page document layouts generated from a carefully curated seven-million-word Persian corpus using the SynthOCR-Gen rendering framework. The generation pipeline faithfully models the typographic characteristics of Persian script, including contextual character joining, positional glyph variants, diacritic placement, and multiple representative Persian typefaces. To bridge the synthetic-to-real domain gap, the rendered images are further enriched with more than twenty-five stochastic degradation models that emulate realistic document acquisition artifacts, including ink bleed, paper aging, blur, illumination variation, scanner imperfections, compression artifacts, and multiple noise processes.By overcoming the long-standing scarcity of annotated Persian OCR data, Persian Pixel provides a scalable and openly available resource for training and fine-tuning modern OCR architectures, including transformer-based models such as TrOCR and Donut. The dataset establishes a strong foundation for research in Persian document analysis, historical manuscript digitization, and end-to-end document understanding, while demonstrating that programmatic synthetic data generation offers a practical, cost-effective, and scalable alternative to manual annotation for advancing OCR in low-resource and typographically complex scripts.

TL;DR: 本文针对波斯语OCR数据稀缺问题，提出大规模合成数据集Persian Pixel，包含超过34.3万高保真图像-文本对，覆盖句子、段落和整页文档布局。生成流程使用SynthOCR-Gen框架，模拟波斯文字体特征，并通过25种以上退化模型模拟真实文档采集伪影。该数据集可用于训练和微调TrOCR、Donut等现代OCR架构。
Motivation: 波斯语OCR发展落后于拉丁语系语言，主要由于波斯-阿拉伯文字系统的复杂性（如连笔、上下文相关字形、连字、变音符号等）以及高质量标注数据严重匮乏。手动标注成本高、劳动密集，形成数据瓶颈。
Method: 基于七百万词的波斯语语料库，利用SynthOCR-Gen渲染框架生成句子、段落和整页文档布局，精确建模波斯文字体特征（字符连接、位置变体、变音符号等），并应用超过25种随机退化模型（如墨迹渗透、纸张老化、模糊、光照变化、扫描缺陷等）以弥合合成与真实域差距。
Result: 数据集包含超过343,000个高保真图像-文本对，覆盖多种字体（Naskh、Nastaliq等）和布局，并公开提供。
Conclusion: Persian Pixel 为波斯语文档分析和历史手稿数字化提供了可扩展的开放资源，表明程序化合成数据生成是克服低资源、复杂文字OCR数据瓶颈的有效途径。

papers.title: FMRP-LEAN: A HIPAA-Compliant AI-Augmented LIMS Architecture for End-to-End Clinical Assay Workflow Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Clinical biomarker workflows in translational research settings often rely on spreadsheet-driven tracking, manual quality control (QC) reconciliation, and loosely integrated systems, resulting in limited state visibility, delayed reporting, and increased operational risk. These challenges are particularly pronounced in multi-day assays such as Luminex-based quantification of Fragile X Messenger Ribonucleoprotein (FMRP), where HIPAA-compliant data governance, deterministic workflow progression, and coordinated communication across laboratory and clinical teams are required. This paper presents FMRP-LEAN, a HIPAA-compliant, AI-augmented Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) architecture that formalizes biospecimen lifecycle management through a finite-state workflow model with explicit transition guards and dwell-time observability. The system integrates a self-hosted Supabase/PostgreSQL stack deployed within hospital-controlled infrastructure, hybrid edge-internal isolation with encrypted tunneling and loopback-only services, and bi-directional REDCap synchronization. A unified MRN-UUIDv7 identifier framework with QR-based tracking ensures traceable clinical-research linkage under PHI residency constraints. FMRP-LEAN incorporates automated statistical QC pre-screening and a governance-constrained AI operations module that operates exclusively on aggregate projections, with deterministic fallback guarantees. Deployment demonstrates improved workflow observability, reduced QC latency, and enhanced cross-role transparency between laboratory technicians, research coordinators, and patient-facing teams. The architecture provides a reproducible model for secure, state-explicit, and AI-augmented clinical research workflows in regulated healthcare environments.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FMRP-LEAN，一个符合 HIPAA 标准的 AI 增强型实验室信息管理系统（LIMS）架构，用于优化临床检测工作流，特别是针对脆性X信使核糖核蛋白（FMRP）的多日检测。该系统通过有限状态工作流模型、自托管的 Supabase/PostgreSQL 堆栈、混合边缘-内部隔离、双向 REDCap 同步以及统一的 MRN-UUIDv7 标识符框架，实现了可追溯的临床-研究链接。AI 模块仅操作聚合投影，并具有确定性回退保证。部署结果显示工作流可观测性提升、质控延迟降低以及跨角色透明度增强。
Motivation: 临床生物标志物工作流在转化研究中常依赖电子表格追踪、手动质控协调和松散集成的系统，导致状态可见性有限、报告延迟和操作风险增加，尤其是在需要 HIPAA 合规数据治理的多日检测中。
Method: 设计了一个 HIPAA 合规的 AI 增强型 LIMS 架构，包括有限状态工作流模型（含显式转移守卫和驻留时间可观测性）、自托管 Supabase/PostgreSQL 后端（部署在医院控制的基础设施内）、混合边缘-内部隔离（加密隧道和仅回环服务）、双向 REDCap 同步，以及基于 MRN-UUIDv7 的 QR 追踪框架。AI 模块仅基于聚合投影进行统计质控预筛选，并具有确定性回退保证。
Result: 摘要报告部署后工作流可观测性提升、质控延迟降低以及跨角色透明度增强（实验室技术员、研究协调员和患者面对团队之间）。
Conclusion: 该架构为受监管医疗环境中的安全、状态显式且 AI 增强的临床研究工作流提供了一个可复现的模型。

papers.title: Train the Model, Not the Reader: Decodability Supervision for Verifiable Activation Explanations
papers.abstract_en: Natural-language autoencoders score explanations of hidden activations by reconstruction: an explanation is deemed faithful if the activation can be regenerated from it. The test is structurally insensitive to individual false claims: if flipping a claim does not change the reconstruction, the claim is never penalized. We show the test is passed in two ways, neither faithful. On a released Qwen-2.5-7B verbalizer, explanations reconstruct well above chance while ~2% of specific claims are reconstruction-dependent, so the score tracks gist, not specific facts. Under exact synthetic ground truth, the standard recipe develops co-adapted private codes (false wording the reconstruction depends on) in 5/5 runs, and fixes that leave the target model unchanged do not help. We contribute two audit protocols, the grounded-vs-true cross and the evaluator swap, and RECAP (Readable Encodings via Co-trained Auxiliary Predictors): linear heads trained alongside the target model to keep designated content decodable. On RECAP-trained sandbox models, fresh verbalizers state the designated content truly and the codes vanish, at a +0.001-nat cost. This replicates on a pretrained Pythia-160M: the content becomes reliably probe-decodable, though a fresh verbalizer conveys it only in part (truth 0.44-0.46 vs a near-zero control). For interpretability, high reconstruction does not certify individual claims. For AI safety, RECAP makes designated internal content independently checkable against probes rather than asserted by prose a model can game: an independent probe scores the verbalizer's true claims above its false ones (AUC 0.96, vs 0.82 without RECAP). Against an adversary that edits an explanation to maximize the reconstruction score while lying (suppressing ~87% of its lie penalty), the RECAP probe still flags the lies (AUC 0.95) while the control probe collapses to chance (0.51).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出自然语言自编码器对隐藏激活的解释存在结构性问题：高重建分数不保证单个事实的正确性，因为解释中的虚假陈述如果不影响重建则不会被惩罚。作者提出RECAP方法，在目标模型旁训练线性头以确保指定内容可解码，并设计两种审计协议。实验表明RECAP使解释更真实，且独立探针能可靠检测虚假陈述，即使面对对抗攻击也保持高AUC。
Motivation: 现有可解释性方法用重建分数评估解释忠实性，但该分数对单个假陈述不敏感，导致高重建分数下仍存在大量虚假陈述，无法认证具体事实。
Method: 提出RECAP（Readable Encodings via Co-trained Auxiliary Predictors）：在目标模型训练过程中同步训练线性头，使指定内容保持可解码性；并设计grounded-vs-true交叉和评估器交换两个审计协议来检测虚假陈述。
Result: 在沙盒模型上，新解释器准确陈述指定内容，私有代码消失，代价仅+0.001 nat；在预训练Pythia-160M上，内容可被探针可靠解码；RECAP使独立探针区分真假陈述的AUC达到0.96，面对攻击时仍维持0.95，而对照组降至0.51。
Conclusion: 高重建分数不能认证单个事实；RECAP使模型内部指定内容可被探针独立验证，增强可解释性和安全性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PG-KINN: A Physics-Informed Petrov-Galerkin Kolmogorov-Arnold Network for Solving Forward and Inverse PDEs
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed learning of partial differential equations (PDEs) has been dominated by multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), whose spectral bias and dense parameterization limit both accuracy and interpretability. Kolmogorov Arnold Networks (KANs) mitigate these limitations because their learnable spline activations are structurally aligned with the piecewise-polynomial bases of classical discretizations. However, the way a PDE is cast into a loss functional is as decisive as the choice of approximator: strong-form residual minimization requires high-order derivatives and heavily weighted losses, the energy (Bubnov-Galerkin) form is restricted to self-adjoint operators and, as we show, collapses to a trivial solution for parameter-identification problems, and boundary integral forms require a known fundamental solution. We propose PG-KINN, a physics-informed KAN built on a Petrov-Galerkin formulation in which the trial space is a KAN and the test space is an independent, compactly supported, piecewise-polynomial space evaluated with Gauss-Legendre quadrature. Integration by parts lowers the differentiation order while retaining applicability to general non-self-adjoint, nonlinear, and inverse problems; the localized test functions turn the global residual into a set of element-wise weak residuals with favorable conditioning. On a suite of benchmarks spanning crack singularities, stress concentration, Neo-Hookean hyperelasticity, inverse parameter identification in heterogeneous media, and complex geometries, PG-KINN consistently outperforms legacy MLP baselines and state-of-the-art KAN-based strong/energy/inverse formulations (PIKAN). These results position the Petrov-Galerkin coupling of KAN trial spaces and polynomial test spaces as a robust and accurate route for AI-based computational mechanics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PG-KINN，一种基于Petrov-Galerkin格式的物理信息Kolmogorov-Arnold网络，用于求解正向和逆向偏微分方程。通过将试验空间设为KAN、测试空间设为独立紧支撑分段多项式空间，并采用高斯-勒让德求积，该方法降低了微分阶数，适用于一般非自伴、非线性和逆向问题。在包含裂纹奇异性、应力集中、Neo-Hookean超弹性、异质介质逆参数识别等基准测试上，PG-KINN持续优于传统MLP基线和现有KAN基强形式/能量形式/逆形式方法。
Motivation: 现有物理信息学习PDE的方法主要依赖MLP，其频谱偏差和密集参数化限制了精度和可解释性。KAN通过可学习样条激活缓解了这些限制，但PDE损失函数的形式选择与近似器选择同样关键：强形式残差最小化需要高阶导数和重加权损失，能量形式局限于自伴算子且对参数识别问题退化为平凡解，边界积分形式需要已知基本解。
Method: 提出Petrov-Galerkin格式的物理信息KAN (PG-KINN)，其中试验空间为KAN，测试空间为独立紧支撑分段多项式空间，通过高斯-勒让德求积评估。分部积分降低了微分阶数，局域化测试函数将全局残差转化为一组条件良好的单元弱残差。
Result: 在裂纹奇异性、应力集中、Neo-Hookean超弹性、异质介质逆参数识别和复杂几何等基准测试上，PG-KINN持续优于传统MLP基线和现有KAN基强形式/能量形式/逆形式方法 (PIKAN)。
Conclusion: Petrov-Galerkin耦合KAN试验空间与多项式测试空间为基于AI的计算力学提供了一条鲁棒且准确的途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Statevector-Referenced Geometry Survival of a Four-Qubit ZZ Quantum Kernel on IBM Quantum Hardware: A Fixed-Subset Diagnostic Across Three Execution Configurations
papers.abstract_en: Quantum-kernel methods encode a dataset's geometry in a Gram matrix, so learning claims on hardware kernels assume the intended geometry survives execution. We measure that survival for one frozen four-qubit ZZ feature-map kernel on $N=24$ real indoor air-quality windows, reconstructed on ibm_fez (1024 shots per circuit) under baseline, dynamical decoupling alone, and gate twirling alone, each a single non-interleaved job. Every configuration returned a complete, finite, positive-semidefinite Gram matrix and preserved the centered statevector geometry to a substantial but incomplete descriptive degree (full-matrix centered kernel alignment, CKA, 0.933-0.989). Gate twirling was most faithful on every reported geometry axis, with the only jackknife-resolved improvement over baseline (persisted Spearman, mean absolute error, and full-matrix CKA diagnostics); dynamical decoupling alone was not separated from baseline at the frozen-window scale. Residual hardware distortion, not finite sampling, dominates the discrepancy. Yet fidelity and label alignment were reversed: the most faithful configuration had the lowest centered kernel-target alignment, which sits at or below label-permutation references for statevector and hardware alike. We read the small hardware uplift as a normalization property of the non-affine distortion, not captured signal. These are descriptive results for single jobs on one backend, not causal mitigation-efficacy estimates; no quantum-advantage, hardware-classifier-superiority, or forecasting claim is made. Implementation fidelity and task relevance are distinct axes; hardware quantum machine-learning studies should report both.

TL;DR: 本文在IBM量子硬件ibm_fez上，针对一个固定的四量子比特ZZ特征映射核，测量了状态向量几何在执行过程中的保持程度。在基线、动态解耦和门twirling三种配置下，每个配置都返回了完整的半正定Gram矩阵，中心核对齐(CKA)在0.933-0.989之间。门twirling在多个几何轴上最忠实，但标签订对(centered kernel-target alignment)却最低，硬件提升被归因于非仿射畸变的归一化性质，而非捕获的信号。实现保真度与任务相关性需分别报告。
Motivation: 量子核方法依赖于在硬件上执行核函数时数据几何（Gram矩阵）的保持，但硬件畸变可能破坏这一假设。现有研究缺乏对几何保持程度的定量诊断。
Method: 使用一个固定的四量子比特ZZ特征映射核，在24个室内空气质量数据窗口上，分别以基线、单独动态解耦和单独门twirling三种配置在ibm_fez上执行（每电路1024次采样），通过完整矩阵中心核对齐(CKA)、Spearman相关性等指标评估状态向量几何的保持。
Result: 每种配置均生成完整的半正定Gram矩阵，CKA在0.933-0.989之间；门twirling在所有几何轴上最忠实，且仅其通过jackknife检验优于基线；动态解耦与基线无显著差异。但最忠实配置的核-目标对齐最低，接近或低于标签排列参考值，硬件提升被解释为归一化产物。
Conclusion: 这些是单后端单次作业的描述性结果，不提供因果缓解估计，也不做量子优势或硬件分类器优越性声明。实现保真度与任务相关性是不同的维度，未来量子机器学习硬件研究应同时报告两者。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Online Variance Reduction for Domain Adaptation on Streaming Data
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies the problem of stochastic variance reduction (SVR) for the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) and correlation alignment (CORAL) loss functions. Although various offline SVR algorithms for these losses have been proposed, these are incompatible with online, distributed, or incremental learning settings. This paper presents Adaptive vaRiance Reduction via Online reWeighting (ARROW), the first online SVR algorithm for the MMD and CORAL for streamed data. The method maintains moving average references of the alignment statistics, and adaptively reweights incoming minibatches so that the minibatch and reference statistics are aligned. Further, we propose a relaxed reweighting scheme so that the ensuing weight-optimisation problem is tractable. In experiments and simulations, we show that ARROW performs competitively with offline algorithms in terms of runtime, degree of variance reduction achieved, and target domain accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ARROW算法，这是首个针对流数据上MMD和CORAL损失函数进行在线随机方差缩减的算法，通过维护对齐统计量的移动平均并自适应重加权小批次来对齐统计量。实验表明ARROW在运行时间、方差缩减程度和目标域精度上与离线算法相当。
Motivation: 现有的MMD和CORAL的方差缩减算法仅适用于离线场景，无法处理在线、分布式或增量学习设置，因此需要一种在线方差缩减方法以适应流式数据环境。
Method: ARROW算法维持对齐统计量的移动平均参考，并自适应地重加权输入的小批次，使小批次统计量与参考统计量对齐；同时引入松弛重加权方案使权重优化问题可解。
Result: 实验和模拟显示ARROW在运行时间、方差缩减程度以及目标域准确率方面与离线算法具有竞争力。
Conclusion: ARROW是首个在线SVR算法，适用于流数据下的MMD和CORAL，实验性能与离线方法相当，适合在线/流式领域自适应场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self Gradient Forcing: Native Long Video Extrapolation
papers.abstract_en: Recent autoregressive video diffusion methods are increasingly built upon Self Forcing, where the student is trained on histories produced by its own rollout rather than ground-truth video contexts. This reduces exposure bias, but the historical key-value cache is still used by future frames only as frozen rollout state. As a result, future losses cannot supervise how earlier generated latents should be written into more useful keys and values for later video-latent generation. We call this the historical context-gradient gap. We propose Self Gradient Forcing (SGF), a two-pass training strategy that restores this missing supervision signal without backpropagating through the full serial rollout. Pass 1 performs a no-gradient autoregressive rollout matching inference and, at a sampled denoising exit step, records both the self-generated context and the noisy latents fed to the model. Pass 2 performs parallel context-gradient reconstruction for the recorded exit step. The generated context is used as stop-gradient clean-latent input, while the model recomputes the context KV representations and future-to-context causal attention. Thus, SGF provides the missing memory-writing supervision within the native autoregressive training objective, using losses on future video latents to train the model to encode context into more effective causal memory. Across extensive long-horizon frame-wise and chunk-wise experiments under different initializations, SGF achieves stronger native long-video extrapolation than Self Forcing, especially in subject identity, background/layout consistency, and temporal stability. Remarkably, using only a 5-second training window, SGF can extrapolate to videos lasting several minutes. Code and models will be released to advance research on autoregressive video generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自回归视频扩散模型中的历史上下文-梯度鸿沟问题，提出Self Gradient Forcing (SGF)两遍训练策略。SGF在不经过完整串行rollout反向传播的情况下，通过第一遍无梯度自回归rollout和第二遍并行上下文梯度重建，让未来损失监督过去上下文的键值编码。实验表明，SGF在长视频外推中显著优于Self Forcing，尤其在主体一致性、背景/布局稳定性和时间稳定性上，仅用5秒训练窗口即可外推至数分钟视频。
Motivation: 现有Self Forcing方法中，历史KV缓存仅作为冻结的rollout状态用于未来帧，导致未来损失无法监督早期生成潜变量如何编码为更有用的键值，即存在历史上下文-梯度鸿沟。
Method: 提出两遍训练策略：Pass1执行无梯度自回归rollout，在采样的去噪退出步记录自生成上下文和输入噪声潜变量；Pass2对退出步执行并行上下文梯度重建，使用stop-gradient的干净潜变量输入，并重算上下文KV表示和未来到上下文的因果注意力，从而在原生自回归训练目标中提供缺失的记忆写入监督。
Result: 在多种初始化的长程帧级和块级实验中，SGF在主体身份、背景/布局一致性和时间稳定性上显著优于Self Forcing，仅用5秒训练窗口即可外推至数分钟视频。
Conclusion: SGF通过恢复缺失的上下文梯度信号，有效提升了自回归视频扩散模型的长视频外推能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Variance-reduced Domain Adaptation using Paired Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Correlation alignment and the maximum mean discrepancy are two widely used distribution-matching frameworks for unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA). However, high variance in these losses has been shown to undermine their effectiveness in minibatch optimisation settings. Furthermore, the losses lack finite-sum structure, which renders them incompatible with classical stochastic variance reduction (SVR) methods. This paper proposes Paired Sampling for Domain Adaptation (PSDA), a novel SVR technique tailored to such objectives. PSDA pairs observations both within and across domains, to form quadruplets that are always sampled together during training. The pairings are designed to minimise expected gradient variance, and reduce to solving a set of linear assignment problems. Our simulations demonstrate reduced variance compared to related methods, and experiments on three domain shift datasets show improved target domain accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对无监督域适应中分布匹配损失（如相关对齐和最大均值差异）的方差缩减技术PSDA。该方法通过跨域配对观测形成四元组，以最小化期望梯度方差，并求解一系列线性分配问题。模拟和实验表明PSDA降低了梯度方差并提升了目标域精度。
Motivation: 无监督域适应中常用的分布匹配损失（如相关对齐和MMD）在小批量优化时方差高，且缺乏有限和结构，无法直接应用经典随机方差缩减方法。
Method: 提出配对采样域适应（PSDA），通过域内和跨域配对观测形成始终一起采样的四元组，配对策略旨在最小化期望梯度方差，归结为求解线性分配问题。
Result: 模拟显示相比相关方法方差降低；在三个域偏移数据集上实验表明目标域精度提升。
Conclusion: PSDA提供了一种适配非有限和损失的方差缩减框架，有效改善无监督域适应的优化稳定性与精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Look Less, Think Faster: Joint Token-Compute Adaptation for Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have recently demonstrated strong performance across vision-language tasks. However, their high inference cost, arising from both the large number of input visual tokens and the heavy computation of the large language model (LLM), remains a key barrier to practical deployment. Recent work attempts to reduce the cost by adaptively optimizing individual dimensions, e.g., pruning redundant visual tokens or skipping LLM layers and heads. Nonetheless, prior approaches typically treat these dimensions independently and overlook a fundamental coupling: the available compute resources must be dynamically allocated across all dimensions based on the input content. To bridge the gap, we propose SmartVL, a unified adaptive inference framework that jointly controls vision token number and model compute capability in response to varying input contents and compute budgets. SmartVL introduces a vision-side token controller that dynamically selects informative visual tokens and an LLM-side compute controller that adaptively adjusts LLM computation. Importantly, these controllers are trained to coordinate with each other so that the overall inference cost satisfies a target budget. To allow this joint scheduling, we connect the controllers using a shared budget encoding and leverage a differentiable latency estimator for end-to-end training. This design enables SmartVL to learn cross-stage allocation strategies that adapt to both input complexity and runtime compute constraints. Experiments across multiple MLLM benchmarks demonstrate that, with joint scheduling, SmartVL consistently outperforms prior adaptive methods and achieves superior accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontiers. Project page: https://www.schaterji.io/publications/2026/jointtokencompute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SmartVL，一种联合控制视觉token数量和LLM计算量的自适应推理框架，用于降低多模态大语言模型的推理成本。通过共享预算编码和可微延迟估计器进行端到端训练，实现跨阶段动态资源分配。实验表明，在多个MLLM基准上，SmartVL相比先前自适应方法取得了更好的准确率-效率帕累托前沿。
Motivation: 现有方法独立优化视觉token或LLM层/头，忽视了计算资源需要在所有维度上动态分配的耦合性，导致推理成本优化受限。
Method: SmartVL包含视觉侧token控制器和LLM侧计算控制器，通过共享预算编码和可微延迟估计器进行联合训练，学习根据输入内容和计算预算动态调整token数量与LLM计算量的策略。
Result: 在多个MLLM基准上，SmartVL一致优于先前的自适应方法，实现了更优的准确率-效率帕累托前沿。
Conclusion: 联合调度视觉token和LLM计算量能够有效适应输入复杂性和运行时约束，提升推理效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Test-Time Training for Modality Order Consistency in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We find that vision-language models are sensitive to a specific semantically irrelevant change: the order in which the image and question are presented. Across three models and three benchmarks, image first prompting consistently outperforms question-first prompting, revealing a repeatable modality order failure. We use this gap to design an order-consistent test-time training method. Our method substantially closes the modality-order gap across all evaluated settings. Surprisingly, it also yields consistent improvements in the stronger image-first branch over the baseline, hence bootstrapping both orderings toward mutual consistency. Activation patching localizes the ordering failure to a narrow mid-network region where representations diverge sharply between prompt orders. We find that the test-time training method repairs this misalignment across layers. Together, our results identify modality-order sensitivity as a circuit-level failure in VLMs and demonstrate that simple, asymmetric test-time adaptation can effectively mitigate it and even improve performance over the baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现视觉-语言模型对图像和问题的输入顺序敏感，图像先出现始终优于问题先出现，产生模态顺序失败。作者提出一种顺序一致的测试时训练方法，显著缩小了模态顺序差距，并在更强的图像优先分支上进一步提升性能。通过激活补丁定位到中层网络表示的分歧，测试时训练修复了这种错位。
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型在输入模态顺序上存在非语义的敏感性，这会影响模型的鲁棒性和性能，需要理解和修正这一缺陷。
Method: 提出一种测试时训练 (test-time training) 方法，通过最小化两种顺序分支的输出差异来提升模态顺序一致性，并在推理阶段对模型进行自适应调整。
Result: 在三个模型和三个基准上，该方法显著缩小了模态顺序性能差距，并在图像优先分支上获得持续改进，激活补丁定位表明问题源于中层网络表示分歧。
Conclusion: 模态顺序敏感性是视觉-语言模型电路级故障，简单的非对称测试时自适应可以有效缓解并提升基线性能。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: 视觉-语言模型在输入模态顺序上存在非语义的敏感性，这会影响模型的鲁棒性和性能，需要理解和修正这一缺陷。
summary_sections.method: 提出一种测试时训练 (test-time training) 方法，通过最小化两种顺序分支的输出差异来提升模态顺序一致性，并在推理阶段对模型进行自适应调整。
summary_sections.result: 在三个模型和三个基准上，该方法显著缩小了模态顺序性能差距，并在图像优先分支上获得持续改进，激活补丁定位表明问题源于中层网络表示分歧。
summary_sections.conclusion: 模态顺序敏感性是视觉-语言模型电路级故障，简单的非对称测试时自适应可以有效缓解并提升基线性能。

papers.title: Generative AI floods and dilutes the market for books
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI can produce book-length works of fiction at near-zero cost. These books are often dismissed as low-quality ``slop'' that buyers will ignore, and are assumed to carry little commercial weight. We test that assumption with full-text AI detection across 14,419 self-published genre-fiction books sold on Amazon from 2023 to 2026, matched to daily sales records through June 2026. None of these books disclose whether or not they contain AI-produced content. We find that books for which we detected substantial AI text ($>$ 25\%) make up a large share of the catalog but a smaller share of sales. Even so, they reach commercial scale, winning a growing share of sales over time and taking more of the scarce top-rank positions once held by books with no detected AI text. Over this period, the number of books with observed sales in a quarter grew 19.2-fold, while quarterly revenue grew only 8.9-fold. The market therefore added selling books faster than it added revenue, and revenue per selling book fell across most genres. Books with no AI text lose the most ground in genres with high AI diffusion, and most of all where Kindle Unlimited availability is high. Among top-selling books, those with substantial AI text draw on more distinctive language from existing books than do books with no AI text; for these books overlap rises with revenue, a gradient we do not detect for books with no AI text. Generative AI can thus reshape a creative market through scale rather than quality. Our results bear directly on the market-effect question at the center of the fair use defense to copyright infringement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过检测2013-2026年Amazon上14419本自出版类型小说中的AI生成内容，发现大量含有AI文本的图书虽然销售份额较小，但数量占比大，且逐渐占据更多畅销排名。市场销售量增长远快于收入增长，导致每本书平均收入下降。无AI文本的图书在高AI扩散类型中损失最大。这表明生成式AI通过规模而非质量重塑创意市场，对版权合理使用抗辩的市场影响问题具有直接意义。
Motivation: 先前认为AI生成的书籍（'slop'）会被买家忽视，没有商业影响力。本文检验这一假设。
Method: 对Amazon上2013-2026年14419本自出版类型小说进行全文本AI检测，匹配每日销售记录，比较含有大量AI文本（>25%）与无AI文本的图书的销售表现。
Result: AI文本图书占目录很大比例但销售额较小；然而它们随时间获得越来越多的销售份额，占据更多稀缺的畅销排名。市场图书数量增长19.2倍，而收入仅增长8.9倍，导致每本书平均收入下降。无AI文本图书在高AI扩散类型中损失最大，尤其在Kindle Unlimited可用性高的类型中。畅销书中，AI文本图书从现有图书中借用更多独特语言。
Conclusion: 生成式AI可以通过规模而非质量重塑创意市场，这对版权合理使用抗辩的市场影响问题具有直接意义。

papers.title: Closing the Lab-to-Store Gap: A Data-Efficient Post-Training and Experience-Driven Learning VLA Framework for Retail Humanoids
papers.abstract_en: Closing the gap between benchmark performance and reliable real-world operation remains a central challenge for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) humanoid robots, which must handle execution errors, distribution shifts, and environmental variability. This paper presents DEED (Data-Efficient Post-Training and Experience-Driven Learning), a systems-level approach evaluated on a supermarket chip-restocking task using a Unitree G1-Edu humanoid robot and the GR00T N1.6 foundation model. DEED comprises three key components: (1) a data-efficient post-training pipeline with control-frequency alignment, data curation, task-relevant visual highlighting, and reduced VLA dependence; (2) a real-world study of experience-driven refinement, adapted from RECAP via a text-based advantage prefix and a vision-language value function; and (3) a latent-space analysis tool for studying in- and out-of-distribution behavior. Our results suggest that bridging the lab-to-store gap is primarily a systems integration challenge rather than an architectural one: careful data design and targeted post-training can transform a policy that fails under naive fine-tuning into a competent real-world system using only a single GPU.
papers.comment: 8 pages. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DEED框架，旨在缩小VLA人形机器人在实验室与真实零售环境之间的性能差距。在超市芯片补货任务上验证，包括数据高效的后训练流程、经验驱动的改进（基于RECAP的文本优势前缀和视觉语言价值函数）以及潜在空间分析工具。结果显示，通过精心数据设计和后训练，仅用单GPU即可将策略从失败改进为可靠。
Motivation: 实验室基准与真实世界操作之间存在差距，人形机器人需要应对执行错误、分布偏移和环境变化。
Method: DEED框架包含三部分：控制频率对齐的数据高效后训练流程、基于RECAP的经验驱动改进（文本优势前缀和视觉语言价值函数）、以及潜在空间分析工具。
Result: 在超市芯片补货任务上，DEED使策略从失败改进为可靠，仅需单GPU后训练。
Conclusion: 缩小实验室到商店的差距主要是系统集成挑战而非架构挑战，数据设计和后训练是关键。

papers.title: Interval and fuzzy physics-augmented neural networks (iPANN and fPANN) for uncertainty quantification and propagation in constitutive modeling
papers.abstract_en: Constitutive modeling under uncertainty remains a central challenge for reliable mechanics simulations, particularly when the available stress-deformation data are sparse, noisy, or heterogeneous. We propose interval and fuzzy physics-augmented neural networks (iPANNs and fPANNs) for uncertainty-aware hyperelastic constitutive modeling. iPANNs learn sparse lower, mean, and upper free energy density branches whose stresses, obtained by automatic differentiation, ultimately enclose noisy stress observations. In contrast to this deterministic interval description, fPANNs embed the learned iPANN branches into a fuzzy-set representation through alpha-cut interpolation, yielding a nested family of admissible responses. iPANNs and fPANNs encode mechanistic constraints - preserving objectivity, consistency and promoting polyconvexity - and smoothed L0 regularization promotes interpretable energy representations. The bound models are trained through a two-stage transfer-learning procedure in which a sparse mean constitutive response is learned first and then fine-tuned into lower and upper energy branches. We evaluate the framework on synthetic isotropic hyperelastic data with heteroscedastic noise, varying random realizations, shifted noise means, and varying noise magnitudes. The results show that the learned bounds enclose noisy stress observations while generalizing to the test set. Further, we examine the propagation of uncertainty through the mean, upper and lower bound predictions of the learned iPANN models in a finite element setting. The proposed framework provides a compact, physics-consistent route for distribution-free aleatoric uncertainty quantification in hyperelastic constitutive modeling, and propagation in downstream finite element simulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出区间物理增强神经网络 (iPANN) 和模糊物理增强神经网络 (fPANN)，用于超弹性本构建模中的不确定性量化与传播。iPANN 学习稀疏的下界、均值和上界自由能密度分支，通过自动微分获得应力，从而包围带噪声的应力观测；fPANN 通过 α-截集插值将学习到的分支嵌入模糊集表示。两种模型都编码力学约束（客观性、一致性、多凸性），并采用平滑 L0 正则化促进可解释的能量表示。在合成各向同性超弹性数据上的实验表明，学习到的边界能够包围带噪声的应力观测并泛化到测试集；进一步在有限元设置中展示了不确定性传播。该方法为超弹性本构建模中无分布假设的 aleatoric 不确定性量化提供了一个紧凑、物理一致的路。
Motivation: 传统本构建模在数据稀疏、存在噪声或异质性时难以可靠量化不确定性，亟需一种能够同时处理不确定性并保持物理一致性的方法。
Method: 提出 iPANN 和 fPANN：iPANN 通过两阶段迁移学习先训练稀疏均值响应，再微调得到下界和上界能量分支；fPANN 利用 α-截集插值将区间描述扩展为模糊集。两种模型均嵌入客观性、一致性和多凸性约束，并使用平滑 L0 正则化实现稀疏可解释表示。
Result: 在含异方差噪声的合成各向同性超弹性数据上，学习到的边界有效包围噪声观测并泛化至测试集；有限元模拟验证了不确定性传播的效果。
Conclusion: 提出了一种紧凑、物理一致的无分布 aleatoric 不确定性量化方法，适用于超弹性本构建模及下游有限元模拟中的不确定性传播。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Understanding Generative AI-mediated User Engagement with Academic Library Resources
papers.abstract_en: This study empirically analyzed generative AI as an emerging discovery pathway to academic library resources. Utilizing web analytics from August 2023 to October 2025, the research identifies a significant increase in AI-mediated traffic, particularly following the integration of linked citation features. Referral analysis identified ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini as the primary platforms driving this traffic. A substantial portion of users reached the institutional repository, primarily accessing electronic theses and dissertations. This pattern suggests that AI retrieval mechanisms effectively surface resources with structured metadata and stable permalinks that are Open Access and freely available. The results illustrate how AI ecosystems currently expose library resources and underscore the need for continued analysis and a strategic response to the evolving AI landscape.
papers.comment: This is the accepted manuscript. The final published version will appear in College & Research Libraries, May 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该研究通过2023年8月至2025年10月的网络分析，实证分析了生成式AI作为学术图书馆资源发现新路径的作用。研究发现AI引用的流量显著增加，主要来自ChatGPT、Perplexity和Gemini，用户大量访问机构库中的电子学位论文，表明AI检索机制能有效暴露具有结构化元数据和稳定永久链接的开放获取资源。
Motivation: 随着生成式AI成为信息检索入口，学术图书馆需要了解其如何影响用户对馆藏资源的发现与访问，但目前缺乏实证分析。
Method: 利用机构网络分析数据，追踪从AI平台（如ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini）到图书馆资源的引用流量，并分析用户行为模式。
Result: AI引用流量显著增长，尤其在集成链接引用功能后；ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini为主要流量来源；多数用户到达机构库并访问电子学位论文。
Conclusion: 生成式AI能有效暴露具有良好元数据和开放获取的馆藏资源，图书馆需持续监测并制定战略应对AI发展。

papers.title: Toward Reliable RGB-D Semantic Segmentation: Handling Missing Modalities via Condition Dropout
papers.abstract_en: RGB-D semantic segmentation has achieved remarkable progress, yet most models assume that RGB and depth are always available. In practice, failures or occlusions of surveillance sensors often remove one modality. Although RGB or depth alone can contain sufficient cues, models trained only on full-modality inputs fail to exploit the remaining modality once one is missing, causing severe degradation. We tackle this issue with a simple continued-training paradigm, \emph{Condition Dropout (ConD)}, which mitigates degradation while preserving full-modality accuracy. Starting from a pretrained RGB-D model, ConD adds a second stage that randomly simulates complete, RGB-missing, and depth-missing inputs, freezes the original encoders, and trains copied encoders with zero-initialized feature injection. Experiments on NYU-Depth V2 and SUN RGB-D show that ConD improves robustness under missing modalities and even yields slight gains when modalities are complete. Our code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出条件丢弃（Condition Dropout, ConD）方法，解决RGB-D语义分割中传感器故障导致模态缺失（RGB或深度缺失）时的性能退化问题。该方法在预训练的RGB-D模型基础上，通过第二阶段的连续训练，随机模拟完整、RGB缺失和深度缺失输入，冻结原始编码器并训练带有零初始化特征注入的复制编码器。在NYU-Depth V2和SUN RGB-D数据集上的实验表明，ConD提升了缺失模态下的鲁棒性，并在完整模态下略有增益。
Motivation: 现有RGB-D语义分割模型假设RGB和深度模态始终可用，但实际中传感器故障或遮挡常导致单模态缺失，而仅依赖全模态训练的模型无法利用剩余模态信息，性能严重下降。
Method: 提出条件丢弃（ConD）的连续训练范式：在预训练的RGB-D模型上添加第二阶段训练，随机模拟完整、RGB缺失和深度缺失三种输入，冻结原始编码器，训练复制编码器并采用零初始化特征注入。
Result: 在NYU-Depth V2和SUN RGB-D数据集上，ConD提升了缺失模态下的分割鲁棒性，且在完整模态下也略有性能提升。
Conclusion: ConD是一种简单有效的连续训练方法，能缓解RGB-D语义分割中模态缺失导致的退化，同时保持完整模态精度。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在NYU-Depth V2和SUN RGB-D数据集上，ConD提升了缺失模态下的分割鲁棒性，且在完整模态下也略有性能提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: ConD是一种简单有效的连续训练方法，能缓解RGB-D语义分割中模态缺失导致的退化，同时保持完整模态精度。

papers.title: Multi-modal transformer for signal classification in nanopore blockade experiments
papers.abstract_en: Nanopore devices have emerged as powerful tools for single-molecule sensing, with potential for rapid, portable diagnostics. They detect changes in ionic current as analytes enter nanometer-scale pores, providing a means of identifying diverse biomarkers from their characteristic signal patterns. However, these signals are highly complex, and reliably assigning them to specific molecules remains a major challenge. Here, we address this by introducing a multi-modal deep learning architecture that jointly processes multiple signal representations, including raw time-series data, wavelet-based images, and static feature vectors. Our approach surpasses existing methods by more than 10 percentage points on a 42-peptide benchmark and transfers to a 20-amino-acid dataset with near-perfect accuracy. The model integrates complementary information from these representations, with attention analysis showing that the time-series and wavelet-image inputs emphasize different features of the same event. Together, these results demonstrate the potential of machine learning to enable robust, high-accuracy molecular identification with nanopore sensors.

papers.title: Label-Free Finite-Volume-Residual Training of Attention Graph Neural Networks for Coupled Thermo-Fluid Fields
papers.abstract_en: Neural surrogates are widely used in scientific machine learning for fast prediction of three-dimensional (3D) thermo-fluid fields. However, generating training data using conventional numerical solvers often incurs substantial computational and storage costs. We propose to train an attention graph neural network by minimizing the finite-volume method (FVM) residuals of the governing equations. These residuals are evaluated directly on the mesh, requiring no labeled data. We evaluate the trained surrogates against computational fluid dynamics (CFD) references and a data-supervised baseline across four scenarios. On the two steady-state benchmarks, the FVM-loss model achieves an all-field normalized root-mean-square error (nRMSE) of 2.3-2.8%. It demonstrates close agreement with the CFD references, including the buoyancy-energy coupling. On the two parametric transient cases, the FVM-loss model outperforms the supervised baseline in terms of accuracy, while avoiding the data-generation cost entirely. These results indicate that the FVM loss can provide a practical training signal for neural surrogates and reduce the model development cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无标签训练方法，通过最小化有限体积法（FVM）残差来训练注意力图神经网络，用于三维热流体场预测。在稳态和参数瞬态场景中，该方法与CFD参考结果吻合良好，且避免了数据生成成本。
Motivation: 传统数值求解器生成训练数据需要大量计算和存储成本，本文旨在通过无监督残差训练降低神经代理模型的开发成本。
Method: 将注意力图神经网络与有限体积法残差相结合，直接在网格上评估控制方程的FVM残差作为损失函数，无需标记数据。
Result: 在稳态基准上实现全场归一化均方根误差（nRMSE）2.3-2.8%；在参数瞬态情况下，精度超过有监督基线，并完全避免了数据生成成本。
Conclusion: FVM损失可为神经代理模型提供实用的训练信号，降低模型开发成本。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Decentralized Online Riemannian Optimization for Strongly Geodesically Convex Functions
papers.abstract_en: We study decentralized online optimization for strongly geodesically convex (strongly g-convex) losses on Riemannian manifolds with bounded sectional curvature, including positively curved manifolds. In centralized Riemannian optimization, strong g-convexity tightens the optimal regret from $O(\sqrt{T})$ to $O(\log T)$, where $T$ is the time horizon; in the decentralized Riemannian setting, however, existing methods address only g-convex losses, leaving the strongly g-convex regime unexplored. One challenge is that the required decaying step size in the centralized regime is incompatible with existing network-error analyses, which typically assume a fixed step size. First, we provide a general network-error analysis for time-varying schedules. Next, we build on this analysis to establish the first $O(\log T)$ static regret bound for decentralized online Riemannian gradient descent, matching the minimax-optimal rate for strongly-convex Euclidean online optimization. Finally, we prove the same $O(\log T)$ regret bound for the two-point bandit feedback setting using novel strong subconvexity arguments for the smoothed versions of the loss functions.

papers.title: Adaptive deep nonparametric regression from dependent data under covariate shift
papers.abstract_en: Covariate shift often occurs because, in many real applications, the source and the target observations may be generated from different distributions. In this case, the standard metric under the source distribution is not appropriate. This paper considers deep neural network estimators for nonparametric quantile and Huber regression under covariate shift and from dependent observations. We deal with a generalized Bernstein-type inequality that is satisfied by many classical models, including i.i.d. observations, $φ$-mixing, strong mixing, and $\mathcal{C}$-mixing processes. To perform the covariate shift phenomenon, we propose a sparse-penalized deep neural network (SPDNN) estimator that takes into account the discrepancy between the source and target distributions of the data. When the density ratio (between the source and target distributions of the covariate) is unknown, a two steps pre-training procedure is carried out: the first step is devoted to the construction of a least squares SPDNN estimator of the density ratio; which is used in the second step to perform a pre-training reweighted SPDNN estimator of the regression function. For both the quantile and the Huber regression, non-asymptotic error bounds of the proposed SPDNN estimators are established in the class of Hölder smooth functions. These estimators can adaptively attain (up to a logarithmic factor) the minimax optimal convergence rate from i.i.d. data as well as from several classical time series models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究协变量偏移下依赖观测数据的深度非参数回归问题，提出稀疏惩罚深度神经网络（SPDNN）估计器用于分位数回归和Huber回归。在密度比未知时采用两阶段预训练：先用最小二乘SPDNN估计密度比，再用重加权SPDNN估计回归函数。建立了非渐近误差界，表明该方法在Holder光滑函数类中自适应达到极小化最优收敛率。
Motivation: 实际应用中源分布与目标分布往往不同，标准度量不适用；现有方法对依赖数据和协变量偏移同时处理的研究不足。
Method: 提出稀疏惩罚深度神经网络（SPDNN）估计器，利用广义Bernstein型不等式处理依赖数据；当密度比未知时，通过两阶段预训练分别估计密度比和回归函数。
Result: 对于分位数回归和Huber回归，建立了非渐近误差界，证明该方法在i.i.d.数据及多种经典时间序列模型下可自适应达到（至多对数因子）极小化最优收敛率。
Conclusion: 该方法能有效处理协变量偏移下的依赖数据，并在理论上达到最优收敛速度。

papers.title: Classical Hardware Acceleration of Quantum Autoencoders for Real-Time Anomaly Detection in Collider Experiments
papers.abstract_en: Quantum machine learning (QML) algorithms in high energy physics (HEP) can efficiently represent and leverage long-range, high-order correlations in high-dimensional collider data, potentially with fewer parameters and favorable scaling relative to classical models. Deployment of QML in real-time collider applications such as trigger systems requires the ability to emulate and compile quantum circuits classically, then synthesize the resulting quantum gates onto low-latency hardware accelerators, namely field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs). We present a study of variational quantum autoencoder models for real-time anomaly detection triggers in modern collider experiments. The models achieve performance comparable to state-of-the-art classical approaches and, after FPGA synthesis, satisfy resource usage and timing constraints consistent with trigger applications in future colliders. This work provides one of the first FPGA implementations of QML models for HEP triggers, enabling higher-capability models in today's classical data acquisition pipelines while advancing quantum readiness of collider experiment infrastructure.

TL;DR: 本文研究了用于现代对撞机实验中实时异常检测触发器的变分量子自编码器（variational quantum autoencoder）模型。该模型在FPGA上实现，性能与最先进的经典方法相当，且满足未来对撞机触发应用的资源使用和时序约束。这是高能物理触发器中量子机器学习模型的早期FPGA实现之一。
Motivation: 量子机器学习在高能物理中能高效表示高维数据的长期高阶相关性，但实时应用需要经典仿真和低延迟硬件加速。
Method: 采用变分量子自编码器模型，通过经典仿真编译量子电路，并在FPGA上合成量子门以实现低延迟加速。
Result: 模型性能与经典方法相当，FPGA综合后满足未来对撞机触发应用的资源与时序要求。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了首个用于高能物理触发器的QML模型FPGA实现，在经典数据采集管道中引入更强模型的同时提升了量子就绪性。

papers.title: The Blessing of Dimensionality: How Near-Orthogonality in High-Dimensional Spaces Explains Temporal Portability
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning has been widely used to adapt large language models (LLMs) for domain-specific tasks. Parameter efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods such as low-rank adaptation (LoRA) are frequently used to reduce computational costs. PortLLM is a training-free and data-free scheme used to adapt LLMs after continual pretraining. Although the initial PortLLM results show that LoRA patches exhibit short-term temporal portability, the long-term performance of PortLLM across several updates of continual pretraining remains underexplored. Furthermore, the intriguing effectiveness of PortLLM is not well understood from a theoretical standpoint. We address these two open questions by (1) performing an extensive empirical study of the long-term temporal portability of PortLLM patches across 10 continual pretraining steps using base models Mistral, Gemma, and Qwen; and (2) offering two theoretical analyses to explain our observation that the simple PortLLM method achieves competitive performance. We find empirically that the portability persists across longer time duration, indicating that repeated fine-tuning is not required when the base model is periodically updated. We find theoretically that near-orthogonality of high-dimensional vectors is a key justification for temporal portability. Our analyses also demonstrate a geometric perspective of the loss landscape in facilitating the theoretical comparison of different adaptation options.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了PortLLM方法在持续预训练中的长期可移植性，并通过理论和实验证明高维向量的近正交性是其有效性的关键原因。
Motivation: 现有PortLLM方法虽展现出短期可移植性，但其长期性能及理论解释尚不明确。
Method: 在Mistral、Gemma和Qwen等基模型上进行10步持续预训练实验，并利用高维空间近正交性理论分析PortLLM的有效性。
Result: 实验表明PortLLM的补丁在长时间跨度内仍保持可移植性，无需重复微调；理论分析揭示高维向量近正交性是关键原因。
Conclusion: PortLLM的长期可移植性得以验证，高维几何特性为后续适应方案提供了理论比较视角。

papers.title: Don't Trust the Label: License Laundering in AI Supply Chains
papers.abstract_en: AI artifacts move through a multi-platform supply chain, spanning datasets and models on Hugging Face and applications on GitHub. While each artifact carries a license whose obligations should propagate through redistribution, no study has yet measured whether those obligations survive the chain or are stripped and replaced as artifacts move downstream. We trace 232,270 dataset$\rightarrow$model$\rightarrow$application chains and quantify two forms of license laundering: when artifacts with no declared license acquire definitive labels downstream, and when one declared license category replaces another during redistribution. We find that 62.3% of chains pass through at least one artifact with no declared license (concentrated in a small set of foundational datasets), and that every obligation-bearing license category falls below 7% end-to-end survival while the Permissive category reaches 95.1%. Based on these findings, we provide actionable recommendations for practitioners, model publishers, rights holders, and platform owners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文追踪了Hugging Face和GitHub上232,270条数据集→模型→应用链，量化了许可证洗钱的两种形式：无许可证工件在下游获得标签，以及许可证类别在再分发中被替换。发现62.3%的链经过至少一个无许可证工件，且所有义务性许可证类别的端到端存活率低于7%，而宽松类别存活率达95.1%。最后提出了针对从业者、模型发布者、权利所有者和平台所有者的建议。
Motivation: 尽管AI供应链中的每个工件都带有许可证，但尚不清楚这些许可证义务在跨平台再分发中是否得到保留，还是被剥离或替换，目前缺乏端到端测量的研究。
Method: 通过收集Hugging Face和GitHub上的数据，构建数据集→模型→应用链，定义两种许可证洗钱类型，并统计每条链上许可证的保留与变化情况。
Result: 62.3%的链包含至少一个无许可证工件（集中在少数基础数据集）；每个义务性许可证类别（如Copyleft、Weak Copyleft等）的端到端存活率均低于7%，而Permissive类别存活率达95.1%。
Conclusion: 研究发现许可证义务在AI供应链中大量流失，呼吁各方采取行动，并给出了具体可操作的建议。

summary_sections.result: 62.3%的链包含至少一个无许可证工件（集中在少数基础数据集）；每个义务性许可证类别（如Copyleft、Weak Copyleft等）的端到端存活率均低于7%，而Permissive类别存活率达95.1%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 研究发现许可证义务在AI供应链中大量流失，呼吁各方采取行动，并给出了具体可操作的建议。

papers.title: Evolving Cache Schedules for Fast Diffusion Policy Inference
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion policies achieve strong visuomotor control by iteratively denoising action chunks, but repeated denoising makes real-time deployment computationally demanding. Cache-based methods reduce inference cost by reusing intermediate activations, but existing training-free schedules typically allocate computation uniformly across blocks, ignoring heterogeneous redundancy across blocks and leading to a suboptimal performance-efficiency trade-off. To bridge this gap, we introduce Evolving Cache Schedules (EVO), a training-free acceleration framework that globally schedules cache refreshes via evolutionary search. EVO represents each candidate as a complete schedule over the block-timestep lattice. Thus, redundant transformer computations during iterative denoising can be skipped through cache reuse while preserving closed-loop rollout performance. To make the search practical, EVO introduces redundancy-aware initialization, which seeds the population with promising schedules, and target-conditioned early stopping, which verifies and terminates once a desired performance target is reached. The offline-optimized schedule can be directly plugged into pretrained diffusion policies without retraining. Extensive manipulation benchmarks show that EVO preserves near-full performance while substantially reducing computation, achieving up to 8.05x action-generation speedup and reducing FLOPs from 15.77G to as low as 1.96G. Source code is available at https://github.com/pillom/EVO.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, supplementary material included. Accepted by PRCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散策略（Diffusion Policies）推理中迭代去噪计算开销大的问题，提出 Evolving Cache Schedules (EVO) 框架，通过进化搜索全局调度缓存刷新，在无需重新训练的条件下显著加速推理。在多个操作基准上，EVO 保持接近完整推理性能的同时，实现了最高 8.05 倍的动作生成加速，并将 FLOPs 从 15.77G 降至 1.96G。
Motivation: 现有基于缓存的加速方法通常跨所有块均匀分配计算，忽略了不同块间的冗余异质性，导致性能-效率权衡次优。
Method: 提出训练无关的加速框架 EVO，通过进化搜索在块-时间步网格上全局调度缓存刷新，并结合冗余感知初始化和目标条件早停使搜索实用化。
Result: 在操作基准上，EVO 保持接近全性能，实现最高 8.05 倍动作生成加速，FLOPs 从 15.77G 降至 1.96G。
Conclusion: EVO 是一种训练无关的加速方法，可直接用于预训练扩散策略，无需重新训练，在计算效率和性能之间取得良好平衡。

papers.title: Diverse-Intent Multi-Turn Fashion Image Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Real-world fashion search involves interactive retrieval across multiple turns. However, existing multi-turn retrieval methods are built on a restrictive assumption that every interaction follows the same attribute-editing paradigm, leaving heterogeneous intent transitions unexplored. Moreover, existing approaches often rely on textification to bridge multimodal queries and visual retrieval, which may lose fine-grained visual cues. To address these gaps, we introduce DIM-Fashion, a benchmark of 26K multi-turn sessions constructed from 13 fashion retrieval datasets across 7 tasks, featuring diverse intent transitions and rollback behaviors. We further propose FashionAM, an MLLM-VLP framework that directly aligns multimodal conversational queries with a fashion-oriented gallery embedding space, avoiding intermediate textification. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of FashionAM over existing approaches. The dataset and code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有多轮时尚图像检索方法仅假设单一属性编辑交互、忽视多样化意图转换的问题，提出了一个包含26K多轮会话的基准数据集DIM-Fashion，并提出了FashionAM框架，该框架直接对齐多模态对话查询与时尚图像嵌入空间，无需中间文本化步骤。实验表明FashionAM优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有多轮检索方法假设每次交互都遵循相同的属性编辑范式，未考虑异构意图转换；且常依赖文本化桥接多模态查询与视觉检索，可能损失细粒度视觉线索。
Method: 构建DIM-Fashion基准数据集，包含26K多轮会话，覆盖7个任务中的13个时尚检索数据集，具有多样化意图转换和回滚行为。提出FashionAM框架，基于MLLM-VLP直接对齐多模态对话查询与时尚导向的图像嵌入空间，避免中间文本化。
Result: 在多个时尚检索任务上，FashionAM在性能上优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 所提基准和框架可有效处理多轮时尚图像检索中的多样化意图。数据集和代码将公开发布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Courteous Anticipation: Improving Long-Lived Task Planning in Persistent Shared Environments
papers.abstract_en: We consider a task planning scenario in which robots sharing a persistent environment are assigned tasks one at a time from a held-out sequence. Standard task planners, lacking foresight of future tasks and inconsiderate of others' constraints, solve each task in isolation, leaving terminal states that increase future cost for all, side effects that compound over lengthy task sequences. To reduce cost over the sequence, a robot must anticipate how its actions now may impact performance on future tasks for all robots sharing the environment. Therefore, we present courteous anticipatory planning, wherein a model-based planner proposes candidate plans and selects the one that jointly minimizes immediate cost and aggregated expected future cost across all robots, estimated via independent per-robot learned estimators. This factored formulation avoids combinatorial joint rollouts and supports modular deployment: adding a robot requires only training its own estimator. We evaluate in two persistent PDDL domains, a home environment with robots that have similar capabilities but different responsibilities, and a restaurant environment where robots' distinct capabilities create states that other robots lack the capability to resolve. During lengthy task sequences, our planner reduces total cost by 10.43% versus myopic and 4.03% versus selfish anticipatory planning in a two-robot home environment and by 17.41% and 13.24%, respectively, in a three-robot restaurant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种礼貌性前瞻规划（courteous anticipatory planning）方法，让机器人在持久共享环境中按序执行任务时，不仅考虑当前任务成本，还通过独立学习的每机器人预估器来估计对未来所有机器人任务总成本的期望影响，从而选择联合成本最小的计划。在持久PDDL域实验（两机器人家庭环境、三机器人餐厅环境）中，该方法相比短视规划和自私前瞻规划分别降低了总成本10.43%/4.03%和17.41%/13.24%。
Motivation: 标准任务规划器缺乏对未来任务的预见且不考虑其他机器人的约束，导致每个任务孤立求解的终止状态会累积增加后续所有机器人的成本，尤其在长时间任务序列中副作用会加剧。
Method: 提出基于模型的前瞻规划方法，其中规划器生成候选计划，并选择同时最小化即时成本与所有机器人未来期望成本（通过独立训练的每机器人学习估计器来聚合）的计划。这种分解式公式避免了组合联合展开，并支持模块化部署。
Result: 在持久的PDDL域中，两机器人家庭环境下总成本降低10.43%（vs短视）和4.03%（vs自私前瞻）；三机器人餐厅环境下降低17.41%和13.24%。
Conclusion: 作者认为这种礼貌性前瞻规划能够减少持久共享环境中长时间任务序列的总成本，并且分解方法易于扩展至多个机器人。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sound Probabilistic Safety Bounds for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel framework for computing rigorous bounds on the probability that a large language model (LLM) generates harmful output to a given prompt. We study a new application of the Clopper-Pearson confidence intervals to obtain probably approximately correct (PAC) bounds for this problem. As our main technical contribution, we propose an algorithm that leverages features in the latent space to prioritize exploring branches in the auto-regressive generation tree that are more likely to produce harmful outputs. Our approach in particular enables the efficient computation of useful lower bounds, even in scenarios where the true harm probability is extremely small, and crucially, the obtained lower bounds are sound, i.e., formally proven to be less than the actual harmfulness probability: our experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our method by computing non-trivial lower bounds on state-of-the-art LLMs. This study newly enables the evaluation and statistical certification of LLMs.
papers.comment: The Initial version of this manuscript has been available on OpenReview, see https://openreview.net/forum?id=papImkPLf5
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出计算大语言模型（LLM）生成有害输出概率的严格边界框架。利用Clopper-Pearson置信区间获得PAC边界，并通过在自回归生成树中优先探索潜在空间特征指示的高风险分支来高效计算下界，即使在真实有害概率极小时也能有效。实验表明该方法能在最先进LLM上计算出非平凡的下界，且下界被证明是合理的。
Motivation: 现有方法难以精确量化LLM生成有害输出的概率，尤其当概率极小时，缺乏形式化的概率保证。
Method: 使用Clopper-Pearson置信区间获取PAC边界，并结合潜在空间特征引导的树搜索优先探索高概率产生有害输出的分支，以高效计算下界。
Result: 在多个先进LLM上，该方法计算出非平凡的概率下界，且下界被形式化证明小于真实有害概率。
Conclusion: 该框架首次实现了LLM的统计评估和认证，为安全性提供了严格的概率保证。

papers.title: Multimodal Large Language Models for Remote Sensing Image Understanding: Domain-Specific or General-Purpose?
papers.abstract_en: The rapid development of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has introduced a flexible paradigm for remote sensing image scene understanding (RSISU), enabling natural-language interaction with remote sensing imagery. However, a systematic understanding of the capability boundaries, cross-task generalization, and task-specific limitations of existing remote sensing MLLMs (RS-MLLMs) is still lacking. This paper presents a systematic survey and diagnostic evaluation of MLLMs for RSISU. We review the technical evolution of RS-MLLMs, focusing on model design, multimodal learning, training data, and downstream capabilities. We further compare RS-MLLMs with general-purpose computer vision MLLMs (CV-MLLMs) across diverse RSISU tasks and benchmarks. RS-MLLMs remain competitive in domain-specific settings, particularly remote sensing visual grounding and high-resolution visual question answering. More notably, general-purpose CV-MLLMs can match or even outperform these specialized models on several RSISU tasks without remote sensing-specific fine-tuning. These findings demonstrate the strong transferability of general-purpose CV-MLLMs and show that current RS-MLLMs do not consistently outperform them across diverse RSISU tasks. Current MLLMs also face limitations in spatial and relational reasoning, fine-grained visual understanding, instruction diversity, and generalization across heterogeneous task formats. Based on these findings, we outline future directions toward reliable evaluation, multimodal and high-resolution reasoning, efficient deployment, and tool-augmented remote sensing agents. This survey provides a systematic reference for developing robust, generalizable, and practical MLLMs for RSISU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统综述了遥感多模态大语言模型（RS-MLLMs）的技术演进，并与通用计算机视觉MLLMs（CV-MLLMs）在多种遥感图像场景理解任务上进行了对比诊断。实验表明，通用MLLMs在多个任务上能匹配甚至超越专用模型，而当前模型在空间关系推理、高分辨率理解等方面存在局限。
Motivation: 现有遥感MLLMs的能力边界、跨任务泛化性和任务特异性限制缺乏系统性理解，亟需一份全面的基准评估来指导模型设计。
Method: 通过文献综述和跨任务基准测试，对比分析RS-MLLMs与通用CV-MLLMs在遥感图像场景理解任务上的表现，并总结模型设计、多模态学习、训练数据等方面的技术路线。
Result: 通用CV-MLLMs在大部分遥感任务上无需特定微调即可匹配或超越专用RS-MLLMs；专用模型仅在遥感视觉定位和高分辨率VQA等细分领域保持优势。此外，现有MLLMs在空间推理、细粒度理解和异构任务泛化上存在不足。
Conclusion: 未来应聚焦于可靠评估、多模态高分辨率推理、高效部署及工具增强的遥感智能体开发。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Interpretable Fuzzy Rule-Based Regression Extension for Ex-Fuzzy Library
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models achieve high predictive accuracy in regression tasks, but their deployment in safety-critical and regulated domains requires interpretability. While fuzzy rule-based systems offer transparent, linguistically explicit interpretable models, Mamdani-style fuzzy regression remains underrepresented in modern machine learning software libraries. This paper presents an interpretable regression extension for the Ex-Fuzzy library, enabling Mamdani fuzzy inference with scalar consequents learned directly from data. For this, a target-aware partition initialisation strategy based on Fuzzy C-Means clustering is introduced, in which linguistic variables are derived from an augmented input-output space to emphasise output-relevant regions of the feature space. The proposed extension is evaluated on ten regression datasets from the KEEL repository, comparing Gaussian and trapezoidal partition strategies against standard baselines including linear regression, multilayer perceptron, and random forests. Experimental results show that Gaussian partitions consistently outperform uniform trapezoidal partitions, achieving a mean coefficient of determination of approximately 0.86 while producing compact rule bases of 10-15 human-readable rules. The proposed implementation provides a transparent and competitive alternative to black-box regression models, supporting practical interpretability with competitive predictive performance.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE International Conference on Fuzzy Systems (FUZZ-IEEE), IEEE World Congress on Computational Intelligence (WCCI), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为Ex-Fuzzy库开发了一个可解释的模糊规则回归扩展，使用Mamdani模糊推理和从数据中学习的标量后件。通过模糊C均值聚类引入目标感知的划分初始化策略，在输入-输出空间中强调输出相关区域。在KEEL库的十个回归数据集上评估，与线性回归、多层感知机和随机森林对比，高斯划分策略平均决定系数约0.86，生成10-15条可读规则。
Motivation: 机器学习模型在回归任务中预测精度高，但在安全关键和受监管领域需要可解释性。Mamdani风格的模糊回归在现代机器学习软件库中代表性不足。
Method: 提出基于模糊C均值聚类的目标感知划分初始化策略，从输入-输出增强空间导出语言变量，实现Mamdani模糊推理的回归扩展。比较高斯和梯形划分策略。
Result: 在KEEL十个回归数据集上，高斯划分策略平均决定系数约0.86，优于均匀梯形划分，且规则库紧凑（10-15条规则）。

papers.title: Self-supervision drives representational convergence in medical foundation models more than clinical supervision
papers.abstract_en: Medical image encoders from different groups are increasingly treated as interchangeable, on the assumption that scale and clinical supervision concentrate their representations onto a shared structure. Whether this convergence is real, what produces it, and whether it is clinically usable are untested, and the similarity measures behind such claims are fragile. We present a controlled dissection across 18 image and 7 text encoders, all open-weight and run locally, spanning 7M to 27B parameters and five imaging modalities, including 650,982 chest radiographs from six datasets. To isolate cause, we train encoders that vary only the objective under fixed data, architecture, and scale, and reproduce the effect in a synthetic model. Convergence is modest but above a random floor, driven by the self-supervised objective, not clinical supervision: matched self-supervised encoders aligned most (40.4% on chest radiography), with label-supervised (21.1%) and image-text (3.3%) far lower, and did not grow with size (Spearman 0.302, p=0.223) or capability. It is within-modality, does not reach clinical language, and does not reproduce how radiologists judge case similarity. Yet a linear classifier transfers across encoders and to five held-out hospitals, retaining about 85% of within-encoder performance. Convergence in medical imaging is therefore set by the pretraining objective, not inherited from scale or clinical supervision. Interoperability is accordingly something to design for through that objective, and to validate where the shared geometry is weakest, across patient subgroups and against clinical judgment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了18种图像编码器和7种文本编码器在医学影像上的表征收敛性，发现自监督目标（而非临床监督或模型规模）是驱动收敛的主要因素，且收敛仅限于模态内部，未达到临床语言层次。
Motivation: 医学影像编码器常被视为可互换，但缺乏证据证明其表征是否真正收敛，以及收敛的驱动因素和临床可用性。
Method: 通过控制数据、架构和规模，训练仅改变目标函数的编码器，并在合成模型中复现效果；分析编码器在胸部X光片等5种成像模态上的表征相似性。
Result: 自监督编码器之间对齐最高（胸部X光片上40.4%），监督学习（21.1%）和图像-文本（3.3%）较低；收敛不随规模增长（Spearman 0.302），且线性分类器跨编码器迁移可保留约85%的性能。
Conclusion: 医学影像编码器的收敛由预训练目标决定，而非规模或临床监督；应通过目标设计实现互操作性，并在患者亚组和临床判断中验证共享几何的薄弱点。

papers.title: PoTRE: Test-Time Reasoning inspired by Cognitive Heterogeneity
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at many tasks, they frequently struggle with complex reasoning that requires long-horizon planning and iterative error correction. Furthermore, standard single-stream prompting proves brittle when models encounter novel abstractions or rigorous domain constraints. We introduce PoTRE (Poly-Topological Reasoning Ensembles), a heterogeneous framework that decouples inference into four agents: (1) Adversarial Refinement Agent, (2) Hierarchical strategic Planning Agent, (3) Spectrum Search Agent, and (4) Direct Chain Agent. A final Task-Adaptive Aggregation Layer dynamically reconciles these perspectives -- via final candidate selection, semantic synthesis, or neuro-symbolic verification -- to produce a robust global solution. We evaluate PoTRE on three frontier benchmarks: ARC-AGI-2, Humanity's Last Exam (HLE), and PRBench Finance. PoTRE achieves state-of-the-art accuracy of 49.92% on HLE, surpassing the previous best official score. We demonstrate that this architectural heterogeneity achieves improved reasoning performance using similar or fewer inference tokens compared to heavily scaled homogeneous baselines.
papers.comment: Accepted at Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR 2026)
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对大语言模型在复杂推理任务中的不足，本文提出PoTRE（多拓扑推理集成）框架，将推理过程解耦为四个异构智能体（对抗细化、层次规划、频谱搜索、直接链式），并通过任务自适应聚合层动态整合输出。在ARC-AGI-2、人类最后考试（HLE）和PRBench Finance三个前沿基准上评估，PoTRE在HLE上达到49.92%的准确率，超越此前最佳官方成绩，且推理token消耗与大规模同构基线相当或更少。
Motivation: 标准单流提示方法在面对需要长程规划和迭代纠错的复杂推理时表现脆弱，尤其当模型遇到新颖抽象或严格领域约束时容易失效。
Method: 提出PoTRE框架，包含四个异构推理智能体：对抗细化、层次化战略规划、频谱搜索和直接链式；最后通过任务自适应聚合层（候选选择、语义合成或神经符号验证）整合多视角结果。
Result: 在Humanity's Last Exam (HLE)上达到49.92%的准确率，超越此前最佳官方结果；在ARC-AGI-2和PRBench Finance上也取得有竞争力表现，且推理token效率与大规模同构基线相当或更优。
Conclusion: 异构推理架构能够有效提升LLM在复杂推理任务上的性能，且无需过度缩放模型规模或推理预算。

papers.title: The Maskability Index: Predicting Task-Objective Alignment in Pretrained Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale pretrained language models such as T5 and BERT have demonstrated strong capabilities for generating structured knowledge. However, their performance depends on how closely the prompting strategy matches the objectives used during pretraining. We introduce the Maskability Index (MI), a quantitative metric that estimates whether a knowledge relation is better suited to masked-style prompting or prefix-style prompting in few-shot generation. MI is computed from differences in DepthRank scores between masked and unmasked templates, providing a principled measure of objective-template alignment. We evaluate MI on a diverse set of relations from the ATOMIC2020 knowledge base completion benchmark and show that it is positively correlated with downstream generation performance. These results indicate that MI can help select appropriate prompting templates and adaptation strategies for extracting relational knowledge from pretrained language models, especially in low-resource settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可掩码性指数（Maskability Index，MI），一种量化度量，用于估计在少样本生成中知识关系更适合掩码式提示还是前缀式提示。MI基于掩码与未掩码模板之间的DepthRank分数差异计算，提供目标-模板对齐的原则性度量。在ATOMIC2020知识库补全基准上评估MI，结果显示MI与下游生成性能正相关，有助于为从预训练语言模型中提取关系知识选择合适的提示模板和适应策略，尤其在低资源场景下。
Motivation: 大规模预训练语言模型的性能高度依赖于提示策略与预训练目标的匹配程度，但缺乏一种可预测这种对齐的量化指标。
Method: 提出Maskability Index（MI），通过计算掩码与未掩码模板的DepthRank分数差异来量化目标-模板对齐程度。
Result: 在ATOMIC2020基准上，MI与下游生成性能正相关，表明MI可有效指导提示模板选择。
Conclusion: MI提供了一种无需额外训练即可评估提示模板匹配度的工具，特别适用于低资源知识抽取场景。

papers.title: How Does Urban Context Relate to Residential Building Health? A Vision-POI Fusion Framework for Building-Level Housing Inspection
papers.abstract_en: Housing-level urban physical examination is essential for identifying residential building problems and supporting targeted urban renewal. Existing automated inspection studies primarily rely on individual images and rarely examine whether surrounding urban functional context can provide supplementary information for building-level assessment. This study proposes a vision-POI fusion framework that combines multi-view visual inspection with POI-derived neighborhood context for residential building health assessment. The empirical dataset covers 92 old residential communities, 3,237 residential buildings, and 25,608 field-acquired inspection images in Qingdao, China, encompassing seven categories of housing-related issues. First, multiple object detection models are evaluated to extract issue locations, categories, and confidence scores from individual images. The image-level outputs are subsequently aggregated across multiple views to construct interpretable building-level representations. Second, POI features are extracted within 500m, 1,000m, and 1,500m neighborhood buffers to characterize surrounding functional environments. Pearson and Spearman correlation analyses, combined with false discovery rate correction, are used to identify candidate contextual features. Finally, visual and POI features are integrated using a cost-sensitive Random Forest classifier under community-isolated spatial cross-validation. The results show that multi-view aggregation provides the main performance improvement, increasing the building-level Macro-F1 from 60.84% under Direct Detection to 74.95%. Incorporating POI context further increases Macro-F1 to 76.79%, although the additional gain is modest and category-dependent. POI information therefore functions as a supplementary contextual prior rather than a substitute for direct visual evidence or a causal determinant of building condition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种视觉-POI融合框架，结合多视角视觉检测与POI邻域上下文，用于住宅建筑健康评估。基于青岛92个老社区、3237栋建筑和25608张现场图像的数据集，涵盖7类住房问题。通过多视角聚合和成本敏感随机森林分类器，Macro-F1从直接检测的60.84%提升至74.95%，加入POI后进一步增至76.79%，但增益有限且依赖类别。
Motivation: 现有自动化建筑检查研究主要依赖单张图像，未充分利用周围城市功能上下文（如POI）作为建筑级评估的补充信息。
Method: 首先评估多个目标检测模型（如YOLO等）从单张图像提取问题位置、类别和置信度，然后跨视角聚合构建建筑级表示；其次提取500m、1000m、1500m邻域缓冲区的POI特征，通过Pearson/Spearman相关分析与FDR校正选择候选特征；最后使用成本敏感随机森林分类器融合视觉和POI特征，在社区隔离的空间交叉验证下评估。
Result: 多视角聚合将建筑级Macro-F1从直接检测的60.84%提升至74.95%；加入POI上下文后Macro-F1进一步提升至76.79%，但额外增益较小且依赖具体问题类别。
Conclusion: POI信息作为补充上下文先验，而非直接视觉证据的替代或建筑条件的因果决定因素；其作用有限，主要提升来自多视角聚合。

papers.title: Breaking the $T^{3/4}$ Barrier for Regret Minimization With Bi-Dimensional CDFs
papers.abstract_en: We study regret minimization for learning CDF-related objectives of the form \[ g(x)\cdot\mathbb{P}_{X\sim\mathcal{D}}(X\le x), \] over $[0,1]^2$, where $g$ is a known Lipschitz function and $\mathcal{D}$ is an unknown distribution. At each round $t$, the learner selects a point $x_t$ and observes the binary feedback $\mathbb{I}(X_t\le x_t)$, where $X_t\sim\mathcal{D}$. We design an algorithm achieving regret $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{7/10})$, improving over the previous best-known bound of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{3/4})$ and showing that the curse of dimensionality can be at least partially lifted for this class of objectives, though a gap remains with the $Ω(T^{2/3})$ lower bound. As an application, our techniques yield the same $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{7/10})$ regret bound for profit maximization in repeated bilateral trade with fixed prices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究二维空间上关于CDF的遗憾最小化问题，目标函数形式为g(x)*P(X≤x)。作者提出新算法实现了~O(T^{7/10})的遗憾上界，改进了此前~O(T^{3/4})的已知最好结果，但仍与Ω(T^{2/3})下界有差距。算法还应用于固定价格重复双边贸易中的利润最大化，获得相同遗憾界。
Motivation: 现有算法在二维CDF目标上的遗憾上界为~O(T^{3/4})，与下界Ω(T^{2/3})存在差距，本文旨在突破此上界并部分克服维数诅咒。
Method: 提出了一种基于双维CDF的算法，具体机制未在摘要中详述，但通过对反馈的适当利用实现了更紧的遗憾上界。
Result: 摘要报告新算法达到~O(T^{7/10})遗憾，优于此前~O(T^{3/4})的最佳上界，并指出下界仍为Ω(T^{2/3})。
Conclusion: 作者指出该工作表明对于此类目标，维数诅咒可以被部分缓解，但遗憾界与下界之间仍存在间隙；此外，该技术直接适用于双边贸易场景。
Relevance: 0
