papers.title: Directional Kernel Mean Difference: A Fast Signed Statistic for Univariate Distribution Comparison
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Directional Kernel Mean Difference (DKMD), a signed statistic for univariate distribution comparison that preserves the direction of distributional shifts. Unlike the squared Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD), which discards directional information by squaring the RKHS distance, DKMD integrates the difference of kernel mean embeddings against a fixed odd weighting function. This construction yields three structural properties: antisymmetry, immunity to symmetric distributional differences, and directional monotonicity under stochastic dominance. We derive a data-driven Riemann estimator that ensures asymptotic consistency with the continuous formulation, strictly preserving the theoretical guarantees of the signed statistic in empirical evaluations. To overcome the quadratic computational cost of kernel methods, we develop an $O(N \log N)$ prefix--suffix scanning algorithm that exploits the total order of the real line while requiring only $O(N)$ memory. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks demonstrate that DKMD correctly isolates directional shifts from symmetric perturbations, remains robust to heavy-tailed outliers that can flip the sign of the mean difference, and scales to millions of samples in seconds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Directional Kernel Mean Difference (DKMD)，一种用于单变量分布比较的有符号统计量，保留了分布偏移的方向信息。与平方 MMD 不同，DKMD 通过将核均值嵌入的差异与固定奇加权函数积分来获得方向性。作者推导了数据驱动的 Riemann 估计量，并开发了 O(N log N) 的前缀-后缀扫描算法，内存 O(N)。实验表明 DKMD 能正确分离方向偏移与对称扰动，对重尾异常值鲁棒，能秒级处理百万样本。
Motivation: 现有 MMD 通过平方丢失方向信息，无法区分分布偏移的方向（如均值增加或减少）。需要一种有符号统计量来捕捉方向性。
Method: 提出 DKMD，将核均值嵌入差异与固定奇加权函数积分，确保反对称性、对对称差异免疫、在随机占优下方向单调。使用数据驱动的 Riemann 估计量保证一致性，并设计前缀-后缀扫描算法将计算复杂度降至 O(N log N)。
Result: 实验表明 DKMD 正确识别方向偏移，对对称扰动不敏感，对重尾异常值鲁棒（这些异常值可能翻转均值差异的符号），可扩展至百万样本秒级处理。
Conclusion: DKMD 提供了一种快速、有符号的单变量分布比较工具，保留了方向信息，具有理论保证和计算效率。

papers.title: RIM: A Retrieval-In-Matching Framework for Cross-Domain Global Visual Localization of UAVs
papers.abstract_en: Global visual localization of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) using remote-sensing reference maps has attracted increasing attention. However, acquisition-time and imaging-platform differences between UAV and reference imagery induce substantial cross-domain appearance and viewpoint shifts, challenging robust six-degree-of-freedom (6-DoF) pose estimation. We address these shifts by sampling UAV-viewpoint reference views from Google 3D Tiles across locations, altitudes, and orientations. A two-stage cross-domain fine-tuning recipe adapts SALAD using pose-near positives and geographically distant hard negatives, while local geometric consistency re-ranks the Top-K candidates. We further propose Retrieval-In-Matching (RIM), which freezes the adapted DINOv2-B retriever and distils a local-descriptor decoder that reuses its token field alongside a shallow VGG19 detail stream. One query-side DINOv2-B forward thus serves both SALAD retrieval and local description, eliminating a second foundation-model backbone while preserving retrieval descriptors by construction. We evaluate RIM zero-shot on the reconstructed EPFL Urbanscape and self-collected Chang'an Park datasets, both geographically disjoint from the training data. RIM outperforms ten recent retrieval baseline families. At 25/50 m under the full 3D distance metric, it improves Recall@1 over SALAD by 8.55/13.77 percentage points on EPFL and 4.45/8.94 points on Park. At Top-K=5, the complete measured localization query, including retrieval, candidate matching, and robust geometric verification, takes 67.9 ms end-to-end: 1.8 times faster than the strongest separate sparse-matching baseline and over 40 times faster than RoMa, while achieving comparable re-ranking accuracy. These results establish an efficient and deployable pipeline for UAV global visual localization in GNSS-challenged environments.
papers.comment: 56 pages, 10 figures, and 18 tables. Supplementary material is included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RIM框架，通过冻结适配的DINOv2-B检索器并蒸馏局部描述符解码器，实现无人机全局视觉定位的检索与匹配共享同一骨干网络，消除第二个基础模型。在跨域数据集上，RIM在Recall@1上优于SALAD等10个基线，端到端定位速度比稀疏匹配快1.8倍，比RoMa快40倍以上。
Motivation: 无人机与参考遥感图像之间存在跨域外观和视角差异，影响6-DoF姿态估计的鲁棒性，现有方法需要双骨干网络导致计算开销大。
Method: 提出RIM框架：冻结适配后的DINOv2-B作为检索器，蒸馏一个局部描述符解码器，重用其token字段并加入浅层VGG19细节流；同时采用两阶段跨域微调SALAD与局部几何一致性重排序。
Result: 在EPFL Urbanscape和长安公园数据集上，RIM零样本测试Recall@1在25/50米下比SALAD高8.55/13.77和4.45/8.94个百分点；端到端定位耗时67.9ms，比稀疏匹配快1.8倍，比RoMa快40倍以上。
Conclusion: RIM为GNSS受限环境下的无人机全局视觉定位提供了高效且可部署的流水线。

papers.title: ENTRAP-VL: A Taxonomic Probe for Dual Contextual Entrainment in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Contextual entrainment is the tendency of a model to let auxiliary context in its input pull its output, independently of whether that context is relevant, true, or even meaningful. Recently, it has been identified and given a mechanistic account in unimodal language models. Whether and how it manifests in vision-language models (VLMs) is, by contrast, largely unexamined, and the field lacks a purpose-built instrument with which to investigate it. We take the position that studying contextual entrainment in VLMs requires more than porting an existing text-only benchmark to the multimodal setting: it requires a taxonomically structured, dual-modality instrument whose conditions are constructed around the item at hand (the depicted image in the textual stream, the textual query in the visual stream). We argue that the move to VLMs is substantive rather than incremental. It makes entrainment a dual phenomenon, drivable independently by textual and by visual context, and it opens a veracity distinction (context that is false of the depicted scene yet possible in the world) that has no counterpart in the unimodal, world-knowledge-only formulation of prior work. To make this position concrete and actionable, we introduce ENTRAP-VL (ENTRainment Assessment Probe for Vision and Language), a manually curated dataset of 1,500 items across eight categories, organized by a taxonomy that spans two axes, i.e., the association of context with the item and its relationship to truth, and split into a textual-entrainment stream (eight context conditions) and a visual-entrainment stream (three context conditions). We do not claim to measure entrainment in any particular model; we provide the instrument, the taxonomy that motivates it, and the evaluation protocols it enables, so that the community can investigate the phenomenon rigorously. We will release the dataset and its documentation publicly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ENTRAP-VL，一个用于研究视觉语言模型（VLM）中双重上下文诱导（contextual entrainment）现象的探测数据集和分类体系。上下文诱导是指模型因输入中的辅助上下文而改变输出，无论该上下文是否相关或真实。作者认为VLM中的上下文诱导是双重模态现象，可由文本和视觉上下文独立驱动，并引入了一个真实性与世界知识的新区分。ENTRAP-VL包含1,500个手动整理的数据项，分为文本诱导流（8种上下文条件）和视觉诱导流（3种上下文条件），旨在为社区提供标准化评估工具。
Motivation: 之前的上下文诱导研究仅限于单模态语言模型，缺乏对视觉语言模型中该现象的系统性探讨，且没有专门为此设计的多模态基准和分类工具。
Method: 构建了ENTRAP-VL数据集，基于一个两轴分类体系（上下文与项目的关联性及其与真实性的关系），包含文本和视觉两个诱导流，覆盖11种上下文条件，共1,500个手动标注项。
Result: 论文未报告具体模型测量结果，主要贡献是提供了数据集、分类体系及评估协议，供社区后续研究使用。
Conclusion: 作者强调VLM中的上下文诱导是一个实质性的新问题，需要专用的多模态探测工具，ENTRAP-VL旨在支持对该现象的严格研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Model Selective Evidence Adoption from Contaminated Retrieval Results
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented large language models frequently face contexts that interleave useful evidence with misleading statements or instruction-like content. Blanket refusal discards valid evidence, whereas uncritical adoption yields incorrect or unsafe answers. The ability to selectively adopt relevant information while rejecting deceptive or harmful content is therefore critical for reliable deployment in real-world retrieval settings. We introduce SelectBench, a controlled benchmark and training set for selective evidence adoption, and post-train Qwen3.5-4B directly with DAPO using either deterministic rule rewards or a frozen semantic judge. On the corrected 325-example SelectBench-v2 test set, strict success rises from 22.46% for the original checkpoint to 25.54% with DAPO-Rule and 26.46% with DAPO-DeepSeek. Both trained policies reduce forbidden-content adoption and produce shorter, more focused responses, yet prompt-injection following does not improve. The paired gains are modest and fail to survive Holm correction, suggesting that stronger reward shaping or additional training iterations may be needed for more robust gains. DAPO-DeepSeek exhibits no material degradation on MMLU or clean HotpotQA, indicating that the post-training procedure preserves general capabilities. These results demonstrate a directional improvement in selective evidence use, while identifying injection resistance and statistical robustness as important remaining challenges for future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SelectBench基准和训练集，用于大型语言模型在污染检索结果中选择性采纳证据。使用DAPO算法对Qwen3.5-4B进行后训练，采用确定性规则奖励或冻结语义评判器。在SelectBench-v2测试集上，严格成功率从22.46%提升至25.54%（DAPO-Rule）和26.46%（DAPO-DeepSeek），但改进在统计上不显著。后训练减少了禁止内容采纳，生成了更短更集中的响应，但提示注入跟随没有改善。在MMLU和干净HotpotQA上未出现实质性退化。
Motivation: 检索增强的大型语言模型经常面临上下文混合有用证据和误导性语句或指令式内容的问题。全面拒绝会丢弃有效证据，而不加批判地采纳会产生错误或不安全的答案。因此，选择性采纳相关信息同时拒绝欺骗性或有害内容对于在真实检索场景中可靠部署至关重要。
Method: 引入SelectBench基准和训练集，用于选择性证据采纳。使用DAPO算法直接后训练Qwen3.5-4B，采用确定性规则奖励或冻结语义评判器（DeepSeek）作为奖励模型。
Result: 在修正后的325示例SelectBench-v2测试集上，严格成功率从原始检查点的22.46%提升至DAPO-Rule的25.54%和DAPO-DeepSeek的26.46%。两种训练策略均减少了禁止内容采纳，生成了更短更集中的响应。但改进在统计学上不显著（未通过Holm校正）。在MMLU和干净HotpotQA上无实质退化。
Conclusion: 结果表明在选择性证据使用方面有方向性改进，同时识别出注入抵抗和统计鲁棒性作为未来工作的重要挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Development of an automated, reliable, and clinically meaningful artificial intelligence (AI) tool for diagnosing cardiac disease from conventional cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) images
papers.abstract_en: Aims: Cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging enables non-invasive assessment of myocardial structure, function, and pathology, but requires substantial experience in interpretation of CMR images that could be supported by artificial intelligence (AI)-based models. However, use of AI models for enhanced CMR reading is limited by labor-intensive data curation, suboptimal model performance, and unclear implementation pathways. Methods and results: We developed an automated data curation pipeline for CMR-based cardiovascular disease (CVD) diagnosis, integrating open-source locally-run large language models (LLMs) to extract diagnostic labels from narrative CMR reports and preprocessing multimodal imaging data, including cine and late-gadolinium-enhancement (LGE) CMR sequences. Three vision foundation models (DINO, VST, UMedPT) were fine-tuned across these modalities in a two-stage approach. The dataset comprised hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM), dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM), ischemic cardiomyopathy (ICM), cardiac amyloidosis (CA), and normal controls (NOR). A total of 988 curated cases were randomly divided into 742 for training and 246 for validation. Fine-tuned AI-models achieved high discriminative diagnostic performance on an independent test set comprising 1067 patients , with individual AUC-ROC values of up to 0.937 for the correct diagnosis of HCM and 0.945 for cardiac amyloidosis. Ensemble strategies combining multiple models and modalities further improved AI-based diagnostic accuracy and robustness, achieving the highest overall diagnostic performance for HCM (AUC=0.959, CI [0.936-0.978]), CA (AUC=0.966, CI [0.939-0.986]), NOR (AUC=0.872, CI [0.852-0.894]), DCM (AUC=0.848, CI [0.808-0.885]) and ICM (AUC=0.840, CI [0.809-0.868]). All training and inference code, along with the trained model weights, are publicly available on https://github.com/sinaamirrajab/CMR_CVD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文开发了一套自动化数据整理流程，利用本地运行的开源大语言模型从CMR报告中提取诊断标签，并预处理多模态影像数据（包括cine和LGE序列）。三种视觉基础模型（DINO、VST、UMedPT）以两阶段方式进行微调，在独立测试集（1067名患者）上对肥厚型心肌病（HCM）和心脏淀粉样变性（CA）实现了高诊断性能（AUC分别为0.959和0.966）。
Motivation: CMR影像解读需要丰富经验，而现有AI模型受限于数据整理劳动强度大、模型性能欠佳和实现路径不明确。
Method: 开发了自动化数据整理流程，集成开源大语言模型提取诊断标签，并预处理cine和LGE序列数据；对DINO、VST、UMedPT三种视觉基础模型进行两阶段微调，并采用集成策略组合多模型与多模态。
Result: 在独立测试集中，单模型AUC-ROC最高达0.937（HCM）和0.945（CA）；集成模型进一步提升，HCM AUC=0.959，CA AUC=0.966，正常对照AUC=0.872，扩张型心肌病AUC=0.848，缺血型心肌病AUC=0.840。
Conclusion: 集成多模型与多模态策略能提升AI诊断的准确性和鲁棒性，相关代码和模型权重已开源。

papers.title: Cumsum-Composable Phase Transport for Low-Cost Streaming Keyword Spotting
papers.abstract_en: State-space sequence models are attractive for streaming speech because they maintain compact recurrent state, but scan-style training kernels can have unfavorable constants for short audio tasks. We study cumsum-composable phase transport, a streaming-native temporal layer for keyword spotting. Each layer projects acoustic frames to complex channels, transports them by learned unitary rotations, accumulates a finite window using prefix differences, and applies a gated residual update. The same prefix representation gives exact batched training with ordinary cumulative sums and exact online inference with one prefix update per frame. Unitary transport is the key constraint: inverse rotations have norm one, keeping prefix terms well conditioned while memory is supplied by windows or block readouts. On Google Speech Commands v2 with 12 labels, mel+cumsum models retain competitive accuracy with compact baselines. The strongest single-seed run reaches 97.3\% test accuracy; a 51.6K-parameter tied model also reaches 97.3\%, and a 24.8K tied model reaches 96.8\% versus 97.1\% for a 25.6K MelCNNMaxPool baseline. In a matched cumsum-versus-scan benchmark, cumsum+window gives comparable accuracy, 94.82\% versus 94.33\%, while training 1.07x faster and reducing single-example latency from 7.09 ms to 5.01 ms on a Tesla T4. These results support cumsum phase transport as a simple low-cost temporal primitive for streaming keyword spotting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出了一种基于cumsum-composable phase transport的流式关键词识别时间层，利用复数通道和酉旋转实现高效训练与在线推理。在Google Speech Commands v2上达到97.3%准确率，同时降低延迟。
Motivation: 现有状态空间序列模型在短音频任务上扫描式训练核常数不利，需更高效的时间层。
Method: 每个层将声学帧投影到复数通道，通过可学习酉旋转传输，用前缀差分累积有限窗口，并施加门控残差更新；批训练使用普通累积和，在线推理仅需每帧一次前缀更新。
Result: 在12标签Google Speech Commands v2上，mel+cumsum模型达97.3%准确率，51.6K参数模型同样达97.3%，24.8K模型达96.8%（基线25.6K为97.1%）；对比扫描，准确率相当（94.82% vs 94.33%），训练快1.07x，延迟从7.09ms降至5.01ms。
Conclusion: cumsum相位传输作为流式关键词识别的简单低成本时间基元是有效的。

papers.title: Non--negative matrix factorization using the \textit{R} package \textsf{nnmf}
papers.abstract_en: Non--negative matrix factorization (NMF) has become an established dimensionality reduction technique for extracting latent structures from non--negative data and has found widespread applications in fields such as bioinformatics, text mining, image analysis, and recommender systems. As the popularity of NMF has increased, numerous \textit{R} packages implementing different optimization strategies and computational frameworks have been developed. Despite their widespread availability, comprehensive evaluations of these implementations under real--world data conditions remain limited. Consequently, researchers often lack objective guidance when selecting an appropriate package for practical applications. This study introduces a new \textit{R} package for NMF and offers asystematic performance comparison with two widely available \textit{R} packages for NMF analysis. Rather than relying on simulated datasets, the evaluation is conducted using real--world data to better reflect the complexity, heterogeneity, and noise characteristics encountered in practical analytical settings. The packages are assessed using a consistent experimental framework, with emphasis on computational efficiency, convergence behavior, reconstruction accuracy, memory utilization, and the stability of the resulting matrix factorization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个新的R包nnmf用于非负矩阵分解（NMF），并基于真实世界数据，与两个现有的R包进行了系统性性能比较，评估指标包括计算效率、收敛行为、重构精度、内存使用和分解稳定性。
Motivation: 尽管NMF流行且有多款R包实现，但这些实现在真实数据条件下的综合评估有限，研究者缺乏客观选择指南。
Method: 开发了新的R包nnmf，并设计了一致的实验框架，使用真实世界数据（而非模拟数据）对比两个现有R包。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，但强调评估基于真实数据的复杂性和噪声特征。
Conclusion: 该包和比较结果旨在为研究者选择NMF R包提供客观指导。

papers.title: Co-Evolving LLM Evaluators and Policies via DynamicRubric
papers.abstract_en: Post-training with evaluator feedback on policy-induced samples serves as a major mechanism for improving large language models. As policies improve, these sampled responses become close in quality. These close candidates create a bottleneck for policy optimization: collapsed relative evaluator score gaps yield weak or misleading policy supervision. We theoretically characterize why these gaps matter through a probability allocation view, showing that the directional gain of shifting probability mass from one response to another is exactly the evaluator score gap between them. This identifies relative score gaps as the policy optimization signals that guide updates. Motivated by this view, we propose DynamicRubric, a response-set-conditioned evaluator--policy co-evolution framework that generates weighted binary rubric items for each candidate set and aggregates the resulting judgments into response-level scores. In our experiments with 8B backbones, DynamicRubric improves evaluator performance and provides stronger policy supervision than baselines using a 70B reward model or a 235B static rubric generator. DynamicRubric-optimized policies also show gains on verifiable reasoning and coding tasks. A DynamicRubric-optimized model is fully deployed in WeChat Search's AI answering scenario, where it serves all online traffic across tens of millions of requests per day and improves key online metrics. These results suggest a principle for evaluator-guided post-training: evaluators should evolve with the policies they supervise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DynamicRubric，一个响应集条件化的评估器-策略协同进化框架，用于改进大型语言模型的后训练。该框架通过为每个候选集生成加权二元评分项，并聚合为响应级分数，从而提供更强的策略监督。实验表明，使用8B骨干网络时，DynamicRubric 在评估器性能和策略监督上优于70B奖励模型或235B静态评分生成器基线，并在可验证推理和编码任务上取得改进。该方法已部署在微信搜索的AI回答场景中，服务于数千万日请求。
Motivation: 随着策略改进，政策诱导的采样响应质量接近，导致评估器分数差距缩小，从而产生微弱或误导性的策略监督信号。理论分析表明，相对分数差距是策略优化的关键信号。
Method: 提出 DynamicRubric，一种响应集条件化的评估器-策略协同进化框架，为每个候选集生成加权二元评分项并聚合为响应级分数，使评估器与策略共同进化。
Result: 在8B骨干网络上，DynamicRubric 优于70B奖励模型和235B静态评分生成器基线，提升评估器性能并提供更强策略监督；优化后的策略在可验证推理和编码任务上取得改进；全面部署于微信搜索AI回答场景，提升关键在线指标。
Conclusion: 评估器应与所监督的策略共同进化，这是评估器引导后训练的一个原则。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Evaluating and Mitigating Gender Bias in Pre-trained Embeddings for ML-based Recruitment
papers.abstract_en: AI-based recruitment systems that rely on machine learning models trained on historical CV data, risk perpetuating and amplifying social biases. A key challenge arises in unstructured CV text, where pre-trained language model embeddings may infer sensitive attributes such as gender even after explicit indicators are removed. In this paper, we evaluate nine pre-trained embedding models on the synthetic FairCVdb dataset, analyzing the informativeness of their embeddings for applicant scoring and their susceptibility to gender leakage, on both original and gender-scrubbed biographies. We further use a multi-task adversarial learning framework with gradient reversal to predict applicant suitability while suppressing gender information from learned representations. Finally, we use a multi-objective Pareto-front-based model selection to balance predictive utility and fairness. Our experimental results show that explicit gender scrubbing substantially reduces but does not eliminate gender leakage, while adversarial learning improves fairness mainly on original biographies and acts as a complementary strategy rather than a substitute for text-level debiasing.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at the TRUST-AI 2026 Workshop, held in conjunction with IJCAI/ECAI 2026, Bremen, Germany
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了九种预训练嵌入模型在合成招聘数据集FairCVdb上的性别偏见，发现即使移除显式性别指示词，嵌入仍可能泄露性别信息。提出多任务对抗学习框架结合梯度反转来抑制性别信息，并使用基于Pareto前沿的多目标模型选择来平衡预测效用与公平性。实验表明，显式性别擦除显著减少但未消除泄露，对抗学习主要改善原始简历的公平性，作为文本级去偏的补充策略。
Motivation: 基于AI的招聘系统使用历史简历数据训练，可能延续和放大社会偏见。关键挑战在于非结构化简历文本中，预训练语言模型嵌入可能推断出性别等敏感属性，即使显式指示词已被移除。
Method: 在FairCVdb数据集上评估九个预训练嵌入模型（包括原始和性别擦除简历），分析嵌入对申请人评分的信息量及性别泄露程度。采用多任务对抗学习框架（梯度反转）预测申请人适合度的同时抑制性别信息，并利用基于Pareto前沿的多目标模型选择权衡预测效用与公平性。
Result: 显式性别擦除大幅降低了但未能完全消除性别泄露；对抗学习在原始简历上改善了公平性，但作为文本级去偏的补充策略而非替代方案。
Conclusion: 对抗学习可以作为文本级去偏的有效补充，但单独使用不足以完全消除偏见；需要结合多种策略实现更公平的招聘模型。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文评估了九种预训练嵌入模型在合成招聘数据集FairCVdb上的性别偏见，发现即使移除显式性别指示词，嵌入仍可能泄露性别信息。提出多任务对抗学习框架结合梯度反转来抑制性别信息，并使用基于Pareto前沿的多目标模型选择来平衡预测效用与公平性。实验表明，显式性别擦除显著减少但未消除泄露，对抗学习主要改善原始简历的公平性，作为文本级去偏的补充策略。
summary_sections.motivation: 基于AI的招聘系统使用历史简历数据训练，可能延续和放大社会偏见。关键挑战在于非结构化简历文本中，预训练语言模型嵌入可能推断出性别等敏感属性，即使显式指示词已被移除。
summary_sections.method: 在FairCVdb数据集上评估九个预训练嵌入模型（包括原始和性别擦除简历），分析嵌入对申请人评分的信息量及性别泄露程度。采用多任务对抗学习框架（梯度反转）预测申请人适合度的同时抑制性别信息，并利用基于Pareto前沿的多目标模型选择权衡预测效用与公平性。
summary_sections.result: 显式性别擦除大幅降低了但未能完全消除性别泄露；对抗学习在原始简历上改善了公平性，但作为文本级去偏的补充策略而非替代方案。
summary_sections.conclusion: 对抗学习可以作为文本级去偏的有效补充，但单独使用不足以完全消除偏见；需要结合多种策略实现更公平的招聘模型。

papers.title: Factor-Informed Uncertainty Distillation for Gaze Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Deep gaze estimation works well in controlled capture but degrades in unconstrained settings, where systems must reject unreliable predictions. Single-pass uncertainty (e.g., heteroscedastic regression) infers uncertainty from pixels without explicit input-validity cues, while sampling based methods are often too costly for real time use. We propose Factor-Informed Uncertainty Distillation (FIUD), a teacher-student framework that aligns uncertainty with interpretable image-quality failure modes. A gradient-boosting teacher predicts expected gaze error from factors such as illumination, sharpness, eye visibility and symmetry; a neural student distills these signals via curriculum learning and ranking supervision into a lightweight single-pass uncertainty head. Across ETH-XGaze, Gaze360, and MPIIFaceGaze (>300k samples), FIUD improves uncertainty, error rank correlation and selective prediction versus deterministic and sampling-based baselines, with the largest gains in unconstrained settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出因子信息不确定性蒸馏（FIUD）框架，用于视线估计中的不确定性预测。教师模型利用图像质量因素（光照、清晰度、眼睛可见性和对称性）预测预期误差，学生模型通过课程学习和排序监督将不确定性信号蒸馏到轻量级单次不确定性头。在ETH-XGaze、Gaze360和MPIIFaceGaze上，FIUD改进了不确定性、误差秩相关和选择性预测，在非约束场景下增益最大。
Motivation: 现有方法在非约束环境下可靠性下降，单次不确定性缺乏输入有效性线索，采样方法计算成本高。
Method: 教师-学生框架：基于梯度提升的教师利用可解释图像质量因素预测预期误差；学生通过课程学习和排序监督蒸馏不确定性信号到单次不确定性头。
Result: 在三个数据集上（超过30万样本），FIUD在不确定性、误差秩相关和选择性预测方面优于确定性和基于采样的基线，在非约束场景下增益最大。
Conclusion: 摘要强调FIUD在非约束环境下有效提升视线估计的可靠性，但未说明局限性。

papers.title: GaussianSeed: Hierarchical Gaussian Seeding for High-Resolution 3D Occupancy Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Vision-centric 3D occupancy prediction provides dense scene representations essential for autonomous driving and robotic navigation, yet existing methods struggle to scale to high voxel resolutions due to prohibitive computational costs. To address this, we introduce GaussianSeed, a progressive multi-scale Gaussian occupancy prediction framework that organizes primitives into a coarse-to-fine hierarchy. Benefiting from this hierarchical design, GaussianSeed effectively circumvents the memory bottlenecks inherent in dense representations, successfully scaling to a $0.1\text{m}$ spatial resolution while maintaining real-time inference capabilities. To comprehensively evaluate high-resolution geometric perception, we further construct TJScenes, a panoramic six-camera occupancy dataset with highly detailed $0.1\text{m}$ annotations. Extensive experiments on Occ3D-nuScenes and TJScenes demonstrate that GaussianSeed delivers the lowest latency among all evaluated methods while maintaining highly competitive accuracy, advancing the efficiency-quality frontier of high-resolution 3D occupancy prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GaussianSeed，一种渐进式多尺度高斯占用预测框架，通过从粗到细的分层高斯基元组织，有效规避高体素分辨率下的内存瓶颈，在 0.1m 空间分辨率下实现实时推理。同时，作者构建了全景六相机占用数据集 TJScenes，提供精细的 0.1m 标注。实验表明，GaussianSeed 在保持高精度的同时，延迟在所有方法中最低。
Motivation: 现有视觉为中心的 3D 占用预测方法在扩展到高体素分辨率时面临巨大计算开销，难以满足实时需求。
Method: 提出分层高斯种子框架，利用从粗到细的多级高斯基元渐进式表示场景，避免密集表示的内存瓶颈。
Result: 在 Occ3D-nuScenes 和 TJScenes 数据集上，GaussianSeed 以最低延迟达到 0.1m 空间分辨率，且精度极具竞争力。
Conclusion: 该工作通过分层高斯设计推进了高分辨率 3D 占用预测的效率与质量边界，为自动驾驶和机器人导航提供了实时方案。

papers.title: TRUST-ESD: A Risk-Calibrated and Governance-Aware AI Framework for Enterprise Strategic Decision Support Under Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise strategic decision support requires AI systems that are not only accurate, but also uncertainty-aware, risk-calibrated, explainable, and governance-compliant. This paper proposes TRUST-ESD, a risk-calibrated and governance-aware framework for enterprise decision support under uncertainty. TRUST-ESD evaluates feasible counterfactual strategies through predictive utility estimation, conformal uncertainty calibration, CVaR-based downside-risk scoring, risk-memory retrieval, policy-as-code governance, explainability, and human oversight. Unlike prediction-only methods that select actions by maximum expected utility, TRUST-ESD recommends strategies that balance value, reliability, risk exposure, and compliance. Experimental results show that TRUST-ESD improves risk-adjusted utility by 7.95%, reduces risk exposure by 23.22%, reduces CVaR by 23.78%, lowers calibration error by 13.89%, improves explanation fidelity by 10.90%, and increases governance compliance by 9.76% compared with strong uncertainty-aware baselines, while maintaining competitive predictive accuracy. Ablation and case-study analyses further confirm that uncertainty calibration, downside-risk scoring, risk memory, explainability, and governance validation jointly improve trustworthy enterprise decision-making.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to APWeb-WAIM 2026, Danang, Vietnam, September 7-9, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TRUST-ESD框架，用于企业战略决策支持，整合了预测效用估计、共形不确定性校准、CVaR风险评分、风险记忆检索、策略即代码治理、可解释性和人工监督。实验表明在风险调整效用、风险暴露、CVaR、校准误差、解释保真度和治理合规性方面均优于强不确定性感知基线。
Motivation: 企业决策支持需要同时考虑准确性、不确定性、风险校准、可解释性和合规性，现有方法多只关注预测精度。
Method: 提出TRUST-ESD框架，结合共形不确定性校准、CVaR下行风险评分、风险记忆、策略即代码治理、可解释性和人类监督，选择平衡价值、可靠性、风险暴露和合规性的策略。
Result: 与强不确定性感知基线相比，风险调整效用提升7.95%，风险暴露降低23.22%，CVaR降低23.78%，校准误差降低13.89%，解释保真度提升10.90%，治理合规性提升9.76%。
Conclusion: 消融和案例研究证实，不确定性校准、下行风险评分、风险记忆、可解释性和治理验证共同提升了可信企业决策。

papers.title: PRO-LONG: Programmatic Memory Enables Long-Horizon Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon tasks require sustained perception, reasoning, and exploration, and are a persistent challenge for large language model (LLM) agents. This gap is reflected in their limited performance on continual learning benchmarks such as ARC-AGI-3, especially when models are evaluated out of the box. Various agent harnesses have been proposed to close this gap, and each commits to a strategy for handling long sequences of observations, i.e., what information to save from the environment and how to load it into model context, a choice we argue is particularly consequential. Existing methods for context management face a significant tradeoff, as preserving more information makes retrieving relevant details less tractable. We propose PRO-LONG, a minimal context management framework built around programmatic memory for LLM agents in long-horizon, exploratory settings. PRO-LONG addresses the tradeoff by keeping a complete, structured interaction log and capitalizing on recent progress in coding agents to search this history efficiently. On the full ARC-AGI-3 public game set, PRO-LONG improves over a base coding agent by an average of 18.0 percentage points across frontier models, and matches or exceeds state-of-the-art specialized harnesses (up to 76.1% pass@1) while using 4.2-5.8x fewer tokens. With Fable 5, PRO-LONG achieves 97.4% best@2 at a total cost of \$1,750. Relevant code and logs are available at https://github.com/alexisfox7/PRO-LONG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PRO-LONG，一种针对长时域、探索性场景中 LLM agent 的上下文管理框架，通过程序化记忆保存完整结构化交互日志，并利用编码 agent 高效搜索历史。在 ARC-AGI-3 基准上，PRO-LONG 将基础编码 agent 平均提升 18.0 个百分点，匹配或超越最先进专用框架，同时节省 4.2-5.8 倍 token。
Motivation: 长时域任务中 LLM agent 的上下文管理面临保存更多信息与检索相关细节之间的权衡，现有方法存在显著折衷。
Method: 提出 PRO-LONG 框架，围绕程序化记忆构建最小上下文管理，保持完整结构化交互日志，并利用编码 agent 的高效搜索能力。
Result: 在 ARC-AGI-3 完整游戏集上，PRO-LONG 在多个前沿模型上平均提升 18.0 个百分点；与最先进专用框架相比，达到 76.1% pass@1，token 使用减少 4.2-5.8 倍。在 Fable 5 上，以 $1,750 总成本达到 97.4% best@2。
Conclusion: 摘要强调程序化记忆可以有效解决长时域 agent 上下文管理的权衡，提高性能和效率。

papers.title: Reading and Steering Representations of Materials-Science Mechanisms in an Open-Weight Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can answer scientific questions, yet a correct output does not reveal whether the model represents or uses the governing physics. Here we show that materials science mechanism information in the open-weight google/gemma-4-E4B-it model has three experimentally separable forms: concepts are readable in individual hidden states, constitutive orientation is carried by controlled transformations between states, and selected internal representations causally control engineering answers. We combine matched direct and Jacobian vocabulary readouts, option-free state geometry, a 60-law counterfactual benchmark and causal interventions. In 50 held-out materials descriptions, three independently fitted Jacobian lenses reproduced concept ranks, and target-free word sets from both readouts enabled blinded identification of 9 of 10 mechanism families. A separate 72-prompt benchmark produced mechanism-specific hidden-state neighborhoods, but an exact graph audit showed that this apparent physical organization was equally explained by numerical comparison. We therefore compared otherwise identical prompts in which only the direction of the physical input was reversed, asking whether the resulting hidden-state movement followed the supplied constitutive law. These state transformations ordered direct, physically neutral and inverse laws across 60 frozen relations and correctly oriented 39 of 40 directional laws, whereas lexical controls were near chance. Bidirectional interventions shifted answer probabilities toward or away from the physically appropriate outcome across all 12 matched cases, while counterfactual state patches transferred opposing decision signals across mechanisms and answer formats. Physical relationships were therefore more visible in controlled state changes than in absolute states alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究开放权重语言模型 gemma-4-E4B-it 中材料科学机制的内部表示。通过匹配直接读出和雅可比词汇读出、无选项状态几何、60条定律反事实基准和因果干预，发现机制概念可在隐藏状态中读取，本构方向由受控状态变换携带，内部表示因果控制工程答案。在50个材料描述中，三个独立拟合的雅可比透镜重现了概念排名；72提示基准显示机制特定隐藏状态邻域，但精确图审计表明该结构可由数值比较同等解释。状态变换实验在60条冻结关系中对直接、物理中性和逆定律排序，并正确识别40条定向定律中的39条；双向干预在所有12个匹配案例中改变了答案概率，反事实状态修补传递了对立决策信号。
Motivation: 大语言模型能回答科学问题，但正确输出不揭示模型是否表示或使用控制物理机制。本文旨在证明材料科学机制信息在模型中有三种实验可分离的形式。
Method: 结合匹配直接读出和雅可比词汇读出、无选项状态几何、60条定律反事实基准和因果干预方法，分析 open-weight 模型 gemma-4-E4B-it 的内部表示。
Result: 在50个材料描述中，三个独立拟合雅可比透镜重现概念排名；72提示基准显示机制特定隐藏状态邻域但可由数值比较解释；40条定向定律中正确识别39条；双向干预改变12个案例中的答案概率。
Conclusion: 物理关系在受控状态变化中比绝对状态更可见。本文证明了语言模型中材料科学机制的可读性和可控性。

papers.title: Antigen-specific Antibody Multi-modal Foundation Model for Functional Antibody Design
papers.abstract_en: Antibodies are essential proteins that play a central role in immune recognition by binding specific antigen molecules. Although recent protein language models have enabled progress in single-chain protein modeling and generation, they often fall short in antigen-specific antibody design, where effective modeling requires explicit pairing between antibody and antigen, particularly at the epitope level. To address these limitations, we introduce AAMFM, an Antigen-specific Antibody Multimodal Foundation Model that learns unified representations of antibody sequences and structures conditioned on antigen context. AAMFM incorporates rich antigen information including geometric interfaces and epitope annotations via a cross-modal adapter, enabling joint modeling of antibody-antigen interactions in a shared latent space. To further guide the model toward functional relevance, we fine-tune AAMFM using Calibrated Direct Preference Optimization (Cal-DPO), leveraging preference signals extracted from a strong structural prior to align learning with binding-specific objectives. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AAMFM achieves state-of-the-art performance in functional antibody design, revealing its potential for antigen-specific antibody engineering. Our code is available at https://github.com/XL-S224/AAMFM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AAMFM，一个抗原特异性抗体多模态基础模型，联合建模抗体序列与结构并融合抗原几何界面和表位注释，通过校准直接偏好优化（Cal-DPO）微调以增强功能性。实验表明在功能性抗体设计上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有蛋白语言模型在抗原特异性抗体设计方面不足，无法有效建模抗体-抗原配对，特别是表位层面的交互。
Method: 提出抗原特异性抗体多模态基础模型（AAMFM），通过跨模态适配器整合抗原几何界面和表位注释，在共享潜在空间联合建模抗体-抗原交互，并使用Cal-DPO进行微调以对齐结合特异性目标。
Result: 摘要报告在功能性抗体设计任务上达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: AAMFM展示了抗原特异性抗体工程潜力，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Language-Specific versus Cross-Lingual Knowledge Graphs for Implicit Aspect Identification in Arabic: A Comparative Study of Reasoning and Adaptation Strategies
papers.abstract_en: Aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) in Arabic must recover both explicitly stated aspects and implicit aspects that are never named in the text. Implicit identification typically relies on an auxiliary knowledge source (e.g., a knowledge graph (KG)) linking opinion cues to aspect categories, but for a lower-resource language the practitioner faces a design choice: reuse a mature English KG through multilingual embeddings, or build a smaller native Arabic KG. This paper reports a controlled comparison of the two strategies within a single hybrid pipeline, evaluated on three Arabic benchmarks (M-ABSA, SemEval-2016 Arabic, and HAAD). We further compare two adaptation strategies for the generative extractor that feeds the KG -- zero-shot prompting versus task-specific fine-tuning of an 8B-parameter large language model (LLM). The native Arabic KG (Strategy 2) outperforms the cross-lingual English KG (Strategy 1) by +0.199 micro-F1 on M-ABSA and +0.251 on SemEval-2016, gaining on both precision and recall. Task-specific fine-tuning raises explicit-extraction micro-F1 from <= 0.13 (zero-shot) to 0.66-0.76 on M-ABSA and SemEval-2016 (0.45 on the smaller HAAD), confirming that task adaptation, rather than model scale, is decisive in a morphologically rich language.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对比了阿拉伯语隐式方面识别中两种知识图谱策略：使用跨语言英语知识图谱（通过多语言嵌入）与构建原生阿拉伯语知识图谱。在三个阿拉伯语基准上的实验表明，原生阿拉伯语知识图谱在微F1上显著优于跨语言策略。同时比较了零样本提示与任务微调两种生成式提取器适应策略，发现任务微调在显式提取上远优于零样本。
Motivation: 阿拉伯语隐式方面识别需要辅助知识源，但低资源语言面临选择：重用成熟的英语知识图谱还是构建较小的原生阿拉伯语知识图谱。现有研究缺乏对这两种策略的受控比较。
Method: 提出一个统一的混合流水线，比较两种知识图谱策略（跨语言英语KG与原生阿拉伯KG）以及两种生成式提取器适应策略（零样本提示与8B参数LLM的任务微调）。
Result: 原生阿拉伯语知识图谱在M-ABSA和SemEval-2016上分别比跨语言策略提高+0.199和+0.251微F1。任务微调将显式提取微F1从≤0.13（零样本）提升至0.66-0.76，表明任务适应而非模型规模对形态丰富语言至关重要。
Conclusion: 摘要强调原生语言知识图谱和任务微调对阿拉伯语隐式方面识别的重要性，但未提及局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Importance-Aware OBS Pruning for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose importance-aware pruning for diffusion models, a training-free framework that prioritizes preserving parameters critical to semantically salient image regions. To do so, we incorporate spatial importance maps -- derived from conditioning signals or model attention -- into the pruning objective. This produces parameter rankings aligned with perceptual relevance rather than uniform reconstruction error. On MS-COCO dataset, our proposed approach consistently retains subject fidelity and structural correctness at high compression ratios where conventional pruning causes visible degradation. These results demonstrate that content-aware objectives are key to perceptually faithful compression of generative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向扩散模型的重要性感知剪枝框架，无需重新训练，通过引入空间重要性图（来自条件信号或模型注意力）来优先保留对语义显著图像区域关键的参数。在MS-COCO数据集上，该方法在高压缩比下保持了主体保真度和结构正确性，而传统剪枝会导致明显退化。
Motivation: 现有剪枝方法基于统一的参数重要性度量，无法区分图像中语义重要区域与背景区域，导致高压缩比下感知质量严重下降。
Method: 将空间重要性图（从条件信号或模型注意力中获取）融入剪枝目标，生成与感知相关性对齐的参数排序，而非基于均匀重构误差。
Result: 在MS-COCO数据集上，该方法在高压缩比下有效保留主体保真度和结构正确性，传统剪枝则产生可见退化。
Conclusion: 内容感知的剪枝目标对生成模型的感知保真压缩至关重要。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Test Case Prioritization for DNNs via Neural Collapse Instability
papers.abstract_en: With the widespread deployment of deep neural networks (DNNs) in safety-critical domains, reducing the cost of model validation under limited testing budgets has become increasingly important. Existing test case prioritization techniques often rely on single-checkpoint confidence signals derived from output probabilities. However, DNNs can be confidently wrong, and the confidence margin between the predicted and competing classes is frequently small, which weakens early fault discovery. To address this limitation, we propose a Neural-Collapse-Inspired Prioritization (NCIP) framework that replaces absolute confidence with cross-checkpoint prediction variability in the terminal training regime, where model geometry becomes highly structured. NCIP introduces two key components. First, it selects an NC-guided representative subset of training checkpoints using an equiangularity score of classifier weights, quantified as the standard deviation of pairwise cosine similarities among class weight vectors. Second, it prioritizes test inputs by their prediction variability across the selected checkpoints, surfacing boundary-adjacent and failure-prone samples that are unstable under checkpoint-induced decision boundary shifts. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and architectures show that NCIP achieves strong performance in early fault discovery compared with competitive baselines, with 1.5 to 16.6 percent RAUC-ALL gains and 4.9 to 20.6 percent RAUC-500 gains under the same testing budget. NCIP further attains the best average performance across all dataset-model pairs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对深度神经网络测试用例优先级排序问题，提出基于神经坍缩（Neural Collapse）的NCIP框架。该方法利用跨检查点预测变异性替代传统单检查点置信度，通过选择NC引导的代表性检查点子集并依据预测变异性排序测试输入，在多个数据集和架构上实现1.5-16.6% RAUC-ALL和4.9-20.6% RAUC-500的提升。
Motivation: 现有测试用例优先级排序技术依赖单检查点置信度（如输出概率），但DNN可能自信地犯错且置信度边际小，导致早期故障发现能力不足。
Method: 提出NCIP框架：1）使用分类器权重的等角性分数（pairwise余弦相似度的标准差）选择NC引导的代表性训练检查点子集；2）根据测试输入在所选检查点上的预测变异性进行排序，暴露决策边界附近且不稳定的失败样本。
Result: 在多个数据集和架构上的实验表明，同等测试预算下，NCIP相比竞争基线在RAUC-ALL上获得1.5-16.6%提升，在RAUC-500上获得4.9-20.6%提升，并在所有数据集-模型对上取得最佳平均性能。
Conclusion: 摘要指出NCIP在早期故障发现上表现优异，但未明确讨论局限性或适用范围。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PN-QNN: Harnessing Physical Noise as a Native Regularizer in Photonic Hybrid Quantum Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Physical noise in near-term quantum hardware is usually treated as a nuisance to suppress. We ask whether it can instead act as a hardware-native regularizer for photonic hybrid quantum-classical neural networks (PHQCNNs), analogous to noise-injection regularization in classical deep learning. Using Quandela's Perceval simulator and the MerLin framework, we build PHQCNNs for Iris, Digits, and MNIST and inject Perceval's seven-parameter physical noise model directly into training. A genetic algorithm searches the six continuous noise dimensions and 1 boolean parameter to find, per dataset, the configuration maximizing validation accuracy, compared against a noiseless baseline across five seeds. GA-tuned noise yields modest accuracy gains on Iris (+0.82pp) and Digits (+1.45pp), but a clear degradation on MNIST (-1.21pp). Per-parameter sweeps show that no individual noise parameter is consistently beneficial, motivating the joint search, while a second-order loss expansion shows that physical noise induces a Tikhonov-like regularization term whose effect is dataset-dependent. Physical photonic noise can thus act as a free regularizer, but not universally.
papers.comment: Accepted at the IEEE International Conference on Quantum Computing and Engineering (QCE), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索了光量子混合经典神经网络（PHQCNN）中物理噪声作为硬件原生正则化器的可能性。利用Quandela的Perceval模拟器和MerLin框架，在Iris、Digits和MNIST数据集上训练PHQCNN，并通过遗传算法搜索噪声参数配置。结果显示，调节噪声在Iris和Digits上有微小准确率提升（+0.82pp和+1.45pp），但在MNIST上下降（-1.21pp）。物理噪声可作为一种免费正则化器，但效果依赖于数据集。
Motivation: 近期的量子硬件中的物理噪声通常被视为需要抑制的干扰，本文提出是否可将其作为类似经典深度学习中的噪声注入正则化方法来利用。
Method: 构建光量子混合经典神经网络（PHQCNN），使用Perceval模拟器的七参数物理噪声模型，在训练中直接注入噪声。通过遗传算法搜索六维连续噪声参数和一布尔参数，针对每个数据集寻找最大化验证准确率的配置，并与无噪声基线比较。
Result: 遗传算法调节的噪声在Iris上提升0.82个百分点，在Digits上提升1.45个百分点，但在MNIST上下降1.21个百分点。单参数扫描表明没有单个噪声参数一致有益，二阶损失展开表明物理噪声引入类似Tikhonov正则化项，但效果依赖于数据集。
Conclusion: 物理光量子噪声可以作为免费正则化器，但并非普遍适用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Systematic Benchmark of Intensity Normalisation Methods for 3D Knee MRI Segmentation and Cross-Domain Generalisability
papers.abstract_en: Robust out-of-the-box performance is essential for the clinical deployment of deep learning models in medical imaging. An important but underexplored factor affecting model generalisability is intensity normalisation, particularly for magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), where image intensities vary across scanners and protocols. In this study, we systematically compared seven normalisation methods and their impact on the performance of a 3D U-Net model for meniscus segmentation from knee MRI. The methods included standard scaling approaches, histogram-based techniques, and a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM)-based method. Models were trained on the IWOAI 2019 dataset and evaluated on both internal and external test sets (SKM-TEA) to assess generalisability. Performance was similar internally but differences were significant on external data, with Z-score, Nyúl histogram matching, and CLAHE showing greater robustness than other methods. However, these differences were small compared to the significant performance drop observed between datasets. Overall, while intensity normalisation had a measurable effect on model generalisability, its impact was limited relative to the effects of domain shift, highlighting the need for complementary strategies for robust deployment.
papers.comment: This preprint has not undergone peer review or any post-submission improvements or corrections. The Version of Record of this contribution is published in 3Oth Annual Conference on Medical Image Understanding and Analysis, MIUA 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/oliverjm1/mri_normalisation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了七种强度归一化方法对3D U-Net模型在膝关节MRI半月板分割任务中的性能影响，包括内部和外部数据集上的泛化性评估。结果表明，归一化方法在内部数据上表现相似，但在外部数据上存在显著差异，其中Z-score、Nyúl直方图匹配和CLAHE表现更鲁棒；然而，与数据域偏移造成的性能下降相比，归一化的影响相对有限。
Motivation: 强度归一化是影响MRI模型泛化性的一个重要但探索不足的因素，尤其在图像强度随扫描仪和协议变化的临床部署场景中。
Method: 系统比较七种归一化方法（包括标准缩放、基于直方图的方法和高斯混合模型方法），使用IWOAI 2019数据集训练3D U-Net，并在内部和外部测试集（SKM-TEA）上评估泛化性。
Result: 内部数据上性能相似，但外部数据上差异显著；Z-score、Nyúl直方图匹配和CLAHE表现出更高的鲁棒性；然而，归一化带来的改善远小于数据集间域偏移导致的性能下降。
Conclusion: 强度归一化对模型泛化性有可测量影响，但相对于域偏移效果有限，强调需要互补策略以实现稳健的临床部署。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 系统比较七种归一化方法（包括标准缩放、基于直方图的方法和高斯混合模型方法），使用IWOAI 2019数据集训练3D U-Net，并在内部和外部测试集（SKM-TEA）上评估泛化性。
summary_sections.result: 内部数据上性能相似，但外部数据上差异显著；Z-score、Nyúl直方图匹配和CLAHE表现出更高的鲁棒性；然而，归一化带来的改善远小于数据集间域偏移导致的性能下降。
summary_sections.conclusion: 强度归一化对模型泛化性有可测量影响，但相对于域偏移效果有限，强调需要互补策略以实现稳健的临床部署。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Heart Rate Variability Forecasting from Consumer Wearables Using Time Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Short-term Heart Rate Variability (HRV) forecasting could provide clinicians with actionable lead time for detecting autonomic dysfunction and adverse cardiac events. Consumer wearable devices generate fragmented, artifact-rich HRV signals that challenge conventional forecasting approaches. In this study, we evaluated the forecasting ability of three Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs), TimesFM, Chronos, and MOIRAI, against traditional baselines (Mean, Exponential Smoothing, and Exponentially Weighted Moving Average) on real-world wearable data collected from 49 healthy individuals. To address data fragmentation, we introduce a variability-preserving imputation method that augments linear interpolation with locally adaptive stochastic noise, retaining physiological dynamics essential for accurate forecasting. The results show that TSFMs outperformed all baselines without fine-tuning, achieving average Mean Absolute Scaled Error (MASE) between 0.81 and 0.87 across TSFMs and both context lengths (32 and 64 time steps), with Chronos and TimesFM as the top models, though MOIRAI showed limited gains over baselines. With up to a 2-hour forecast horizon, the results establish a baseline for TSFMs' performance on a real-world dataset, highlighting domain-specific fine-tuning as a promising direction for clinical deployment.
papers.comment: Accepted to Computing in Cardiology (CinC) 2026. 4 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了三种时间序列基础模型（TimesFM、Chronos、MOIRAI）在来自49名健康个体的真实可穿戴设备数据上的短时心率变异性（HRV）预测能力，提出一种保留变异性的插值方法处理数据碎片化问题。零样本情况下，TSFMs在所有基线之上取得平均MASE为0.81-0.87，但MOIRAI提升有限。
Motivation: 消费级可穿戴设备产生的HRV信号碎片化且含伪迹，传统预测方法难以处理，而短时HRV预测可为临床检测自主神经功能障碍和不良心脏事件提供前置时间。
Method: 引入一种保留变异性的插值方法，将线性插值与局部自适应随机噪声结合，保留生理动态；使用三个时间序列基础模型（TimesFM、Chronos、MOIRAI）进行零样本预测，并与均值、指数平滑等基线对比。
Result: TSFMs在32和64时间步两种上下文长度下均优于所有基线，平均MASE为0.81-0.87；Chronos和TimesFM表现最佳，MOIRAI相比基线提升有限；预测时长达2小时。
Conclusion: TSFMs在真实世界可穿戴HRV数据上零样本表现良好，领域特定微调是临床部署的有前景方向。

papers.title: Global Difference Constraint Propagation for Constraint Programming
papers.abstract_en: Difference constraints of the form $x - y \leq d$ are well studied, with efficient algorithms for satisfaction and implication, because of their connection to shortest paths. Finite domain propagation algorithms, however, typically do not make use of these algorithms, and treat each difference constraint as a separate propagator. Propagation does guarantee completeness of solving, but can be needlessly slow. In this paper we describe how to build a (bounds consistent) global propagator for difference constraints that treats them all simultaneously. SAT modulo theory solvers have included theory solvers for difference constraints for some time. While a theory solver for difference constraints gives the basis of a global difference constraint propagator, we show how the requirements on the propagator are quite different. Crucially, we show how to explain propagations by a global difference constraint propagator, in order to use it within a lazy clause generation solver. We give experiments showing that treating difference constraints globally can substantially improve on the standard propagation approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为约束规划中的差异约束构建了一个全局传播器，同时处理所有差异约束，并展示了如何解释其传播以用于惰性子句生成求解器。实验表明，全局处理差异约束可显著优于标准传播方法。
Motivation: 传统有限域传播算法将每个差异约束视为独立传播器，导致求解缓慢；而差约束的全局传播在约束规划中尚未充分利用。
Method: 构建一个边界一致的全局传播器，同时处理所有差异约束，并展示如何生成传播解释以支持惰性子句生成求解器。
Result: 实验表明，全局差异约束传播器在多个问题上显著提升了传播效率。
Conclusion: 全局差异约束传播能有效加速约束求解，尤其是在惰性子句生成框架中。

papers.title: EvoDRC: A Self-Evolving Agentic Framework for Automated DRC Violation Repair
papers.abstract_en: Design rule check (DRC) closure remains a major bottleneck in advanced-node physical design. Although detailed routers are rule-aware, residual design rule violations (DRVs) often require manual engineering change order iterations. Automating this process is challenging because repairs must account for complex geometric interactions, preserve circuit connectivity, and avoid introducing new violations. We present EvoDRC, a skill-evolution framework for agentic block-level DRC repair. EvoDRC initializes layer-specific repair skills using knowledge distilled from an unrelated reference design and continuously evolves these skills using traceable repair experience collected from the target design. EvoDRC decomposes the layout into bounded repair regions and assigns an LLM repair agent to each region. Local DRC analysis, connectivity-checking, and impact-preview tools provide feedback on proposed modifications. Repair operations and their resulting DRV changes are stored in a knowledge database and used to evolve the repair skills. Experiments on seven block-level designs from the DAC26 DRC Benchmark show that EvoDRC achieves a 73.5\% overall reduction compared to the reported baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EvoDRC，一个自动修复版图设计规则违规（DRV）的技能进化框架。它从无关参考设计中提取知识初始化每层修复技能，然后利用目标设计的可追溯修复经验持续进化。布局被划分为有界区域，每个区域分配一个LLM修复代理，并通过本地DRC分析、连通性检查和影响预览工具提供反馈。在DAC26 DRC基准测试的7个块级设计上，相比基线，DRV总体减少73.5%。
Motivation: DRC闭合是先进节点物理设计的主要瓶颈，手动修复需要多次工程变更单迭代，且需考虑复杂几何交互、保持电路连通性并避免引入新违规。
Method: 提出技能进化框架：从无关参考设计蒸馏知识初始化层特定修复技能，在目标设计上通过可追溯修复经验连续进化；将布局分解为有界修复区域，每个区域由LLM代理负责，通过本地DRC分析、连通性检查和影响预览工具提供反馈；修复操作和DRV变化存储在知识库中用于进化。
Result: 在DAC26 DRC基准测试的7个块级设计上，与基线相比，DRV总体减少73.5%。
Conclusion: EvoDRC通过技能进化实现了自动化DRC修复，显著减少违规数量，并展示了利用经验进化修复技能的有效性。

papers.title: Drift-Aware RL-based Wavelet Denoising for Network-Traffic Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Traffic-utilisation measurements for network monitoring are corrupted by additive noise and statistical drift: time-dependent change in the signal's mean, variance, distributional shape, or tail behaviour. Static wavelet denoising, calibrated under stationary independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) Gaussian assumptions, becomes mismatched under drift and, at moderate-to-high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), over-suppresses useful structure and degrades monitoring decisions. We propose a drift-aware framework treating adaptive wavelet denoising as a preprocessing layer optimised for two tasks: anomaly detection, recovering the multi-scale transient load bursts that noise and drift obscure, and capacity estimation, recovering the operational required capacity $C_{95}$ (95th percentile of utilisation). Because localised bursts are multi-scale structure a wavelet preserves but a low-pass filter removes, detection discriminates denoiser families. A four-detector gate (Page-Hinkley, variance-ratio, Jensen-Shannon, Anderson-Darling) determines when to invoke a learned policy, and a Proximal Policy Optimization agent selects a per-window wavelet configuration over a mixed discrete-continuous action space. Unlike prior work, the reward is downstream task utility, not reconstruction fidelity. The denoiser is benchmarked, per drift type and input SNR, against a low-pass moving-average filter, VisuShrink, SureShrink, BayesShrink, and a Wiener filter. Defining the anomaly target on the clean signal and the drift gate on the corruption keeps both stages non-circular.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向网络流量异常检测的漂移感知小波去噪框架，利用强化学习（PPO）根据漂移类型和信噪比自适应选择小波配置，以恢复多尺度突发负载并优化下游任务（异常检测和容量估计）。
Motivation: 静态小波去噪在统计漂移（均值、方差等时变）和中等至高信噪比下会过度压制有用结构，导致网络监测决策退化。现有方法未针对漂移自适应调整去噪策略。
Method: 框架包含四检测器门控（Page-Hinkley、方差比、Jensen-Shannon、Anderson-Darling）触发学习策略，PPO智能体在混合离散-连续动作空间中选择每窗口小波配置，奖励基于下游任务效用而非重建保真度。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，但声称该方法在漂移类型和输入信噪比下优于低通移动平均滤波器、VisuShrink、SureShrink、BayesShrink和维纳滤波器。
Conclusion: 该工作强调将自适应小波去噪作为预处理层，通过下游任务驱动优化，并利用漂移门控避免循环验证。

papers.title: Generalized Kalman filter based temporal difference reinforcement learning
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we present a generalized temporal-difference (TD) reinforcement learning framework based on the theory of conditional expectations. The value and action-value (Q-value) functions are treated as uncertain quantities, and their estimation is formulated as a stochastic inference problem. Unlike classical Kalman-based temporal-difference learning, which relies on linear-Gaussian assumptions, the proposed formulation is derived directly from the conditional expectation framework and naturally extends to nonlinear models and non-Gaussian probability distributions. The proposed method recursively estimates not only the conditional expectation of the value function but also its second probabilistic moment, thereby quantifying the uncertainty associated with the learned value function throughout the learning process. To obtain a computationally tractable algorithm, the stochastic problem is discretized using either polynomial chaos expansions or ensemble-based approximations, providing efficient representations of the underlying random variables. The proposed framework is demonstrated on two optimal control problems: a linear mass--spring--damper system and a nonlinear heat conduction problem in a closed cavity. The numerical examples illustrate the capability of the proposed method to accurately estimate both the value function and its associated uncertainty, while extending classical Kalman-based temporal-difference learning to a broader class of stochastic systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于条件期望理论提出一种广义的时间差分（TD）强化学习框架，将值函数视为不确定量，递归估计其一阶和二阶矩，利用多项式混沌展开或集成近似进行离散化，扩展了经典卡尔曼滤波TD学习到非线性非高斯系统。线性质量-弹簧-阻尼系统和非线性封闭空腔热传导问题的数值实验验证了该方法能准确估计值函数及其不确定性。
Motivation: 经典卡尔曼滤波TD学习局限于线性高斯假设，无法处理非线性或非高斯分布系统。
Method: 从条件期望框架直接推导广义TD学习，递归估计值函数的条件期望和二阶概率矩，并通过多项式混沌展开或集成近似实现可计算算法。
Result: 在线性质量-弹簧-阻尼系统和非线性封闭空腔热传导问题上的数值实验表明，该方法能准确估计值函数及其不确定性。
Conclusion: 该方法将经典卡尔曼滤波TD学习扩展到更广泛的随机系统，具有处理非线性非高斯系统的能力。

papers.title: Safe Remediation as Risk-Constrained Intervention Decision in Microservice Systems
papers.abstract_en: In modern IT operations (IT-Ops), the cost of an incorrect repair often exceeds the cost of no action at all. Yet existing automated remediation systems are designed to generate actions rather than to decide whether intervention is warranted, leaving safety as an afterthought enforced by manual approval. This paper makes three contributions to close this gap: (i) we reformulate safe remediation as a risk-constrained intervention decision problem and cast it as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP), in which the agent maximizes repair success subject to a bounded false remediation rate (FRR); (ii) we introduce a three-dimensional risk decomposition comprising blast radius, reversibility, and epistemic uncertainty, providing operators with an interpretable per-action safety interface; and (iii) we design a context-adaptive human-in-the-loop (HITL) gate that turns escalation from a binary failsafe into a bandwidth-aware control layer responsive to on-call load and business criticality. The full policy is learned offline from historical incident logs, enabling explicit control of the expected FRR. Experiments on the Train Ticket microservice benchmark with Chaos Mesh fault injection and an RCAEval-aligned fault taxonomy show that our framework reduces FRR by 39% while improving repair success by 2.5 points over a strong runbook baseline, and reduces on-call escalation load by 17% relative to a fixed-threshold variant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对微服务系统中的自动化修复安全问题，提出将安全修复视为风险约束的干预决策问题，并建模为受约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）。引入包含爆炸半径、可逆性和认知不确定性的三维风险分解，以及上下文自适应的人机协作门控机制。实验表明，该方法在Train Ticket基准上降低了39%的错误修复率，同时提升了修复成功率。
Motivation: 现有自动化修复系统注重生成修复动作，但缺乏对是否应该干预的决策，导致错误修复成本可能高于不修复。需要一种安全优先的干预决策框架。
Method: 将安全修复建模为CMDP，优化修复成功同时约束错误修复率（FRR）。提出三维风险分解（爆炸半径、可逆性、认知不确定性）和上下文自适应人机协作门控，离线从历史日志学习策略。

papers.title: Taming the Security-Energy Paradox: A Green AI Approach to Optimized Android Malware Detection
papers.abstract_en: An increase in advanced Android malware requires the use of deep learning models, which can run on Android devices. But there is a trade-off between security and energy use, as strong detection models can drain the battery of devices fast. This work tests different Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) model configurations to balance malware detection performance and energy efficiency. In this work, we compared standard FP32 models with optimized INT8 quantized neural networks with different model depths using TUANDROMD and DREBIN datasets for both classification performance and energy consumption. The results show that INT8 quantization reduces model size by about 3.5 times with a decrease in energy consumption to 0.0189 mJ per inference, while maintaining more than 99.2\% detection accuracy. We found that shallow quantized architectures, such as 3-layer and 4-layer QNNs, reduce energy costs by improving throughput and shortening the time of CPU operating in a high-power state. This work shows that efficient malware protection can be achieved on resource-constrained smartphones and provides a foundation for Green AI in mobile security.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Android恶意软件检测中安全性与能耗之间的矛盾，测试不同多层感知机（MLP）配置，包括标准FP32和INT8量化模型，在TUANDROMD和DREBIN数据集上平衡检测性能和能效。结果显示INT8量化将模型大小减少约3.5倍，每次推理能耗降至0.0189 mJ，同时保持超过99.2%的检测准确率。浅层量化架构（如3层和4层QNN）通过提高吞吐量和缩短CPU高功率状态时间来降低能耗。
Motivation: 先进Android恶意软件需要能够在设备上运行的深度学习模型，但强检测模型会快速耗尽设备电池，存在安全性与能耗之间的权衡。
Method: 比较不同深度的标准FP32模型与INT8量化神经网络（QNN）在TUANDROMD和DREBIN数据集上的分类性能和能耗，特别评估浅层量化架构的能源效率。
Result: INT8量化将模型大小减少约3.5倍，每次推理能耗降至0.0189 mJ，检测准确率保持在99.2%以上。浅层3层和4层QNN降低了能耗。
Conclusion: 本文证明在资源受限的智能手机上可以实现高效的恶意软件防护，为移动安全中的绿色AI提供基础。

papers.title: Post-Training in Time Series Foundation Models: A Unifying Framework
papers.abstract_en: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) have emerged as general-purpose models for time series analysis, but pretraining alone is often insufficient for reliable downstream deployment. Bridging this gap requires further intervention to handle domain shift, task heterogeneity, limited supervision, and computational constraints, which motivates post-training as a broad class of methods to adapt, augment, compose, calibrate, or specialize pretrained TSFMs for downstream tasks. In this work, we analyze TSFM post-training methods based on their locus of intervention in the prediction pipeline, yielding five categories: parameter adaptation, context augmentation, model composition, output processing and uncertainty control, and compression and specialization. Within each category, we study main representative methods and discuss their current limitations. We further identify future directions toward controlled adaptation, reliable context construction, uncertainty-aware model composition, calibrated output processing, and deployment-aware specialization. Overall, by providing a unifying framework for the emerging TSFM post-training landscape, this work aims to support future research to navigate the design space between a pretrained TSFM and its reliable downstream deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时间序列基础模型（TSFM）预训练后仍不足以部署的问题，提出后训练方法的统一框架，将方法分为参数自适应、上下文增强、模型组合、输出处理与不确定性控制、压缩与专门化五类，并讨论了每类方法的局限与未来方向。
Motivation: 预训练TSFM在领域迁移、任务异质性、有限监督和计算约束下直接部署不可靠，需要后训练方法桥接差距。
Method: 通过对TSFM后训练方法在预测管道中的干预点进行分类，建立了五类方法的统一框架，并分析了代表性方法。
Result: 论文识别了各类方法的当前局限，并指出了未来方向，如受控适应、可靠上下文构建、不确定性感知模型组合、校准输出处理和部署感知专门化。
Conclusion: 本文为TSFM后训练提供了统一视角，旨在帮助后续研究在预训练TSFM与可靠下游部署之间导航设计空间。

papers.title: Are Attributions of Consciousness to AI Chatbots Epistemically Innocent?
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots (e.g., ChatGPT) can communicate in strikingly humanlike ways. This has prompted many chatbot users to attribute psychological properties, including consciousness, to these systems. However, there is little scientific evidence that current AI chatbots are conscious. How, then, should we understand people's consciousness attributions to chatbots? Are they merely metaphorical claims, or do they express genuine beliefs? If these attributions lack evidential support, are users epistemically blameworthy for making them, or might they be epistemically innocent, yielding significant benefits otherwise unattainable? This paper offers a conceptual analysis of consciousness attributions to AI chatbots and develops a multidimensional taxonomy of the attitudes they may express, ranging from non-doxastic stances (e.g., pretence) to different forms of belief, including delusions. This taxonomy helps avoid conflations by showing that linguistically identical attributions can reflect importantly different attitudes and degrees of epistemic commitment to the proposition that chatbots are conscious. The taxonomy also provides a framework for empirical studies to operationalize and measure different forms of epistemic commitment to AI consciousness. Using this taxonomy, I argue that although some consciousness attributions to chatbots are epistemically benign, and even some irrational ones may be epistemically innocent, many others render the attributor epistemically blameworthy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对用户将意识归因于 AI 聊天机器人进行概念分析和分类学构建，探讨这些归因是否具有认识论上的正当性。
Motivation: 人们普遍将意识等心理属性归因于聊天机器人，但缺乏科学证据，本文旨在理解这些归因的本质及其认识论地位。
Method: 通过概念分析，提出一个多维分类法，区分从假装到不同形式的信念（包括妄想）等态度。
Result: 指出一些意识归因在认识论上是良性的，甚至某些非理性的归因可能是认识论上无罪的，但许多其他归因使得归因者在认识论上应受责备。
Conclusion: 分类法有助于避免混淆，并为未来实证研究提供操作化框架。

papers.title: Good Practice Guide for quantifying uncertainties for machine learning models applied to photoplethysmography signals
papers.abstract_en: This Good Practice Guide presents work done in the QUMPHY project (Uncertainty quantification for machine learning models applied to photoplethysmography signals) that considered both machine learning and uncertainty quantification for problems which used photoplethysmography (PPG) signals from wearable devices as input. It provides high-level guidance on what types of machine learning model might be used and how different models compare when applied to both regression and classification tasks. It provides guidance on the implementation of different methods for uncertainty quantification, covering both model-dependent and model-independent techniques, and on the validation of the results provided by those methods. It also describes six benchmark problems together with pointers to different benchmark datasets for each problem. Software is described that can assist practitioners in implementing the methods described herein and there is a brief consideration of ethical issues. It concludes with a summary and recommendations.

papers.title: CLARK: Closed-loop Learning for Adaptive Reasoning over Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Machine Learning models are widely used for automating classification tasks by extracting statistical patterns from data. However, their performance deteriorates if the data distribution changes, making them ill-suited to handle uncertain and evolving information. Moreover, they provide limited support for integrating prior knowledge. To address these limitations, we present CLARK (Closed-loop Learning for Adaptive Reasoning over Knowledge Graphs), a framework that integrates knowledge graphs, symbolic rule mining, and probabilistic reasoning under the Logic Programs with Markov Logic Networks (LP$^{\text{MLN}}$) formalism. Starting from CACTUS-derived KGs, CLARK translates graph structure into an LP$^{\text{MLN}}$ program and iteratively enriches it with candidate rules proposed by symbolic learners. These rules are calibrated through probabilistic weight learning, enabling reasoning under uncertainty and refinement of the underlying graph structure. We evaluate CLARK on two medical datasets, analysing both rule quality and downstream classification performance. Results demonstrate that CLARK leads to improved classification performance and more generalisable inference. Overall, CLARK provides a principled approach to constructing adaptive, interpretable, knowledge-driven models for classification.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 3 Figures, 1 algorithm, 3 tables, submitted to The International Semantic Web Conference'26
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLARK 是一个集成知识图谱、符号规则挖掘和概率推理的框架，用于自适应分类。它利用 CACTUS 构建的知识图谱，将其转换为 LP^MLN 程序，并通过迭代添加候选规则和概率权重学习来优化推理。在医学数据集上的实验表明，该框架提升了分类性能和推理的泛化能力。

Method: 提出 CLARK 框架，首先从 CACTUS 派生知识图谱，将其转化为 LP^MLN 程序，然后通过符号学习器生成候选规则，并通过概率权重学习进行校准，实现不确定性推理和图结构优化。
Result: 在两个医学数据集上，CLARK 改善了分类性能，并实现了更可泛化的推理。
Conclusion: CLARK 提供了一种构建自适应、可解释、知识驱动分类模型的原则性方法。

papers.title: Toward Seasonal Guidelines for Robust Deep-Learning Sentinel-2 Building Detection in Different Area Types
papers.abstract_en: Sentinel-2 imagery offers open access, global coverage, and frequent revisit times, making it attractive for practical building mapping at scale; however, its native 10m resolution makes building vs non-building classification challenging, particularly for small or sub-pixel buildings, and performance can vary with both seasonality and the heterogeneity of built-up environments. This paper introduces a Sentinel-2 building-detection framework designed to systematically quantify these effects and to support more formalised, practice-oriented model selection. We construct a dedicated multi-temporal Sentinel-2 dataset over the Warsaw region and derive binary ground-truth masks by rasterising official Polish topographic database (BDOT10k) building footprints onto the Sentinel-2 pixel grid. Using two established convolutional segmentation backbones (U-Net and DeepLabV3+), we first perform scene-specific fine-tuning to select a robust architecture and identify the best monthly models for L1C and L2A products separately. We then conduct cross-temporal inference by applying each best monthly model to all scenes, enabling an assessment of (i) which months provide favourable training and inference conditions, (ii) how performance transfers between seasons, (iii) the impact of processing level, and (iv) how these effects differ across built-up typologies. Based on these results, we provide practical guidance for routine Sentinel-2 building classification under varying acquisition periods and settlement characteristics.

TL;DR: 本文针对 Sentinel-2 影像在不同区域类型和季节下建筑物检测的鲁棒性问题，构建了华沙地区的多时相数据集，采用 U-Net 和 DeepLabV3+ 进行场景微调，系统评估了不同月份、处理级别（L1C/L2A）和建成区类型对检测性能的影响，并提供了实用指南。
Motivation: Sentinel-2 的 10m 分辨率使建筑物检测具有挑战性，且季节性和建成环境异质性会影响性能，缺乏系统性的量化评估和选择指南。
Method: 基于官方波兰地形数据库（BDOT10k）的建筑物足迹栅格化生成二值掩膜，构建多时相 Sentinel-2 数据集；使用 U-Net 和 DeepLabV3+ 进行场景特定微调，选择最佳月度模型，然后进行跨时相推理以分析季节、处理级别和区域类型的影响。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值，但表明能够识别有利的训练和推理月份、季节间性能迁移情况、处理级别的影响以及不同建成区类型上的差异。
Conclusion: 提供了针对不同采集时期和居民点特征的 Sentinel-2 建筑物分类实用指导。

summary_sections.conclusion: 提供了针对不同采集时期和居民点特征的 Sentinel-2 建筑物分类实用指导。

papers.title: TINY_SCHILLER: A Drop-In German Drama Corpus for Small Language Models
papers.abstract_en: tiny_schiller closes the small-language-model prototyping, fine-tuning, education, and research gap for German literary text, providing a single-file, drop-in counterpart to Karpathy's tiny_shakespeare. The available German literary corpora are larger and richer, but require parser engineering before a single line of training or fine-tuning code can run. tiny_schiller is a 2.07-megabyte single file of eleven public-domain Schiller dramas, sourced from DraCor's GerDraCor export (CC0) and processed by deterministic parser engineering. Character-level, GPT-2 byte-pair encoding, and cl100k_base tokenization splits, an instruction-formatted dialogue-completion split, and 89 per-character persona splits load from a single HuggingFace call. A small language model literally reaches German literary text in one line of code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TINY_SCHILLER 是一个面向小语言模型的德语戏剧语料库，类似 Karpathy 的 tiny_shakespeare，提供单文件、即插即用的数据。该语料库包含 11 部席勒的公共领域戏剧，大小为 2.07 MB，来自 GerDraCor 导出（CC0），通过确定性解析工程处理。它支持字符级、GPT-2 BPE、cl100k_base 分词拆分，以及指令格式对话拆分和 89 个角色人格拆分，可通过一行 HuggingFace 调用加载。

Method: 从 DraCor 的 GerDraCor 导出（CC0）中提取 11 部席勒戏剧，通过确定性解析工程处理成单个 2.07 MB 文件。提供多种 tokenization 拆分（字符级、GPT-2 BPE、cl100k_base）、指令格式对话拆分以及每个角色的 89 个人格拆分，所有拆分均可通过一次 HuggingFace 调用加载。
Result: 该语料库支持小语言模型在德语文学文本上的即用训练，只需一行代码即可加载。摘要未报告具体的训练或评估结果。
Conclusion: 该语料库直接弥合了小语言模型在德语文学文本上的数据空白，使得小语言模型能够以极简代码访问德语文学文本。

papers.title: STEREOFLOW: Progressive Stereo Matching with StereoDiT and Transition Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Stereo matching is a fundamental task in 3D reconstruction. Despite remarkable advances, the prevailing paradigms formulate stereo matching as a deterministic regression problem, collapsing the multimodal distribution modeling into a single-point estimation. This formulation suffers from a regression-to-mean bias, frequently struggling with ambiguous regions. In contrast, we introduce a prior-guided generative framework that integrates deterministic matching regression and generative distribution modeling within a complementary formulation. Built upon this formulation, we introduce StereoFlow through three key components: (i) a two-stage progressive cascade matching network that progressively produces multi-resolution stereo conditions with complementary matching cues; (ii) a pixel diffusion transformer (termed StereoDiT) with a frequency-decoupled architecture for modeling correspondence ambiguity; (iii) a few-step flow matching objective (termed Transition Flow Matching) for efficient optimization. In summary, \textsc{\textbf{StereoFlow}} achieves strong geometric consistency and rich fine-grained details in ill-posed, discontinuous regions and under zero-shot generalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed StereoFlow establishes multiple state-of-the-art results across benchmarks, including Scene Flow, KITTI, ETH3D, and Middlebury.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StereoFlow，一种将确定性匹配回归与生成式分布建模相结合的立体匹配框架，用于处理歧义区域。该方法包含渐进级联匹配网络、频率解耦的像素扩散变换器（StereoDiT）以及少步流匹配目标（Transition Flow Matching），在多个基准上取得最优结果。
Motivation: 现有立体匹配方法通常建模为确定性回归，导致多模态分布被压缩为单点估计，在模糊区域易出现回归到均值偏差。
Method: 提出先验引导的生成框架，包含三部分：两阶段渐进级联匹配网络生成多分辨率立体条件；频率解耦的像素扩散变换器（StereoDiT）建模对应歧义；少步流匹配目标（Transition Flow Matching）实现高效优化。
Result: 在Scene Flow、KITTI、ETH3D和Middlebury等多个基准上取得多项最优结果，在病态、不连续区域和零样本泛化下表现出强几何一致性和丰富细节。
Conclusion: StereoFlow将确定性回归与生成式建模互补结合，有效处理立体匹配中的模糊区域，并实现高效优化。

papers.title: Coordinating from Memory: Graph-Structured Experience Reuse for Multi-Agent Adaptation in Dynamic Manufacturing
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic manufacturing environments require multi-agent systems to coordinate effectively under frequent operational disturbances such as machine failures, urgent job arrivals, and processing time variations. Existing multi-agent reinforcement learning approaches treat each disturbance episode independently, discarding valuable coordination experience that could accelerate future adaptation. In this paper, we propose a Graph-Structured Experiential Memory (GSEM) framework for multi-agent coordination in dynamic manufacturing. The framework encodes historical coordination episodes as heterogeneous relational graphs that capture task dependencies, machine states, and inter-agent collaboration patterns. When a new disturbance occurs, a graph neural network-based retrieval mechanism identifies structurally similar past episodes, enabling experience-guided policy adaptation rather than learning from scratch. Experiments on dynamic flexible job-shop scheduling benchmarks with three disturbance types show that GSEM reduces makespan by 4.1%-10.0% and adaptation time by 33%-38% compared to the strongest memory-augmented baseline, with the advantage increasing under higher disturbance frequency. Ablation studies and cross-disturbance transfer experiments further validate the necessity of graph-structured encoding and similarity-based retrieval and demonstrate the cross-disturbance generalizability of learned coordination patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出图结构经验记忆（GSEM）框架，用于动态制造环境下的多智能体协调。该框架将历史协调经验编码为异构图，通过图神经网络检索相似经验以加速策略适应。在动态柔性作业车间调度基准上，GSEM在三种干扰类型下相比最强基线降低了4.1%-10.0%的完工时间和33%-38%的适应时间。
Motivation: 现有多智能体强化学习方法在处理动态制造环境中的干扰（如机器故障、紧急任务到达）时，每次干扰独立处理，丢弃了有价值的协调经验，导致适应慢。
Method: 提出GSEM框架，将历史协调经验编码为异构关系图，捕获任务依赖、机器状态和智能体协作模式；当新干扰发生时，利用图神经网络检索结构相似的历史经验，指导策略适应。
Result: 在动态柔性作业车间调度基准上，GSEM减少完工时间4.1%-10.0%，适应时间33%-38%，优势在高频干扰下更明显；消融实验验证了图结构编码和相似性检索的必要性，跨干扰迁移实验展示了所学协调模式的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 图结构经验记忆能够有效加速多智能体系统在动态制造中的适应，且协调模式具有跨干扰类型泛化性。

papers.title: Forecasting the Number of Harvest-ready Fruits of Sweet Peppers Using Multimodal Time-Series Data
papers.abstract_en: Accurate yield forecasting at the individual-plant level is critical for precision agriculture and supply-chain planning, yet public datasets capturing both visual growth dynamics and per-plant measurement labels are scarce. In this paper, we introduce a novel, annotated image time-series dataset of 691 sweet pepper plants monitored over two growing seasons, comprising 4837 images with per-plant fruit counts categorized by maturity. We propose a multimodal deep learning framework that fuses high-dimensional image features, extracted using the DinoV3 encoder, with numerical count measurements. Our architecture utilizes a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network to model temporal dependencies and handles irregular sampling intervals common in greenhouse monitoring. Through quantitative experiments, we demonstrate that this multimodal approach reduces RMSE over a persistence baseline by 33% and 38% in the 2022 and 2023 seasons, respectively, with a further 1.2% average gain over a measurement-only model. Furthermore, we employ Deep Ensembles and Gaussian Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL) to provide calibrated uncertainty estimates, with an Uncertainty Calibration Error (UCE) ranging from 0.39 to 0.89 depending on the cross-season evaluation direction, offering a principled confidence signal for real-world agricultural decision-making. We release the dataset and code to support reproducible research and to accelerate development of data-driven yield forecasting methods for horticultural crops.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个包含691株甜椒、4837张图像并标注了每株果实成熟度的多季时间序列数据集，并提出一种多模态深度学习框架，融合DinoV3图像特征与数值计数，利用LSTM建模时序依赖并处理不规则采样间隔。实验显示该方法在预测成熟果实数量上RMSE比持久性基线降低33%-38%，并提供了校准后的不确定性估计。
Motivation: 单株水平的准确产量预测对精准农业和供应链规划至关重要，但缺乏同时包含视觉生长动态和每株测量标签的公开数据集。
Method: 提出多模态框架：使用DinoV3编码器提取图像特征，与数值测量值融合，通过LSTM建模时间依赖；采用Deep Ensembles和Gaussian负对数似然提供校准的不确定性估计。
Result: 在2022和2023季，多模态方法相比持久性基线分别降低RMSE 33%和38%，相比仅测量模型平均提升1.2%；不确定性校准误差UCE在0.39-0.89之间。
Conclusion: 论文强调该数据集和方法为数据驱动的园艺作物产量预测奠定了可重复研究的基础，有助于实际农业决策。

papers.title: Time Series Network Utilization KPI Forecasting Using Advanced AI/ML Models
papers.abstract_en: The rapid proliferation of data-intensive applications, cloud infrastructure, and IoT ecosystems has made proactive resource provisioning critical for maintaining optimal network performance. However, network administrators face a constant battle against capacity constraints, where traditional reactive approaches fail to accurately anticipate traffic fluctuations. This inability to foresee demand leads to costly over-provisioning, unexpected downtime, and degraded quality of service directly impacting operational budgets and business continuity. To achieve efficient capacity planning, accurate forecasting of bandwidth utilization is essential. This study addresses the challenge by evaluating a diverse spectrum of models including seasonal decomposition, Prophet, Random Forest, XGBoost, Support Vector Regression, and advanced deep learning architectures like bidirectional and Convolutional LSTMs - using a common interface dataset benchmarked across MAPE, NRMSE, and R-square metrics. Ultimately, this research delivers actionable insights into the trade-offs between model accuracy and computational efficiency, empowering engineers, operators, and business owners to select the optimal forecasting model for their specific infrastructure needs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对网络带宽利用率预测问题，评估了季节性分解法、Prophet、随机森林、XGBoost、支持向量回归以及双向和卷积LSTM等多样化的时间序列模型。在统一接口数据集上使用MAPE、NRMSE和R平方指标进行基准测试，旨在为网络管理员提供主动资源规划的工具，并揭示了模型准确性与计算效率之间的权衡。
Motivation: 传统反应式资源管理无法准确预测流量波动，导致过度配置或服务质量下降，威胁运营预算和业务连续性，因此需要准确的带宽利用率预测以支持主动容量规划。
Method: 在一个通用接口数据集上，系统比较了从经典统计方法（季节性分解、Prophet）到机器学习（随机森林、XGBoost、SVR）再到深度学习（双向LSTM、卷积LSTM）的多种预测模型，并使用MAPE、NRMSE和R平方指标衡量性能。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但指出研究提供了模型准确性与计算效率之间权衡的可操作洞察，帮助选择最适合特定基础设施的预测模型。
Conclusion: 研究为工程师、运营商和业务所有者选择最优带宽利用率预测模型提供了实际指导，强调了在准确性和计算开销之间进行权衡的重要性。

papers.title: The Giant Hippocampus: From Structural Monoculture to a System of Systems
papers.abstract_en: AI researchers describe state-of-the-art models as one thing repeated at scale: the Transformer, wired identically for text, pixels, or speech. Neuroscientists describe the cortex as a mosaic - dense Layer 4 in visual cortex for spatial encoding, thick Layers 5/6 in motion cortex for temporal integration - different jobs solved by different structures. This paper argues the gap is a structural error, not a stylistic one, and is measurable. A century of cytoarchitecture, from Brodmann to single-cell Patch-seq, shows distinct cognitive functions are implemented by qualitatively different structures, not by rescaling one template. The convolutional neural network is the field's own proof: local receptive fields and hierarchical depth encoded this prior directly, reaching strong image recognition on far less data than later architectures needed. The paper traces how this lesson was discarded: the "Hardware Lottery" made the Transformer the path of least resistance, not the principled choice, and Mixture-of-Experts, often cited as diversity, in fact partitions parameters among identical experts. A functionalist analysis shows the Transformer is best understood as a functional analog of the hippocampal formation, not a general-purpose cortex - the same mistake as treating cortex as one giant Broca's area, except the field has now standardized on a giant hippocampus, applied to tasks it was never built for: audition, executive gating, working memory. The paper closes with an alternative: a Heterogeneous Topological Network, a System of Systems in which distinct modules keep the inductive bias their computation demands and communicate through standardized interfaces. This is a design discipline for AI architects, not cognitive science: specify modularity before training, using structural evidence as a design input rather than reverse-engineering architecture from a trained model's behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对比了AI模型（如Transformer）的单一结构与大脑皮层的异质性结构，指出当前AI领域错误地将海马体功能的模拟（而非皮层通用计算）作为标准架构。通过分析从Brodmann到单细胞Patch-seq的细胞构筑证据，作者认为不同认知功能需要不同的结构而非同一模板的缩放。最后提出基于异构拓扑网络（Heterogeneous Topological Network）的设计范式，要求预先指定模块化结构而非事后反向工程。
Motivation: AI研究往往忽视神经科学中结构异质性的原则，将Transformer作为通用架构应用于所有任务，而大脑皮层却因功能不同具有不同结构。这种结构性错误导致模型效率低下，亟需一种基于结构证据的模块化设计方法。
Method: 通过回顾百年细胞构筑学证据，批判性分析当前Transformer的通用性假设，提出异构拓扑网络（Heterogeneous Topological Network），即由不同计算模块通过标准化接口组成的系统之系统。
Result: 论文并未提供实验数值结果，而是提出一个理论框架和设计原则，强调在训练前指定模块化结构，利用结构证据作为设计输入。
Conclusion: 论文主张AI架构设计应从大脑的结构多样性中汲取灵感，而非将某一脑区（海马体）的简单缩放通用化；未来应走向模块化、异构化，并认为这是工程原则而非认知科学问题。
Relevance: 0
