papers.title: Unified Prediction and Planning via Conflict-Aware Disjoint Parameter Training
papers.abstract_en: Accurate motion prediction of surrounding agents and safe motion planning are two closely coupled key tasks for social robot navigation in crowded environments. Deploying these systems on resource-constrained edge devices necessitates compact, unified models that can perform both tasks simultaneously. However, within these compact shared encoders, recent unified models often overlook severe representational conflicts that arise from the distinct objectives of predicting neighbor behaviors versus ego-centric safety planning. To address this issue, we first identify the Skill Conflict$\unicode{x2014}$a phenomenon where overlapping parameter assignments cause distinct tasks to compete for the same weights, preventing the model from fully specializing in individual skills. To resolve this, we propose a novel model-merging-based framework, Disjoint Parameter Training (DPT). DPT mitigates performance degradation caused by Skill Conflict through distributed parameter learning, which separates the key parameter regions of each task while preserving their core capabilities prior to merging. In addition, we observe that sparse merging, which selectively integrates only the most influential parameters for each task rather than combining all task-specific parameters, yields optimal performance by preventing interference among adjacent features and concentrating representational capacity. DPT can be applied in parallel with a variety of merging methods. Evaluated on standard crowd navigation benchmarks (JRDB and JTA), our framework demonstrates superior performance, validating its versatility and effectiveness for safe, resource-efficient robot navigation.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. 38 pages, 14 figures. Project page: https://dpt2026.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对社交机器人导航中运动预测与运动规划之间的表征冲突问题，提出了一种基于模型融合的框架 Disjoint Parameter Training (DPT)。DPT通过分离各任务的关键参数区域，在合并前保持各自的核心能力，并采用稀疏合并选择性整合最有影响力的参数，从而缓解技能冲突（Skill Conflict）。在JRDB和JTA行人导航基准上，该方法展示了优越性能，适用于资源受限的边缘设备。
Motivation: 在紧凑的共享编码器中，统一模型常因预测邻居行为与自我安全规划的不同目标而产生严重的表征冲突（Skill Conflict），导致性能下降，阻碍模型对单个任务的充分专业化。
Method: 提出 Disjoint Parameter Training (DPT) 框架，通过分布式参数学习分离各任务的关键参数区域，并在合并前保留核心能力；采用稀疏合并，仅选择性整合每个任务最有影响力的参数，以防止相邻特征干扰并集中表征能力。DPT可并行应用于多种模型合并方法。
Result: 在JRDB和JTA标准人群导航基准上，DPT框架实现了优越性能，验证了其在安全、资源高效的机器人导航中的通用性和有效性。
Conclusion: DPT通过分离参数和稀疏合并有效解决了统一模型中的技能冲突问题，为边缘设备上的高效导航提供了可行方案。

papers.title: When Shippers Become Algorithms: Candidate Exposure, Information Design, and the Concentration of LLM-Mediated Freight Markets
papers.abstract_en: Shippers are beginning to delegate carrier selection to large language model (LLM) agents. We ask what such delegation does to a freight matching market, and which platform design choices contain it. We carried out agent-based simulations in which fifty shipper agents, built on commercial LLMs from OpenAI (GPT), Anthropic (Claude), and Google (Gemini), procure truckload capacity for thirty days. The market implements the rules of digital freight matching: each load is offered down the shipper's ranked list of carriers (waterfall tendering), carriers have daily capacity limits, spot prices respond to congestion, and carrier ratings accumulate with transactions. We found three risks and one remedy that works. Agents converged at once: for a fixed sampled carrier population, the same carrier was the modal first choice of every model on day one, attracting up to 76% of requests. Because each agent picks from its own randomly drawn list of displayed candidates, the platform controls how many options each shipper sees; concentration rose steeply once lists exceeded about ten carriers, with the onset differing across models. Which carriers ended up dominant varied widely from one sampled market to another, and displaying true quality instead of estimated ratings changed neither the level nor this variability (by design, quality affects only what agents see, never delivery outcomes). Against these risks, disclosing each carrier's remaining daily capacity cut concentration by a third and doubled shipper surplus, while vendor diversification, list-order randomization, and popularity display showed no clearly detectable effect. Platform information design, ahead of model choice or model regulation, is the lever that works.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过基于商业LLM（GPT、Claude、Gemini）的多智能体模拟，研究托运人将承运人选择委托给语言模型代理对数字货运匹配市场的影响。模拟发现市场迅速集中：同一承运人在所有模型中成为首选，吸引高达76%的请求；当每个托运人看到的候选名单超过约10家时，集中度急剧上升。披露承运人剩余日运力可将集中度降低三分之一并使托运人剩余翻倍，而供应商多元化、列表顺序随机化和流行度显示无明显效果。平台信息设计是有效的调节杠杆。
Motivation: 托运人开始使用LLM代理进行承运人选择，但这一行为对货运匹配市场的集中度和效率的影响尚不明确，且哪些平台设计选择能缓解潜在风险有待探索。
Method: 采用基于智能体的模拟方法：50个基于商业LLM（GPT、Claude、Gemini）的托运人代理在数字货运匹配市场规则下（瀑布招标、运力限制、现价响应、评分累积）进行30天模拟，并测试多种平台信息设计（如披露剩余运力、随机化列表顺序等）。
Result: 所有模型在第一天即收敛于同一首选承运人，吸引高达76%的请求；候选名单超过约10家时集中度急剧上升；披露剩余运力使集中度降低三分之一并加倍托运人剩余，而其他设计无显著效果。
Conclusion: 平台信息设计是控制LLM代理导致的货运市场集中度的有效工具，且比模型选择或模型监管更具可操作性。摘要未明确讨论方法的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EvoThink: Evolving Thinking in Large Reasoning Models via Self-Pruning and Aha-Moment Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) often suffer from overthinking due to redundant verification steps. Existing approaches for mitigating overthinking, such as fast-slow thinking switching and reasoning trajectory compression, fail to make a fine-grained distinction between beneficial and redundant steps within the LRM's reasoning process, and may thus impair reasoning capability in their pursuit of efficiency. To simultaneously improve reasoning efficiency and capability, we propose EvoThink, a framework that reduces redundant verification and encourages the exploration of new reasoning paths. EvoThink comprises two key components: Self-Pruning Training (SPT), an unsupervised method that iteratively prunes redundant reasoning steps and self-trains on the concise trajectories; and Aha-Moment Preference Optimization (AMPO), which, inspired by genetic algorithms, identifies valuable failed reasoning attempts, synthesizes from-wrong-to-right aha-moment data, and optimizes the model to internalize this reasoning pattern. Extensive evaluations across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks demonstrate that EvoThink not only substantially reduces inference-time token usage but also improves the reasoning capability of LRMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EvoThink框架，通过自剪枝训练（SPT）和“啊哈时刻”偏好优化（AMPO）同时提升大推理模型（LRMs）的推理效率和能力。SPT无监督地剪枝冗余推理步骤并自训练简洁轨迹；AMPO受遗传算法启发，识别有价值失败尝试并合成从错到对的推理数据。在数学推理和代码生成基准上，EvoThink不仅大幅减少推理token使用，还提升了推理能力。
Motivation: 现有LRMs因冗余验证步骤常导致过度思考，而现有缓解方法（如快慢思维切换、轨迹压缩）无法细粒度区分有益与冗余步骤，可能损害推理能力。
Method: 提出EvoThink框架，包含：1) Self-Pruning Training (SPT)，无监督迭代剪枝冗余步骤并自训练简洁轨迹；2) Aha-Moment Preference Optimization (AMPO)，借鉴遗传算法识别有价值失败尝试，合成从错到对的“啊哈时刻”数据，优化模型内化该模式。
Result: 在数学推理和代码生成基准上，EvoThink显著减少推理时token用量，同时提升推理能力。
Conclusion: EvoThink通过结合自剪枝和偏好优化，能够同时改善LRMs的推理效率和能力，避免过度思考且不损害性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: HijackKV: New Threat in Position-Independent KV Cache Reuse
papers.abstract_en: Key-Value (KV) cache reduces inference latency in large language models (LLMs). Traditional prefix-based reuse has low cache hit rates across inference requests because it requires exact token and position matches. To improve efficiency, recent system optimizations introduce position-independent KV reuse, allowing KV cache to be reused whenever identical text chunks appear, regardless of their position in the sequence. We show this design introduces a new threat, KV Cache Hijacking. Since KV caches are retrieved by token match but encode the context in which they were originally computed, the KV tied to a benign-looking token chunk may encode an attacker-controlled prefix. When later reused in a victim query, this contaminated KV silently hijacks the model's behavior, even if no attacker-controlled text appears in the input. We introduce HIJACKKV, the first attack framework that systematically exploits this vulnerability, demonstrating its severity and practicality. HIJACKKV optimizes an attacker-controlled prefix, so that the KV computed for a subsequent common benign text encodes the attacker's goal, while the text remains unchanged for future cache hits. HIJACKKV achieves an average 94% success rate in a single attempt, remains effective under realistic constraints including low hit rates (10%) and frequent recomputation (50%), persists over multi-turn interactions, and transfers across models in black-box settings. We further provide design insights for building secure KV reuse systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示位置无关的KV缓存复用机制中的安全漏洞——KV缓存劫持，并提出首个系统性攻击框架HIJACKKV。攻击者通过在良性文本的KV中嵌入恶意上下文，使后续复用该缓存时模型行为被篡改，即使输入中不含攻击者文本。实验表明单次攻击成功率达94%，在低命中率（10%）和频繁重计算（50%）条件下仍然有效，且可跨模型黑盒迁移。
Motivation: 位置无关的KV缓存复用虽提升了缓存命中率，但依据文本片段匹配缓存的设计忽略了KV中编码的上下文信息，导致攻击者可通过特定前缀注入恶意上下文，这是现有安全分析未覆盖的威胁。
Method: 提出HIJACKKV攻击框架，优化攻击者控制的前缀，使得后续公共良性文本计算出的KV编码了攻击目标，同时保持文本内容不变以维持缓存命中；攻击方法考虑多轮交互和黑盒迁移场景。
Result: 单次攻击平均成功率达94%；在命中率仅10%或重计算频率50%的现实约束下仍可成功；攻击可跨模型黑盒迁移。
Conclusion: 该工作揭示了KV缓存复用设计中的新威胁，并提供了安全设计洞察；强调构建安全的KV复用系统需要防止KV被劫持。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Does Knowledge Distillation Hurt? Reliability-Aware Distillation for Low-Resource Language Summarization
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD) is a standard approach for compressing sequence-to-sequence models, but its per-sample effects are rarely examined. On the BanSum Bangla summarization benchmark, we find that standard KD improves ROUGE-L by only +0.0003 over a cross-entropy baseline, and that approximately 51.3% of training samples are estimated to actively harm student validation loss under standard KD. We propose two complementary reliability-aware distillation methods. CHAD (Counterfactual Harm-Aware Distillation) measures per-sample KD usefulness via gradient alignment with the validation loss direction and trains a lightweight gate that generalizes this counterfactual judgment to the full training set. EWAD+CPDP combines token-level entropy-weighted adaptive distillation with a capacity-proportional geometric constraint from a second, vocabulary-incompatible teacher. On BanSum, both methods substantially outperform standard KD: CHAD by +0.0173 ROUGE-L and EWAD+CPDP by +0.0219 ROUGE-L, where standard KD itself improves ROUGE-L by only +0.0003; despite using only 60M parameters, both outperform a fine-tuned Qwen 2.5-3B model (50x larger). We further evaluate the stronger method, EWAD+CPDP, across 15 typologically diverse XL-Sum languages organised into three sets, beating the CE-only baseline on 10/15 languages; gains are most reliable where the two teachers contribute complementary signal, and weakest where they have saturated or jointly weak target-language coverage. We release code and trained models to support reproducibility and further research on selective distillation.

papers.title: OffNadirLoc: Benchmark and Framework for Challenging UAV-to-Satellite Geo-Localization under Large Off-Nadir Views
papers.abstract_en: Cross-view geo-localization between UAV and satellite imagery remains a fundamental yet highly challenging task, especially under large off-nadir views where drastic perspective distortions, occlusions, and appearance gaps occur. Existing benchmarks and methods primarily focus on near-nadir scenarios and often overlook the importance of structural scene understanding and intra-domain relational constraints, limiting their performance in real-world deployments. In this work, we introduce OffNadirLoc, a new benchmark for large off-nadir UAV-to-satellite geo-localization. To tackle the unique challenges posed by off-nadir perspectives, we further propose ONLoc, a framework that incorporates a structure-aware contextual weighting mechanism to dynamically emphasize reliable local features while suppressing ambiguous or repetitive regions. Additionally, we design a view-coherent learning strategy, which treats one satellite image and the corresponding UAV images from multiple views as a cohesive semantic group. This set-level supervision enables the model to learn viewpoint-invariant and discriminative features, making it more effective at capturing multi-view consistency than conventional pairwise contrastive learning. Extensive experiments on the OffNadirLoc benchmark and four near-nadir datasets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches while exhibiting strong zero-shot generalization to unseen datasets without additional training. The code will be released at https://montalario.github.io/offnadirloc/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OffNadirLoc基准和ONLoc框架，用于大倾斜视角下无人机与卫星图像的跨视角地理定位。ONLoc通过结构感知上下文加权机制和视角一致学习策略，利用多视角UAV图像与卫星图像组成语义组进行集合级监督，显著优于现有方法并具备零样本泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位方法主要针对近天底场景，忽视大倾斜视角下的透视畸变、遮挡和外观差异，导致实际部署性能受限。
Method: 提出ONLoc框架，包含结构感知上下文加权机制（动态强调可靠局部特征）和视角一致学习策略（将单张卫星图像与多视角UAV图像作为语义组，进行集合级监督学习视角不变特征）。
Result: 在OffNadirLoc基准和四个近天底数据集上，ONLoc持续超越现有最先进方法，并在未见数据集上表现出强零样本泛化能力。
Conclusion: 大倾斜视角下的跨视图地理定位可通过结构感知加权和集合级视角一致性学习有效提升，且模型具备良好泛化性。

papers.title: SenWorld: A Digital-Twin Simulation for Generating Context-Rich Evaluation Data
papers.abstract_en: Smartphone personal assistants reason over longitudinal personal data, yet evaluating them requires context-rich evaluation data whose correct answers are known, and real device traces are too privacy-sensitive to share. To address this challenge, we present SenWorld, a physically grounded, deterministic, event-sourced digital-twin simulation that generates such data with ground truth fixed by construction. In SenWorld, personas live through a full day in a world built from real map, weather, holiday, and network data; every observable signal is archived in full-system snapshots; and each evaluation case is labeled by a pointer to an existing record rather than by post-hoc annotation or a large language model (LLM) judge. We evaluate this method with 16 personas in Beijing. The generated data closely matches the held-out real-user benchmark in category distribution (Jensen--Shannon divergence (JSD) 0.070) and in the daily rhythm of communication records (JSD below 0.1), though generated records remain shorter than real ones. Without scripted interaction, personas form a fully reciprocated dialogue subgraph and differentiated behavioral repertoires. Projected into 717 evaluation cases, the generated data exposes 78 failures in a production smartphone assistant, concentrating on call and Short Message Service (SMS) records while contacts, schedules, and alarms never fail. The snapshot pointer confirms each failure as an assistant-side retrieval error, with no LLM judge involved. Overall, SenWorld offers a privacy-safe, reproducible, and distribution-checked path to evaluation data whose labels are fixed by construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SenWorld 是一个基于物理的数字孪生模拟系统，用于生成上下文丰富的智能手机个人助理评估数据，其真实标签由构造固定，无需后验标注或大模型评判。在北京 16 个角色实验中，生成数据在类别分布（JSD 0.070）和通信记录日常节奏（JSD <0.1）上与真实用户数据匹配良好，但记录长度较短。该方法在生产助理中发现了 78 个检索错误，其中电话和短信记录集中出错，而联系人、日程和闹钟无错误。
Motivation: 智能手机个人助理需基于纵向个人数据进行推理，但评估需要上下文丰富且正确答案已知的数据集，而真实设备数据因隐私敏感难以共享。现有方法依赖后验标注或大模型评判，缺乏确定性和可复现性。
Method: 提出 SenWorld，一种物理模拟的数字孪生系统，通过真实地图、天气、节假日和网络数据构建世界，角色经历完整一天，所有信号存档为系统快照。每个评估案例通过指向现存记录的指针标注，而非 LLM 评判。
Result: 在 16 个北京角色实验中，生成数据在类别分布（JSD 0.070）和通信记录日节奏（JSD <0.1）上与真实用户数据高度匹配，但记录较短。该数据在 717 个评估案例中暴露了生产助理的 78 个失败，全部为检索错误（电话和短信记录集中，联系人等无失败），且无 LLM 评判干预。
Conclusion: SenWorld 提供一条隐私安全、可复现且经分布验证的评估数据生成路径，标签由构造固定，避免了主观标注偏差。当前生成记录长度仍短于真实数据，但框架可扩展。

papers.title: ETPDesigner: Multi-Agent Orchestration for Interactive Multimodal Electronic Theater Program
papers.abstract_en: Electronic Theater Programs (ETPs) serve as critical promotional media in the performing arts, comprising a multi-page collection of heterogeneous visual assets such as theatrical posters, performance details, and character portraits. However, existing text-to-image paradigms struggle with such complex design tasks due to their inability to comprehend long-context narratives and maintain visual consistency across multiple distinct pages. To address this, we introduce ETPDesigner, a collaborative Multi-Agent framework that directly synthesizes high-quality ETPs from raw dramatic scripts. Emulating a professional design pipeline, our framework orchestrates specialized agents for semantic script analysis, core poster synthesis, functional background generation, and the stratified composition of character assets. Central to ETPDesigner is a global style anchor mechanism that extracts visual priors from the core poster to enforce strict aesthetic uniformity across all generated components. Furthermore, we elevate the ETP from a static publication to an immersive interactive companion. By integrating portrait animation, customized speech synthesis, and persona-grounded Large Language Models (LLMs), our system enables users to engage in real-time, voice-enabled conversations with the generated virtual characters. To rigorously benchmark this task, we construct ETP-Pro, a domain-specific benchmark of professional theater posters and high-quality character portraits. Extensive evaluations demonstrate our method's superiority in producing semantically faithful, aesthetically consistent, and highly interactive program sets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ETPDesigner，一个多智能体协作框架，用于从原始戏剧脚本直接合成高质量电子剧场节目（ETP），包括多页异构视觉资产，如海报、细节和人物肖像。框架模拟专业设计流程，协调语义分析、核心海报合成、功能背景生成和角色资产分层组合等智能体，并通过全局风格锚机制确保美学一致性。此外，系统通过肖像动画、定制语音合成和基于角色的大语言模型实现实时的语音交互。在自建基准ETP-Pro上的评估表明，该方法在语义保真度、美学一致性和交互性方面具有优势。
Motivation: 现有文本到图像方法难以处理长上下文叙事且无法在多页之间保持视觉一致性，无法胜任电子剧场节目这种复杂的多页异构视觉设计任务。
Method: 提出多智能体框架ETPDesigner，包含语义分析、核心海报合成、功能背景生成和角色资产分层组合的专门智能体；引入全局风格锚机制从核心海报提取视觉先验以强制所有组件美学统一；结合肖像动画、定制语音合成和基于角色的大语言模型实现实时语音交互。
Result: 在自建的专业基准ETP-Pro上，该方法在语义保真度、美学一致性和交互性方面优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了多智能体协作与全局风格锚机制在复杂多页面视觉设计任务中的有效性，并将静态出版物提升为沉浸式交互体验。

papers.title: SIINR: Structurally Informed Implicit Neural Representations for super-resolution with uncertainty quantification of clinical quality diffusion MRI datasets
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Magnetic Resonance Imaging (dMRI) is a powerful tool for probing brain microstructure, but clinical acquisitions are often limited by low out-of-plane resolution, resulting in degraded structural information and reduced utility for advanced analysis. We introduce SIINR (Structurally Informed Implicit Neural Representations), a general framework for super-resoltion of clinical dMRI datasets while quantifying uncertainty in the reconstructed outputs. SIINR utilizes a supervised 3D U-net as a prior and combines it with a self-supervised implicit neural representation (INR) that fuses the high-resolution prior and the original low-resolution data. The INR enables joint modeling across spatial and angular domains, enforces data consistency, and provides analytic approximate posterior distributions for downstream uncertainty quantification. We validate the framework on a diverse set of open-access dMRI datasets, demonstrating that SIINR outperforms standard interpolation methods in both quantitative error metrics and qualitative anatomical fidelity. Experiments on clinical cases, including subjects with multiple sclerosis and brain lesions, illustrate the framework its ability to propagate intensity changes and flag uncertain regions in challenging scenarios. SIINR is flexible, modular, and can be adapted to different upsampling ratios and downstream tasks, providing a principled approach for enhancing clinical dMRI and supporting robust interpretation of derived neuroimaging metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SIINR框架，用于临床弥散磁共振成像（dMRI）的超分辨率，并结合不确定性量化。该框架利用有监督3D U-net作为先验，与自监督隐式神经表示（INR）融合，实现空间和角度域的联合建模，提供解析近似后验分布用于不确定性估计。在开放dMRI数据集上，SIINR优于标准插值方法，并在多发性硬化症和脑病变等临床案例中展示了传播强度变化和标记不确定区域的能力。
Motivation: 临床dMRI采集常受限于低面外分辨率，导致结构信息退化，影响下游分析。需要一种超分辨率方法同时提供不确定性量化，以支持稳健的神经影像学指标解释。
Method: SIINR框架结合有监督3D U-net作为高分辨率先验，与自监督INR融合原始低分辨率数据，实现空间-角度联合建模，保持数据一致性，并提供解析近似后验分布用于不确定性量化。
Result: 在多个开放dMRI数据集上，SIINR在定量误差指标和定性解剖保真度上均优于标准插值方法。临床案例（多发性硬化症、脑病变）展示了其传播强度变化和标记不确定区域的能力。
Conclusion: SIINR灵活模块化，可适应不同上采样比例和下游任务，为增强临床dMRI和支持衍生神经影像指标的稳健解释提供了原则性方法。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在多个开放dMRI数据集上，SIINR在定量误差指标和定性解剖保真度上均优于标准插值方法。临床案例（多发性硬化症、脑病变）展示了其传播强度变化和标记不确定区域的能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: SIINR灵活模块化，可适应不同上采样比例和下游任务，为增强临床dMRI和支持衍生神经影像指标的稳健解释提供了原则性方法。

papers.title: G-MAD: A Game-Based Data Generation Framework for Multi-View RGB-T Aerial Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: This work introduces G-MAD, an open-source framework that uses Arma3 to generate synchronized multi-view RGB-T data for aerial object detection. G-MAD addresses key limitations of real-world aerial dataset construction, including limited viewpoint control, imperfect RGB-T alignment and high annotation cost. The framework supports structured scenario specification, controllable multi-view camera placement, simultaneous visible/thermal capture, and automatic bounding box annotation using engine-level geometric metadata. These capabilities enable controlled studies of viewpoint variation, multi-modal fusion, and synthetic-to-real transfer in aerial object detection. Besides, using G-MAD, we construct and release AMOD, a new large-scale multi-view aerial RGB-T object detection benchmark. The source code and the dataset are available at https://unique-chan.github.io/G-MAD-Project.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 G-MAD，一个基于 Arma3 游戏引擎的开源框架，用于生成同步的多视角 RGB-T 航空目标检测数据。框架支持结构化场景配置、可控多视角相机放置、同步可见光/热红外捕获，并利用引擎级几何元数据自动生成边界框标注。基于该框架构建并发布了大规模多视角航空 RGB-T 目标检测基准 AMOD。
Motivation: 真实航空数据集的构建受限于视角控制有限、RGB-T 对齐不完美以及标注成本高，G-MAD 旨在解决这些问题。
Method: 使用 Arma3 游戏引擎生成同步多视角 RGB-T 数据，支持结构化场景规范、可控多视角相机放置、同步可见光与热红外捕获，并通过引擎级几何元数据自动生成边界框标注。
Result: 构建并发布了 AMOD，一个大规模多视角航空 RGB-T 目标检测基准。
Conclusion: G-MAD 框架可支持视角变化、多模态融合以及合成到真实迁移在航空目标检测中的受控研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Framework of User Experience Principles for Human-AI Agent Interaction in the Workplace
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents become integral to business workflows, establishing guiding user experience (UX) principles is crucial for ensuring user trust and successful adoption. To address this, our study uses a multi-method approach - combining participatory design workshop, paper-and-pencil, expert review, meta-analysis, and in-depth interviews - to identify and validate a design framework of eight core UX principles for human-AI agent interaction in the workplace. Together with their underlying criteria, these principles provide actionable guardrails for designers and software engineers, creating a foundation for developing effective and human-centered AI agent interactions. This study contributes to a structured foundation for future empirical studies on agentic AI in enterprise settings.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 1 table, to be published in the proceedings of Mensch und Computer 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI代理在职场集成中缺乏用户体验指导的问题，采用参与式设计工作坊、纸笔测试、专家评审、元分析和深度访谈等多方法，识别并验证了八条核心用户体验原则框架。该框架为设计师和软件工程师提供了可操作的设计准则，旨在支持以人为中心的AI代理交互开发。
Motivation: 随着AI代理成为企业工作流程的核心，缺乏统一的用户体验原则可能导致用户信任不足和采用失败。
Method: 采用多方法研究：参与式设计工作坊、纸笔测试、专家评审、元分析和深度访谈，综合识别并验证八个核心UX原则及其底层标准。
Result: 提出了包含八条核心UX原则的设计框架，并搭配具体标准，为职场AI代理交互提供可操作的指导。
Conclusion: 该框架为未来在企业环境中进行AI代理的实证研究奠定了基础，强调以人为中心的设计。

papers.title: MOF-Sleuth: Tool-Grounded Reward Alignment for Explainable Fine-Grained MOF CIF Auditing
papers.abstract_en: Large metal-organic framework (MOF) databases support simulation, screening, and machine learning through crystallographic information files (CIFs). Subtle chemical and structural errors in these inputs can compromise downstream results and hinder manual inspection. LLM advances in computational chemistry offer paths beyond predictive screening toward fine-grained diagnosis with evidence-grounded explanations. However, two challenges remain: (i) limited fine-grained attribution: MOF-specific validators and machine-learning models scale detection but provide fixed checks, readiness scores, or coarse labels rather than evidence-grounded explanations; and (ii) unreliable CIF reasoning: direct LLM auditing is costly and unreliable because chemical evidence is implicit across atom-site records and requires geometric, connectivity, occupancy, and charge calculations. Both stem from weak coupling between chemical evidence and language-model explanation. We introduce MOF-Sleuth, a reinforcement-guided CIF auditing agent with two modules: a deterministic Forensic Lab and a Sleuth reasoning engine. The Lab derives composition, geometry, connectivity, occupancy, coordination, and charge evidence, and Sleuth uses this evidence to produce an evidence-grounded explanation, error types, and a binary decision. Reward-guided reinforcement learning (RL) turns tool measurements into chemical explanation-level supervision, rewarding not only the final answer but also cited chemical evidence and evidence-supported diagnoses. We introduce Chemically Grounded Diagnosis (Chem-GD), a metric that assesses whether a correct diagnosis is explained by factual, relevant CIF-derived evidence. Across four benchmarks, MOF-Sleuth establishes state-of-the-art performance among LLM-based approaches and MOF-specific machine-learning methods, demonstrating gains in detection, attribution, and grounded explanation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MOF-Sleuth，一种基于强化学习的金属有机框架(MOF)晶体信息文件(CIF)审计代理，由确定性法医实验室(Forensic Lab)和侦探推理引擎(Sleuth)组成，通过工具生成化学证据并用奖励引导的强化学习将测量结果转化为化学解释级别的监督，在多个基准上达到领先性能。
Motivation: 现有MOF检测方法只能提供固定检查或粗粒度标签，缺乏基于证据的解释；直接使用LLM审计成本高且不可靠，因为化学证据隐含在原子位点记录中。
Method: 构建双模块CIF审计代理：法医实验室推导组成、几何、连接性、占有率、配位和电荷证据；侦探引擎利用证据生成基于证据的解释、错误类型和二元决策。采用奖励引导的强化学习，不仅奖励最终答案，还奖励引用的化学证据和基于证据的诊断。
Result: 在四个基准上，MOF-Sleuth在基于LLM的方法和MOF专用机器学习方法中取得最优性能，在检测、归因和基于证据的解释质量上均有提升。
Conclusion: 论文强调通过工具测量的奖励引导强化学习可以弥合化学证据与语言模型解释之间的鸿沟，实现细粒度、可解释的CIF审计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WearWow: Native 2K Multi-Garment Virtual Try-On via Adaptive Token Packing and Preference Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Synthesizing native 2K multi-garment virtual try-on is a formidable frontier in digital fashion, critically bottlenecked by two fundamental limitations: the O(N^2) memory explosion induced by 2k conditions, and the spectral bias of diffusion models that over-smooths high-frequency fabric details. We present WearWow, an end-to-end, mask-free generative framework that pioneers ultra-high-resolution multi-garment synthesis. To mitigate the memory explosion , we propose Adaptive 2D Token Packing (ATP). ATP leverages inherent garment sparsity to algorithmically pack heterogeneous items onto a unified 2D canvas and prune uninformative background tokens, minimizing the effective sequence length and subsequent memory overhead while rigorously preserving 2D spatial priors. To rectify texture degradation, we introduce the Multi-dimensional Try-on Reward (MTR) system. MTR synergizes a Semantic Guidance Reward to explicitly drive tactile restoration with a Cloth Distribution Reward to implicitly anchor the physical distribution, a joint formulation that effectively mitigates the severe reward hacking. Furthermore, we curate WearWow-2K, an extreme-quality dataset comprising native 2K triplets, providing physically correct spatial interactions that naturally empower the model's mask-free generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that WearWow establishes a new state-of-the-art, exceeding existing commercial baselines in native 2K multi-garment synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WearWow提出了一种端到端、无掩码的生成框架，用于原生2K分辨率多服装虚拟试穿。通过自适应2D令牌打包（ATP）解决内存爆炸问题，利用多维度试穿奖励（MTR）系统改善纹理退化，并构建了WearWow-2K数据集。实验表明，该方法在原生2K多服装合成中超越了现有商业基线。
Motivation: 现有方法在高分辨率多服装虚拟试穿中受限于O(N^2)内存爆炸和扩散模型的光谱偏差导致的高频织物细节过度平滑问题。
Method: 提出自适应2D令牌打包（ATP）利用服装稀疏性有效压缩序列长度；引入多维度试穿奖励（MTR）系统，结合语义引导奖励和衣物分布奖励，缓解奖励黑客攻击；构建WearWow-2K数据集支持无掩码生成。
Result: 在原生2K多服装合成任务上达到新最优，超越现有商业基线。
Conclusion: WearWow通过内存优化和纹理恢复机制实现了高分辨率多服装虚拟试穿的突破，但未提及对复杂场景或未见类别的泛化能力。

papers.title: Diffusion ReRoll: Revisable Denoising for Robotic Sequential Prediction
papers.abstract_en: We propose Diffusion ReRoll, a diffusion-based framework for robotic sequential prediction that enables revisable denoising over horizons. Existing diffusion-based sequence predictors typically perform a single monotonic denoising process. In contrast, Diffusion ReRoll selectively re-noises regions that have become locally stable while the remaining regions continue denoising, so the re-noised regions can be refined again using context from the rest of the horizon. This structured re-noising enables iterative cross-horizon revision, allowing earlier and later segments to revise one another, while maintaining local consistency. We evaluate Diffusion ReRoll against full-sequence diffusion and causal denoising based on Diffusion Forcing across long-horizon planning, policy learning, and unified video-action modeling. On OGBench PointMaze and AntMaze, Diffusion ReRoll achieves relative gains in average success rate of 21% over Diffusion Forcing in matched guidance-based planning and 23% over Diffuser in matched goal-inpainting. In diffusion-policy-style action prediction, Diffusion ReRoll improves average success by 56.5% relative to Diffusion Policy across different prediction horizons and history lengths on the LIBERO-10 multi-task benchmark. In unified video-action prediction, Diffusion ReRoll improves policy and inverse dynamics performance, especially under out-of-distribution evaluation, and achieves the best action-video consistency. These results support structured re-noising as an effective mechanism for revisable robotic sequence generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Diffusion ReRoll，一种用于机器人序列预测的可修正去噪扩散框架。与现有单调去噪不同，它允许对局部稳定区域重新加噪并利用全局上下文修正，实现跨时间步的迭代修订。在OGBench、LIBERO-10等基准上，相比Diffusion Forcing和Diffuser等方法，成功率提升显著。
Motivation: 现有扩散序列预测器通常执行单调去噪，无法利用未来信息修正早期预测，限制了长期规划中的一致性。
Method: 提出结构化重新加噪机制：在去噪过程中，对已局部稳定的区域选择性重新加噪，使其能根据其他区域的上下文被再次细化，从而允许跨时间步的迭代修订。
Result: 在OGBench PointMaze和AntMaze上，平均成功率相对Diffusion Forcing提升21%，相对Diffuser提升23%；在LIBERO-10上，相对Diffusion Policy提升56.5%；在统一视频-动作预测中，提升了策略和逆动力学性能，尤其在外分布评估下。
Conclusion: 结构化重新加噪作为一种可修正的机器人序列生成机制是有效的，能够提升长程规划和策略学习的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Long-Term Sequential Decision Making under Risk
papers.abstract_en: We study finite-horizon MDP planning under \emph{root-based} (resolute) risk objectives that apply a rank-dependent functional to the distribution of total returns. Such objectives are non-linear in the return distribution and generally break Bellman optimality, so direct optimization by scenario-tree enumeration is intractable. We propose \textbf{ERQDP}, an enumeration-free and sampling-free method that solves a rank--quantile surrogate via exact DP (Dynamic Programming), evaluates candidate policies exactly by DP over return Probability Mass Functions (PMFs) on a discretized return grid (with an explicit rounding bound), and refines the surrogate in an anytime loop that reports an explicit upper--lower gap (certificate) for the target objective up to discretization budgets. Across tested benchmarks, ERQDP returns certified solutions or explicit residual gaps, enables fast risk-parameter sweeps with substantial runtime gains, and supports both risk-averse and risk-seeking behaviors.
papers.comment: Accpeted in Forty-Second Annual Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了有限时域MDP在根风险目标下的规划问题，该目标对回报总分布的秩依赖非线性，破坏了贝尔曼最优性。作者提出ERQDP方法，通过精确动态规划求解秩-分位数代理，并在离散化回报网格上计算候选策略的精确性能，最终在任意循环中输出目标的上界-下界间隙（包含离散化预算内的认证）。实验表明ERQDP能返回可认证解或显式残差间隙，支持快速风险参数扫描，同时兼容风险厌恶与风险寻求行为。
Motivation: 现有MDP规划在根风险目标（如秩依赖函数）下无法直接应用贝尔曼方程，且场景树枚举法计算复杂，缺乏高效且可认证的求解方法。
Method: 提出ERQDP方法：通过精确动态规划求解秩-分位数代理问题；在离散化回报网格上对回报概率质量函数进行精确DP评估，并给出显式舍入误差界限；通过任意循环迭代细化代理，输出目标函数的上界-下界间隙作为认证。
Result: 在多个基准测试中，ERQDP返回可认证的解或显式残差间隙，显著加速风险参数扫描，同时支持风险厌恶和风险寻求行为。
Conclusion: ERQDP为非线性风险目标下的MDP规划提供了一种无枚举、无采样的精确DP框架，具备可认证误差界限和广泛的适用性。

papers.title: JANUS: Foreseeing Latent Risk for Long-Horizon Agent Safety
papers.abstract_en: Agent safety is moving from content moderation toward preventing operational failures before tool-using agents act. We propose Janus, a foresight-oriented framework for long-horizon agent safety that trains guards to anticipate delayed risks from partial trajectories. Janus synthesizes diverse agent trajectories via multi-agent simulation and learns a shared policy with two coupled tasks: an anticipation task that forecasts safety-relevant futures and an adjudication task that decides safety from both the observed prefix and anticipated future. The two tasks are jointly optimized with CoAA-RL, which rewards forecasts by their utility for downstream safety judgment. The resulting guard model, Vanguard, blocks unsafe actions before execution. Across four agent-safety benchmarks, Vanguard improves average protection by 15.9 percentage points over baseline guards while increasing benign task completion by 5.1 percentage points.

papers.title: LoRFT: Benchmarking Long-Range Vehicle Trajectory Reconstruction from Fixed Highway Cameras
papers.abstract_en: Long-range vehicle trajectories provide important spatio-temporal evidence for traffic safety analysis, autonomous driving evaluation, and data-driven traffic management, yet continuously recovering them from fixed highway cameras remains difficult. As vehicles recede into distant road regions, perspective compression and scale decay often fragment or prematurely terminate automatic tracklets, even when their continuation remains identifiable from motion consistency across neighboring frames. We formulate this problem as recovering the far-range continuation of a vehicle trajectory from a reliable near-field tracklet. We introduce LoRFT, to our knowledge the first open benchmark dedicated to long-range vehicle trajectory reconstruction from fixed highway cameras. LoRFT comprises 22 expressway surveillance scenes, 366,109 video frames, 6,601 manually verified trajectories, 2,694,889 bounding boxes, road-geometry annotations, scene-level splits, and evaluation scripts. We further propose Map-RSTNet, a map-aware residual sequence-to-sequence model that reconstructs distant trajectories in a road-geometry-aligned state space and dynamically refreshes local road geometry during decoding. On LoRFT, Map-RSTNet reduces ADE, FDE, and 5-second RMSE by 11.0%, 15.4%, and 10.5%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline. These results demonstrate that road-geometry-aware reconstruction can extend usable trajectory records from existing fixed-camera infrastructure. LoRFT provides a reproducible testbed for long-range vehicle trajectory reconstruction.

papers.title: MV-Bench: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models for Coordinated Multi-View Interface Construction
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly expected to automate visualization development by generating code directly from visual designs. However, existing evaluations mainly focus on single-chart generation and overlook coordinated multi-view interface construction, which requires joint reasoning about data semantics, view coordination, and interaction logic. Consequently, MLLM capabilities in this setting remain underexplored, and the field lacks a dedicated benchmark for systematic assessment. We introduce MV-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on coordinated multi-view interface construction. Instead of relying on incomplete or inconsistent open-source implementations, we use Tableau workbook files as ground truth because they explicitly encode data bindings, visual mappings, and interactions. We develop a multi-stage pipeline that converts these specifications into executable web interfaces through structured intermediate representations. The benchmark contains 92 base interfaces and 1,048 verified instances created by recombining chart types, datasets, and interaction patterns. Each instance includes executable code, a rendered interface, a dataset, and interaction annotations. We evaluate five state-of-the-art MLLMs in a single-pass setting using metrics for visual fidelity, data binding correctness, and interaction completeness. The strongest model achieves 75.45 percent accuracy in visual layout reproduction, but only 21.71 percent in data binding and 11.68 percent in interaction completeness. These results show that current MLLMs can reproduce visual appearance but remain limited in generating the data semantics and interactive logic required by coordinated multi-view interfaces. Iterative refinement improves code executability but does not substantially reduce the gap in data binding and interaction generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MV-Bench，一个用于评估多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs) 在协调多视图界面构建中能力的基准。基准包含 92 个基础界面和 1048 个实例，使用 Tableau 工作簿作为真值，并通过多阶段管道转换为可执行 Web 界面。评估了五个最先进 MLLM 在单次设置下的视觉保真度、数据绑定正确性和交互完整性。最强模型在视觉布局再现上达到 75.45% 准确率，但数据绑定仅 21.71%，交互完整性仅 11.68%，表明当前 MLLM 在生成数据语义和交互逻辑方面仍有限。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 评估主要关注单图表生成，忽略了协调多视图界面构建所需的数据语义、视图协调和交互逻辑的联合推理，缺乏系统评估基准。
Method: 构建包含 92 个基础界面和 1048 个实例的基准，以 Tableau 工作簿为真值，通过多阶段管道将规范转换为可执行 Web 界面，并使用视觉保真度、数据绑定正确性和交互完整性指标评估 MLLM。
Result: 最强 MLLM (Gemini 1.5 Pro) 在视觉布局再现上准确率 75.45%，但数据绑定仅 21.71%，交互完整性仅 11.68%。迭代精化可提高代码可执行性，但未能显著缩小数据绑定和交互生成差距。
Conclusion: 当前 MLLM 能较好再现视觉外观，但在生成协调多视图界面所需的数据语义和交互逻辑方面仍不足，需要进一步研究。

papers.title: Nonlinear Bias-Compensated Adaptive Filter and Its Application for Time-Series Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Most existing nonlinear adaptive filtering algorithms only account for output noise, neglecting the fact that input noise is also prevalent in practice. Although the recently proposed bias-compensated kernel least mean square (BCKLMS) algorithm addresses input noise in the nonlinear errors-in-variables (EIV) model, it still suffers from two major limitations. First, the use of a fixed-size dictionary restricts network growth but also prevents it from fully capturing the characteristics of the input signal. Second, as an least mean square (LMS) based algorithm, it exhibits poor robustness in the presence of non-Gaussian noise in the output signal. To overcome these issues, this paper proposes the random Fourier bias-compensated filter under general adaptive function (RFFBCGA) algorithm. Within the random Fourier feature based bias-compensated (RFFBC) framework, the proposed algorithm not only maintains a fixed network structure and effectively mitigates input noise interference through the BC term, but also achieves improved characterization of the input signal. Moreover, by leveraging the flexible form of the general adaptive (GA) function, the algorithm's robustness across various noise scenarios is further enhanced. Extensive simulations, including real-world time series prediction tasks, demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非线性自适应滤波中同时存在输入噪声和输出非高斯噪声的问题，提出随机傅里叶偏置补偿通用自适应函数（RFFBCGA）算法。该算法在随机傅里叶特征偏置补偿（RFFBC）框架下，通过偏置补偿项减小输入噪声干扰，并利用通用自适应（GA）函数增强对不同噪声场景的鲁棒性。在真实时间序列预测上的仿真验证了其优越性。
Motivation: 现有非线性自适应滤波算法多只考虑输出噪声，忽略输入噪声；已有的偏置补偿核最小均方（BCKLMS）算法受限于固定字典大小且对非高斯输出噪声鲁棒性差。
Method: 提出RFFBCGA算法，结合随机傅里叶特征（RFF）实现固定网络结构，通过偏置补偿（BC）项抑制输入噪声，并引入通用自适应（GA）函数作为代价函数以提高对多种噪声场景的适应性。
Result: 仿真表明，该算法在输入噪声干扰下能有效恢复信号，并在真实时间序列预测任务中优于对比方法。
Conclusion: RFFBCGA算法在保持固定网络结构的同时，兼具输入噪声补偿和非高斯噪声鲁棒性，是处理非线性误差变量（EIV）模型的有效方案。

papers.title: StrokeSeg2: Stroke Lesion Segmentation in Clinical Research Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning frameworks like nnU-Net achieve state-of-theart brain lesion segmentation performance but remain difficult to deploy in clinical research environments due to, among other reasons, software dependencies and computational requirements. We introduce StrokeSeg2, a lightweight, modular, cross-platform C++/Qt framework designed to adapt resource-intensive 3D stroke segmentation pipelines into portable and reproducible applications. To improve compatibility with standard clinical workstations, we investigate the combined effect of architectural compression through knowledge distillation and inference optimisation using ONNX Runtime with Float16 quantisation. Across heterogeneous hardware configurations (CPU, integrated GPU, and dedicated GPU) architectural distillation emerged as the primary contributor to efficiency gains, contributing to over 90% reduction in energy consumption and an average 84% reduction in inference time. Specifically, we identify a 0.84M-parameter student model as the most favourable trade-off, reducing the original 102.3M-parameter teacher architecture to a 2.1 MB disk footprint while preserving robust lesion localisation and competitive segmentation performance. This small footprint supports the development of a self-contained installer for clinical workstation targets. Finally, StrokeSeg2 packages these optimisations into standalone installers for Windows, macOS, and Linux. By providing both graphical and commandline interfaces without Docker or external environment dependencies, StrokeSeg2 facilitates deployment of high-performance segmentation workflows for routine clinical research pipelines.
papers.journal_ref: Efficient Medical AI (EMA4MICCAI) Workshop 2026, Oct 2026, Strasbourg, France
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 StrokeSeg2，一个轻量级模块化跨平台 C++/Qt 框架，旨在将资源密集的 3D 脑卒中分割管线适配为便携可重复的应用。通过知识蒸馏进行架构压缩，并使用 ONNX Runtime 和 Float16 量化进行推理优化，在异构硬件上实现了超过 90% 的能耗降低和平均 84% 的推理时间减少。一个 0.84M 参数的 student 模型将原 102.3M 参数的教师架构压缩至 2.1 MB 磁盘占用，同时保持了鲁棒的病灶定位和竞争性分割性能。该框架提供独立安装程序，支持无 Docker 或外部依赖的部署。
Motivation: 现有深度学习框架（如 nnU-Net）在脑病变分割上性能优异，但因软件依赖和计算需求难以部署到临床研究环境。
Method: 提出 StrokeSeg2 框架，采用知识蒸馏进行架构压缩，并结合 ONNX Runtime 和 Float16 量化进行推理优化，将资源密集的 3D 分割管线转化为轻量级跨平台应用。
Result: 在异构硬件配置下，架构蒸馏贡献了主要效率提升：能耗降低超过 90%，推理时间平均减少 84%。一个 0.84M 参数的 student 模型将教师模型压缩至 2.1 MB，同时保持竞争性分割性能。

summary_sections.method: 提出 StrokeSeg2 框架，采用知识蒸馏进行架构压缩，并结合 ONNX Runtime 和 Float16 量化进行推理优化，将资源密集的 3D 分割管线转化为轻量级跨平台应用。
summary_sections.result: 在异构硬件配置下，架构蒸馏贡献了主要效率提升：能耗降低超过 90%，推理时间平均减少 84%。一个 0.84M 参数的 student 模型将教师模型压缩至 2.1 MB，同时保持竞争性分割性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: StrokeSeg2 通过提供图形化和命令行界面，无需 Docker 或外部环境依赖，促进了高性能分割工作流在常规临床研究管线中的部署。

papers.title: Harnessing Disagreement: Detecting Correlated Agreement Blindness in Multi-Agent Triage
papers.abstract_en: Disagreement-triggered escalation can create a structural blind spot in multi-agent arbitration: as base learners improve, they tend to converge, weakening safety monitoring where correlated failures concentrate. We term this correlated agreement blindness and present ARAT (Arbitrated Reasoning Agents for Alarm Triage), a directed-star system combining an inductive Random Forest (RF) agent, an analogical case-based k-nearest neighbour (k-NN) agent, and a calibrated meta-model to mitigate this effect. On 82,332 holdout samples from the UNSW-NB15 network intrusion detection dataset, 57.2% of errors occur under agreement and 90.6% of dangerous under-predictions evade disagreement-based monitoring even after conservative override; ablation shows that strengthening base learners increases error correlation while reducing disagreement. ARAT reduces under-prediction relative to soft voting from 4.80% to 1.70% via conservative override (-2.6pp) and a safety-flag gate (-0.5pp), demonstrating architectural gains. Cross-dataset validation on clinical readmission supports these indicators, suggesting that diversification improves safety only when it generates productive disagreement rather than convergence. These results indicate that disagreement-triggered escalation can be blind to correlated failure, a risk that may intensify as agentic pipelines deploy increasingly capable, correlated models.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at PAAMS 2026; this is the author's pre-review submitted version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文识别了多代理协商中一种结构性的盲点：当基础学习器趋于一致时，基于分歧触发的升级机制会失效，因为错误变得相关。作者提出了ARAT系统，结合随机森林和k-NN代理以及校准的元模型来缓解此问题。在UNSW-NB15数据集上，57.2%的错误发生在一致同意下，90.6%的危险低估逃脱了基于分歧的监控。ARAT通过保守覆盖和安全标志门将低估从4.80%降至1.70%。
Motivation: 现有基于分歧触发的升级机制在多代理仲裁中存在盲点：当基础学习器性能提升并趋于一致时，相关错误集中，导致安全监控失效。
Method: 提出ARAT（Arbitrated Reasoning Agents for Alarm Triage）系统，采用有向星型架构，结合归纳随机森林代理、类比k近邻代理以及校准的元模型来减轻一致同意盲区的影响。
Result: 在UNSW-NB15的82,332个样本上，57.2%的错误发生在一致同意下，90.6%的危险低估逃脱了基于分歧的监控。ARAT相比软投票将低估从4.80%降至1.70%（保守覆盖-2.6pp，安全标志门-0.5pp）。交叉数据集验证支持这些指标。
Conclusion: 分歧触发的升级可能对相关错误盲区产生盲点，随着代理管道部署越来越强大且相关的模型，风险可能加剧。多样化只有在产生有成效的分歧而非收敛时才能提高安全性。

papers.title: OSVE: One Step Video Editing with One Step Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-guided video editing with diffusion models is impractically slow, hindered by costly multi-step sampling and inversion. We present OSVE, the first framework to successfully adapt one-step Text-to-Image (T2I) models for high-quality video editing, addressing the core challenges of inversion, editability, and temporal consistency. To bypass slow iterative inversion, we train a learnable encoder that predicts the initial noise for each frame in a single forward pass. This encoder is trained with a novel Structure-Aware Editing (SAE) loss on a curated dataset of structurally-aligned image pairs, teaching it to preserve the source video's geometry during edits. For temporal coherence, we introduce Unified-Frame Editing (UFE), a technique that concatenates frame latents to facilitate cross-frame attention in a single generation step. Furthermore, for long videos, a sliding-window strategy with an anchor frame maintains global consistency. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that OSVE achieves editing quality comparable or superior to state-of-the-art multi-step methods, while operating approximately 155--171 times faster. This breakthrough paves the way for practical, real-time video editing applications. Code is available at https://github.com/KU-VGI/OSVE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OSVE，首个将一步式文本到图像模型成功应用于高质量视频编辑的框架，解决了反演、可编辑性和时间一致性的核心挑战。通过训练可学习的编码器预测初始噪声，引入结构感知编辑损失和统一帧编辑技术，实现比多步方法快155-171倍的编辑速度。
Motivation: 现有文本引导视频编辑方法因需要多步采样和反演，速度极慢，难以实用。
Method: OSVE 包含：1) 可学习编码器在单次前向中预测每帧初始噪声，避免迭代反演；2) 结构感知编辑损失用于保持源视频几何结构；3) 统一帧编辑技术通过拼接帧潜在码实现单步跨帧注意力；4) 针对长视频的滑动窗口锚帧策略保证全局一致性。
Result: 实验表明 OSVE 编辑质量与现有最先进多步方法相当或更优，速度快约155-171倍。
Conclusion: OSVE 为实现实时实用视频编辑应用铺平了道路，代码已公开。

papers.title: Defense Against LLM Backdoors using Critical Neuron Isolation Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are vulnerable to backdoor attacks, where hidden triggers induce malicious outputs. Existing defenses generally fall into inference-time detection or training-time mitigation, but face two key limitations. First, they focus on fine-tuning-based backdoors (e.g., PEFT modules) and fail to address insidious model-editing attacks that bypass training pipelines. Second, they target simple classification settings and do not naturally extend to open-ended LLM generation and do not naturally extend to the open-ended generation characteristics of LLMs. Consequently, these methods focus on surface-level behavioral patterns while neglecting the deeper representational causes of malicious activations. This lack of mechanistic understanding forces defenses to depend on empirical heuristics, limiting their robustness, generality, and practical applicability in real-world LLM deployment. To bridge this gap, we introduce DeCNIP (Defense with Critical Neuron Isolation Pruning), which leverages representational analysis to identify and neutralize backdoors in a unified pipeline. Specifically, DeCNIP identifies trigger-like behaviors by optimizing a cross-entropy loss between harmful prompts with candidate tokens and benign inputs. This representational discovery exposes latent threats by uncovering mechanisms through which triggers hijack model weights. It then isolates Backdoor Critical Neurons (BCNs) and prunes them selectively to remove malicious influence while preserving model utility. Extensive evaluations on six open-source LLMs and two benchmark datasets demonstrate that DeCNIP achieves over 95% relative reduction in Attack Success Rate (ASR), outperforming seven state-of-the-art defenses with only 0.1% neuron intervention. Moreover, it maintains 97% of the model's performance on normal benchmarks, demonstrating its efficacy, robustness, and scalability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DeCNIP，一种基于关键神经元隔离剪枝的LLM后门防御方法。该方法通过表征分析识别后门关键神经元（BCNs）并选择性剪枝，以消除恶意影响同时保持模型效用。实验表明，在六个开源LLM和两个基准数据集上，DeCNIP实现了超过95%的攻击成功率（ASR）相对降低，仅需0.1%的神经元干预，并在正常基准上保持了97%的性能。
Motivation: 现有LLM后门防御方法主要针对微调后门，难以处理模型编辑攻击，且局限于简单分类任务，未能扩展到开放生成的LLM场景。缺乏对恶意激活背后表征机制的深度理解，导致防御依赖于经验启发式，鲁棒性、通用性和实用性受限。
Method: 提出DeCNIP框架，包含两个步骤：首先通过有害提示与候选令牌之间的交叉熵损失优化来识别触发器类行为，进行表征发现；然后隔离后门关键神经元（BCNs）并选择性剪枝以去除恶意影响，同时保留模型效用。
Result: 在六个开源LLM和两个基准数据集上，DeCNIP实现超过95%的攻击成功率（ASR）相对降低，优于七种现有防御方法，仅需0.1%的神经元干预，并在正常基准上保持97%的模型性能。
Conclusion: DeCNIP通过表征分析和关键神经元剪枝实现了高效、鲁棒且可扩展的LLM后门防御，解决了现有方法对模型编辑攻击和开放生成场景的适应性不足。

papers.title: LAVIFT: Latent-Action-Guided Vision Fine-Tuning for Surgical Interaction Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Understanding instrument-tissue interactions is essential for context-aware surgical AI and autonomous robotic surgery. Pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) and vision encoders offer an alternative to conventional interaction classifiers by transferring broad visual and semantic knowledge. However, adapting them to fine-grained surgical interactions remains challenging: (1) freezing the vision encoder depends entirely on pretrained representations that may retain noise and provide weak spatial localization, while (2) full fine-tuning can improve global semantic alignment without ensuring that the encoder learns meaningful features in the correct action region. We address these limitations by introducing LAViFiT, an end-to-end latent-action-guided framework for vision-language fine-tuning. An inverse dynamics model captures the visual changes induced by each action, while a forward world model drives the encoder to represent action-relevant regions. A patch-level SIG Regularizer further prevents local feature collapse without additional supervision, such as bounding boxes or pseudo-labels. Experiments across multiple encoders and datasets improve recognition and image-text alignment, while representation analyses show stronger grounding over the complete instrument-tissue interaction region and more spatially coherent features.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LAViFiT，一个端到端的潜在动作引导的视觉-语言微调框架，用于手术交互识别。通过逆动力学模型和正向世界模型引导视觉编码器关注动作相关区域，并加入 patch 级 SIG 正则化防止局部特征崩溃。在多个编码器和数据集上改进了识别和图像-文本对齐。
Motivation: 现有预训练视觉语言模型在微调时，冻结编码器依赖可能含有噪声的预训练表示且空间定位弱，而全微调可能改善全局语义对齐但不能确保编码器学习到正确动作区域的有意义特征。
Method: 提出 LAViFiT，包含逆动力学模型捕捉动作引起的视觉变化，正向世界模型引导编码器表示动作相关区域，以及 patch 级 SIG 正则化无需额外监督防止局部特征崩溃。
Result: 实验表明在多个编码器和数据集上改进了识别和图像-文本对齐，表示分析显示更强的 grounding 和更空间一致的特征。
Conclusion: LAViFiT 通过潜在动作引导有效改善了手术交互识别中的视觉微调。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MTVDiff: Multimodal Conditional Latent Diffusion for Enhanced Thermal-to-Visible Face Translation
papers.abstract_en: Thermal-to-visible face translation presents fundamental challenges including geometric discontinuities, semantic attribute mismatches, and identity degradation. We propose MTVDiff, a novel multimodal latent diffusion framework that synergistically integrates depth and textual information to address these limitations while preserving identity characteristics. The MTVDiff framework presents three core technical contributions: (1) a Dual-Branch Cross-Attention Fusion (DBCAF) module for multi-scale thermal-depth feature extraction and fusion; (2) a Gated Text-to-Visual Feature Alignment mechanism for semantically-guided generation; and (3) Spatial Feature Transformations (SFT) for adaptive multimodal prior integration. Extensive experiments on the MCXFace and SpeakingFaces datasets demonstrate that our multimodal approach significantly outperforms existing GAN-based and diffusion-based approaches across multiple metrics, achieving substantial improvements in both image quality and face verification performance, with FID reductions of up to 48.3% and Rank-1 accuracy improvements of up to 8.9\%. Our work provides a robust solution for face recognition systems operating under varying illumination conditions and advances the state-of-the-art in cross-spectral facial image translation through effective multimodal integration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MTVDiff，一种多模态条件潜扩散框架，用于热成像到可见光人脸翻译。通过融合深度和文本信息，利用双分支交叉注意力融合模块、门控文本到视觉特征对齐机制和空间特征变换，在MCXFace和SpeakingFaces数据集上显著优于现有方法，FID降低最高48.3%，Rank-1准确率提升最高8.9%。
Motivation: 热成像到可见光人脸翻译面临几何不连续、语义属性不匹配和身份退化等挑战，现有方法难以有效保留身份特征并生成高质量图像。
Method: 提出MTVDiff框架，包含三个核心模块：双分支交叉注意力融合模块用于多尺度热-深度特征提取与融合；门控文本到视觉特征对齐机制实现语义引导生成；空间特征变换用于自适应多模态先验集成。
Result: 在MCXFace和SpeakingFaces数据集上，FID降低高达48.3%，Rank-1准确率提升高达8.9%，在图像质量和人脸验证性能上均显著优于现有GAN和扩散方法。
Conclusion: 多模态信息（深度和文本）的有效集成显著提升了热成像到可见光人脸翻译的质量，为变光照条件下的人脸识别系统提供了鲁棒解决方案。
Relevance: 10

summary_sections.conclusion: 多模态信息（深度和文本）的有效集成显著提升了热成像到可见光人脸翻译的质量，为变光照条件下的人脸识别系统提供了鲁棒解决方案。

papers.title: EA-Nav: Learning Safe Visual Navigation Policies with Embodiment Awareness
papers.abstract_en: Cross-embodiment navigation is a key challenge in embodied intelligence. Due to differences in embodiment, the same visual observation may imply different actions for different agents, making prediction ambiguous when relying solely on vision. Existing studies mainly rely on reinforcement learning, which requires large-scale interaction and careful reward design, making it difficult to support scalable pretraining and real-world adaptation. In contrast, imitation-learning-based approaches remain limited. To address these challenges, we propose an imitation-learning-based embodiment-aware navigation framework with a modular multi-stage design. In pretraining, we construct a cross-embodiment navigation dataset from Internet videos and introduce embodiment geometry as conditional tokens to reduce action ambiguity under the same observation. In fine-tuning, we design a multimodal information injection mechanism based on a decoupled architecture. Specifically, we design a trajectory augmentation strategy to generate high-risk samples, which are used to train spatial perception and risk-aware correction separately, thereby explicitly incorporating embodiment geometry for safe navigation. Experimental results show that the proposed method effectively improves navigation performance across different embodiment settings, demonstrating the effectiveness of incorporating embodiment geometry into embodied navigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于模仿学习的具身感知导航框架 EA-Nav，通过引入具身几何条件令牌减少相同视觉观测下的动作歧义，并设计轨迹增强策略生成高风险样本以训练空间感知与风险感知修正，实验证明该方法能有效提升跨形态导航性能。
Motivation: 现有跨形态导航方法主要依赖强化学习，需要大量交互和精心设计的奖励，难以扩展预训练和现实适应；而基于模仿学习的方法仍有限。
Method: 提出模块化多阶段设计：预训练阶段从互联网视频构建跨形态导航数据集，并引入具身几何作为条件令牌；微调阶段基于解耦架构设计多模态信息注入机制，包含轨迹增强策略生成高风险样本，分别训练空间感知和风险感知修正。
Result: 实验显示该方法在不同具身设置下有效提升导航性能，验证了将具身几何融入导航的有效性。
Conclusion: 该方法通过显式融入具身几何提升了导航安全性和跨形态适应性，但未提及在真实机器人上的部署或与其他方法的全面对比。

papers.title: Current Injection Spiking Neural Network for Infrared and Visible Image Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Infrared and visible image fusion (IVIF) integrates the complementary information of two modalities into a single image with richer scene content. While existing methods are largely built on artificial neural networks (ANNs), which densely compute over all activations, spiking neural networks (SNNs) communicate through sparse binary spikes and compute only where and when a spike occurs, offering a route to more energy-efficient fusion. However, directly applying SNNs to IVIF creates a fundamental tension: cross-modal fusion relies on fine-grained responses from both modalities, whereas binary spikes can discard complementary cues that remain below the firing threshold. The membrane potential retains these subthreshold responses before firing, letting both modalities jointly shape the output when integrated at this stage. Building on this, we propose CIS-Fuse, a spiking network that performs cross-modal fusion directly at the membrane-potential level. At its core is the current injection spiking (CIS) operator, which injects one modality as a gated auxiliary current into the driving neuron of the other, so the two integrate before spike firing, with a per-channel learnable injection strength that adaptively regulates the modulation magnitude. Building on CIS, we construct a bidirectional cross-modal fusion (BCMF) module and deploy it on a dual-branch architecture with asymmetric stacking depths, where the two branches develop a clear functional specialization. Extensive experiments on four IVIF benchmarks and on downstream detection and segmentation show that CIS-Fuse achieves fusion quality on par with state-of-the-art ANN-based methods while inheriting the energy efficiency of spike-based computation, with roughly an order of magnitude lower inference energy than the similarly-sized ANN-based DCEvo. Code will be released upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CIS-Fuse，一种基于膜电位级交叉模态融合的尖峰神经网络（SNN）用于红外与可见光图像融合（IVIF）。其核心电流注入尖峰（CIS）算子在神经元的膜电位阶段注入另一模态的门控辅助电流，实现融合前整合；双向交叉模态融合（BCMF）模块部署在非对称深度的双分支架构上。实验表明，CIS-Fuse的融合质量与当前最先进的基于人工神经网络（ANN）的方法相当，而推理能耗降低约一个数量级。
Motivation: 现有IVIF方法多基于ANN，计算密集；SNN能耗低但直接应用于IVIF时，二进制尖峰会丢失低于阈值的互补模态信息，而膜电位保留这些信息，但尚未有工作利用该特性进行融合。
Method: 提出CIS算子：将一种模态作为门控辅助电流注入另一种模态的驱动神经元，在膜电位层面进行融合，并带有可学习的每通道注入强度。基于CIS构建BCMF模块，部署在非对称深度（不同层数）的双分支架构上，形成功能特化。
Result: 在四个IVIF基准以及下游检测和分割任务上，CIS-Fuse融合质量与基于ANN的SOTA方法（如DCEvo）相当，而推理能耗仅为后者的约十分之一。
Conclusion: CIS-Fuse表明在膜电位层面进行跨模态融合能够兼顾SNN的低能耗与高质量融合，为IVIF提供了一条新的节能路径。

papers.title: Robust Activation Map Rectification for Weakly Supervised Volumetric Segmentation: Temporal Coherence as a Free Lunch
papers.abstract_en: Weakly supervised segmentation relies heavily on class activation maps (CAMs) to initially localize target regions. However, CAMs are often noisy and prone to catastrophic failures. Existing remedies typically introduce additional training stages or prototype learning, increasing computational cost and reducing robustness. In this paper, we propose a training-free prototype-free framework that rectifies unreliable CAMs by exploiting temporal and structural coherence in volumetric data as a free lunch. Our approach is built on two key components. First, we introduce Variance-Reduced Activation Aggregation (VRAA) which suppresses noise and amplify coherent semantic signals. We provide a theoretical justification by modeling CAMs as high-dimensional random vectors and show that aggregation yields provable variance reduction. Second, we design a Bidirectional Extremity Rectification (BER) mechanism that detects and rectifies implausible activations through bidirectional extremity checks, effectively mitigating extreme-value failures without learning additional parameters. Our method is model-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated with existing pipelines. Extensive experiments on multiple public benchmarks demonstrate substantial improvements over state-of-the-art weakly supervised methods, achieving up to 20% Dice and 40% mIoU gains while reducing inference time by more than 5 times. These results indicate that leveraging coherence as an implicit inductive bias yields a principled and efficient approach to stabilizing weakly supervised volumetric segmentation. Our code will be available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练、无需原型的弱监督体积分割框架，通过利用体积数据中的时间与结构一致性来修正不可靠的类激活图（CAMs）。核心包括方差缩减激活聚合（VRAA）和双向极端修正（BER），理论证明VRAA可降低方差。实验表明，该方法在多个公开基准上取得显著提升，最高Dice提升20%、mIoU提升40%，推理时间减少5倍。
Motivation: 弱监督分割依赖类激活图（CAMs）进行初始定位，但CAMs噪声大且易出现灾难性失败。现有修复方法通常引入额外训练阶段或原型学习，增加了计算开销并降低了鲁棒性。
Method: 提出训练无关、原型无关的框架，包含两个组件：方差缩减激活聚合（VRAA），通过将CAMs建模为高维随机向量并聚合来抑制噪声、增强一致语义信号；双向极端修正（BER），通过双向极端检查检测并修正不合理激活，无需学习额外参数。方法模型无关，可无缝集成现有流程。
Result: 在多个公共基准上，该方法相比最先进弱监督方法实现显著改进：最高Dice提升20%，mIoU提升40%，推理时间减少5倍以上。
Conclusion: 利用时间与结构一致性作为隐式归纳偏置，为稳定弱监督体积分割提供了一种原则性且高效的方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: KineBench: Benchmarking Embodied World Models via IDM-Free Kinematic Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating the physical consistency of embodied world models(EWMs) is a critical open challenge. While closed-loop evaluation via simulator rollouts offers a more faithful assessment of physical plausibility than open-loop alternatives, existing frameworks almost exclusively rely on Inverse Dynamics Models(IDMs) for action extraction. Due to the intricate mapping from 2D pixel space to 3D kinematic space, the learned IDMs can be brittle to data outside their training distribution, resulting in unreliable action extraction from the generated videos with novel objects and scenarios. This creates an unavoidable attribution ambiguity between world model inaccuracies and extractor errors. To reduce this ambiguity, we present KineBench, an IDM-free closed-loop benchmark for EWMs, built upon an explicit kinematic grounding pipeline. Given a generated video, KineBench employs cascaded visual foundation models to directly extract 6D end-effector poses from individual frames, which are then executed in a physics simulator for closed-loop validation. Beyond execution-based task success, KineBench incorporates two classical 3D kinematic metrics--Spectral Arc Length (SPARC) and the Maruyama Manipulability Index--to characterize trajectory smoothness and kinematic feasibility from a robot-centric perspective. Built on 20 diverse manipulation tasks in ManiSkill3, KineBench evaluates EWMs across four progressive suites: basic execution, task transfer, visual out-of-distribution generalization, and complexity-conditioned scaling. Evaluation across frontier models reveals task-complexity-bounded nonlinear scaling in embodied video generation, providing empirical guidance for future data-scaling strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出了 KineBench，一种无逆动力学模型（IDM-free）的具身世界模型闭环基准，通过级联视觉基础模型直接从视频帧提取6D末端执行器位姿，并在物理模拟器中进行闭环验证，避免了IDM外推不可靠导致的归因歧义。基准包含20个多样操作任务和四个渐进测试套件，评估发现前沿模型在具身视频生成中表现出任务复杂度约束的非线性缩放行为。
Motivation: 现有闭环评估依赖逆动力学模型（IDM）提取动作，但IDM对分布外数据脆弱，导致世界模型误差与提取器误差难以区分；亟需消除这种归因模糊的评估方法。
Method: 构建无IDM的闭环评估基准：使用级联视觉基础模型从生成视频的逐帧提取6D位姿，在物理模拟器中执行以实现闭环验证，并引入光谱弧长（SPARC）和Maruyama可操作性指数两种3D运动学指标。
Result: 在ManiSkill3的20个操作任务上，评估发现前沿模型在具身视频生成中呈现任务复杂度约束的非线性缩放规律。
Conclusion: KineBench为具身世界模型提供了更可靠的物理一致性评估手段，并揭示了视频生成能力与任务复杂度之间的非线性缩放关系，为未来数据缩放策略提供了经验指导。

papers.title: Overview of FinMMEval 2026 Task 2: Multilingual Financial Short-Answer Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: FinMMEval 2026 Task 2 evaluates short-answer financial question answering over multilingual evidence. Each final-test item pairs an English question with financial statements and news in English, Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, and Greek. Participating systems submit one concise answer per item in JSONL format. The final-test set contains 256 items, split evenly between easy and expert tiers; each tier contains four question templates instantiated over 32 company-report groups. Gold answers were withheld during submission, and systems were ranked by macro-averaged item-level ROUGE-1 F1 against organizer-held reference answers. The final leaderboard includes 12 ranked submissions. The strongest systems are closely clustered, with the top four separated by less than one percentage point in ROUGE-1 F1. The submitted system papers document retrieval-augmented generation, cross-lingual evidence handling, structured prompting, answer compression, and validation strategies.
papers.comment: 9 pages. Task overview paper for CLEF 2026 Working Notes (CEUR Workshop Proceedings)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FinMMEval 2026 任务2是一项多语言金融短答案问答评测，要求系统根据英语问题及多语种（英、中、日、西、希腊）财务证据生成简洁答案。最终测试集含256个问题，分为简单和专家两档，系统提交结果后按宏平均ROUGE-1 F1排名。最强的前四名系统得分差距小于1个百分点。
Motivation: 金融领域问答需要跨语言证据处理，现有评测多局限于单一语言或长文本，缺乏多语言短答案问答的标准化评测。
Method: 组织者提供了多语言财务陈述和新闻作为证据，要求系统输出每个问题的JSONL格式简短答案，采用宏观平均ROUGE-1 F1进行自动评估。
Result: 共有12个团队提交有效结果，前四名系统ROUGE-1 F1相差不到1个百分点，表现紧密。
Conclusion: 该评测揭示了多语言金融短答案问答的挑战，包括检索增强生成、跨语言证据处理、结构化提示、答案压缩与验证策略。

papers.title: Local Causal Structure Learning in the Presence of Latent Variables and Selection Bias
papers.abstract_en: Discovering the direct causes and effects of a target variable from observational data is a fundamental problem in causal discovery, with broad applications in domains such as gene regulatory analysis and biomedical research. Existing causal discovery methods either learn a global causal structure, which incurs substantial computational cost, or assume the absence of latent variables and selection bias, assumptions that are often violated in real-world settings. Motivated by these challenges, we study local causal structure learning in the presence of latent variables and selection bias. Specifically, we first characterize a local region that enables target-specific causal discovery without recovering the entire global structure. We then establish a theoretical bridge between causal information learned from the observed distribution induced on this local region and the corresponding information in the global causal structure. Building on these foundations, we propose LoCaLS, a local causal structure learning algorithm that is sound and complete under standard assumptions and identifies the same direct causes and effects of a target variable as those identifiable by global causal discovery methods, while allowing for latent variables and selection bias. Extensive experiments on random and real-world structures demonstrate that the proposed method consistently achieves higher structural accuracy than existing local methods while requiring substantially less computational effort than state-of-the-art global methods. Furthermore, applications to two real-world gene expression datasets reveal biologically plausible target-specific causal structures, demonstrating its practical applicability in large-scale biological data analysis.

TL;DR: 本文研究存在隐变量和选择偏差时的局部因果结构学习问题。作者首先刻画了一个局部区域，使得无需恢复全局结构即可进行目标特定的因果发现，并建立了局部观测分布与全局因果结构之间的理论联系。在此基础上提出LoCaLS算法，该算法在标准假设下是完备且可靠的，能够识别与全局方法相同的直接原因和效应，同时允许隐变量和选择偏差。实验表明，该方法在随机和真实结构上比现有局部方法具有更高的结构精度，且计算效率远优于全局方法。在真实基因表达数据集上的应用验证了其在实际大规模生物数据分析中的有效性。
Motivation: 现有因果发现方法要么学习全局结构导致高计算成本，要么假设不存在隐变量和选择偏差，这在现实中往往不成立。目标变量的直接原因和效应发现是因果发现的基本问题，但缺乏高效且能处理隐变量和选择偏差的局部方法。
Method: 提出LoCaLS算法。首先通过刻画一个局部区域实现目标特定的因果发现，无需全局结构；然后建立局部区域上观测分布与全局因果结构之间的理论桥梁，从而利用局部信息识别目标变量的直接原因和效应。
Result: 在随机和真实结构上的实验表明，LoCaLS比现有局部方法具有更高的结构精度，同时比最先进的全局方法计算量更少。在真实基因表达数据集上的应用发现了生物学上合理的因果结构。
Conclusion: LoCaLS能够在存在隐变量和选择偏差的情况下，仅通过局部信息识别目标变量的直接原因和效应，计算高效且理论完备。这对于大规模因果发现，特别是生物数据分析，具有实际应用价值。

papers.title: DocOps: A Verifiable Benchmark for Autonomous Agents in Complex Document Operations
papers.abstract_en: As autonomous agents rapidly evolve, their ability to reliably manipulate ubiquitous digital documents has become critical for enabling general-purpose AI assistants and automating complex workspace workflows. In this paper, we introduce DocOps, a deterministically verifiable evaluation framework underpinned by a hierarchical taxonomy that deconstructs document operations inspired by real-world practices into atomic dimensions and escalating workflow complexities. Based on DocOps, we systematically evaluate representative closed- and open-source models across various agentic harnesses, revealing that even the most advanced frontier configurations still exhibit profound limitations when handling highly coupled, long-range tasks. Furthermore, a fine-grained analysis of existing agents' manipulation behaviors uncovers 3 key failure modes: long-term state tracking collapse, shallow semantic verification, and destructive editing of structural metadata. Ultimately, our work exposes the capability boundaries of agents in maintaining global document consistency, shedding light on the future design of robust, non-destructive agents for complex digital ecosystems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DocOps，一个可确定性验证的评估框架，用于自主智能体在复杂文档操作中的能力。基于层次化分类法将文档操作分解为原子维度和递增的工作流复杂度。系统评估了多个闭源和开源模型，揭示了即使在最先进的配置下，处理高度耦合的长程任务时仍存在严重局限。细粒度分析发现了三种关键失败模式：长期状态跟踪崩溃、浅层语义验证、破坏性编辑结构元数据。
Motivation: 自主智能体的可靠文档操作能力对于通用AI助手和自动化工作流至关重要，但现有评估缺乏系统性和可验证性。
Method: 提出DocOps框架，基于层次化分类法分解文档操作，并构建可确定性验证的基准。
Result: 评估显示最先进模型在处理高度耦合长程任务时存在严重局限；发现三种关键失败模式。
Conclusion: 揭示了智能体在维护全局文档一致性方面的能力边界，为设计鲁棒、非破坏性的智能体提供启示。

papers.title: PRISM-DR: Per-lesion Retinal Inference with Specialist Models for Diabetic Retinopathy
papers.abstract_en: Diabetic retinopathy is a leading cause of preventable blindness; its early lesions are small, low contrast, and easily missed in manual screening. Most automated detectors handle the four non-proliferative DR lesions: microaneurysms, hemorrhages, hard exudates, and soft exudates, with a single multi-class model, even though these lesions differ sharply in size, color, morphology, and prevalence, so a shared model favors common, easy classes over rare, difficult ones. We present PRISM-DR, a lesion-specific pipeline that trains one single-class detector per lesion, each with its own configuration. From a raw fundus image, the pipeline applies region of interest cropping, fundus-specific preprocessing, four parallel YOLO detectors, tiling, per-lesion ensembling of five cross-validation folds, and an inter-lesion suppression step that resolves overlaps by physical lesion size and clinical priority rather than confidence. Per lesion, the best of five YOLO generations is selected, and augmentation is tuned by Bayesian optimization. Trained on IDRiD with stratified five-fold cross-validation, the system reaches a test mAP50 of 0.527 and F1 of 0.529, highest AP50 on hard exudates with 0.561. Without fine-tuning, the models transfer well where the imaging scale is close to IDRiD and degrade as field of view and resolution depart. These modest absolute results reflect a small single-source training set and a difficult task; however, treating each lesion as a separate detection problem is a practical alternative to a single multi-class model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PRISM-DR，一种针对糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）中四种非增殖性病变（微动脉瘤、出血、硬性渗出、软性渗出）的逐个病变检测流水线。每个病变使用独立的YOLO检测器，并分别配置预处理、数据增强和模型选择。在IDRiD数据集上，系统达到mAP50 0.527和F1 0.529，其中硬性渗出的AP50最高为0.561。尽管绝对值不高，但该方法表明将每个病变作为独立检测问题是一种实用的替代方案。
Motivation: 现有大多数自动检测器使用单一多类模型处理四种DR病变，但这些病变在大小、颜色、形态和患病率上差异显著，导致模型偏向常见类别而忽略罕见病变。本文旨在通过为每个病变训练专用检测器来缓解这一不平衡问题。
Method: PRISM-DR流水线包括：感兴趣区域裁剪、眼底图像特定预处理、四个并行的YOLO检测器（每个病变一个）、图像平铺、五折交叉验证的逐病变集成，以及基于病变物理大小和临床优先级的病变间抑制步骤。每个病变从五代YOLO中选出最佳版本，并使用贝叶斯优化调整数据增强。
Result: 在IDRiD数据集上使用分层五折交叉验证，系统达到测试集mAP50 0.527、F1 0.529，其中硬性渗出的AP50最高（0.561）。未经过微调迁移到其他数据集时，仅在与IDRiD成像尺度接近的数据集上表现良好，随着视野和分辨率差异增大而性能下降。
Conclusion: 虽然绝对性能指标不高，但这反映了训练集规模小且任务难度大。作者认为，将每种病变视为独立的检测问题，是实践中优于单一多类模型的可行替代方案。

papers.title: Memory-Augmented Multimodal Large Language Models for Small Object Understanding in Streaming Aerial Videos
papers.abstract_en: Language-guided aerial perception aims to understand user-specified tiny targets in complex unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) scenes. In real UAV deployment, the UAV must respond while it flies, so such perception runs in an online streaming manner, where frames arrive sequentially and the model responds to each one without access to future frames. However, applying current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to this setting raises two challenges. First, targets viewed from the air are often tiny, yet the visual compression in existing MLLMs treats all regions equally and discards their fine-grained details. Second, understanding a continuous stream requires past-frame context, yet retaining the entire history is infeasible on resource-constrained onboard hardware, whereas discarding it causes the target to drift or disappear. We address the tiny object and streaming challenges from both data and method perspectives. From the data perspective, we present \textbf{DroneEyes}, the \textbf{first} pixel-level and open-vocabulary referring-segmentation dataset for tiny aerial targets, comprising $2,140$ high-definition videos and $176,623$ pairs across Object Description and Referring Expression tasks, with dense per-frame masks. From the method perspective, we propose \textbf{SkyAnchor}, an MLLM with two designs to the above challenges: a Semantics-Aware Token Router that preserves small-target under a reduced visual-token budget, and a Hierarchical Memory Bank that keeps the target consistently understood on streams.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无人机在线流式航拍视频中小目标理解的两个核心挑战——视觉压缩丢失小目标细节以及资源受限下无法保留完整历史上下文——提出新数据集DroneEyes和新模型SkyAnchor。DroneEyes是首个像素级、开放词汇的航拍小目标指代分割数据集，包含2140个高清视频和176623对样本，带有逐帧密集掩码。SkyAnchor模型包含语义感知Token路由器（在减少视觉Token预算下保留小目标信息）和层次化记忆库（在流式处理中保持目标一致理解）。
Motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在无人机在线流式部署中面临两个问题：1）航拍目标通常很小，但MLLM的视觉压缩均匀对待所有区域，丢失了细粒度细节；2）流式理解需要过去帧的上下文，但在资源受限的机载硬件上保留全部历史不可行，而丢弃历史会导致目标漂移或消失。
Method: 从数据和模型两方面解决。数据方面，构建DroneEyes数据集，涵盖目标描述和指代表达任务，提供密集逐帧掩码。模型方面，提出SkyAnchor，包含两个核心设计：语义感知Token路由器（Semantics-Aware Token Router）在缩减视觉Token预算的同时保留小目标信息，以及层次化记忆库（Hierarchical Memory Bank）在流式处理中保持对目标的持续理解。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值，但声称通过数据集和模型设计有效解决了航拍小目标和流式理解两大挑战。
Conclusion: 本文贡献了首个专为航拍小目标设计的像素级开放词汇指代分割数据集，并提出了针对性的模型架构，为无人机在线流式感知场景提供了数据和方法基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Overview of FinMMEval 2026 Task 1: Multilingual Financial Multiple-Choice Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: FinMMEval 2026 Task 1 evaluates multilingual financial multiple-choice question answering in English, Chinese, Arabic, and Hindi. The task tests whether systems can select the correct answer to finance questions involving domain terminology, numerical interpretation, and conceptual financial reasoning across languages and scripts. The final-test set contains 800 questions, with 200 questions per language; gold answers were withheld during submission, and each language was ranked independently by accuracy. The final leaderboards contain 13 English, 11 Chinese, 11 Arabic, and 10 Hindi ranked submissions. Top accuracies range from 92.0% in Hindi to 97.5% in English and Arabic, with the same leading teams appearing near the top across all four languages. The documented systems used retrieval augmentation, direct answer-option scoring, language-specific prompting, selective self-consistency, confidence checks, and LLM-based review stages.
papers.comment: 9 pages. Task overview paper for CLEF 2026 Working Notes (CEUR Workshop Proceedings)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FinMMEval 2026 Task 1 是一个多语言金融多项选择题问答任务，涵盖英语、中文、阿拉伯语和印地语。测试集包含800道题（每语言200题），要求系统选择正确答案。最终排行榜显示，英语和阿拉伯语最高准确率达97.5%，印地语为92.0%。参赛系统使用了检索增强、直接答案评分、语言特定提示、自一致性、置信度检查和LLM评审等方法。
Motivation: 金融领域需要多语言问答能力，但缺乏跨语言金融问答基准。该任务旨在评估系统在不同语言和文字下处理金融术语、数值解释和概念推理的能力。
Method: 任务设计为800道多项选择题（每语言200题），各语言独立排名。参赛系统采用检索增强、直接答案选项评分、语言特定提示、选择性自一致性、置信度检查和基于LLM的评审阶段。
Result: 最终排行榜包含13个英语、11个中文、11个阿拉伯语和10个印地语提交结果。最高准确率：英语和阿拉伯语97.5%，中文未明确但相近，印地语92.0%。领先团队在所有四种语言中均名列前茅。
Conclusion: 该任务建立了多语言金融问答的基准，展示了不同语言下的性能差异，并确认检索增强和提示策略是有效方法。

summary_sections.result: 最终排行榜包含13个英语、11个中文、11个阿拉伯语和10个印地语提交结果。最高准确率：英语和阿拉伯语97.5%，中文未明确但相近，印地语92.0%。领先团队在所有四种语言中均名列前茅。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该任务建立了多语言金融问答的基准，展示了不同语言下的性能差异，并确认检索增强和提示策略是有效方法。

papers.title: Adversarial Frontiers: Minimum-Norm Attack Ensembles for Robustness Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial robustness is commonly evaluated with predefined attack ensembles, such as AutoAttack, at a single perturbation budget $\varepsilon$ and on a selective choice of perturbation norms. We argue this formulation is fundamentally limited. First, robustness--perturbation curves may intersect or decay at different rates across models, making single-$\varepsilon$ rankings unstable. Second, current ensembles provide no evidence of optimality, leaving an unknown gap to worst-case performance. Third, fixed attack configurations provide no systematic control over the trade-off between attack strength and evaluation cost. To address these limitations, we introduce a unified evaluation framework based on a comprehensive pool of minimum-norm attacks and robustness--perturbation curves across $\ell_0$, $\ell_1$, $\ell_2$ and $\ell_\infty$ norms. We define the attack frontier as the worst-case robustness estimate the attack pool produces against a model. We then formalize evaluation as a frontier-approximation problem, constructing minimum-norm attack ensembles, optimized subsets of the comprehensive pool, that approach the frontier under a controllable query budget, with larger budgets monotonically tightening the estimate. Furthermore, we define the defense frontier as the maximum robustness across the model set at each perturbation size. We finally propose the Defense Optimality Index to rank defenses by their gap to the defense frontier, providing a ranking without selecting a reference $\varepsilon$. On CIFAR-10 and ImageNet, our ensembles match or exceed AutoAttack on most defenses at every budget tier, at fixed and controllable query cost, offering practitioners a query-controlled, curve-based alternative to fixed-$\varepsilon$ evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于最小范数攻击的综合池和鲁棒性-扰动曲线的评估框架，定义了攻击前沿和防御前沿，并提出了防御最优性指数来对防御进行排序。在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上，该集成方法在可控查询预算下匹配或超越AutoAttack。
Motivation: 现有对抗鲁棒性评估使用预定义攻击集成（如AutoAttack），基于单一扰动预算和范数，存在局限性：单点排名不稳定、缺乏最优性证据、无法系统控制攻击强度与评估成本之间的权衡。
Method: 提出统一评估框架，包含跨ℓ0, ℓ1, ℓ2, ℓ∞范数的综合最小范数攻击池。定义攻击前沿为攻击池对模型产生的最坏情况鲁棒性估计，将评估形式化为前沿逼近问题，构建最小范数攻击集成，在可控查询预算下逼近前沿。同时定义防御前沿，提出防御最优性指数衡量防御与前沿的差距。
Result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上，提出的集成方法在大多数防御上匹配或超过AutoAttack，且查询代价固定可控。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了基于曲线的、查询可控的替代方案，优于固定ε评估。

papers.title: Asymptotically Optimal Regret for Reinforcement Learning without Horizon Dependence
papers.abstract_en: We study horizon-free regret minimization for finite-horizon time-homogeneous tabular Markov decision processes with $S$ states, $A$ actions, horizon $H$, and per-trajectory total reward bounded by $1$. We propose a new algorithm and prove a regret upper bound \[\tilde O(\sqrt{SAK}+S^8A^3)\] with failure probability $δ$, where $K$ is the number of episodes and $\tilde O(\cdot)$ hides $\mathsf{poly}\log(S,A,K,1/δ)$. Thus, the regret is $H$-free and asymptotically optimal, matching the contextual-bandit lower bound $Ω(\sqrt{SAK})$ up to logarithmic factors. This completely removes the $\log H$ dependence from the previous $\tilde O(\sqrt{SAK\log H}+S^2A\log H)$ guarantee of Zhang et al. (2021), and drastically improves the prior best horizon-free regret $\tilde O(\sqrt{S^9A^3K})$ of Zhang et al. (2022) asymptotically. The main technical difficulty is that the optimal value functions $\{V_h^*\}_{h=1}^H$ are time-inhomogeneous even though the transition kernel is time-homogeneous. A direct union bound over all value functions typically incurs an additional $\min\{\log H,S\}$ factor. We avoid this factor by (i) exploiting the monotonicity of $V_h^*$ in $h$ and (ii) non-trivially projecting the value functions onto an $S$-dimensional grid. Our analysis relies on three additional ingredients. First, we introduce a horizon-truncation argument that enables reward-based exploration and removes the cost of a separate reward-free exploration phase. Second, we design a cutting bonus that preserves both optimism and the monotonicity needed for planning. Third, we prove a new bound on total deviation for time-homogeneous MDPs, which controls the clipped variance terms in the cutting bonus with adjustable polynomial dependence on $S$ and without any dependence on $H$. Together, these tools yield an asymptotically optimal horizon-free regret guarantee.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对有限时域齐次表格型MDP，提出一种新算法，实现无水平依赖的渐近最优遗憾界 $\tilde O(\sqrt{SAK}+S^8A^3)$，完全去除了此前工作中的 $\log H$ 因子，并在渐近意义上大幅改进了先前最佳的 $\tilde O(\sqrt{S^9A^3K})$ 遗憾界。主要技术包括利用最优值函数的单调性、投影到 $S$ 维网格、水平截断论证、切割奖励函数以及时间齐次MDP的总偏差新界。
Motivation: 现有强化学习遗憾界通常依赖水平 $H$，而 $H$ 可能未知或极大，导致实际应用受限。本文旨在消除 $H$ 依赖，实现与上下文赌博机相匹配的渐近最优遗憾。
Method: 提出一种新算法，通过利用最优值函数 $V_h^*$ 在 $h$ 上的单调性，将其非平凡地投影到 $S$ 维网格，避免直接联合界带来的额外 $\min\{\log H,S\}$ 因子。同时引入水平截断论证、保证乐观与单调性的切割奖励函数，以及针对时间齐次MDP的总偏差新界。
Result: 证明遗憾上界为 $\tilde O(\sqrt{SAK}+S^8A^3)$，其中 $K$ 为回合数，且不依赖于水平 $H$，匹配了上下文赌博机的下界 $\Omega(\sqrt{SAK})$（忽略对数因子）。相比 Zhang et al. (2021) 的 $\tilde O(\sqrt{SAK\log H}+S^2A\log H)$ 去除了 $\log H$ 依赖，相比 Zhang et al. (2022) 的 $\tilde O(\sqrt{S^9A^3K})$ 有渐近提升。
Conclusion: 本文完全消除了强化学习遗憾界中的水平依赖，实现了渐近最优的无水平遗憾保证，主要贡献在于处理时间不均匀最优值函数的新技术以及一系列分析工具。
