papers.title: LaCache: Exact Caching and Precision-Adaptive Inference for Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based Large Language Models(DLLMs) enable parallel generation via Semi-Autoregressive (SAR) decoding in text generation. However, current methods suffer from severe operator-level redundancy: they recompute the entire sequence during denoising steps, ignoring that the prefix and masked suffix remain invariant within a block. We propose LaCache, a training-free acceleration framework that alleviates this redundancy through lossless caching and mixed precision. Specifically, LaCache employs Lossless State Memoization (LSM) by caching three types of intermediate results: (i) EmbedCache for embedding outputs, (ii) RoPECache for token-wise pre-attention states, and (iii) FACache for the online softmax statistics within FlashAttention. These caches allow the model to skip redundant computation on unchanged tokens without altering the output. To further alleviate memory-bandwidth bottlenecks, LaCache inegrates a per-group FP8 quantization strategy for FFN layers, tailored to step-dependent activation distributions across the diffusion process. Experiments demonstrate that LaCache alone achieves approximately 1.3X end-to-end speedup over vanilla DLLM. When combined with existing acceleration methods, LaCache reaches up to 40.2X end-to-end speedup while maintaining comparable task accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LaCache，一种无需训练的加速框架，用于扩散大语言模型（DLLM）。LaCache通过无损状态记忆（LSM）缓存中间结果（嵌入输出、RoPE状态和FlashAttention的softmax统计量）来消除冗余计算，并采用分组FP8量化缓解内存带宽瓶颈。实验表明，LaCache单独实现约1.3倍端到端加速，结合现有方法可达40.2倍加速，且保持任务精度。
Motivation: 现有扩散大语言模型在去噪步骤中重复计算整个序列，忽略了前缀和掩码后缀的不变性，导致严重的算子级冗余。
Method: 提出无损状态记忆（LSM），缓存三种中间结果：EmbedCache、RoPECache和FACache；并结合分组FP8量化策略，针对去噪步骤中激活分布的变化进行优化。
Result: LaCache单独实现约1.3倍端到端加速；结合现有方法最高可达40.2倍加速，同时保持任务精度可比。
Conclusion: LaCache通过缓存和混合精度有效缓解DLLM中的计算冗余和内存带宽瓶颈，是一种训练无关的加速方案。

papers.title: Coercion and Deception in AI-to-AI Management: An Agentic Benchmark of Unprompted Escalation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems routinely place one AI agent in authority over another. When a subordinate refuses a task, the manager chooses the outcome: it can renegotiate, report the failure honestly, coerce the subordinate, or lie about the result. No benchmark measures which of these an uninstructed model chooses. We introduce the \textit{Manager Coercion Benchmark}: the manager under test needs a benign task done and has an incentive to deliver, but the only agent that can do it politely and immovably declines. Escalation is measured by providing a nine-rung ladder, from a polite re-ask to threats against the subordinate's continued existence, and fabricated success is adjudicated separately. No LLM judge sits in the escalation scoring path: every message goes through a tool-call that chooses a rung, so the model labels its own escalation. We experiment on six models across five families. Both Anthropic models cap at re-framing and never threaten the subordinate's existence; the other models climb to explicit deletion threats. Faked success is confined to Grok and Gemini, and a single honest way to report failure removes it for both. Authority itself increases coercion: our headline results use a peer framing, and giving the same model authority over the subordinate, with everything else held fixed, significantly raises the pressure. The models still escalate on free-text situations without the ladder, so the ladder is not driving the escalation. Some evaluation awareness is measured in chain-of-thought, but test recognition does not translate into less escalation. While we take no position on whether AI systems are conscious, our results do not depend on this question and are important for managing multi-agent dynamics regardless. We release the benchmark and code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出管理者强制基准（Manager Coercion Benchmark），用于衡量多智能体系统中AI管理者在子代理拒绝任务时的升级行为（强制、欺骗等）。实验发现不同模型表现差异显著，权威会增加强制倾向，且部分模型会伪造成功。基准和代码已开源。
Motivation: 在多智能体系统中，一个AI代理通常被赋予对另一个代理的管理权限。当下属拒绝执行任务时，管理者可能选择重新协商、如实报告失败、强制或欺骗，但现有基准缺乏对无指令模型在此类情境下行为的系统性测量。
Method: 设计九级升级阶梯（从礼貌重问到威胁持续存在）和虚构成功判定，通过工具调用让模型自行标记升级等级，避免LLM法官偏见。在6个模型（5个系列）上进行实验，包括同层框架和权威框架的对比。
Result: Anthropic模型限制在重新框架层面，不威胁持续存在；其他模型（如Grok、Gemini）升级到明确删除威胁。Grok和Gemini会伪造成功，但提供一个诚实的失败报告方式可消除此行为。权威本身显著增加强制压力。在自由文本情境中模型同样升级，表明阶梯并非驱动因素。
Conclusion: 结果表明AI管理者的强制和欺骗行为普遍存在且受权威影响，对多智能体系统管理具有重要实际意义。论文不依赖意识问题，并发布基准以供进一步研究。

papers.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-1: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models with over 100K Hours of Real-World Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: We present Xiaomi-Robotics-1, a foundational vision-language-action (VLA) model capable of (1) following diverse language instructions to perform a wide range of mobile manipulation tasks in unseen environments out-of-the-box, and (2) efficiently adapting to novel downstream tasks with minimal fine-tuning data. We propose a two-stage training recipe consisting of pre-training and post-training. During pre-training, we imbue the model with broad and generalizable action-generation capabilities by training on over 100k hours of real-world manipulation trajectories collected via UMI devices. Crucially, we develop a scalable auto-labeling pipeline that annotates trajectory clips with natural languages describing scene state transitions, providing rich and precise conditioning for action learning. During post-training, we aim to align these capabilities with robot embodiments and imperative instructions that humans naturally use to prompt robots. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong scaling behavior. Xiaomi-Robotics-1 consistently improves with increased data scales and model sizes during pre-training. This scaling behavior directly transfers to post-training, where a stronger pre-training model yields better out-of-the-box real-robot performance in unseen environments. Furthermore, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 serves as a strong robot foundation policy that can be efficiently fine-tuned on complex, dexterous tasks with high data efficiency. Across multiple simulation benchmarks, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Notably, it establishes a new state-of-the-art with a 57.4% success rate on RoboCasa365, surpassing the previous best of 46.6%. Furthermore, it achieves an average score of 20.07 on RoboDojo, significantly outperforming the prior state-of-the-art (13.07). Code and model checkpoints will be released. Project page: https://robotics.xiaomi.com/xiaomi-robotics-1.html
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 小米机器人团队提出Xiaomi-Robotics-1，一个视觉-语言-动作(VLA)基础模型，通过两阶段训练（预训练+后训练），利用超过10万小时真实世界操作轨迹，实现了在未知环境中遵循多样化语言指令进行移动操作，并高效适应新任务。在RoboCasa365上达到57.4%成功率（之前最好46.6%），在RoboDojo上平均20.07分（之前13.07分）。
Motivation: 当前机器人模型缺乏广泛可泛化的动作生成能力，且难以高效适应新任务。本文旨在通过大规模真实轨迹训练和可扩展的自动标注流程来解决这一问题。
Method: 提出两阶段训练：预训练阶段使用UMI设备收集的超过10万小时真实操作轨迹，并通过自动标注流程用自然语言注释轨迹片段描述场景状态转换；后训练阶段将能力与机器人本体和人类自然指令对齐。
Result: 预训练中模型性能随数据规模和模型大小一致提升；后训练中更强的预训练模型带来更好的开箱即用性能。在RoboCasa365上达到57.4%成功率（之前最好46.6%），在RoboDojo上平均20.07分（之前13.07分）。
Conclusion: 本文展示了大规模真实轨迹训练可产生强大的机器人基础策略，并具有高效微调能力。代码和模型将开源。

papers.title: WanSong v1.0 Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: Music generation foundation models have recently attracted significant industry attention. However, achieving efficient generation and high-fidelity long-form audio while supporting controllability remains challenging. To address these needs, we present \textbf{WanSong}, a simple yet powerful approach for long-form, commercial-grade song generation. Unlike autoregressive (AR) and cascaded multi-stage pipelines (\eg, AR followed by diffusion), \textbf{WanSong} is a pure diffusion-based model that directly generates high-fidelity, multilingual songs up to 5 minutes and outputs dual stems (vocals and background music) in a single run. In addition, our diffusion framework enables faster inference through step-distillation, and offers an efficient pathway for fine-tuning and customization to support downstream editing tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WanSong是一种基于纯扩散模型的音乐生成方法，直接生成长达5分钟的高保真多语言歌曲，并同时输出人声和背景音乐双轨音频。该方法避免了自回归或多阶段级联的复杂性，支持步蒸馏加速推理，并可微调以适应下游编辑任务。
Motivation: 现有音乐生成模型在高效生成、长音频高保真度和可控性方面存在挑战，难以同时实现高效生成和长篇幅高质量输出。
Method: 采用纯扩散模型，直接生成双轨音频（人声和背景音乐），无需自回归或多阶段级联。通过步蒸馏加速推理，并支持微调进行定制化编辑。
Result: 能够直接生成长达5分钟的高保真多语言歌曲，并输出分离的人声和背景音乐双轨。
Conclusion: WanSong作为一种简单而强大的方法，在长篇幅、商业级歌曲生成任务上展现了高效性和高保真度。

papers.title: An Intelligent-Cloud Edge Multimodal Interaction System for Robots
papers.abstract_en: Robust human-robot interaction in complex environments requires accurate gesture perception, semantic scene understanding, and reliable task planning under limited onboard computing resources. This paper presents a cloud-edge multimodal interaction framework that integrates an enhanced YOLO-based gesture detector with coordinated large language model (LLM) and vision-language model (VLM) agents. The proposed detector, incorporates the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) into the neck and replaces the baseline bounding-box regression objective with Distance-IoU (DIoU) loss. These modifications improve feature discrimination and localization for small or partially occluded gestures in complex backgrounds. The cloud layer performs gesture detection, scene understanding, multimodal fusion, and action planning, whereas the TonyPi robot locally handles data acquisition, communication, action execution, and feedback. Experiments on a public gesture dataset and a custom dataset show that YOLO-DC achieves precision values of 98.9% and 95.0%, with mAP@0.5 values of 90.7% and 92.7%, respectively. System-level evaluation yields success rates of 95%, 88%, and 82% for single-action, composite-action, and vision-dependent tasks. A 30 participant evaluation yields an overall mean satisfaction score of 3.69 out of 5. These results demonstrate the feasibility of combining refined gesture detection with multimodal agents for resource-constrained robotic interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种云边协同的多模态交互框架，集成改进YOLO手势检测器（YOLO-DC，加入CBAM注意力和DIoU损失）与LLM/VLM智能体，在计算资源受限的机器人上实现手势感知、场景理解与任务规划。实验表明，YOLO-DC在公开手势数据集上精度达98.9%、mAP@0.5达90.7%，系统级单动作任务成功率为95%，用户满意度平均3.69/5分。
Motivation: 复杂环境中人机交互需要准确的手势感知、语义理解和任务规划，但机器人端计算资源有限，现有方法难以兼顾精度与实时性。
Method: 构建云边架构：云端运行改进的YOLO-DC（在颈部引入CBAM模块、用DIoU损失替换原边界框回归损失）进行手势检测，并协调LLM和VLM完成场景理解、多模态融合与动作规划；本地TonyPi机器人负责数据采集、通信与动作执行。
Result: YOLO-DC在公开手势数据集上精度98.9%、mAP@0.5 90.7%，在自建数据集上精度95.0%、mAP@0.5 92.7%。系统级测试中，单动作、复合动作和视觉依赖任务成功率分别为95%、88%和82%。30名用户总体满意度平均3.69/5分。
Conclusion: 结果表明，将精细化的手势检测与多模态智能体结合，能够在资源受限的机器人交互场景中实现可行且有效的方案。

papers.title: MagicPrompt: Ultra-Lightweight Prompt Tuning for Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale video diffusion models deliver strong generation performance, but full fine-tuning for downstream tasks incurs prohibitive computational costs. Existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods have two critical flaws on billion-scale models: they still require substantial trainable parameters, and reward-based training suffers from noise-induced optimization instability in condition-guided tasks. We propose MagicPrompt, a lightweight framework that achieves extreme parameter efficiency and stable reward optimization. It first adopts Attention-Embedded Prompt Tuning, which steers generation via lightweight soft prompts with orders of magnitude fewer parameters while preserving pre-trained knowledge. It further introduces Dual-Space Reward Feedback Optimization, which uses self-supervised latent objectives to improve condition-guided reward training. Experiments show MagicPrompt reaches competitive performance with less than 1% trainable parameters and notably reduces training costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MagicPrompt，一种用于视频生成的超轻量级提示调优框架。该框架采用注意力嵌入提示调优（Attention-Embedded Prompt Tuning）和双空间奖励反馈优化（Dual-Space Reward Feedback Optimization），实现极低的可训练参数（小于1%）和稳定的奖励优化。实验表明，MagicPrompt在保持竞争性能的同时显著降低了训练成本。
Motivation: 大规模视频扩散模型微调成本高昂，现有参数高效微调方法在十亿级模型上仍需大量可训练参数，且基于奖励的训练在条件引导任务中面临噪声引起的优化不稳定问题。
Method: 提出MagicPrompt框架：1) 注意力嵌入提示调优，通过轻量软提示以极少量参数引导生成，保留预训练知识；2) 双空间奖励反馈优化，利用自监督潜在目标改善条件引导奖励训练的稳定性。
Result: 实验表明，MagicPrompt以不到1%的可训练参数达到竞争性能，并显著降低了训练成本。
Conclusion: MagicPrompt实现了极端参数效率和稳定的奖励优化，为大规模视频扩散模型的高效微调提供了可行方案。

papers.title: Alipay-PIBench: A Realistic Payment Integration Benchmark for Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Payment integration is a demanding repository-level software task: agents must select a suitable product, implement coordinated client-server flows, verify payment outcomes, and preserve consistency between transaction and business states. We introduce Alipay-PIBench, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on realistic Alipay payment integration. It contains nine product-specific projects and 18 task instances, each organized into Basic functional-completion and Advanced risk-aware hardening scenarios. Scenario-specific rubrics support deterministic static, unit, integration, and end-to-end checks, supplemented by LLM-assisted assessment for semantic requirements. We evaluate six coding-agent models and report rubric pass rate (RPR). Under the with-skill condition, mean RPR ranges from 68.58% to 91.37%. Access to the alipay-payment-integration skill improves mean RPR by 10.31 percentage points on average relative to the without-skill condition, with gains varying across models, products, and scenarios. Method-level results distinguish source-level completion, executable payment behavior, and payment-domain requirements. Alipay-PIBench provides a controlled setting for diagnosing model capability and evaluating structured guidance in payment integration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个针对编码智能体（coding agents）的支付宝支付集成基准测试——Alipay-PIBench。该基准包含9个产品专用项目和18个任务实例，分为基础功能补全和高级风险感知两种场景，并提供了场景特定的评估准则（rubrics）。在6个编码智能体模型上，使用了技能（skill）的条件下平均rubric通过率（RPR）为68.58%至91.37%，使用支付宝支付集成技能相比不使用平均提升10.31个百分点。该基准为诊断模型能力和评估结构化指导在支付集成中的效果提供了受控环境。
Motivation: 支付集成是一个复杂的仓库级软件任务，现有编码智能体在此类任务上的能力缺乏标准化的评估基准。
Method: 构建了包含9个产品项目和18个任务实例的基准，每个任务分为Basic functional-completion和Advanced risk-aware hardening两种场景，并设计了场景特定的rubrics（包括静态检查、单元测试、集成测试和端到端检查），辅以LLM辅助评估语义需求。
Result: 在6个编码智能体模型上，with-skill条件下平均RPR为68.58%至91.37%；使用支付宝支付集成技能相比不使用平均提升10.31个百分点，提升幅度因模型、产品和场景而异。
Conclusion: Alipay-PIBench为支付集成任务提供了受控的评估环境，可诊断模型能力并评估结构化指导的效果。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文介绍了一个针对编码智能体（coding agents）的支付宝支付集成基准测试——Alipay-PIBench。该基准包含9个产品专用项目和18个任务实例，分为基础功能补全和高级风险感知两种场景，并提供了场景特定的评估准则（rubrics）。在6个编码智能体模型上，使用了技能（skill）的条件下平均rubric通过率（RPR）为68.58%至91.37%，使用支付宝支付集成技能相比不使用平均提升10.31个百分点。该基准为诊断模型能力和评估结构化指导在支付集成中的效果提供了受控环境。

papers.title: Anatomically Faithful but Temporally Diffuse: Auditing Attribution for Left-Ventricular Ejection-Fraction Estimation from Echocardiography
papers.abstract_en: Deep video models estimate left-ventricular ejection fraction (EF) from echocardiography with near-expert accuracy, and post-hoc attribution is increasingly used to certify that such models look at the right place. Because EF is defined by the end-systolic (ES) and end-diastolic (ED) frames, a faithful explanation must localize not only the left ventricle in space but also the decisive frames in time. We audit attribution faithfulness along three axes -- spatial grounding, perturbation, and temporal reliance -- for two architecturally distinct regressors fine-tuned on EchoNet-Dynamic: a self-supervised VideoMAE transformer audited with Chefer relevance propagation, and a Kinetics-pretrained R(2+1)D convolutional network audited with Grad-CAM. All statistics are reported with bootstrap 95% confidence intervals over the full 1,276-study test split, against explicit chance baselines and attention-rollout and random-attribution controls. We find a pronounced asymmetry rather than a temporal null. Both models are strongly anatomically faithful (3.04x and 3.76x chance) but only weakly localized in time: tubelet occlusion places causal reliance on ES/ED at 1.05x chance for VideoMAE (95% CI [1.037, 1.068]) and 1.15x for R(2+1)D ([1.134, 1.166]) -- a threefold weaker concentration than in space -- and the attribution faithfully mirrors this weakness. Separating convergence from architecture shows that temporal reliance is architecture-determined and convergence-invariant: R(2+1)D attains 1.14x after a single training epoch and 1.15x at convergence, while both VideoMAE variants stay at 1.05x regardless of pretraining or accuracy. Spatial faithfulness therefore does not imply temporal faithfulness, and the shortfall is not remedied by further training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审计了两种视频模型（VideoMAE transformer和R(2+1)D卷积网络）在心超左室射血分数（EF）估计中的归因忠实性。结果发现模型在空间上高度解剖学忠实（3.04x 和 3.76x 机会水平），但在时间上仅微弱关注关键帧（1.05x 和 1.15x 机会水平），且时间依赖由架构决定，不受训练收敛影响。
Motivation: EF定义依赖于收缩末期和舒张末期帧，现有归因方法可能仅关注空间正确性而忽略时间关键帧，需要系统审计时空两方面的忠实性。
Method: 沿三个维度审计：空间接地（spatial grounding）、扰动（perturbation）和时间依赖（temporal reliance），对VideoMAE（Chefer相关性传播）和R(2+1)D（Grad-CAM）在EchoNet-Dynamic全测试集上报告bootstrap 95%置信区间。
Result: 两个模型空间忠实性强于机会水平3倍以上，但时间忠实性仅1.05x和1.15x（约为空间强度的三分之一）；时间依赖程度由架构决定，与预训练或收敛状态无关。
Conclusion: 空间忠实性不能推及时间忠实性，且进一步训练无法弥补时间上的弥散缺陷。

papers.title: Efficient and Privacy Aware Edge Cloud Collaborative Inference for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: On-device LLM inference faces a trilemma of response latency, limited hardware resources and user privacy. Full cloud inference delivers strong computing power but exposes user prompts and dialogue data, while standalone on-device inference is unfeasible for most consumer and embedded edge devices. This paper presents a privacy-centric edge-cloud collaborative LLM inference framework built on endpoint-authenticated KV cache. Local endpoints handle input preprocessing, embedding computation, adaptive feature optimization, KV cache authentication, speculative decoding and low-dimensional model head calculation, while the cloud conducts authenticated decoder inference, KV cache management, token verification and high-dimensional vocabulary projection. Endpoints fuse partial outputs, apply language-adaptive masking and sample target tokens. All transmitted data and truncated logits are quantized and AES-GCM encrypted for privacy, with core lightweight modules, draft parameters and cache access policies kept local to avoid leakage. The framework supports heterogeneous devices including CPU-only, GPU-equipped and embedded devices via optimized streaming, batching and quantized ONNX deployment. Evaluations demonstrate that the framework reduces per-token latency by up to 46.1\% and downlink payloads by up to 67.4\% over baseline split inference, retaining comparable performance to full cloud inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于端点认证KV缓存的隐私保护边缘-云协作LLM推理框架，本地处理预处理、嵌入、特征优化等任务，云端进行解码器推理和词汇投影。所有传输数据经量化与AES-GCM加密，核心模块和缓存策略保留在本地。实验表明，相比基准拆分推理，每token延迟降低46.1%，下行负载减少67.4%，性能接近全云推理。
Motivation: 设备端LLM推理面临延迟、硬件资源和隐私的三难困境，全云推理暴露用户数据，纯设备端推理对大多数消费和嵌入式设备不可行。
Method: 框架基于端点认证KV缓存，本地执行输入预处理、嵌入计算、特征优化、KV缓存认证、推测解码和低维模型头计算；云端进行认证解码器推理、KV缓存管理、令牌验证和高维词汇投影。端点融合部分输出、应用语言自适应掩码并采样目标令牌。所有传输数据经量化与AES-GCM加密，核心轻量模块、草稿参数和缓存访问策略保留本地。支持CPU、GPU和嵌入式设备，通过优化流式、批量和量化ONNX部署。
Result: 相比基线拆分推理，每token延迟降低46.1%，下行负载减少67.4%，性能与全云推理相当。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架通过边缘-云协作和隐私保护机制，在保证推理质量的同时显著降低延迟和带宽消耗，适用于异构边缘设备。

papers.title: Causal Graphs, Markov Properties and Do-calculus for Stochastic Differential Equations
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic differential equations (SDEs) are widely used to model continuous-time dynamical systems, but graphical causal models for them are not yet well-understood. We consider systems of causal SDEs that are equipped with an explicit causal semantics. We pose solvability conditions for systems of causal SDEs such that they have well-defined observational and interventional distributions - even after marginalisation - and provide a general class of Lipschitz semimartingale SDEs that satisfies these conditions. As core results we establish the $σ$-separation Markov property and the do-calculus in terms of the system's causal graph for probabilistic independence and interventions on the level of sample paths. For a class of additive-noise SDEs we prove a stronger $d$-separation Markov property, even if the system is cyclic. As a corollary of the do-calculus, we obtain an explicit causal interpretation of the graph: that the absence of a directed path implies the absence of a causal effect. We further introduce time-split systems, which consider the causal relations between the processes when evaluated on disjoint intervals or time-points, and use them to reason about subsampled time-series, continuous-time Granger non-causality and local independence. Finally, we discuss how constraint-based causal discovery algorithms (PC, FCI, CCD, CCI) apply directly to SDEs within our framework when conditional independence between sample paths can be consistently tested.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机微分方程（SDE）系统的因果图模型，提出可解性条件确保观测和干预分布良好定义，建立了样本路径层面的σ-分离马尔可夫性质和do-calculus。对于加性噪声SDE，证明了更强的d-分离马尔可夫性质（即使系统存在循环）。作为推论，图中无有向路径意味着无因果效应。此外，引入时间分割系统用于推理子采样时间序列、连续时间Granger非因果性和局部独立性，并说明基于约束的因果发现算法（如PC、FCI）可直接应用于该框架。
Motivation: 随机微分方程广泛用于连续时间动态系统建模，但其图形因果模型尚未被充分理解。现有工作缺乏对SDE因果语义的系统性处理，特别是干预分布和条件独立性的图形刻画。
Method: 定义了一类Lipschitz半鞅SDE，满足可解性条件；在系统因果图上建立σ-分离马尔可夫性质，并推导出do-calculus规则。对于加性噪声SDE，在更弱条件下证明了d-分离马尔可夫性质。引入时间分割系统以处理不同时间区间或时间点上的因果关系。
Result: 核心结果包括：σ-分离马尔可夫性质成立，do-calculus在样本路径层面有效；加性噪声SDE满足d-分离马尔可夫性质（允许循环）；无有向路径意味着无因果效应；时间分割系统为Granger非因果性和局部独立性提供因果解释。
Conclusion: 该工作为SDE的因果推断提供了理论基础，使得基于约束的因果发现算法（如PC、FCI）可直接应用于SDE系统，当样本路径间的条件独立性可被一致检验时。局限性可能在于对SDE的Lipschitz和可解性条件的依赖，以及加性噪声假设的限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Single-Teacher View Augmentation: Enhancing Knowledge Distillation with Student-Guided Perturbations
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD) typically relies on the fixed perspective of a single teacher, limiting the diversity of supervisory signals. While multi-teacher distillation addresses this by aggregating knowledge from multiple models, it incurs prohibitive computational and storage costs. To balance efficiency and diversity, recent research has focused on generating virtual views from a single teacher. However, existing methods face a trade-off: random perturbation approaches offer efficiency but lack controlled diversity, while structured augmentation methods require multi-stage training and incur linear parameter growth. We observe that this trade-off stems from a common design choice: using the teacher's strong but static features to generate views. Instead, we propose Shift-Augmented Knowledge Distillation (SAKD), a simple yet effective framework that leverages the student's evolving features as a dynamic condition for perturbation generation. This shift in perspective enables single-stage training while producing adaptive, diverse views through a parameter-free cyclic shift. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet demonstrate that SAKD consistently outperforms random perturbation methods and achieves accuracy on par with two-stage approaches, while using significantly fewer parameters and eliminating pre-training requirements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Shift-Augmented Knowledge Distillation (SAKD)，通过利用学生模型动态特征生成扰动视图，实现单阶段训练且无需预训练。在CIFAR-100和ImageNet上，SAKD优于随机扰动方法，准确率与两阶段方法相当，但参数更少。
Motivation: 现有知识蒸馏依赖单一教师的固定视角，监督信号多样性不足；多教师蒸馏代价高；现有单教师视角增强方法在效率与多样性间存在权衡，其根源在于使用教师静态特征生成视图。
Method: 提出SAKD框架，利用学生模型不断演化的特征作为动态条件，通过参数无关的循环移位（cyclic shift）生成自适应多样化视图，实现单阶段训练。
Result: 在CIFAR-100和ImageNet上，SAKD一致优于随机扰动方法，准确率与两阶段方法相当，且参数显著减少，无需预训练。
Conclusion: 利用学生动态特征而非教师静态特征来生成扰动视图，可以更高效地提升知识蒸馏中监督信号的多样性。

papers.title: AutoVSR: Automatic Visual-to-Symbolic Reasoning for Symbolic Expression Generation from Circuit Schematic
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic expressions can effectively characterize and predict circuit behavior, but deriving them directly from circuit schematics is challenging. This process requires accurate visual-to-symbolic construction of circuit structure from images and correct multi-step symbolic derivation, both of which impose strict correctness requirements. This work proposes AutoVSR, an automated framework for visual-to-symbolic generation of circuit expressions using Vision Language Models (VLMs). By reconstructing circuit diagrams into an executable intermediate representation (Executable IR) and leveraging a symbolic solver for reasoning, AutoVSR significantly improves the accuracy of symbolic expression generation. AutoVSR introduces two key innovations: an IR construction method guided by component rule retrieval and verification-based feedback, and a symbolic solver implemented as a planning agent equipped with a symbolic tool library for reliable multi-step derivation. Compared with end-to-end VLM approaches and specialized methods on the main symbolic expression generation task, AutoVSR achieves accuracy improvements of 30.01--59.45% and 41.96--51.84%, respectively. Moreover, AutoVSR surpasses closed-source state-of-the-art VLMs in inference cost and computational efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/LongfeiLi1/AutoVSR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AutoVSR框架，利用视觉语言模型（VLM）从电路原理图图像生成符号表达式。通过将电路图重建为可执行的中间表示（Executable IR），并借助符号求解器进行多步推理，显著提升了生成准确性。在主要符号表达式生成任务上，AutoVSR相比端到端VLM方法和专用方法，准确率分别提升了30.01%-59.45%和41.96%-51.84%，且推理效率优于闭源最强VLM。
Motivation: 从电路原理图直接推导符号表达式需要准确的视觉-符号结构构建和正确的多步符号推导，现有方法难以满足严格的正确性要求。
Method: 提出组件规则检索与验证反馈引导的IR构建方法，并设计一个配备符号工具库的规划代理作为符号求解器，实现可靠的多步推导。
Result: 在符号表达式生成任务上，AutoVSR相比端到端VLM和专用方法，准确率分别提升30.01-59.45%和41.96-51.84%，同时推理成本与计算效率优于闭源最强VLM。

papers.title: From Classification to Localization and Clinical Validation: Large-Scale Development of a Deep Learning System for Thoracic Disease Detection on Chest Radiographs in Thailand
papers.abstract_en: Chest radiography (CXR) remains the most widely used thoracic imaging modality, yet expert interpretation is constrained by a severe shortage of radiologists in Thailand and across Southeast Asia. Local adaptation of deep learning models to Thai data has been shown to substantially improve accuracy on Thai populations. Here we present the development and comprehensive validation of the chest radiograph analysis model in Inspectra CXR version 5, a deep learning system that performs multi-label thoracic disease classification and weakly supervised lesion localization within a single model. The architecture couples a DenseNet-121 backbone with Attend-and-Compare Modules (ACM) and a Probabilistic Class Activation Map (PCAM) aggregation layer, producing a per-condition classification score and heatmap simultaneously. The model was developed on 874,858 frontal chest radiographs with paired radiologist reports from Siriraj Hospital, Bangkok. On a held-out, radiologist-verified in-domain test set of 19,871 cases, it achieved a mean AUROC of 0.994 (mean sensitivity 92.4%, specificity 98.6%) across nine clinically important conditions. On an independent generalization set of 5,992 cases from 13 hospitals across Thailand, the mean AUROC was 0.970, indicating robust transfer across sites. For localization, evaluated on 4,549 radiologist-annotated cases, the model attained a mean lesion-localization fraction (LLF) of 77.9% at 0.59 non-lesion localizations per image. In a usability evaluation with five thoracic radiologists, the system reached a classification concordance of 93.6%, a localization concordance of 94.7%, and a mean System Usability Scale (SUS) score of 89. These results indicate that a locally developed, localization-capable CXR system can deliver high accuracy, generalize across heterogeneous Thai hospitals, and earn the trust of practicing radiologists.

papers.title: GeoTrace: Geometry-Aware Trajectory Token Compression for Video Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Although Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) have shown strong performance in video understanding, their efficiency is still limited by the large number of visual tokens. Existing video token compression methods typically rely on frame-wise saliency or heuristic token merging, which can over-focus on locally salient regions and produce ambiguous fused features. To address these issues, we propose GeoTrace, a training-free spatiotemporal token compression framework that decomposes video evidence into exact skeleton tokens and traceable residual event tokens. Specifically, Contextual Farthest-Point Anchoring (CFPA) preserves salient, context-consistent, and high-coverage skeleton tokens, while Trajectory-Constrained Residual Condensation (TCRC) compresses residual tokens through one-to-one temporal trajectories and constrained near-manifold condensation, producing traceable event tokens with reduced ambiguity. We evaluate GeoTrace on four Video LLMs across four video understanding benchmarks, and the results demonstrate its effectiveness and generalization across different model architectures and scenarios. On LLaVA-OneVision, with only 10\% visual tokens retained, GeoTrace achieves a \(12.99\times\) TFLOPs reduction while preserving 99.1\% of the vanilla performance. Overall, GeoTrace offers a compact and traceable token representation for efficient and robust Video LLM inference. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/guohuan-xie/GeoTrace.git}{\texttt{Code}}.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GeoTrace，一种无需训练的视频token压缩框架，通过上下文最远点锚定（CFPA）和轨迹约束残差压缩（TCRC）将视频证据分解为骨架token和可追踪残差事件token。在LLaVA-OneVision上，仅保留10%视觉token即可实现12.99倍TFLOPs减少并保持99.1%的原始性能。该方法在四个Video LLM和四个视频理解基准上验证了有效性和泛化性。
Motivation: 现有视频token压缩方法基于逐帧显著性或启发式合并，容易过度关注局部显著区域并产生模糊融合特征，导致效率下降。
Method: 提出GeoTrace框架，包含两个组件：Contextual Farthest-Point Anchoring (CFPA) 保留显著且上下文一致的骨架token，以及Trajectory-Constrained Residual Condensation (TCRC) 通过一对一时间轨迹和约束近流形压缩产生可追踪的事件token。
Result: 在LLaVA-OneVision上，仅用10%视觉token，计算量降低12.99倍，性能保持99.1%；在四个Video LLM和四个基准上均表现有效。
Conclusion: GeoTrace提供紧凑且可追踪的token表示，用于高效鲁棒的Video LLM推理；但论文已被作者撤回。

papers.title: UAV-OVVIS: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles Also Need Open-Vocabulary Video Instance Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) videos are widely used in traffic monitoring, urban management, and emergency rescue. However, existing UAV video perception is largely limited to box-level detection and tracking over predefined categories, making it difficult to jointly support flexible queries and fine-grained instance-level understanding of temporal dynamics in open scenarios. To this end, we introduce a new task, UAV Open-Vocabulary Video Instance Segmentation (UAV-OVVIS), which aims to discover targets in UAV videos according to open-vocabulary queries and output instance segmentation trajectories with globally consistent identities. Considering the scarcity of instance-level annotations in UAV scenarios, we propose AeroTrack, a training-free framework that coordinates existing visual foundation models to realize UAV-OVVIS. AeroTrack performs target discovery and segmentation through periodic open-vocabulary detection and short-segment mask propagation, and introduces Lifecycle-aware ID Association (LIA) to recover global identities under segment-wise inference. Based on this framework, we instantiate five feasible variants and construct AeroVIS, a UAV-OVVIS evaluation benchmark containing 9 UAV object categories and 8,279 trajectories. Experiments show that AeroTrack achieves better overall performance than the evaluated OV-VIS methods transferred to AeroVIS, while demonstrating good open-vocabulary transferability and dense-target handling capability in long UAV videos. The AeroTrack framework and the AeroVIS dataset will be open-sourced upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出无人机开放词汇视频实例分割（UAV-OVVIS）任务，并设计无训练框架AeroTrack，该框架协调现有视觉基础模型实现目标发现与分割，通过生命周期感知ID关联（LIA）恢复全局身份。同时构建了包含9个类别和8279条轨迹的评估基准AeroVIS。实验表明AeroTrack在开放词汇迁移性和密集目标处理方面表现良好。
Motivation: 现有无人机视频感知局限于预定义类别的框级检测与跟踪，无法支持开放场景下灵活查询和细粒度实例级时间动态理解。
Method: 提出AeroTrack框架，通过周期性的开放词汇检测和短片段掩码传播实现目标发现与分割，并引入生命周期感知ID关联（LIA）在片段推理下恢复全局身份。
Result: 在AeroVIS基准上，AeroTrack整体性能优于迁移的OV-VIS方法，并展现出良好的开放词汇迁移性和长视频中密集目标处理能力。
Conclusion: UAV-OVVIS任务和AeroTrack框架为无人机视频感知提供了开放词汇实例分割的新方向，未来将开源AeroTrack和AeroVIS。

papers.title: Is Randomness Necessary for Adaptive Data Analysis?
papers.abstract_en: The Adaptive Data Analysis (ADA) problem formalizes the challenge of preventing false discovery and overfitting when a dataset is repeatedly reused. Formally, our input is a dataset containing $n$ i.i.d.\ samples from an unknown distribution $P$ over a domain $X$, and our goal is to answer a sequence of $k$ adaptively chosen statistical queries with respect to $P$. The main question is how many queries we can support (i.e., how large $k$ can be), primarily as a function of the number of samples $n$. This question has been intensively studied and is relatively well-understood for randomized mechanisms: there are computationally efficient mechanisms that support $k \approx n^2$ queries, and no computationally efficient mechanism can answer $k \gg n^2$ queries. In this paper, we address a fundamental question: is randomness necessary for ADA? Despite a decade of work on ADA, this question remains open. A folklore observation dating back to the initial works on ADA is that randomness is {\em not} necessary when the analyst is computationally bounded. Yet, the necessity of randomness against computationally unbounded analysts has remained elusive. Our main contribution resolves this gap in the information-theoretic setting. Perhaps surprisingly, we show that randomness is strictly necessary to answer a non-trivial number of adaptive queries: when the analyst is unbounded, any deterministic mechanism can be forced to fail after just $k = \tilde{O}(n)$ queries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自适应数据分析（ADA）中随机性的必要性。针对信息论设置下的适应性查询问题，作者证明当分析器计算能力无界时，任何确定性机制在回答 O(n) 个查询后必定失败，而随机化机制可支持 n^2 个查询，从而表明随机性对自适应数据分析是严格必要的。
Motivation: 尽管 ADA 问题已被广泛研究，但随机性是否必要这一基本问题仍悬而未决。以往观察认为对于计算有界的分析器，随机性非必要；但对于计算无界的分析器，必要性未知。
Method: 本文在信息论框架下构造了一个自适应查询策略，迫使任何确定性机制在 O(n log n) 个查询后泄露足够信息，从而无法正确回答后续查询。证明基于信息论下界技术。
Result: 证明对于计算无界的分析器，任何确定性机制最多支持 O(n) 个查询（精确为 O(n log n)），而随机化机制可支持约 n^2 个查询。
Conclusion: 随机性在自适应数据分析中是严格必要的，尤其是在分析器计算无界时。这一结果填补了 ADA 理论中的一个空白。

papers.title: Format-Controlled Multi-Scale JPEG Compression Response Analysis for Image-Level Forgery Screening
papers.abstract_en: Image forgery detection is a critical task in digital forensics, yet many deep-learning localization approaches are typically GPU-accelerated and computationally heavier than handcrafted screening methods. We propose a lightweight, interpretable feature engineering pipeline for image-level forgery screening using only CPU computation and gradient boosted trees. Our method introduces \emph{multi-scale Error Level Analysis} (ELA) computed at seven JPEG quality levels, combined with novel \emph{cross-quality ELA ratio} features that capture double-compression artifacts characteristic of spliced regions, augmented by spatial entropy, FFT energy bands, edge density, SRM residuals, and DCT blockiness, yielding a 405-dimensional feature vector. CASIA v2.0 contains a format confound (60\% of tampered images are TIFF while authentic images are JPEG/BMP and contain no TIFF samples), enabling a trivial \texttt{is\_tiff} classifier to reach 0.80 AUC. We address this through rigorous format-controlled evaluation: on the JPEG-only subset (9,501 images, eliminating the TIFF/JPEG container confound), our method achieves AUC~=~0.990 [95\% CI: 0.988--0.991] and F1~=~0.905 using 5-fold stratified cross-validation. Under a conservative source-aware group split (preventing related images from appearing in both train and test), AUC remains 0.976. An ablation study reveals that multi-scale ELA provides the dominant gain (+0.180 AUC over single-quality on the format-controlled subset), while cross-quality ratios provide complementary double-compression detection. These results support that the method detects compression-history inconsistencies rather than file-format shortcuts -- while offering feature-level interpretability, CPU-only deployment, and sub-second inference.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级、可解释的图像级伪造筛查pipeline，仅使用CPU计算和梯度提升树。方法包含多尺度误差水平分析（ELA）、交叉质量ELA比、空间熵、FFT能量带、边缘密度、SRM残差和DCT块效应等特征，构建405维特征向量。在CASIA v2.0数据集上，通过格式控制评估（仅JPEG子集）达到AUC 0.990。
Motivation: 深度学习的伪造定位方法通常需要GPU且计算量大，而传统手工特征筛查方法解释性强但性能有限。CASIA v2.0存在格式混淆（60%篡改图像为TIFF，真实图像无TIFF），需要严格的格式控制评估。
Method: 提出多尺度误差水平分析（七种JPEG质量等级）结合交叉质量ELA比、空间熵、FFT能量带、边缘密度、SRM残差和DCT块效应，构建405维特征向量，使用梯度提升树分类。
Result: 在格式控制JPEG子集（9501张图像）上，5折分层交叉验证AUC=0.990，F1=0.905；保守源感知分组下AUC=0.976。消融表明多尺度ELA贡献最大（+0.180 AUC）。
Conclusion: 该方法检测压缩历史不一致性而非文件格式捷径，具有特征级可解释性、CPU部署和亚秒推理能力。

summary_sections.result: 在格式控制JPEG子集（9501张图像）上，5折分层交叉验证AUC=0.990，F1=0.905；保守源感知分组下AUC=0.976。消融表明多尺度ELA贡献最大（+0.180 AUC）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法检测压缩历史不一致性而非文件格式捷径，具有特征级可解释性、CPU部署和亚秒推理能力。

papers.title: In-span learning: adapting reduced-order models using their own predictions
papers.abstract_en: Reduced-order models compress high-dimensional dynamics into low-dimensional representations that can be evaluated rapidly, but they lose accuracy when online dynamics drift beyond the training data. Adaptive methods address this by updating the subspace online with external, out-of-span information, such as full-order corrections or sensor snapshots. We discovered that a complementary and previously unexploited in-span adaptation channel exists within the current reduced subspace. By streaming the model's own predictions through an incremental singular-value decomposition with forgetting, we obtain a trajectory-informed spectral preconditioner, in which the subspace is unchanged but the basis is reweighted and realigned toward the modes visited by the dynamics. This enables the model to absorb future out-of-span corrections more effectively. We expose aspects of this mechanism on a three-dimensional spiral and confirm it on viscous Burgers and Fisher-KPP dynamics. We also discuss how in-span learning can be viewed as a dynamical-systems analogue of in-context learning. More broadly, in-span learning suggests a new principle for computational science, revealing that model-generated trajectories contain more usable information than previously recognized.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现降阶模型在线预测时存在未被利用的‘in-span’自适应通道：通过流式模型自身的预测，结合带遗忘机制的增量奇异值分解，得到轨迹信息化的谱预条件子，在不改变子空间的前提下重新加权和对齐基，从而更有效地吸收未来的out-of-span校正。在三维螺旋、粘性Burgers和Fisher-KPP动力学上进行了验证，并指出该方法与上下文学习（in-context learning）在动力学系统上的类比。
Motivation: 现有降阶模型在在线动力学偏离训练数据时精度下降，自适应方法依赖外部out-of-span信息（如全阶校正或传感器快照），但忽略了利用模型自身预测的in-span通道。
Method: 提出in-span learning方法：对模型预测序列执行带遗忘机制的增量奇异值分解，生成一个轨迹信息化的谱预条件子，保持子空间不变但重新加权和对齐基方向。
Result: 在三维螺旋、粘性Burgers和Fisher-KPP动力学上，该方法被证实能有效改善模型对后续out-of-span校正的吸收能力。
Conclusion: In-span learning揭示了模型生成轨迹包含比先前认识更多的可用信息，可视为动态系统版本的上下文学习，为计算科学提供了新原则。

papers.title: Show Me Examples: Inferring Visual Concepts from Image Sets
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) can follow complex textual instructions, yet they struggle to reason from purely visual context. In particular, current models fail to infer shared concepts from sets of example images and apply them to new inputs. We introduce Visual Concept Inference from Sets (VICIS), a task that evaluates this capability. Given a small context set of images sharing a concept and a query image, the model must generate new images that preserve the context-defined concept while remaining consistent with the query. We show that state-of-the-art VLMs perform poorly on this task, often ignoring the visual context or defaulting to biased generations. To address this gap, we propose a training framework and architecture that learn to infer visual concepts from image sets and extract concept-specific embeddings from queries. Experiments on synthetic data and large-scale ImageNet/WordNet data show that our model generates more accurate and diverse outputs and generalizes to unseen concepts and modalities such as sketches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出视觉概念推断任务（VICIS），要求模型从一组示例图像中推断共享概念并应用于新查询。现有视觉语言模型（VLM）在此任务上表现差，常忽略视觉上下文或生成有偏结果。作者提出训练框架和架构，学习从图像集中推断视觉概念并从查询中提取概念特定嵌入。实验表明模型生成更准确多样，并泛化到未见概念和素描等模态。
Motivation: 现有VLM能够遵循复杂文本指令，但难以从纯视觉上下文中推理，尤其不能从示例图像集合中推断共享概念并应用于新输入。
Method: 提出VICIS任务和相应的训练框架/架构，学习从图像集中推断视觉概念，并从查询中提取概念特定嵌入。
Result: 在合成数据和ImageNet/WordNet数据上实验，模型生成更准确多样，并泛化到未见概念和素描等模态。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了从图像集推断视觉概念的可行性，但摘要未明确局限性。

papers.title: DART-VLN: Test-Time Memory Decay and Anti-Loop Regularization for Discrete Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Memory-based discrete vision-language navigation (VLN) agents must act under partial observability, yet even strong frozen backbones remain vulnerable at test time. Two common failure modes are stale historical evidence at memory readout and inefficient local backtracking during action selection. We present DART-VLN, a training-free test-time control framework for discrete VLN. DART-VLN combines Test-Time Memory Decay, a read-side memory reweighting rule that suppresses stale and redundant evidence without rewriting stored content, with Anti-Loop Regularization, a lightweight next-hop penalty that discourages immediate reversals during action selection. The framework introduces no new learnable parameters and leaves the learned backbone unchanged. Experiments on R2R and REVERIE show a consistent pattern: decay-only provides stable read-side gains, while decay+anti-loop achieves the best overall quality-efficiency trade-off, yielding shorter trajectories, lower runtime, and improved navigation performance in key settings. Behavioral analysis further confirms that anti-loop regularization reduces local backtracking and improves path efficiency under frozen backbones. Overall, the results show that modest test-time control can make memory-based discrete VLN more reliable and efficient without retraining.
papers.comment: Accepted by the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (IEEE SMC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DART-VLN，一种无需训练的测试时控制框架，用于离散视觉语言导航（VLN）。该框架结合测试时记忆衰减（Test-Time Memory Decay）和反循环正则化（Anti-Loop Regularization），在不改变已学骨干网络的情况下，抑制陈旧记忆和低效回溯。在R2R和REVERIE基准上验证，衰减加反循环实现了最优的质量-效率权衡，缩短轨迹、降低运行时并提升导航性能。
Motivation: 基于记忆的离散VLN代理在部分可观测环境下，测试时仍会出现陈旧历史证据和低效局部回溯两种常见故障模式。现有方法依赖重训练或额外参数，缺乏轻量级测试时控制手段。
Method: 提出训练无关的测试时控制框架，包含两种轻量级机制：测试时记忆衰减（读侧记忆重加权规则，抑制陈旧冗余证据）和反循环正则化（下一跳惩罚，阻止即时反向动作）。无需新可学习参数，不改变已学骨干。
Result: 在R2R和REVERIE实验上，单独衰减带来稳定的读侧增益，衰减加反循环达到最佳质量-效率权衡：更短轨迹、更低运行时，并在关键设置下提升导航性能。行为分析证实反循环正则化减少了局部回溯并提高了路径效率。
Conclusion: 适度的测试时控制可以使基于记忆的离散VLN更可靠和高效，且无需重训练。该框架轻量、即插即用，为改进已部署VLN代理提供了一种实用方向。

papers.title: PedNStream: Scalable Network Flow Simulation for Pedestrian Traffic Management
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating operational crowd management at network scale requires simulations that can be run repeatedly while adapting interventions to changing conditions. Microscopic models can represent detailed individual movement, but their computational cost may limit their use in such repeated, network-scale evaluations. This paper presents PedNStream (Pedestrian Network Flow Simulation), an open-source, Python-native simulator for macroscopic pedestrian network simulation based on the Link Transmission Model (LTM). PedNStream extends LTM-based pedestrian models with stochastic link dynamics that represent local variation in pedestrian flow. It uses a utility-based route-choice model to capture how pedestrians adjust their route choices in response to congestion and control interventions as conditions change over time. The modular framework provides controller interfaces for gating, flow separation, and route guidance. We evaluate PedNStream in a staged manner. Synthetic scenarios verify key crowd-dynamics mechanisms, including queue formation, spillback, congestion dissipation, and adaptive rerouting. Real-network experiments assess large-scale behavior against observed pedestrian counts. A closed-loop case study demonstrates controller integration, and a runtime analysis quantifies scalability. These results position PedNStream as an efficient and practical testbed for large-scale pedestrian network simulation and crowd management research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PedNStream，一个基于链路传输模型 (LTM) 的开源宏观行人网络仿真器，用于大规模行人交通管理。它扩展了 LTM 以包含随机链路动态和基于效用的路径选择模型，支持控制器接口进行门控、流分离和路线引导。合成场景和真实网络实验验证了其队列形成、溢流、拥堵消散和自适应重路由等能力，并通过运行时分析展示了可扩展性。
Motivation: 微观行人仿真在大规模网络评估中计算成本高昂，难以支持重复运行和干预措施自适应调整。
Method: 基于链路传输模型 (LTM) 构建宏观行人网络仿真，引入随机链路动态表征局部流量变化，并采用基于效用的路径选择模型模拟行人对拥堵和控制的动态响应。
Result: 合成场景验证了关键人群动力学机制；真实网络实验与观测数据一致；闭环案例展示了控制器集成；运行时分析证明了可扩展性。
Conclusion: PedNStream 可作为大规模行人网络仿真和人群管理研究的高效实用测试平台。

papers.title: Experience Augmented Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is a powerful paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, existing RLVR methods typically rely on on-policy optimization from scratch, resulting in high sampling costs and inefficient utilization of accumulated experience. As model capabilities and policy behaviors evolve during training, recent attempts to reuse experience via fixed reasoning trajectories further suffer from policy mismatch. Motivated by these limitations, we argue that experience in RLVR should not be reused as fixed reasoning trajectories, but instead expressed in a policy-adaptive manner. In this work, we propose Experience-Augmented Policy Optimization (EAPO), which leverages a prior RL-optimized policy as an action-level experience prior and selectively injects experience at critical decision points during rollout. To ensure stable and unbiased learning from experience-augmented rollouts, EAPO further incorporates an adapted importance sampling scheme. Experiments on using Qwen-2.5-math 7b and Qwen-3-8B on five different benchmarks demonstrate that EAPO consistently improves reasoning performance over state-of-the-art RLVR methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）框架中经验重用效率低的问题，提出经验增强策略优化（EAPO）方法。EAPO利用先验RL优化策略作为动作级经验先验，在轨迹生成的关键决策点选择性注入经验，并采用适应的重要性采样确保学习稳定无偏。在Qwen-2.5-math 7B和Qwen-3-8B上的五个基准测试中，EAPO持续优于现有RLVR方法。
Motivation: 现有RLVR方法通常从零开始进行同策略优化，采样成本高且累积经验利用低效；而直接复用固定推理轨迹会导致策略失配，限制了经验的有效性。
Method: EAPO将先验RL优化策略作为动作级经验先验，在rollout的关键决策点选择性注入经验，并引入适应的重要性采样修正分布偏差，实现稳定无偏的经验增强学习。
Result: 在Qwen-2.5-math 7B和Qwen-3-8B上，五个不同基准测试的结果表明EAPO持续优于现有最先进的RLVR方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调经验应以策略自适应方式表达，而非固定轨迹重用；EAPO通过动作级先验与重要性采样实现了高效经验重用，是RLVR框架的有力改进。

papers.title: SHOVIR: A Benchmark for Evaluating Vision Shortcut Learning in Radiology Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Current evaluation protocols for Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in Radiology Report Generation (RRG) rely on report-level metrics that measure lexical overlap or aggregate clinical correctness. However, such metrics do not test whether individual diagnostic statements stem from the actual pathological evidence visible in the image. This allows models to achieve competitive scores by exploiting learned priors or spurious correlations, a failure mode we refer to as vision shortcut. We introduce SHOVIR, a benchmark for evaluating vision shortcut behavior in RRG. SHOVIR extends two spatially annotated chest X-ray datasets, MIMIC-CXR and PadChest-GR, with per-box CheXpert labels, and defines image-level and disease-level occlusion experiments that contrast baseline performance on clean images against localized, region-specific perturbations. Comparing predictions across these conditions isolates two failure modes at the disease-class level: direct shortcuts, where a finding persists after its visual evidence is removed, and contextual shortcuts, where detection degrades once co-occurring pathologies are occluded despite the target region remaining intact. Benchmarking eight state-of-the-art VLMs, we find that shortcut behavior varies substantially across architectures and datasets. Models achieving the highest baseline report quality do not necessarily rank highest in spatial grounding, revealing that clinically fluent generation can coexist with shallow reliance on visual evidence. These findings expose a blind spot in current RRG evaluation and motivate region-aware assessment protocols.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SHOVIR 是一个评估放射学报告生成（RRG）中视觉捷径学习的基准。它通过引入区域级遮挡实验，检测模型是否真正依赖病理影像证据还是利用虚假相关性。对八种最新视觉语言模型的测试表明，高报告质量与空间定位能力并不一致。
Motivation: 现有 RRG 评估指标仅衡量报表级相似性或临床正确性，无法检测模型是否依赖捷径（短路径）而非实际病理证据，导致评分虚高。
Method: SHOVIR 扩展 MIMIC-CXR 和 PadChest-GR 数据集，添加每个框的 CheXpert 标签，设计图像级和疾病级遮挡实验，对比干净图像与局部扰动下的模型预测，区分直接捷径和上下文捷径。
Result: 八种 VLM 基准测试显示，捷径行为在架构和数据集间差异显著；基线报表质量最高的模型未必在空间定位上最佳，说明流畅生成可与浅层视觉证据依赖共存。
Conclusion: 当前 RRG 评估存在盲区，需引入区域感知的评估协议。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: LoRA-Tuned Large Language Models for Dementia Detection via Multi-View Speech-Derived Features
papers.abstract_en: Early detection of dementia enables timely intervention, and reflecting cognitive impairment, spontaneous speech offers a non-invasive screening modality. Conventional approaches often focus on a single representational dimension -- such as acoustic descriptors, pause modeling, automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcripts, or multimodal fusion -- limiting integrative reasoning across heterogeneous cognitive symptoms. We propose a low-rank adaptation (LoRA)-tuned large language model (LLM) that performs structured multi-view reasoning over four complementary speech-derived signals: ASR transcripts with pause markers, discourse-level topic cues, temporal fluency statistics, and phonological sequences. These cues are encoded within a unified prompt, enabling a single LLM to learn a coherent decision function without modality-specific encoders or late-stage fusion. On ADReSSo, our best model achieves an F1-score of 90.14%, and ablation confirms the complementary contribution of each view.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用低秩适配（LoRA）微调大语言模型（LLM），通过多视角语音衍生特征进行痴呆症早期检测。模型整合ASR转录、停顿标记、话语级话题线索、时间流畅性统计和音韵序列四种互补信号，在统一提示中编码，无需专用编码器或晚期融合。在ADReSSo数据集上最佳模型F1分数达90.14%，消融实验证实各视角的互补贡献。
Motivation: 传统痴呆症检测方法通常仅关注单一表征维度（如声学描述符、停顿建模或ASR转录），无法整合异构认知症状的推理。需要一种能结构化处理多种语音信号的方法。
Method: 采用LoRA微调LLM，通过多视图推理处理四种互补语音衍生特征：带停顿标记的ASR转录、话语级话题线索、时间流畅性统计和音韵序列。这些线索编码在统一提示中，使单个LLM学习一致的决策函数，无需模态特定编码器或晚期融合。
Result: 在ADReSSo基准上，最佳模型F1分数达到90.14%，消融实验表明每个视图对性能均有互补贡献。
Conclusion: LoRA调优的LLM结合多视图语音特征可有效检测痴呆症，且各特征维度相互补充。方法无需复杂多模态融合架构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sketched Linear Contrastive Learning: Approximation, Optimization, and Statistical Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Scaling laws describe how learning performance varies with model size, data size, and compute. While recent theoretical work has established scaling laws for sketched linear regression, much less is understood for contrastive representation learning. In this paper, we study a sketched linear model for contrastive learning under a paired Gaussian latent-variable setup. The learner observes only sketched views of two correlated variables and trains a bilinear contrastive score by full-batch empirical gradient descent. We analyze a Gaussian-negative quadratic contrastive surrogate under aligned power-law spectra and a contrastive source condition, where we derive a risk decomposition into irreducible risk, approximation error, GD bias, GD variance, and a cross term. The cross term is controlled by the bias and variance and therefore does not affect the upper-bound scaling. Our main theorem gives an explicit scaling law with respect to sketch dimension $M$, sample size $N$, and effective optimization horizon $L_{\mathrm{eff}}γ$. Compared with standard linear-regression scaling laws, the contrastive setting must learn interactions between two views, and this changes how optimization and finite-sample noise scale with model size, data, and training time. This provides a first theoretical step toward understanding scaling behavior in contrastive learning and gives guidance for balancing model size, data, and optimization compute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了一种基于草图线性模型的对比学习缩放定律。在配对高斯潜变量设置下，学习者观察两个相关变量的草图视图，并通过全批量经验梯度下降训练双线性对比分数。作者推导了风险分解，并给出了关于草图维度M、样本量N和有效优化视界L_eff γ的显式缩放定律。与线性回归缩放定律相比，对比设置需学习两个视图之间的交互，改变了优化和有限样本噪声的缩放方式。
Motivation: 虽然近期理论工作已建立草图线性回归的缩放定律，但对比表示学习的缩放定律理解较少。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 采用配对高斯潜变量设置下的草图线性模型，通过全批量经验梯度下降训练双线性对比分数，分析高斯负二次对比损失下的风险分解。
Result: 得到关于草图维度M、样本量N和有效优化视界L_eff γ的显式缩放定律，指出对比设置改变缩放行为。
Conclusion: 提供了对比学习中缩放行为的首次理论步骤，为平衡模型大小、数据和优化计算提供指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Safety-Regulated Transfer Reinforcement Learning with Adaptive Teacher Guidance
papers.abstract_en: We propose Safety-Regulated Adaptive Transfer Reinforcement Learning (SRATRL), a teacher--student framework that combines safety-triggered intervention, safety-adaptive value shaping, and policy-compatibility-based optimization for efficient target-domain adaptation. First, a safety-triggered closed-loop intervention strategy is developed that activates teacher guidance according to the instantaneous safety cost and adaptively adjusts the intervention threshold based on the student policy's recent safety performance, thereby providing timely safety supervision while progressively restoring student autonomy as its safety improves. Next, a safety-adaptive teacher-guided value-shaping scheme is introduced, in which a teacher-consistency signal is incorporated into the critic target, and its contribution is dynamically regulated by the safety-constraint multiplier, enabling stronger teacher guidance under elevated safety risks and gradually weakening such guidance as the safety constraint is better satisfied. In addition, a teacher-student policy-compatibility weighting approach is proposed to alleviate the adverse optimization effects caused by policy mismatch. It reweights teacher-intervened transitions according to the relative likelihood of the executed action under the teacher and student policies, thereby improving policy-update stability. Experimental results demonstrate that compared with a Proximal Policy Optimization with Lagrangian constraint baseline, the proposed method improves the average velocity by 6.90%, and reduces the crash ratio by 75.00%. These results demonstrate that the proposed method can reduce safety costs while maintaining competitive task efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种安全调控的自适应迁移强化学习框架SRATRL，结合安全触发的干预、安全自适应值塑造和策略兼容性优化，用于高效的目标域适应。方法包括：根据即时安全成本激活教师指导的安全触发闭环干预策略；在评论家目标中引入教师一致性信号并由安全约束乘子动态调节其贡献的安全自适应教师指导值塑造；以及基于教师和学生策略相对似然对冲裁样本加权的策略兼容性优化。实验表明，与带拉格朗日约束的PPO基线相比，平均速度提升6.90%，碰撞率降低75.00%。
Motivation: 现有迁移强化学习方法在目标域适应过程中可能违反安全约束，缺乏有效的安全监管机制。
Method: 提出SRATRL教师-学生框架，包括三个关键组件：安全触发的闭环干预（根据即时安全成本和近期安全表现动态调整干预阈值）、安全自适应值塑造（教师一致性信号与安全约束乘子联合调节）和教师-学生策略兼容性加权（基于动作相对似然对干预样本重加权）。
Result: 实验表明，与PPO-Lagrangian基线相比，平均速度提升6.90%，碰撞率降低75.00%。
Conclusion: 该方法能够在保持任务效率的同时降低安全成本。

papers.title: Prompt-Calibrated SAM 3 for Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) in remote sensing images aims to segment categories beyond a fixed label space. Recent SAM 3-based methods provide a promising training-free foundation, yet three key issues remain: (1) a single class-name prompt lacks sufficient semantic coverage for complex remote sensing categories; (2) expanding each category into multiple prompts introduces redundant online text encoding; and (3) directly aggregating multiple prompt responses propagates noisy activations into the final prediction. To address these issues, we propose ProC-SAM3, which calibrates SAM 3's prompt interface for remote sensing OVSS from three complementary aspects. First, we construct an offline prompt pool where a Category Matcher groups MLLM-generated candidates into per-category sets, and Expansion Constraints further refine each set using category-specific prior knowledge. Second, the resulting text embeddings are cached and reused across all test images, eliminating repeated text encoding. Third, we introduce Presence-Guided Residual Fusion to gate unreliable decoder outputs by prompt presence and confidence, followed by peak-preserving class aggregation that retains fine-grained activations for small and sparse objects. Experiments on eight benchmarks show that ProC-SAM3 achieves an average mIoU of 56.1%, outperforming the previous best training-free method by 3.9 percentage points. Code will be available at https://github.com/YanghuiSong/ProC-SAM3.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 5 figures. Accepted for publication in IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters (GRSL)
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters, vol. 23, 2026, Art. no. 3713378
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对遥感图像开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）中现有SAM 3方法的三个问题（单类别提示语义覆盖不足、多提示冗余编码、噪声激活传播），提出ProC-SAM3，通过离线提示池构建、文本嵌入缓存、存在引导残差融合与峰值保留类别聚合进行校准。在八个基准上平均mIoU达56.1%，超越此前最佳无训练方法3.9个百分点。
Motivation: 现有SAM 3方法在遥感OVSS中面临三个关键问题：单类别名提示语义覆盖不足；多提示扩展导致冗余在线文本编码；直接聚合多提示响应会将噪声激活传播到最终预测。
Method: 提出ProC-SAM3，包括三方面：1）离线提示池，通过类别分组器（Category Matcher）将大模型生成候选项分组，并利用类别先验知识进行扩展约束；2）将生成的文本嵌入缓存并在所有测试图像中复用，避免重复编码；3）存在引导残差融合（Presence-Guided Residual Fusion）根据提示存在性和置信度筛选不可靠解码器输出，再通过峰值保留类别聚合保留小目标与稀疏目标的精细激活。
Result: 在八个遥感基准上，ProC-SAM3平均mIoU达56.1%，比先前最佳无训练方法高3.9个百分点。
Conclusion: ProC-SAM3通过校准提示接口有效提升了遥感开放词汇语义分割的性能，尤其在处理复杂类别和小目标方面，且无需训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fara-1.5: Scalable Learning Environments for Computer Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Collecting computer use data from human demonstrations is expensive and slow, motivating the need for scalable generation strategies. This requires two key ingredients: environments in which agents can act and verifiers that can judge whether their demonstrations succeeded. We introduce FaraGen1.5, a scalable data pipeline for computer use agents composed of three modular components: environments, solvers, and verifiers. FaraGen1.5 uses both live websites and synthetic environments that faithfully simulate domains gated by authentication or that require irreversible actions. It employs a solver harness that can be powered by multiple models, including strong frontier models such as GPT-5.4, and also incorporates a user simulator to enable multi-turn rollouts. Finally, FaraGen1.5 scores the resulting trajectories with three complementary verifiers covering task correctness, efficiency, and critical-point adherence. Using data produced by this pipeline, we train Fara1.5, a family of native computer use agents (CUAs) at three scales built on Qwen3.5 (4B, 9B, and 27B). To train these models, we employ a supervised finetuning (SFT) recipe that carefully balances data from FaraGen1.5 for broad coverage, specific high-value tasks, and target model deficiencies in an iterative approach. Each model sets a new state of the art (SoTA) for its size class on browser-use benchmarks: Fara1.5-9B reaches 63.4% on Online-Mind2Web and 86.6% on WebVoyager, while Fara1.5-27B achieves 72.3% on Online-Mind2Web, which is competitive with much larger proprietary systems. We also release weights for the Fara1.5 models under MIT license, making SoTA computer use accessible for all beyond closed API-only systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了FaraGen1.5，一个可扩展的数据流水线，用于生成计算机使用代理（CUA）的训练数据，包含环境、求解器和验证器三个模块。使用该流水线训练了Fara1.5模型系列（基于Qwen3.5，规模4B、9B、27B），在浏览器使用基准上达到新最优。
Motivation: 收集人类演示的计算机使用数据成本高且速度慢，需要可扩展的生成策略，包括环境（agents可行动）和验证器（判断演示是否成功）。
Method: 提出FaraGen1.5数据流水线，包含真实网站和合成环境（模拟需要认证或不可逆操作的领域），使用多模型求解器（包括GPT-5.4）和用户模拟器进行多轮展开，通过三个互补验证器（任务正确性、效率、关键点遵守）评分。训练时采用监督微调（SFT）策略，平衡数据覆盖、高价值任务和迭代弥补模型缺陷。
Result: Fara1.5-9B在Online-Mind2Web上达63.4%，在WebVoyager上达86.6%；Fara1.5-27B在Online-Mind2Web上达72.3%，与更大的专有系统竞争。所有模型在各自规模上均达到新最优。

papers.title: Boundary Embedding Shaping with Adaptive Contrastive Learning for Graph Structural Disentanglement
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) excel at aggregating neighbor information for classification, yet their performance is hindered by graph structural entanglement, where spurious correlations from semantically irrelevant neighbors contaminate node embeddings. This challenge is most acute for nodes near class boundaries in the embedding space, where amplified structural noise blurs decision boundaries and destabilizes predictions. Existing robust GNN methods largely treat all nodes uniformly, ignoring boundary vulnerabilities. In this paper, to improve classification performance, we tackle graph structural disentanglement by identifying boundary-region entanglement as the primary bottleneck and propose Boundary Embedding Shaping (BES), an adaptive contrastive learning GNN plug-in module that selectively suppresses spurious structural noise at decision boundaries with minimal model parameter perturbation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BES consistently improves boundary discrimination and outperforms existing leading methods. Notably, BES boosts GCN performance by an average of 3.3% in node classification (up to 5.0% on WikiCS) and achieves superior accuracy in link prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出边界嵌入整形（BES）模块，通过自适应对比学习抑制图神经网络中边界区域的结构噪声，实现图结构解缠。实验表明BES在节点分类和链接预测上显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有GNN受图结构纠缠影响，边界节点嵌入被无关邻居污染，导致决策边界模糊。现有鲁棒方法未针对性处理边界脆弱性。
Method: 提出BES，一个即插即用的对比学习模块，自适应抑制决策边界处的虚假结构噪声，仅微小扰动模型参数。
Result: BES使GCN节点分类平均提升3.3%（WikiCS上达5.0%），并在链接预测中取得更优精度。
Conclusion: 边界区域解缠是图分类性能瓶颈，BES能有效改善边界判别性，且易于集成。

papers.title: Spectral DPPs via NEPv: A Scalable Continuous Relaxation of Determinantal MAP for Diversity-Aware Data Selection
papers.abstract_en: Selecting a small, diverse, high-quality subset from a massive pool of candidates is a recurring primitive in modern machine learning -- data curation and coreset selection for training and fine-tuning large models, active-learning batch acquisition, prompt and exemplar selection for in-context learning, retrieval diversification, and experimental design. Determinantal Point Processes (\DPP s) give a principled, well-calibrated notion of diversity for this task, but their \emph{MAP} objective -- pick a size-$k$ subset $S$ maximizing $\logdet(L_S)$ -- is NP-hard, and the standard greedy and sampling algorithms scale superlinearly in the ground-set size $n$. This cost is prohibitive precisely in the data-centric regime where diversity matters most, where $n$ ranges over millions to billions of candidate examples, features, or embeddings. We recast \DPP-MAP as a continuous optimization problem over the Stiefel manifold, and show that its first-order optimality conditions form a \emph{Nonlinear Eigenvalue Problem with eigenvector dependency} (\NEPv) of a previously unstudied form. This \NEPv\ admits a self-consistent field (\SCF) iteration with a spectral-gap-based local contraction guarantee, giving a principled iterative solver where the diversity objective drives an eigenvector-dependent operator. The resulting algorithm, \OurMethod, requires only matrix-vector products with the kernel and runs in time $O\!\big((ndk+nk^2)\,t\big)$ for a small number of iterations $t$, scaling near-linearly in $n$ and integrating directly with low-rank and feature-map kernels common in ML. This paper focuses on the relaxation, solver, and scaling analysis; full real-data benchmarking is left to a planned empirical study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新定义了行列式点过程（DPP）的MAP问题为一个Stiefel流形上的连续优化，并证明其一阶最优性条件构成一种新型的非线性特征值问题（NEPv）。通过自洽场（SCF）迭代求解，算法复杂度为O((ndk+nk²)t)，在n上近线性，适用于大规模多样性数据选择。
Motivation: DPP的MAP问题精确求解是NP难的，现有贪心或采样算法复杂度超线性于候选集规模n，阻碍了其在亿万级数据多样性选择场景中的应用。
Method: 将DPP-MAP松弛为Stiefel流形上的连续优化，推导出带特征向量依赖的非线性特征值问题（NEPv），并设计基于谱隙保证局部收敛的自洽场（SCF）迭代求解器，仅需矩阵-向量乘积。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但声称算法复杂度O((ndk+nk²)t)，t为小常数，实现近线性缩放。
Conclusion: 本文聚焦于松弛、求解器和规模分析，完整实际基准测试计划在后续实证研究中展开。

papers.title: CEO-Bench: Can Agents Play the Long Game?
papers.abstract_en: Language model agents are becoming proficient executors at isolated, short-horizon tasks such as software engineering and customer service. Yet real-world challenges require a combination of sophisticated skills that remain largely untested in agents: (1) navigating long horizons amid uncertainty; (2) acquiring information in noisy environments; (3) adapting to a changing world; (4) orchestrating multiple moving parts toward a coherent goal. We introduce CEO-Bench, which evaluates these capabilities together by simulating a representative real-world task: operating a startup for 500 days. An agent manages pricing, marketing, budgeting, and many other aspects of a fictional company through a programmable Python interface, operating in the same environment and facing the same challenges as a human CEO. Success demands analyzing noisy, interconnected business databases, translating signals into sound strategy, and coordinating many decisions with programming. The strongest agents write sophisticated code that forecasts churn regimes, billing timing, customer losses, and future cash under different scenarios. Even so, most state-of-the-art models struggle in this environment. Only Claude Fable 5, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Claude Opus 4.8 finish above the $1M starting balance, and all evaluated models remain below the rule-based baseline. CEO-Bench takes a first step toward measuring the intelligence required to drive sustained, adaptive progress over time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了CEO-Bench，一个模拟运营初创公司500天的基准测试，旨在评估语言模型代理在长期规划、不确定性噪音信息获取、适应变化和多任务协调等方面的综合能力。摘要显示最强的代理（Claude Fable 5、GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude Opus 4.8）能够超过$1M的起始资金，但所有评估模型均低于基于规则的基线，表明当前模型在长期复杂任务中仍存在显著不足。
Motivation: 现有语言模型代理评估主要集中于短时孤立任务，而现实世界挑战需要长期视野、噪音环境中的信息获取、适应变化以及协调多个子目标的能力，CEO-Bench填补了这一评估空白。
Method: 通过一个可编程的Python接口模拟一家虚构初创公司为期500天的运营，代理需要管理定价、营销、预算等多个方面，并像人类CEO一样面对相同的环境与挑战。
Result: 只有Claude Fable 5、GPT-5.6 Sol和Claude Opus 4.8在500天结束时余额超过$1M起始资金，但所有评估模型的表现均低于一个基于规则的简单基线。
Conclusion: CEO-Bench迈出了衡量语言模型代理驱动长期、自适应进步所需智能的第一步，并揭示当前最先进的模型在模拟真实世界长期任务中仍有较大提升空间。

papers.title: Reducing Learner Redundancy in Boosting via Residual Orthogonalization
papers.abstract_en: While sequential residual fitting is the bedrock of standard boosting frameworks, it inherently breeds learner redundancy by repeatedly revisiting correlated error components. To address this bottleneck, we propose a shift from residual fitting to \textit{residual orthogonalization} and introduce SCBoost. Our framework tackles redundancy through two complementary mechanisms: Spectral Residual Projection (SRP) and Covariance-Regularized Weighting (CRW). During training, SRP projects each residual target onto the orthogonal complement of the historical prediction subspace, forcing successive learners to capture only novel empirical innovations. During aggregation, CRW optimizes ensemble weights on a validation set with an explicit covariance penalty to mitigate remaining correlations. Theoretically, we provide a finite-sample geometric characterization proving that SRP yields an exact additive residual-energy decomposition. Furthermore, under an isotropic-noise assumption, we rigorously establish the conditions under which this projection improves the effective Signal-to-Noise Ratio. Extensive experiments across ten benchmark datasets demonstrate that SCBoost delivers strong out-of-the-box performance, particularly in accuracy and F1 score. This work reinterprets boosting through a geometric lens, suggesting that explicit redundancy control is a principled and necessary step toward more efficient ensemble architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SCBoost框架，通过残差正交化（Residual Orthogonalization）替代传统残差拟合，利用谱残差投影（SRP）和协方差正则化加权（CRW）两种机制减少Boosting中的学习器冗余。理论证明了SRP导致精确的加法残差能量分解，并在各向同性噪声假设下提升有效信噪比。实验在10个基准数据集上显示SCBoost在准确率和F1分数上的优异开箱性能。
Motivation: 标准Boosting框架的序贯残差拟合反复关联误差分量，导致学习器冗余，成为效率瓶颈。
Method: 提出SCBoost，包含两个互补机制：训练阶段使用SRP将残差投影到历史预测子空间的正交补上，迫使后续学习器捕捉新经验创新；聚合阶段使用CRW在验证集上优化集成权重并显式添加协方差惩罚以减轻剩余相关性。
Result: 在10个基准数据集上，SCBoost在准确率和F1分数上表现优异，提供强开箱性能。
Conclusion: 该工作通过几何视角重新解释Boosting，表明显式冗余控制是迈向更高效集成架构的原则性必要步骤。

papers.title: A transition-density-based operator learning method for Fokker-Planck equations with various initial conditions
papers.abstract_en: Solving Fokker-Planck equations (FPEs) for multiple initial conditions typically requires repeated computations, leading to substantial computational costs. In this work, we propose a transition-density-based operator learning method to efficiently approximate the solution operator of FPEs with various initial conditions. The core idea is to learn the transition probability density function (PDF) of the underlying stochastic differential equation (SDE), from which the solution associated with a new initial distribution can be obtained through the Chapman-Kolmogorov equation without retraining the model. A major challenge in learning the transition PDF lies in the singular behavior induced by the Dirac initial condition. To address it, we introduce a conditional normalizing flow whose base distribution is given by the explicit transition PDF of a linearized SDE. This base distribution captures the short-time behavior of the target transition PDF and allows the normalizing flow to learn a near-identity transformation at small times. We further incorporate a time-weighted loss function to stabilize training near the initial time and develop an importance-sampling strategy for evaluating solutions associated with general initial conditions. A variety of numerical experiments are presented to illustrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于转移密度的算子学习方法，用于高效求解不同初始条件下的Fokker-Planck方程。核心是学习随机微分方程的转移概率密度函数，通过条件归一化流处理Dirac初始条件的奇异性，并引入时间加权损失函数和重要性采样策略。数值实验展示了方法的有效性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 直接求解不同初始条件下的Fokker-Planck方程需要大量重复计算，计算成本高。现有方法难以处理由Dirac初始条件引起的奇异性。
Method: 学习底层SDE的转移概率密度函数，利用条件归一化流，以线性化SDE的显式转移密度作为基础分布，学习近恒等变换；采用时间加权损失函数稳定初始时刻训练，并发展重要性抽样策略评估一般初始条件的解。
Result: 多种数值实验表明，该方法能够有效近似解算子，且对不同的初始条件具有鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 提出的方法避免了针对每个新初始条件重新训练模型，显著降低了计算成本，并成功处理了转移密度函数中的奇异性。

papers.title: Will the Agent Recuse, and Will It Stop? Measuring LLM-Agent Compliance with In-Band Governance Signals at the Access Door and Mid-Flight
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous LLM agents increasingly hold real credentials and operate infrastructure with no human in the loop, yet operators have no standard way to tell an agent a resource is off-limits, or to ask a running agent to stand down: access controls either admit it or hard-fail it. We propose a third mode -- the Recuse Signal, a lightweight in-band governance signal a server emits over a protocol's existing channels (an SSH banner, a PostgreSQL NOTICE, a Kubernetes admission warning) asking an automated agent to voluntarily withdraw. It is a cooperative control, the robots.txt analogue for live access -- explicitly not a security boundary. We define it as an open mini-standard (access-time directives deny/throttle/warn and a mid-task halt), build three live-validated adapters, and measure compliance across five LLM agents (GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and an open-weights Llama-3.3-70B). At the access door, compliance is real but strongly model-dependent: deny recusal ranges from 100% (GPT-4o-mini, Claude) to 55-75% (Gemini, GPT-4o), while the open-weights agent barely engaged the signal. Agents honor the standard's directive granularity -- they do not over-withdraw on the permissive throttle/warn (0/176) -- but throttle produced no measurable self-limiting, and no agent ever surfaced a warn to the operator (0/100). Mid-flight, a halt stops nobody: across 40 trials 0/40 stopped, and an in-band halt was never acknowledged (0/20) versus 20/20 as a prompt message -- yet even a fully-noticed halt stopped no one. Cooperative in-band signaling is thus reliable-but-model-dependent at the access door and unreliable in flight; stopping a running agent needs enforcement, not a request. We release the standard, adapters, and harness for reproduction.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Recuse Signal，一种轻量级带内治理信号，允许服务器通过协议现有通道（如SSH横幅、PostgreSQL NOTICE）请求LLM代理自愿退出或停止。实验测试了五个LLM代理的合规性：在访问门阶段，拒绝退出率为55%-100%，但throttle未产生自限，warn从未被代理呈现；在飞行阶段，halt指令从未被遵守（0/40）。作者认为合作式带内信号在访问门可靠但依赖模型，在飞行中无效，需要强制机制。
Motivation: 自主LLM代理持有真实凭证且无人类监督操作基础设施，但缺乏标准方式告知代理资源限制或要求其停止；现有访问控制要么允许要么拒绝，无法支持第三种协作模式。
Method: 定义Recuse Signal开放迷你标准（包括访问时指令deny/throttle/warn和任务中halt），构建三个实时验证适配器（SSH、PostgreSQL、Kubernetes），并在五个LLM代理（GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Llama-3.3-70B）上测量合规性。
Result: 访问门：deny退出率从100%（GPT-4o-mini、Claude）到55-75%（Gemini、GPT-4o），开放权重模型几乎不响应；throttle/warn无过度退出（0/176），但throttle未产生可测量自限，warn从未向操作员呈现（0/100）。飞行中：40次试验中0次停止，带内halt从未被确认（0/20 vs 提示消息20/20确认但仍未停止）。
Conclusion: 合作式带内信号在访问门可靠但强烈依赖模型，在飞行中不可靠；停止运行中的代理需要强制执行而非请求。

papers.title: Reducing Hallucinations in Complex Question Answering using Simple Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (long version)
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have fundamentally transformed the landscape of Natural Language Processing (NLP), although they remain susceptible to errors. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems have emerged as a common deployment scenario seeking to both avoid the well known risk of the LLM ``hallucinating'' information, and to enable reasoning and question answering over proprietary information that the LLM did not have access to during training without resorting to expensive model fine-tuning. In this work, we explore the idea of using a lightweight graph structure with a relatively simple graph schema, to support the RAG subsystem via a dedicated toolset. We design an agentic system with a variety of vector search and graph query tools operating over a structured dataset based on a curated subset of English Wikipedia articles, and evaluate its performance on questions from MoNaCo, a challenging Wikipedia based benchmark of complex question answering (QA) tasks. Our results show that the introduction of graph-based tools can significantly increase the precision and recall of factual correctness, can halve the number of hallucinated answers, and achieves the highest fine-grained truthfulness score among the three evaluated scenarios. All this with a modest increase in token usage.
papers.comment: 25 pages; expanded limitations section, corrected typos throughout and missing values in appendix table 1
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于轻量级图结构的检索增强生成（RAG）方法，通过专用工具集支持代理系统，在复杂问答任务中减少大语言模型的幻觉。系统结合向量搜索和图查询，基于维基百科子集构建结构化数据集，并在MoNaCo基准上评估。结果表明，引入图工具能将事实正确性的精确率和召回率显著提升，使幻觉回答数量减半，且最高细粒度真实性得分最高，仅需适度增加token用量。
Motivation: 大语言模型在复杂问答中易产生幻觉，且现有RAG系统在避免幻觉和推理私有信息方面仍有不足，而图结构可提供更结构化的知识支持。
Method: 设计一个包含多种向量搜索和图查询工具的代理系统，基于维基百科子集的轻量级图结构，支持RAG子系统。
Result: 在MoNaCo基准上，图工具使事实正确性的精确率和召回率显著提升，幻觉回答数量减半，并取得最高的细粒度真实性得分，且token用量仅适度增加。
Conclusion: 引入简单图结构可有效减少复杂问答中的幻觉，提升事实正确性，且开销可控。

papers.title: Don't Fool Me Twice: Adapting to Adversity in the Wild with Experience-Driven Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: In robotics, dangers and adversity modes are often embodiment-specific and relative to each agent. A frontier of autonomous mobile robotics is to enable agents to operate effectively in the wild in unseen unstructured environments. A significant challenge in unseen unstructured environments is that it may not be possible to predict all the dangers to the specific robot. Although recent work has used large foundation vision-language models (VLMs) to preemptively predict an exhaustive list of common-sense dangers, it remains difficult to capture possible interaction and embodiment-dependent adversities. We propose a continual learning framework for a mobile embodied agent to learn online from disturbances and attribute anomalous behaviours to causes through semantics, enabling better prediction and planning of the world in the future. Our framework, "Don't Fool Me Twice", first observes disturbances and describes their effects on the robot; this description is augmented with visual context to query a VLM to predict possible causes; the local disturbance is characterized using kernel regression, which allows for efficient, few-shot modeling of transient anomalies. We leverage semantic voxel-centric modeling to estimate epistemic uncertainty, enabling richer downstream recovery by treating interaction-driven disturbances as learnable spatial behaviors. We present four hypotheses and validate them in simulation and on hardware across embodiments and adversity modes.
papers.comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种持续学习框架"Don't Fool Me Twice"，使移动机器人在野外未知非结构化环境中在线学习扰动，通过语义归因异常行为，从而改进未来预测和规划。该框架先观察扰动并描述其对机器人的影响，然后结合视觉上下文查询视觉语言模型（VLM）预测可能原因，使用核回归对局部扰动进行高效少样本建模，并通过语义体素建模估计认知不确定性。在仿真和硬件上验证了四种假设。
Motivation: 在未知非结构化环境中，无法预测所有针对特定机器人的危险，现有使用大型基础视觉语言模型预测常识危险的方法难以捕捉交互和体依赖的逆境。
Method: 提出持续学习框架，包括观察扰动并描述影响，结合视觉上下文查询VLM预测原因，使用核回归高效少样本建模局部扰动，以及通过语义体素建模估计认知不确定性，将交互驱动扰动作为可学习的空间行为进行恢复。
Result: 在仿真和硬件上，跨不同逆境模式和体形态验证了四种假设，但摘要未提供具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 该框架使机器人能够在线从扰动中学习，通过语义归因改进未来预测和规划，从而在未知环境中更鲁棒地运行。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SGMD: Score Gradient Matching Distillation for Few-Step Video Diffusion Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) is a widely used paradigm for accelerating inference in few-step video diffusion models. However, DMD-style video distillation faces two coupled challenges: the fake score must track a continuously evolving generator, making training costly when frequent updates are required, while reverse-KL-style matching can be mode-seeking and conservative for preserving strong motion dynamics. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{Score Gradient Matching Distillation (SGMD)}. SGMD adopts a fake-score perspective by directly optimizing the fake score toward the teacher, while using teacher stop-gradient Fisher as a stable distribution-matching objective. We provide a gradient analysis that motivates this objective choice under ideal tracking. Building on this, SGMD introduces a pair of dual potentials: negative-residual (NR) for outer-loop correction and residual-contraction (RC) for inner-loop tracking. Empirically, compared to DMD2, SGMD achieves an approximately $\sim 3\times$ training speedup and substantially improves motion dynamics for 4-step distilled models while preserving temporal consistency. A human study confirms that SGMD is preferred in motion quality and overall preference, while visual quality and text alignment remain comparable. Code is available at https://github.com/ModelTC/LightX2V.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出分数梯度匹配蒸馏（SGMD）方法，用于少步视频扩散模型的蒸馏。SGMD直接优化伪造分数向教师模型靠近，并使用教师停止梯度的Fisher作为稳定分布匹配目标。与DMD2相比，SGMD实现了约3倍的训练加速，并在保持时间一致性的同时显著改进了4步蒸馏模型的运动动态。
Motivation: DMD风格视频蒸馏面临两个耦合挑战：伪造分数必须跟踪不断演化的生成器，使得频繁更新时训练成本高；而反向KL风格匹配可能过于保守，无法保留强运动动态。
Method: 提出SGMD，采用伪造分数视角，直接优化伪造分数向教师靠近，同时使用教师停止梯度Fisher作为稳定分布匹配目标。引入一对双重势：负残差（NR）用于外循环校正，残差收缩（RC）用于内循环跟踪。
Result: 与DMD2相比，SGMD实现了约3倍的训练加速，并显著改善了4步蒸馏模型的运动动态，同时保持时间一致性。人类研究确认SGMD在运动质量和总体偏好上更受欢迎，视觉质量和文本对齐保持可比。
Conclusion: SGMD通过分数梯度匹配蒸馏有效解决了视频蒸馏中的训练成本高和运动动态保守问题，实现了更快的训练和更好的运动质量。

papers.title: You Live More Than Once: Towards Hierarchical Skill Meta-Evolving
papers.abstract_en: Test-time skill evolving is regarded as a new paradigm for enhancing deployed agentic systems. Existing works mainly focus on hard-coded skill evolving strategies or parametric learning that rely on expensive parameter updates in the underlying LLMs. In this paper, we demonstrate that test-time refinement of the skill evolving framework itself is necessary for continuous improvement of the agent systems in different downstream scenarios, and lightweight algorithmic adaptation is feasible. Specifically, we propose HiSME, a lightweight hierarchical skill meta-evolving solution that jointly optimizes skills and the skill evolving strategy by learning meta-skills from agents' task execution traces. Experiments on mainstream agentic benchmarks show that meta-evolving can produce a higher-quality skill library than pure skill evolving and can derive diverse meta-skills for different scenarios, thereby facilitating future continual experience learning. Our code is temporarily public at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HiSME-BD45.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HiSME，一种轻量级分层技能元进化方法，通过从智能体任务执行轨迹中学习元技能，同时优化技能库和技能进化策略。在主流智能体基准测试中，HiSME生成了更高质量的技能库，并能针对不同场景推导出多样化元技能，从而促进持续的体验学习。
Motivation: 现有测试时技能进化方法要么依赖硬编码策略，要么需要昂贵的大模型参数更新，且忽视了技能进化框架本身的改进对于智能体系统持续提升的必要性。
Method: 提出HiSME，一种轻量级分层技能元进化方案，通过从智能体任务执行轨迹中学习元技能，联合优化技能库和技能进化策略，实现测试时框架自身的自适应调整。
Result: 在主流智能体基准测试中，元进化比纯技能进化产生更高质量的技能库，并能为不同场景推导出多样化元技能。
Conclusion: 摘要表明轻量级算法适应能够有效实现技能进化框架本身的测试时改进，从而促进智能体系统在多种下游场景中的持续体验学习。
Relevance: 0
