papers.title: CityGuard: Graph-Aware Private Descriptors for Bias-Resilient Identity Search Across Urban Cameras
papers.abstract_en: City-scale person re-identification across distributed cameras must handle severe appearance changes from viewpoint, occlusion, and domain shift while complying with data protection rules that prevent sharing raw imagery. We introduce CityGuard, a topology-aware transformer for privacy-preserving identity retrieval in decentralized surveillance. The framework integrates three components. A dispersion-adaptive metric learner adjusts instance-level margins according to feature spread, increasing intra-class compactness. Spatially conditioned attention injects coarse geometry, such as GPS or deployment floor plans, into graph-based self-attention to enable projectively consistent cross-view alignment using only coarse geometric priors without requiring survey-grade calibration. Differentially private embedding maps are coupled with compact approximate indexes to support secure and cost-efficient deployment. Together these designs produce descriptors robust to viewpoint variation, occlusion, and domain shifts, and they enable a tunable balance between privacy and utility under rigorous differential-privacy accounting. Experiments on Market-1501 and additional public benchmarks, complemented by database-scale retrieval studies, show consistent gains in retrieval precision and query throughput over strong baselines, confirming the practicality of the framework for privacy-critical urban identity matching.

papers.title: SubQuad: Near-Quadratic-Free Structure Inference with Distribution-Balanced Objectives in Adaptive Receptor framework
papers.abstract_en: Comparative analysis of adaptive immune repertoires at population scale is hampered by two practical bottlenecks: the near-quadratic cost of pairwise affinity evaluations and dataset imbalances that obscure clinically important minority clonotypes. We introduce SubQuad, an end-to-end pipeline that addresses these challenges by combining antigen-aware, near-subquadratic retrieval with GPU-accelerated affinity kernels, learned multimodal fusion, and fairness-constrained clustering. The system employs compact MinHash prefiltering to sharply reduce candidate comparisons, a differentiable gating module that adaptively weights complementary alignment and embedding channels on a per-pair basis, and an automated calibration routine that enforces proportional representation of rare antigen-specific subgroups. On large viral and tumor repertoires SubQuad achieves measured gains in throughput and peak memory usage while preserving or improving recall@k, cluster purity, and subgroup equity. By co-designing indexing, similarity fusion, and equity-aware objectives, SubQuad offers a scalable, bias-aware platform for repertoire mining and downstream translational tasks such as vaccine target prioritization and biomarker discovery.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SubQuad，一种用于大规模自适应免疫受体库比较分析的高效流水线，通过近亚二次检索、GPU加速亲和力核、学习多模态融合和公平约束聚类，克服了成对亲和力评估的二次成本和数据集不平衡问题。在病毒和肿瘤受体库上，SubQuad在提升吞吐量和内存使用的同时，保持或改进了召回率、聚类纯度和亚群公平性。
Motivation: 现有自适应免疫受体库的群体规模比较分析面临两个瓶颈：成对亲和力评估的近二次计算成本，以及数据集不平衡掩盖了临床重要的少数克隆型。
Method: 使用紧凑的MinHash预过滤减少候选比较，可微门控模块自适应加权每个配对的对齐和嵌入通道，以及自动校准程序强制稀有抗原特异性亚群的按比例表示。
Result: 在大规模病毒和肿瘤受体库上，SubQuad在吞吐量和峰值内存使用上取得显著提升，同时保持或改进了召回率（recall@k）、聚类纯度和亚群公平性。
Conclusion: 通过协同设计索引、相似性融合和公平感知目标，SubQuad为受体库挖掘和下游转化任务（如疫苗靶点优先排序和生物标志物发现）提供了可扩展、偏差感知的平台。

papers.title: AdvSynGNN: Structure-Adaptive Graph Neural Nets via Adversarial Synthesis and Self-Corrective Propagation
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks frequently encounter significant performance degradation when confronted with structural noise or non-homophilous topologies. To address these systemic vulnerabilities, we present AdvSynGNN, a comprehensive architecture designed for resilient node-level representation learning. The proposed framework orchestrates multi-resolution structural synthesis alongside contrastive objectives to establish geometry-sensitive initializations. We develop a transformer backbone that adaptively accommodates heterophily by modulating attention mechanisms through learned topological signals. Central to our contribution is an integrated adversarial propagation engine, where a generative component identifies potential connectivity alterations while a discriminator enforces global coherence. Furthermore, label refinement is achieved through a residual correction scheme guided by per-node confidence metrics, which facilitates precise control over iterative stability. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that this synergistic approach effectively optimizes predictive accuracy across diverse graph distributions while maintaining computational efficiency. The study concludes with practical implementation protocols to ensure the robust deployment of the AdvSynGNN system in large-scale environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdvSynGNN 是一种针对图神经网络在结构噪声或非同质拓扑下性能下降问题的综合架构。该框架通过多分辨率结构合成与对比学习建立几何敏感初始化，使用 Transformer 骨干自适应调节注意力机制，并集成对抗传播引擎进行连接变化识别与全局一致性强制。实验表明该方法在多种图分布上优化了预测准确率，同时保持计算效率。
Motivation: 图神经网络在面对结构噪声或非同质拓扑时经常出现显著的性能下降，现有方法难以有效应对这些系统性的脆弱性。
Method: 提出 AdvSynGNN 架构，包含多分辨率结构合成与对比目标初始化、自适应 Transformer 骨干（通过学习的拓扑信号调节注意力）、对抗传播引擎（生成器识别连接变化，判别器强制全局一致性）以及基于节点置信度的残差标签修正方案。
Result: 实验评估显示，该协同方法有效优化了跨不同图分布的预测准确率，同时保持了计算效率。
Conclusion: 文章总结了实际部署协议以确保 AdvSynGNN 系统在大规模环境中的稳健部署。

papers.title: LiveGraph: Active-Structure Neural Re-ranking for Exercise Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: The continuous expansion of digital learning environments has catalyzed the demand for intelligent systems capable of providing personalized educational content. While current exercise recommendation frameworks have made significant strides, they frequently encounter obstacles regarding the long-tailed distribution of student engagement and the failure to adapt to idiosyncratic learning trajectories. We present LiveGraph, a novel active-structure neural re-ranking framework designed to overcome these limitations. Our approach utilizes a graph-based representation enhancement strategy to bridge the information gap between active and inactive students while integrating a dynamic re-ranking mechanism to foster content diversity. By prioritizing the structural relationships within learning histories, the proposed model effectively balances recommendation precision with pedagogical variety. Comprehensive experimental evaluations conducted on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate that LiveGraph surpasses contemporary baselines in both predictive accuracy and the breadth of exercise diversity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文针对教育练习推荐中长尾学生参与和学习轨迹适应不足的问题，提出了LiveGraph，一种主动结构的神经重排序框架。通过图表示增强策略弥合活跃与不活跃学生之间的信息差距，并集成动态重排序机制促进内容多样性。在多个真实数据集上的实验表明，LiveGraph在预测准确性和练习多样性方面超越了现有基线。
Motivation: 现有练习推荐框架面临学生参与的长尾分布和无法适应个性化学习轨迹的挑战，需要更好的推荐精准度与教学多样性平衡。
Method: 提出LiveGraph框架，利用图结构表示增强策略连接活跃与非活跃学生信息，并加入动态重排序机制以增强内容多样性，优先考虑学习历史中的结构关系。
Result: 在多个真实数据集上的实验表明，LiveGraph在预测准确性和练习多样性方面超越了当前基线。
Conclusion: 本文提出的方法有效平衡了推荐精度与教学多样性，适用于教育领域个性化习题推荐。

papers.title: Emotion Collider: Dual Hyperbolic Mirror Manifolds for Sentiment Recovery via Anti Emotion Reflection
papers.abstract_en: Emotional expression underpins natural communication and effective human-computer interaction. We present Emotion Collider (EC-Net), a hyperbolic hypergraph framework for multimodal emotion and sentiment modeling. EC-Net represents modality hierarchies using Poincare-ball embeddings and performs fusion through a hypergraph mechanism that passes messages bidirectionally between nodes and hyperedges. To sharpen class separation, contrastive learning is formulated in hyperbolic space with decoupled radial and angular objectives. High-order semantic relations across time steps and modalities are preserved via adaptive hyperedge construction. Empirical results on standard multimodal emotion benchmarks show that EC-Net produces robust, semantically coherent representations and consistently improves accuracy, particularly when modalities are partially available or contaminated by noise. These findings indicate that explicit hierarchical geometry combined with hypergraph fusion is effective for resilient multimodal affect understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Emotion Collider (EC-Net)，一个基于双曲超图的多模态情感建模框架。它利用 Poincaré 球嵌入表示模态层级，通过超图机制在节点与超边间双向传递消息进行融合，并在双曲空间中解耦径向与角度对比学习目标。在标准多模态情感数据集上，该方法在模态缺失或含噪声情况下仍能提升准确率，表明显式层级几何与超图融合的有效性。
Motivation: 现有情感建模方法在处理模态缺失或噪声时鲁棒性不足，且缺乏对模态层级结构和高阶语义关系的显式建模。
Method: 将模态层次嵌入 Poincaré 球，构建超图进行消息传递融合；在双曲空间中使用解耦径向与角度的对比学习增强类别分离；自适应构建跨时间步和模态的超边以保留高阶语义。
Result: 在标准多模态情感基准上，EC-Net 在模态部分可用或含噪声时持续提升准确率，生成鲁棒且语义一致的表示。
Conclusion: 显式层次几何与超图融合结合双曲对比学习是多模态情感理解的有效方案。

papers.title: Missing-by-Design: Certifiable Modality Deletion for Revocable Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
papers.abstract_en: As multimodal systems increasingly process sensitive personal data, the ability to selectively revoke specific data modalities has become a critical requirement for privacy compliance and user autonomy. We present Missing-by-Design (MBD), a unified framework for revocable multimodal sentiment analysis that combines structured representation learning with a certifiable parameter-modification pipeline. Revocability is critical in privacy-sensitive applications where users or regulators may request removal of modality-specific information. MBD learns property-aware embeddings and employs generator-based reconstruction to recover missing channels while preserving task-relevant signals. For deletion requests, the framework applies saliency-driven candidate selection and a calibrated Gaussian update to produce a machine-verifiable Modality Deletion Certificate. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that MBD achieves strong predictive performance under incomplete inputs and delivers a practical privacy-utility trade-off, positioning surgical unlearning as an efficient alternative to full retraining.

Motivation: 多模态系统处理敏感个人数据时，需要能够选择性地撤销特定数据模态，以满足隐私合规和用户自主权。
Method: 学习属性感知嵌入，使用生成器重建缺失通道；删除时通过显著性候选选择和校准高斯更新生成可验证的模态删除证书。
Result: 在基准数据集上，MBD 在输入不完整时仍能保持强预测性能，实现了实用的隐私-效用权衡。
Conclusion: 提出了手术式遗忘作为完整重训练的高效替代方案，实现了可撤销的多模态情感分析。

papers.title: GaiaFlow: Semantic-Guided Diffusion Tuning for Carbon-Frugal Search
papers.abstract_en: As the burgeoning power requirements of sophisticated neural architectures escalate, the information retrieval community has recognized ecological sustainability as a pivotal priority that necessitates a fundamental paradigm shift in model design. While contemporary neural rankers have attained unprecedented accuracy, the substantial environmental externalities associated with their computational intensity often remain overlooked in large-scale deployments. We present GaiaFlow, an innovative framework engineered to facilitate carbon-frugal search by operationalizing semantic-guided diffusion tuning. Our methodology orchestrates the convergence of retrieval-guided Langevin dynamics and a hardware-independent performance modeling strategy to optimize the trade-off between search precision and environmental preservation. By incorporating adaptive early exit protocols and precision-aware quantized inference, the proposed architecture significantly mitigates operational carbon footprints while maintaining robust retrieval quality across heterogeneous computing infrastructures. Extensive experimental evaluations demonstrate that GaiaFlow achieves a superior equilibrium between effectiveness and energy efficiency, offering a scalable and sustainable pathway for next-generation neural search systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GaiaFlow 框架，通过语义引导的扩散调优（semantic-guided diffusion tuning）实现碳节约搜索（carbon-frugal search）。该方法结合检索引导的 Langevin 动力学和硬件无关的性能建模，并引入自适应提前退出协议和精度感知量化推理，在保持检索质量的同时降低碳足迹。实验表明 GaiaFlow 在检索效果与能效之间取得平衡。
Motivation: 现代神经排序器虽然精度高，但大规模部署时的环境外部性常被忽略。信息检索领域需要向生态可持续的模型设计转变。
Method: 提出 GaiaFlow，核心是语义引导的扩散调优，包括检索引导的 Langevin 动力学、硬件无关性能建模、自适应提前退出协议和精度感知量化推理。
Result: 实验表明 GaiaFlow 在检索精度与能源效率之间达到优越平衡，显著降低运营碳足迹，且在不同异构计算基础设施上保持稳健的检索质量。
Conclusion: GaiaFlow 为下一代神经搜索系统提供了可扩展且可持续的路径，强调了效果与能效的兼顾。

papers.title: DAV-GSWT: Diffusion-Active-View Sampling for Data-Efficient Gaussian Splatting Wang Tiles
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of 3D Gaussian Splatting has fundamentally redefined the capabilities of photorealistic neural rendering by enabling high-throughput synthesis of complex environments. While procedural methods like Wang Tiles have recently been integrated to facilitate the generation of expansive landscapes, these systems typically remain constrained by a reliance on densely sampled exemplar reconstructions. We present DAV-GSWT, a data-efficient framework that leverages diffusion priors and active view sampling to synthesize high-fidelity Gaussian Splatting Wang Tiles from minimal input observations. By integrating a hierarchical uncertainty quantification mechanism with generative diffusion models, our approach autonomously identifies the most informative viewpoints while hallucinating missing structural details to ensure seamless tile transitions. Experimental results indicate that our system significantly reduces the required data volume while maintaining the visual integrity and interactive performance necessary for large-scale virtual environments.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 7 figures. In the previous version, Juntendo University was erroneously listed as the affiliation; we must clarify that this paper has absolutely no relation to Juntendo University. Therefore, we have replaced this affiliation in the new version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DAV-GSWT框架，结合扩散先验和主动视图采样，实现数据高效的3D高斯泼溅Wang Tiles。通过层次化不确定性量化与生成扩散模型，自动选择信息量最大的视角并补全缺失细节，从而从少量输入观测合成高质量大规模虚拟环境。实验表明，方法大幅降低数据需求同时保持视觉完整性和交互性能。
Motivation: 现有Wang Tiles方法依赖密集采样重构，数据需求高，限制了大规模场景的高效生成。
Method: 集成层次化不确定性量化机制与生成扩散模型，自动识别最具信息量的视角，并生成缺失结构细节以保证瓦片间无缝过渡。
Result: 实验结果表明，该方法显著减少所需数据量，同时保持视觉完整性及交互性能。
Conclusion: 该数据高效框架能从少量观测合成高质量3D高斯泼溅Wang Tiles，适用于大规模虚拟环境。

papers.title: NeuroSymActive: Differentiable Neural-Symbolic Reasoning with Active Exploration for Knowledge Graph Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Large pretrained language models and neural reasoning systems have advanced many natural language tasks, yet they remain challenged by knowledge-intensive queries that require precise, structured multi-hop inference. Knowledge graphs provide a compact symbolic substrate for factual grounding, but integrating graph structure with neural models is nontrivial: naively embedding graph facts into prompts leads to inefficiency and fragility, while purely symbolic or search-heavy approaches can be costly in retrievals and lack gradient-based refinement. We introduce NeuroSymActive, a modular framework that combines a differentiable neural-symbolic reasoning layer with an active, value-guided exploration controller for Knowledge Graph Question Answering. The method couples soft-unification style symbolic modules with a neural path evaluator and a Monte-Carlo style exploration policy that prioritizes high-value path expansions. Empirical results on standard KGQA benchmarks show that NeuroSymActive attains strong answer accuracy while reducing the number of expensive graph lookups and model calls compared to common retrieval-augmented baselines.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NeuroSymActive，一个模块化框架，结合可微神经符号推理层与主动值引导探索控制器，用于知识图谱问答（KGQA）。该方法将软统一风格的符号模块与神经路径评估器以及 Monte-Carlo 式探索策略相结合，优先扩展高价值路径。在标准 KGQA 基准上的实验表明，NeuroSymActive 在保持较高答案准确率的同时，减少了昂贵的图查找和模型调用次数。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型在需要精确结构化多跳推理的知识密集型查询上表现不足，而将知识图谱与神经模型集成存在效率低、检索成本高、缺乏梯度优化等问题。
Method: 提出 NeuroSymActive 框架，包含可微神经符号推理层和主动探索控制器，利用软统一符号模块、神经路径评估器和 Monte-Carlo 探索策略，优先扩展高价值路径。
Result: 在标准 KGQA 基准上取得强答案准确率，同时相比常见检索增强基线减少了昂贵图查找和模型调用的数量。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了结合可微推理与主动探索可提升 KGQA 的效率与准确性，但局限性未在摘要中提及。

papers.title: Statistical Early Stopping for Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: While LLMs have seen substantial improvement in reasoning capabilities, they also sometimes overthink, generating unnecessary reasoning steps, particularly under uncertainty, given ill-posed or ambiguous queries. We introduce statistically principled early stopping methods that monitor uncertainty signals during generation to mitigate this issue. Our first approach is parametric: it models inter-arrival times of uncertainty keywords as a renewal process and applies sequential testing for stopping. Our second approach is nonparametric and provides finite-sample guarantees on the probability of halting too early on well-posed queries. We conduct empirical evaluations on reasoning tasks across several domains and models. Our results indicate that uncertainty-aware early stopping can improve both efficiency and reliability in LLM reasoning, and we observe especially significant gains for math reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM推理中过度思考（overthinking）导致低效的问题，提出两种基于统计的早期停止方法：参数化方法将不确定性关键词到达间隔建模为更新过程并应用序贯检验；非参数方法对良构查询的过早停止概率提供有限样本保证。实验表明不确定性感知的早期停止能提升推理效率与可靠性，在数学推理任务上收益尤为显著。
Motivation: LLM在不确定或模糊查询下会产生不必要的推理步骤，造成计算浪费，需要一种能在推理过程中动态停止的机制。
Method: 提出两种方法：1）参数化方法，将不确定性关键词的到达间隔建模为更新过程，并进行序贯检验决定停止；2）非参数方法，对良构查询提供过早停止概率的有限样本保证。
Result: 在多个领域和模型上的推理任务评估中，不确定性感知的早期停止改善了效率和可靠性，数学推理任务上提升尤为显著。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统计原理的早期停止可以缓解LLM过度推理问题，且无需修改模型结构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Chimera: Neuro-Symbolic Attention Primitives for Trustworthy Dataplane Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Deploying expressive learning models directly on programmable dataplanes promises line-rate, low-latency traffic analysis but remains hindered by strict hardware constraints and the need for predictable, auditable behavior. Chimera introduces a principled framework that maps attention-oriented neural computations and symbolic constraints onto dataplane primitives, enabling trustworthy inference within the match-action pipeline. Chimera combines a kernelized, linearized attention approximation with a two-layer key-selection hierarchy and a cascade fusion mechanism that enforces hard symbolic guarantees while preserving neural expressivity. The design includes a hardware-aware mapping protocol and a two-timescale update scheme that together permit stable, line-rate operation under realistic dataplane budgets. The paper presents the Chimera architecture, a hardware mapping strategy, and empirical evidence showing that neuro-symbolic attention primitives can achieve high-fidelity inference within the resource envelope of commodity programmable switches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Chimera 提出一种将注意力机制的神经计算和符号约束映射到可编程数据平面原语的框架，使得在商品可编程交换机资源预算内实现高保真推理。该框架结合核化的线性注意力近似、两级键选择层级和级联融合机制，通过硬件感知映射协议和双时间尺度更新方案实现线速率、低延迟运行。
Motivation: 在可编程数据平面上直接部署表达能力强的学习模型受限于严格的硬件约束以及对可预测、可审计行为的需求，现有方法难以同时满足这些要求。
Method: Chimera 将核化线性注意力近似与两级键选择层级和级联融合机制相结合，并设计硬件感知映射协议和双时间尺度更新方案，在匹配-动作流水线中实现受符号约束的推理。
Result: 摘要报告在商品可编程交换机的资源约束下，神经符号注意力基元能够实现高保真推理。
Conclusion: Chimera 框架证明了将神经符号注意力基元部署到可编程数据平面的可行性，在保证硬件约束和符号可解释性的同时保持神经表达能力。

papers.title: AgentCgroup: Understanding and Controlling OS Resources of AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are increasingly deployed in multi-tenant cloud environments, where they execute diverse tool calls within sandboxed containers, each call with distinct resource demands and rapid fluctuations. We present a systematic characterization of OS-level resource dynamics in sandboxed AI coding agents, analyzing 144 software engineering tasks from the SWE-rebench benchmark across two LLM models. Our measurements reveal that (1) OS-level execution (tool calls, container and agent initialization) accounts for 55-60% of end-to-end task latency; (2) memory, not CPU, is the concurrency bottleneck; (3) memory spikes are tool-call-driven with a up to 15.4x peak-to-average ratio; and (4) resource demands are highly unpredictable across tasks, runs, and models. Comparing these characteristics against serverless, microservice, and batch workloads, we identify three mismatches in existing resource controls: a granularity mismatch (container-level policies vs. tool-call-level dynamics), a responsiveness mismatch (user-space reaction vs. sub-second unpredictable bursts), and an adaptability mismatch (history-based prediction vs. non-deterministic stateful execution). We propose AgentCgroup, an intent-driven eBPF-based resource controller that exploits agents ability to declare resource needs and reconstruct execution strategies, using hierarchical cgroup structures aligned with tool-call boundaries, in-kernel enforcement via sched_ext and memcg_bpf_ops, and runtime-adaptive policies. Preliminary evaluation demonstrates improved multi-tenant isolation and reduced resource waste. AgentCgroup is open-source at https://github.com/eunomia-bpf/agentcgroup
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统地表征了沙盒化AI编码智能体中的操作系统级资源动态，分析了144个软件工程任务，发现OS执行占端到端延迟的55-60%，内存是并发瓶颈，资源需求高度不可预测。针对现有资源控制的粒度、响应性和适应性三个不匹配问题，提出了基于eBPF的意图驱动资源控制器AgentCgroup，利用层次化cgroup、内核内强制和运行时自适应策略，初步评估显示改善了多租户隔离并减少了资源浪费。
Motivation: AI智能体在多租户云环境中部署，不同工具调用具有不同的资源需求和快速波动，现有操作系统级资源控制存在粒度、响应性和适应性的不匹配问题。
Method: 提出AgentCgroup，一种基于eBPF的意图驱动资源控制器，通过工具调用边界对齐的层次化cgroup结构、sched_ext和memcg_bpf_ops的内核内强制、以及运行时自适应策略来实现更精确的控制。
Result: 测量显示OS执行占延迟的55-60%，内存峰值与平均比最高达15.4倍；初步评估表明AgentCgroup改善了多租户隔离并减少了资源浪费。
Conclusion: 展示了AI智能体工作负载与现有资源控制之间的三个关键不匹配，并提出了AgentCgroup作为解决方案，其设计利用了智能体声明资源需求的能力。

papers.title: Universality Reconsidered: Rethinking the Validation of Foundation Models for General-Purpose 3D Medical Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models have emerged as a transformative paradigm in 3D medical imaging, with the promise of unified quantitative analysis across diverse targets and imaging modalities. Yet the prevailing conception of universality remains incomplete. Current models are predominantly developed and evaluated on datasets largely concentrated around a limited set of imaging modalities and anatomical regions. In this Perspective, we evaluate representative 3D segmentation foundation models using paired whole-body structural and functional imaging data. Our analysis reveals a substantial gap between benchmark-reported performance and real-world generalization, with marked degradation on previously unseen data and particularly severe failures on functional imaging modalities. These findings suggest that current foundation models remain far from achieving true universality. We argue that progress requires not only scaling models and datasets, but also a reconsideration of how universality is defined and validated, extending evaluation beyond regional structural benchmarks toward whole-body structural and functional imaging. Our observations highlight the need to distinguish benchmark success from genuine clinical generalization. Bridging this gap will be essential for translating foundation models from controlled evaluation settings to real-world medical practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对当前主流3D医学分割基础模型在全身结构性和功能性成像数据上的通用性进行了系统性评估。研究发现，这些模型在公开基准上表现良好，但在未见过的数据上性能显著下降，尤其在功能性成像模态上出现严重失败，表明现有模型远未实现真正的通用性。作者呼吁重新定义和验证通用性，将评估范围从局部结构基准扩展到全身结构和功能成像。
Motivation: 当前3D医学分割基础模型声称具有通用性，但大多数评估仅集中在有限的成像模态和解剖区域。本文旨在揭示基准性能与实际泛化能力之间的差距，并探讨如何更合理地进行通用性验证。
Method: 采用配对的全身体结构和功能性成像数据，评估多个代表性3D分割基础模型的跨模态、跨任务泛化能力。通过对比基准测试结果与实际数据上的表现，分析性能下降的程度和模式。
Result: 模型在未见过数据上表现显著退化，功能性成像模态上出现严重失败，基准报告的性能与真实泛化之间存在巨大鸿沟。
Conclusion: 当前基础模型尚未实现真正的通用性；必须重新思考通用性的定义和验证方式，从局部结构基准拓展至全身结构和功能成像，才能弥合基准成功与临床泛化之间的差距。

papers.title: VISTA-Bench: Do Vision-Language Models Really Understand Visualized Text as Well as Pure Text?
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved impressive performance in cross-modal understanding across textual and visual inputs, yet existing benchmarks predominantly focus on pure-text queries. In real-world scenarios, language also frequently appears as visualized text embedded in images, raising the question of whether current VLMs handle such input requests comparably. We introduce VISTA-Bench, a systematic benchmark from multimodal perception, reasoning, to unimodal understanding domains. It evaluates visualized text understanding by contrasting pure-text and visualized-text questions under controlled rendering conditions. Extensive evaluation of over 30 representative VLMs reveals a pronounced modality gap: models that perform well on pure-text queries often degrade substantially when equivalent semantic content is presented as visualized text. This gap is further amplified by increased perceptual difficulty, highlighting sensitivity to rendering variations despite unchanged semantics. Overall, VISTA-Bench provides a principled evaluation framework to diagnose this limitation and to guide progress toward more unified language representations across tokenized text and pixels. The source dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/QingAnLiu/VISTA-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VISTA-Bench 是一个系统性基准，用于评估视觉语言模型（VLM）理解图像中可视化文本的能力。通过对比纯文本和可视化文本问题，发现模型存在显著的模态差距：在纯文本上表现良好的模型，当等价语义以可视化文本呈现时性能大幅下降，且感知难度增加会放大这一差距。
Motivation: 现有基准主要关注纯文本查询，但现实中语言常以可视化文本形式嵌入图像，而当前 VLM 对此类输入的处理能力尚不清楚。
Method: 构建 VISTA-Bench，涵盖多模态感知、推理到单模态理解领域，通过控制渲染条件设计纯文本与可视化文本的对比问题，并评估超过 30 个代表性 VLM。
Result: 所有评估模型均表现出明显的模态差距：纯文本性能与可视化文本性能之间存在显著下降，且渲染复杂度增加进一步恶化该差距。
Conclusion: VISTA-Bench 为诊断 VLM 在可视化文本理解上的局限性提供了原则性评估框架，并指导向更统一的语言表示（跨越 token 化文本和像素）的发展。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Quantile Transfer for Reliable Operating Point Selection in Visual Place Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Visual Place Recognition (VPR) is a key component for localization in Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)-denied environments, but its performance critically depends on selecting an image matching threshold (operating point) that balances precision and recall. Thresholds are typically hand-tuned offline for a specific environment and fixed during deployment, leading to degraded performance under environmental change. We propose a method that automatically estimates the operating point of a VPR system to maximize recall whilst aiming to achieve 100% precision. The method uses a small calibration traversal with known correspondences and transfers thresholds to deployment via quantile normalization of similarity score distributions. This quantile transfer ensures that thresholds remain stable across calibration sizes and query subsets. Experiments with seven state-of-the-art VPR techniques across five benchmark datasets demonstrate that our proposed approach consistently outperforms existing baselines, enabling the underlying VPR technique to operate at 100% precision in approximately twice as many deployment scenarios (median improvement), while retrieving up to 29% more correct matches at that precision. The method eliminates manual tuning by adapting to new environments and generalizing across operating conditions. Our code is available at https://github.com/DhyeyR-007/Quantile-Transfer-for-Reliable-VPR.
papers.comment: Accepted to the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 视觉地点识别（VPR）的性能关键依赖于匹配阈值的选择，传统手动调参无法适应环境变化。本文提出一种基于分位数归一化的阈值迁移方法，利用小规模校准遍历自动估计操作点，旨在保持100%精度下最大化召回。实验表明该方法在多种VPR技术和数据集上一致优于基线，使VPR在约两倍的部署场景中达到100%精度，并在该精度下多检索最多29%的正确匹配。
Motivation: VPR系统通常需要手动调整图像匹配阈值以平衡精度和召回，但阈值固定导致环境变化时性能下降。现有方法缺乏自动且可靠的操作点选择机制。
Method: 提出利用已知对应关系的小规模校准遍历，通过相似度得分分布的分位数归一化（quantile normalization）将阈值迁移到部署场景，从而自动估计操作点。
Result: 在五个基准数据集上使用七种最新VPR技术，该方法使VPR在约两倍的部署场景中达到100%精度（中位数改进），并在该精度下多检索最多29%的正确匹配。
Conclusion: 该方法消除了手动调参，能够适应新环境并跨操作条件泛化，提升VPR系统的可靠性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: NeuroPareto: Calibrated Acquisition for Costly Many-Goal Search in Vast Parameter Spaces
papers.abstract_en: The pursuit of optimal trade-offs in high-dimensional search spaces under stringent computational constraints poses a fundamental challenge for contemporary multi-objective optimization. We develop NeuroPareto, a cohesive architecture that integrates rank-centric filtering, uncertainty disentanglement, and history-conditioned acquisition strategies to navigate complex objective landscapes. A calibrated Bayesian classifier estimates epistemic uncertainty across non-domination tiers, enabling rapid generation of high-quality candidates with minimal evaluation cost. Deep Gaussian Process surrogates further separate predictive uncertainty into reducible and irreducible components, providing refined predictive means and risk-aware signals for downstream selection. A lightweight acquisition network, trained online from historical hypervolume improvements, guides expensive evaluations toward regions balancing convergence and diversity. With hierarchical screening and amortized surrogate updates, the method maintains accuracy while keeping computational overhead low. Experiments on DTLZ and ZDT suites and a subsurface energy extraction task show that NeuroPareto consistently outperforms classifier-enhanced and surrogate-assisted baselines in Pareto proximity and hypervolume.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NeuroPareto，一种面向高维参数空间的多目标优化框架，通过集成排序中心过滤、不确定性解耦和历史条件采集策略，在计算预算严格受限下高效逼近真实 Pareto 前沿。方法利用校准贝叶斯分类器估计非支配层级间的认知不确定性，结合深度高斯过程代理将预测不确定性分为可约与不可约部分，并训练轻量采集网络在线优化超体积增益。实验表明，NeuroPareto 在 DTLZ、ZDT 基准和地下能源开采任务上优于分类增强和代理辅助基线。
Motivation: 高维参数空间中多目标优化面临计算成本高、目标冲突复杂的问题，现有分类增强或代理辅助方法在 Pareto 邻近度和超体积指标上仍有不足。
Method: 提出 NeuroPareto 架构，包括：(1) 基于排序的筛选与校准贝叶斯分类器估计非支配层级不确定性；(2) 深度高斯过程分离可约与不可约预测不确定性；(3) 轻量采集网络在线学习历史超体积改进，指导昂贵评估点的选择；(4) 分层筛选与摊销代理更新保持低计算开销。
Result: 在 DTLZ、ZDT 测试集及地下能源提取任务上，NeuroPareto 在 Pareto 邻近度和超体积方面一致优于分类增强和代理辅助基线方法。
Conclusion: NeuroPareto 为高维昂贵多目标搜索提供了有效的校准采集策略，在有限评估预算下实现收敛性与多样性的平衡。

papers.title: The Geometry of Learning to Avoid Interventions
papers.abstract_en: Human interventions are a common source of supervision in autonomous systems during deployment. Many existing approaches are based on avoiding interventions, yet the consequences of this objective are not well understood. We develop a geometric perspective on intervention learning that characterizes intervention avoidance as constraining policies to a face of the occupancy measure polytope. This view reveals that the effectiveness of intervention learning depends on the informativeness of the intervention strategy: highly informative interventions uniquely determine the solution, while weak interventions leave a large set of feasible policies, many of which are suboptimal. Motivated by this under-specification, we define Robust Intervention Learning (RIL) as the problem of learning policies that perform well under varying levels of intervention informativeness. From the geometric formulation, we derive Residual Intervention Fine-Tuning (RIFT), which combines interventions with a prior policy to select among feasible solutions. We show that RIFT provides provable improvement over the prior and corresponds to solving a constrained reinforcement learning problem with an induced reward. Empirically, RIFT yields consistent policy improvement across a range of intervention settings, particularly when interventions are sparse or weakly informative. These results highlight the importance of accounting for intervention informativeness and suggest a principled path toward robust learning from human feedback.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从几何角度研究干预学习（intervention learning），将避免干预的约束刻画为占据度量多面体的一个面。揭示了干预的信息量决定解的唯一性：信息量大的干预唯一确定策略，弱的干预留下大量可行策略。提出鲁棒干预学习（RIL）和残差干预微调（RIFT），RIFT结合干预和先验策略选择可行解，并在稀疏或弱干预下实现一致改进。
Motivation: 现有干预学习的目标是避免干预，但该目标的后果尚未被充分理解。论文旨在从几何角度理解干预信息量对学习效果的影响。
Method: 建立几何视角，将干预约束映射为占据度量多面体的面。定义鲁棒干预学习（RIL）问题，并推导残差干预微调（RIFT）算法，通过结合干预与先验策略选择可行解，等效于求解带诱导奖励的约束强化学习问题。
Result: 理论证明RIFT可提供优于先验的策略；实验证明在多种干预设置下，尤其当干预稀疏或弱信息时，RIFT实现一致的策略改进。
Conclusion: 强调应考虑干预信息量，为从人类反馈中鲁棒学习提供了有原则的路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptive Visual Autoregressive Acceleration via Dual-Linkage Entropy Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Visual AutoRegressive modeling (VAR) suffers from substantial computational cost due to the massive token count involved. Failing to account for the continuous evolution of modeling dynamics, existing VAR token reduction methods face three key limitations: heuristic stage partition, non-adaptive schedules, and limited acceleration scope, thereby leaving significant acceleration potential untapped. Since entropy variation intrinsically reflects the transition of predictive uncertainty, it offers a principled measure to capture modeling dynamics evolution. Therefore, we propose NOVA, a training-free token reduction acceleration framework for VAR models via entropy analysis. NOVA adaptively determines the acceleration activation scale during inference by online identifying the inflection point of scale entropy growth. Through scale-linkage and layer-linkage ratio adjustment, NOVA dynamically computes distinct token reduction ratios for each scale and layer, pruning low-entropy tokens while reusing the cache derived from the residuals at the prior scale to accelerate inference and maintain generation quality. Extensive experiments and analyses validate NOVA as a simple yet effective training-free acceleration framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉自回归模型（VAR）因大量token导致的巨大计算成本问题，提出一种无需训练的token缩减加速框架NOVA。NOVA通过在线识别尺度熵增长的拐点来自适应确定加速激活尺度，并利用尺度链接和层链接比率调整动态计算各尺度和层的token缩减比率，同时重用前序尺度的残差缓存以保持生成质量。实验验证了NOVA作为简单有效的训练无关加速框架。
Motivation: 现有VAR token缩减方法因忽略建模动态的连续演化而面临启发式阶段划分、非自适应调度和加速范围有限三个关键限制，留下大量加速潜力未被利用。熵变能反映预测不确定性的转移，可捕捉建模动态演化，因此本文利用熵分析实现自适应加速。
Method: 提出NOVA框架：在推理时通过在线识别尺度熵增长的拐点自适应确定加速激活尺度；通过尺度链接和层链接比率调整，动态计算每层每尺度的token缩减比率，剪除低熵token并重用前序尺度的残差缓存，实现无需训练的加速。
Result: 大量实验和分析表明NOVA是一个简单有效的无需训练加速框架，但摘要未报告具体数值结果。
Conclusion: NOVA通过双链接熵分析实现了VAR模型的自适应、动态token缩减加速，且无需重新训练，在保持生成质量的同时显著提升推理效率。

papers.title: SwiftRepertoire: Few-Shot Immune-Signature Synthesis via Dynamic Kernel Codes
papers.abstract_en: Repertoire-level analysis of T cell receptors offers a biologically grounded signal for disease detection and immune monitoring, yet practical deployment is impeded by label sparsity, cohort heterogeneity, and the computational burden of adapting large encoders to new tasks. We introduce a framework that synthesizes compact task-specific parameterizations from a learned dictionary of prototypes conditioned on lightweight task descriptors derived from repertoire probes and pooled embedding statistics. This synthesis produces small adapter modules applied to a frozen pretrained backbone, enabling immediate adaptation to novel tasks with only a handful of support examples and without full model fine-tuning. The architecture preserves interpretability through motif-aware probes and a calibrated motif discovery pipeline that links predictive decisions to sequence-level signals. Together, these components yield a practical, sample-efficient, and interpretable pathway for translating repertoire-informed models into diverse clinical and research settings where labeled data are scarce and computational resources are constrained.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个框架，通过从学习到的原型字典中合成紧凑的任务特定参数化，用于T细胞受体库分析，实现少样本适应新任务，避免全模型微调。该架构通过模体感知探针和校准的模体发现管线保持可解释性，在标签稀疏和计算资源受限的场景下提供样本高效且可解释的免疫信号分析路径。
Motivation: T细胞受体库分析在疾病检测和免疫监测中有生物学基础，但实际部署受限于标签稀疏性、队列异质性以及将大型编码器适应新任务的计算负担。
Method: 框架从基于库探针和池化嵌入统计量导出的轻量级任务描述子中，学习一个原型字典，并合成紧凑的任务特定适配器模块，应用于冻结的预训练骨干网络上，无需全模型微调即可适应新任务。
Result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，但声称该方法具有样本高效性和可解释性，能够在少样本支持下立即适应新任务。
Conclusion: 该框架为将库感知模型转化到标记数据稀缺且计算资源受限的临床和研究场景提供了实用、样本高效且可解释的途径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LatentLens: Revealing Highly Interpretable Visual Tokens in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Transforming a large language model (LLM) into a vision-language model (VLM) can be achieved by mapping the visual tokens from a vision encoder into the embedding space of an LLM. Intriguingly, this mapping can be as simple as a shallow MLP transformation. To understand why LLMs can so readily process visual tokens, we need interpretability methods that reveal what is encoded in the visual token representations at every layer of LLM processing. In this work, we introduce LatentLens, a novel approach for mapping latent representations to descriptions in natural language. LatentLens encodes a large text corpus and stores contextualized token representations for each token in that corpus. Visual token representations are then compared to these contextualized representations and the top-nearest neighbor representations serve as descriptions of the visual token. We evaluate this method on 15 different VLMs, showing that commonly used methods, such as LogitLens, substantially underestimate the interpretability of visual tokens. With LatentLens instead, the majority of visual tokens are interpretable across all studied models and all layers. Qualitatively, we show that the descriptions produced by LatentLens are semantically meaningful and provide more fine-grained interpretations for humans compared to individual tokens. More broadly, our findings contribute new evidence on the alignment between vision and language representations and open up new directions for analyzing the latent representations of LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LatentLens，一种将视觉标记（visual token）的潜在表示映射为自然语言描述的可解释性方法。通过将视觉表示与大型文本语料库中上下文化的标记表示进行最近邻比较，LatentLens能够生成语义丰富的描述。在15个不同的视觉语言模型（VLM）上评估表明，与LogitLens相比，大多数视觉标记在所有层中都是可解释的，且描述更细致。
Motivation: 现有方法如LogitLens低估了视觉标记的可解释性，需要一种更精确的方法来揭示LLM如何处理视觉信息，以理解视觉-语言表示的对齐。
Method: LatentLens编码大型文本语料库并存储每个标记的上下文化表示，然后将视觉标记表示与这些表示进行比较，选取最近邻作为描述。
Result: 在15个VLM上，大多数视觉标记在所有层中都是可解释的，且描述比单个标记更语义丰富和细致。
Conclusion: LatentLens为分析LLM的潜在表示提供了新方向，并补充了视觉-语言表示对齐的证据。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: In-Run Data Shapley for Adam Optimizer
papers.abstract_en: Reliable data attribution is essential for mitigating bias and reducing computational waste in modern machine learning, with the Shapley value serving as the theoretical gold standard. While recent "In-Run" methods bypass the prohibitive cost of retraining by estimating contributions dynamically, they heavily rely on the linear structure of Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) and fail to capture the complex dynamics of adaptive optimizers like Adam. In this work, we demonstrate that data attribution is inherently optimizer-dependent: we show that SGD-based proxies diverge significantly from true contributions under Adam (Pearson $R \approx 0.11$), rendering them ineffective for modern training pipelines. To bridge this gap, we propose Adam-Aware In-Run Data Shapley. We derive a closed-form approximation that restores additivity by redefining utility under a fixed-state assumption and enable scalable computation via a novel Linearized Ghost Approximation. This technique linearizes the variance-dependent scaling term, allowing us to compute pairwise gradient dot-products without materializing per-sample gradients. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves near-perfect fidelity to ground-truth marginal contributions ($R > 0.99$) while retaining $\sim$95\% of standard training throughput. Furthermore, our Adam-aware attribution significantly outperforms SGD-based baselines in data attribution downstream tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Adam感知的运行时数据Shapley值方法，解决现有基于SGD的归因方法在Adam优化器下失效的问题。通过固定状态假设推导封闭形式近似，并设计线性化幽灵近似避免显式梯度存储，实现了接近完美的归因精度（R>0.99），且仅损失约5%训练吞吐量。
Motivation: 现有运行时数据Shapley方法依赖SGD的线性结构，在自适应优化器（如Adam）下与真实贡献相关性极低（Pearson R≈0.11），无法有效应用于现代训练流程。
Method: 提出Adam-Aware In-Run Data Shapley，包括：基于固定状态假设的封闭形式近似以恢复可加性，以及线性化幽灵近似（Linearized Ghost Approximation）来高效计算成对梯度点积，无需实例化每个样本的梯度。
Result: 该方法与真实边际贡献的相关性R>0.99，同时保持约95%的标准训练吞吐量；在数据归因下游任务中显著优于基于SGD的基线方法。
Conclusion: 数据归因本质上是优化器相关的，本文提出的Adam感知归因方法能够准确、高效地评估数据贡献，适用于使用Adam等自适应优化器的现代训练管道。

papers.title: A Sheaf-Theoretic and Topological Perspective on Complex Network Modeling and Attention Mechanisms in Graph Neural Models
papers.abstract_en: Combinatorial and topological structures, such as graphs, simplicial complexes, and cell complexes, form the foundation of geometric and topological deep learning (GDL and TDL) architectures. These models aggregate signals over such domains, integrate local features, and generate representations for diverse real-world applications. However, the distribution and diffusion behavior of GDL and TDL features during training remains an open and underexplored problem. Motivated by this gap, we introduce a cellular sheaf theoretic framework for modeling and analyzing the local consistency and harmonicity of node features and edge weights in graph-based architectures. By tracking local feature alignments and agreements through sheaf structures, the framework offers a topological perspective on feature diffusion and aggregation. Furthermore, a multiscale extension inspired by topological data analysis (TDA) is proposed to capture hierarchical feature interactions in graph models. This approach enables a joint characterization of GDL and TDL architectures based on their underlying geometric and topological structures and the learned signals defined on them, providing insights for future studies on conventional tasks such as node classification, substructure detection, and community detection.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个细胞层理论框架来分析图神经网络中的特征扩散与聚合行为，通过跟踪局部特征对齐和一致性提供拓扑视角，并引入基于拓扑数据分析的多尺度扩展以捕捉层次化特征交互。该框架统一了基于几何和拓扑结构的深度学习架构分析，为节点分类、子结构检测等任务提供理论洞察。
Motivation: 图神经网络等几何/拓扑深度学习模型在实践中广泛应用，但训练过程中特征的分布与扩散行为仍是一个未充分研究的问题。
Method: 引入细胞层理论（cellular sheaf theory）对节点特征和边权重的局部一致性与调和性建模，并利用拓扑数据分析思想提出多尺度扩展以捕获层次化特征交互。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，主要贡献为理论框架的构建与定性分析。
Conclusion: 该框架为基于图、单纯复形、胞腔复形的深度学习架构提供了统一的拓扑视角，有助于未来研究节点分类、子结构检测和社区检测等任务。

papers.title: Diffusion-based Annealed Boltzmann Generators : benefits, pitfalls and hopes
papers.abstract_en: Sampling configurations at thermodynamic equilibrium is a central challenge in statistical physics. Boltzmann Generators (BGs) tackle it by combining a generative model with a Monte Carlo (MC) correction step to obtain asymptotically unbiased samples from an unnormalized target. Most current BGs use classic MC mechanisms such as importance sampling, which both require tractable likelihoods from the backbone model and scale poorly in high-dimensional, multi-modal targets. We study BGs built on annealed Monte Carlo (aMC), which is designed to overcome these limitations by bridging a simple reference to the target through a sequence of intermediate densities. Diffusion models (DMs) are powerful generative models and have already been incorporated into aMC-based recalibration schemes via the diffusion-induced density path, making them appealing backbones for aMC-BGs. We provide an empirical meta-analysis of DM-based aMC-BGs on controlled multi-modal Gaussian mixtures (varying mode separation, number of modes, and dimension), explicitly disentangling inference effects from learning effects by comparing (i) a perfectly learned DM and (ii) a DM trained from data. Even with a perfect DM, standard integrations using only first-order stochastic denoising kernels fail systematically, whereas second-order denoising kernels can substantially improve performance when covariance information is available. We further propose a deterministic aMC integration based on first-order transport maps derived from DMs, which outperforms the stochastic first-order variant at higher computational cost. Finally, in the learned-DM setting, all DM-aMC variants struggle to produce accurate BGs; we trace the main bottleneck to inaccurate DM log-density estimation. Code available at https://github.com/h2o64/dabg.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了基于扩散模型（DM）的退火蒙特卡罗玻尔兹曼生成器（aMC-BGs）在多模态高斯混合基准上的表现。即使完美学习的DM，一阶随机去噪核也会系统失败；二阶去噪核利用协方差信息可显著提升性能。在真实学习DM场景下，所有变体均难以产生准确样本，主要瓶颈是DM对数密度估计不精确。
Motivation: 传统玻尔兹曼生成器依赖重要性采样等MC方法，在高维多模态目标上效率低下。退火蒙特卡罗虽能缓解此问题，但扩散模型作为其骨干的潜力与局限性尚未被充分理解。
Method: 在可控多模态高斯混合上对比完美学习DM和训练DM，提出基于DM的一阶确定性aMC积分，并测试二阶随机去噪核，以及标准一阶随机变体。
Result: 完美DM下，一阶随机核完全失效，二阶核提升显著。确定性一阶积分性能更好但计算成本更高。学习DM时所有变体表现不佳，归因于对数密度估计误差。
Conclusion: DM-based aMC-BGs在高维多模态采样中仍受限于对数密度估计精度，二阶核和确定性积分是潜在改善方向。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文系统研究了基于扩散模型（DM）的退火蒙特卡罗玻尔兹曼生成器（aMC-BGs）在多模态高斯混合基准上的表现。即使完美学习的DM，一阶随机去噪核也会系统失败；二阶去噪核利用协方差信息可显著提升性能。在真实学习DM场景下，所有变体均难以产生准确样本，主要瓶颈是DM对数密度估计不精确。

summary_sections.method: 在可控多模态高斯混合上对比完美学习DM和训练DM，提出基于DM的一阶确定性aMC积分，并测试二阶随机去噪核，以及标准一阶随机变体。

papers.title: Comparative evaluation of training strategies using partially labelled datasets for segmentation of white matter hyperintensities and stroke lesions in FLAIR MRI
papers.abstract_en: White matter hyperintensities (WMH) and ischaemic stroke lesions (ISL) are key imaging biomarkers of cerebral small vessel disease (SVD) detectable on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). The development of robust deep learning models to automatically segment and differentiate these pathologies remains challenging. Specifically, WMH and ISL frequently co-occur within the same subject and present as visually confounding hyperintensities on fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR) sequences, complicating their accurate delineation. To address the scarcity of fully annotated cohorts, we systematically evaluated six accessible strategies for training a joint WMH and ISL segmentation model using partially labelled data. We aggregated privately held and publicly available datasets to curate a large-scale cohort of 2,052 MRI volumes, of which 1341 and 1152 volumes contained ground truth annotations for WMH and ISL, respectively. Our analysis indicates that multiple strategies effectively leverage partially labelled data to enhance overall model performance, with pseudolabelling emerging as the most effective approach. This model exhibited a consistent WMH segmentation policy and successfully detected the majority of FLAIR-positive ISL. These findings demonstrate the viability of using partially labelled data to develop reliable automated segmentation tools, which can support ongoing SVD monitoring and high-throughput biomarker extraction for large-scale clinical research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了六种利用部分标注数据训练分割模型（共分割白质高信号WMH和缺血性卒中病变ISL）的策略。在包含2052个FLAIR MRI体积的大规模队列上，伪标签（pseudolabelling）表现最佳，获得一致的WMH分割策略并成功检测大多数FLAIR阳性ISL。结果表明部分标注数据可用于开发可靠的自动分割工具。
Motivation: WMH和ISL常共存于同一受试者且FLAIR上视觉混淆，完全标注的大规模数据集稀缺，需要探索利用部分标注数据的训练策略。
Method: 系统评估六种利用部分标注数据进行联合WMH和ISL分割的训练策略，包括伪标签方法，并整合私有和公开数据集共2052个MRI体积。
Result: 多种策略能有效利用部分标注数据提升性能，其中伪标签最有效，展现出一致的WMH分割策略并检测到大多数FLAIR阳性ISL。
Conclusion: 研究表明部分标注数据可用于开发可靠的自动分割工具，支持脑小血管病（SVD）监测和大规模临床研究中的高通量生物标志物提取。

papers.title: Geometric Attention: A Regime-Explicit Operator Semantics for Transformer Attention
papers.abstract_en: Geometric Attention (GA) specifies an attention layer by four independent inputs: a finite carrier (what indices are addressable), an evidence-kernel rule (how masked proto-scores and a link induce nonnegative weights), a probe family (which observables are treated as admissible), and an anchor/update rule (which representative kernel is selected and how it is applied). Probe families induce an operational equivalence relation on kernels and therefore a gauge; anchors select representatives relative to that probe. Under a scalar relational-work representation and a multiplicative compositionality law for evidence, the admissible link family is exponential, yielding Gibbs weights; with row anchoring this includes the softmax kernel family as a subregime. After quotienting unary row/column score fields, the remaining interaction component admits a canonical rank-r normal form (Eckart-Young/SVD); dot-product score charts implement the corresponding low-rank interaction regime. Fixing the carrier and extensionalizing the update yields the standard fixed-token Transformer attention operator; allowing carrier updates yields adaptive-carrier and staged-depth regimes. The operator language also supports multihead/mixed kernels, plan-based anchors (e.g., entropic OT/Sinkhorn), and unary operators (e.g., FFN-style fields) as explicit regime choices. This separates invariant structure from modeling choice, enabling principled comparison and extension of attention mechanisms, and attention-based architectures.
papers.comment: Withdrawn by the author because a central non-completability theorem is incorrect as stated, invalidating several downstream claims. The operator-level attention decomposition may be developed separately in a substantially revised form
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Geometric Attention框架，将注意力层分解为有限载体、证据核规则、探针族和锚定/更新规则四个独立输入，通过商去单一场得到标准低秩交互组件，涵盖softmax、点积得分、多头混合核等注意力变体。但作者已撤回论文，因核心定理有误，导致下游声明无效。
Motivation: 现有注意力机制缺乏统一的形式化语义，不同变体之间难以进行原理性比较和扩展。
Method: 定义四个独立输入（carrier、evidence-kernel rule、probe family、anchor/update rule），通过商去单一行/列得分场得到规范秩-r标准型，并展示标准Transformer注意力作为特例。
Result: 论文在抽象层面声称该框架统一了多种注意力机制（softmax、点积、多头、自适应载体等），但已被撤回，核心定理错误，结果不可靠。
Conclusion: 作者撤回论文，表示核心定理错误，下游声明无效；可能以大幅修订形式单独发展算子级注意力分解。

papers.title: Generative Semantic Multi-Object Tracking: A Large-Scale Benchmark and an MLLM-Driven Reasoning Framework
papers.abstract_en: Semantic Multi-Object Tracking (SMOT) is evolving from purely geometric localization toward comprehensive video understanding. However, existing paradigms predominantly rely on closed-set interaction tags and fragmented perception pipelines, creating a bottleneck that prevents the full utilization of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for dynamic scenes. In this paper, we elevate SMOT from rigid classification to an open-ended generative reasoning task. To support this paradigm shift, we introduce Grand-SMOT, a large-scale benchmark featuring high-density, dual-stream narratives. This dataset explicitly decouples micro-level individual dynamics from macro-level environmental contexts, directly resolving the semantic scarcity of prior tracking datasets. Furthermore, we propose LLMTrack, a unified MLLM-driven framework for dynamic SMOT. Guided by a verifiable ``\textit{Macro-Understanding-First}'' mechanism, LLMTrack employs a Spatio-Temporal Fusion Module to compress discrete geometric trajectories into continuous semantic tokens, effectively suppressing temporal hallucinations in long-sequence tracking. Extensive experiments, utilizing a novel decoupled evaluation protocol, validate that LLMTrack achieves state-of-the-art geometric tracking robustness while delivering a qualitative leap in generative semantic reasoning. The code and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/liaopan-lp/LLMTrack-GrandSMOT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将语义多目标跟踪（SMOT）从刚性分类提升为开放式生成推理任务。引入大规模基准Grand-SMOT，具有高密度双流叙述，解耦微观个体动态与宏观环境上下文。提出LLMTrack框架，采用“宏观理解优先”机制和时空融合模块，将离散几何轨迹压缩为连续语义令牌，抑制时间幻觉。实验表明LLMTrack在几何跟踪鲁棒性和生成语义推理方面取得SOTA。
Motivation: 现有SMOT范式依赖封闭集交互标签和碎片化感知流水线，未能充分利用多模态大语言模型进行动态场景理解。
Method: 提出Grand-SMOT基准和LLMTrack框架。LLMTrack采用“宏观理解优先”机制，包含时空融合模块，将离散几何轨迹编码为连续语义令牌。
Result: LLMTrack在几何跟踪鲁棒性上达到SOTA，并在生成语义推理上实现质的飞跃。
Conclusion: 将SMOT提升为开放式生成推理任务，通过新基准和框架证明可行性。

papers.title: ArenaRL: Scaling RL for Open-Ended Agents via Tournament-based Relative Ranking
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has substantially improved the performance of LLM agents on tasks with verifiable outcomes, but it still struggles on open-ended agent tasks with vast solution spaces (e.g., complex travel planning). Due to the absence of objective ground-truth for these tasks, current RL algorithms largely rely on reward models that assign scalar scores to individual responses. We contend that such pointwise scoring suffers from an inherent discrimination collapse: the reward model struggles to distinguish subtle advantages among different trajectories, resulting in scores within a group being compressed into a narrow range. Consequently, the effective reward signal becomes dominated by noise from the reward model, leading to optimization stagnation. To address this, we propose ArenaRL, a reinforcement learning paradigm that shifts from pointwise scalar scoring to intra-group relative ranking. ArenaRL introduces a process-aware pairwise evaluation mechanism, employing multi-level rubrics to assign fine-grained relative scores to trajectories. Additionally, we construct an intra-group adversarial arena and devise a tournament-based ranking scheme to obtain stable advantage signals. Empirical results confirm that the built seeded single-elimination scheme achieves nearly equivalent advantage estimation accuracy to full pairwise comparisons with O(N^2) complexity, while operating with only O(N) complexity, striking an optimal balance between efficiency and precision. Furthermore, to address the lack of full-cycle benchmarks for open-ended agents, we build Open-Travel and Open-DeepResearch, two high-quality benchmarks featuring a comprehensive pipeline covering SFT, RL training, and multi-dimensional evaluation. Extensive experiments show that ArenaRL substantially outperforms standard RL baselines, enabling LLM agents to generate more robust solutions for complex real-world tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对开放环境智能体任务中奖励模型点状评分导致区分崩溃的问题，提出ArenaRL，将评分从点状标量转向组内相对排序。通过过程感知的成对评估机制和锦标赛排名，以O(N)复杂度实现接近O(N^2)全对比较的精度，并构建了Open-Travel和Open-DeepResearch两个全流程基准。实验表明ArenaRL优于标准强化学习基线。
Motivation: 现有强化学习在开放任务中依赖点状标量奖励模型，其区分崩溃导致有效信号被噪声淹没，优化停滞。
Method: 提出ArenaRL，采用过程感知的成对评估机制，利用多级评分标准对轨迹进行细粒度相对评分，并构建组内对抗竞技场与锦标赛排名方案以获得稳定优势信号。
Result: 锦标赛排名在O(N)复杂度下达到接近O(N^2)全对比较的优势估计精度；在复杂现实任务上，ArenaRL使LLM智能体生成更鲁棒的解决方案。
Conclusion: ArenaRL通过相对排名替代点状评分有效缓解区分崩溃，为开放环境智能体任务提供了可扩展的强化学习范式。

papers.title: Revisiting Forest Proximities via Sparse Leaf-Incidence Kernels
papers.abstract_en: Decision forests induce supervised similarities through the partition structure of their trees. Yet forest proximity computation is still often treated as a quadratic operation in the number of samples, which limits scalability and restricts broader use in kernel and representation-learning pipelines. We introduce a unified view of leaf-collision forest proximities through a class of Separable Weighted Leaf-Collision (SWLC) kernels, showing that most existing proximities differ only in their weighting scheme while sharing a common sparse leaf-incidence structure. This yields an explicit leaf-space representation that clarifies their kernel interpretation and leads to an exact finite-sample sparse factorization of the proximity matrix, avoiding an explicit all-pairs comparison and reducing computation to sparse linear algebra over leaf collisions. We implement this framework in a memory-efficient Python library and show, both theoretically and empirically, that exact kernel computation scales near-linearly in time and memory under standard forest regimes. Benchmarks verify the predicted scaling behavior in practice across datasets, proximity definitions, and forest settings, and show that the resulting sparse leaf-space representation can also be used directly for fast task-aware embedding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视决策森林的邻近性（forest proximities），通过稀疏叶-入射核（sparse leaf-incidence kernels）的统一视角，将大多数现有邻近性归为可分离加权叶碰撞（SWLC）核类。作者提出精确的有限样本稀疏分解方法，避免显式的样本对比较，将计算转化为稀疏线性代数，并实现了一个内存高效的Python库。理论和实验表明，在标准森林设置下，精确核计算在时间和内存上呈近线性扩展。
Motivation: 决策森林的邻近性计算通常被视为样本数量的二次操作，限制了在大规模核和表示学习流程中的可扩展性。现有方法缺乏统一的数学框架，且计算效率低下。
Method: 提出可分离加权叶碰撞（SWLC）核的统一视图，将叶碰撞邻近性分解为稀疏叶-入射表示，并利用稀疏矩阵代数实现精确的有限样本分解，避免全样本对比较。
Result: 理论上证明了精确核计算在标准森林设置下时间和内存呈近线性扩展；在多个数据集、邻近性定义和森林设置上的基准测试验证了预测的扩展行为，同时稀疏叶-入射表示可直接用于快速任务感知嵌入。
Conclusion: 该框架统一并简化了森林邻近性的计算，提供了显式的核解释，并在实践中实现了高效的扩展性。作者指出该稀疏表示可直接用于下游任务，但未讨论在大规模或高维数据上的局限性。

papers.title: Varying-coefficient mixture of experts model for dynamic heterogeneous populations: application to mouse cortical development
papers.abstract_en: As cells differentiate, gene-gene associations may change. Because the composition of cell subtypes also shifts with development, it is challenging to establish whether those changes reflect real changes in gene regulation within one or more subpopulations or a spurious one due to the shifting composition. Only formal inference can separate them. We propose a Varying-Coefficient Mixture-of-Experts (VCMoE) model in which the coefficients of both the gating functions and the expert components vary smoothly with the index variable, so that a subgroup-specific association can be inferred without being confounded by the concurrent shift in subgroup composition. We develop a label-consistent EM algorithm and establish the identifiability and asymptotic theory that make the resulting inference valid. These guarantees support simultaneous confidence bands, constructed using asymptotic and bootstrap methods, together with a generalized likelihood ratio test for constant coefficient functions. Simulations demonstrate accurate estimation and satisfactory coverage. Applied to single-nucleus RNA-sequencing data from embryonic mouse cortex, VCMoE finds that the repression of Bcl11b by Satb2 within the upper layer is not yet in place when those neurons first appear and becomes established over the course of differentiation, a dynamic that an ordinary mixture-of-experts model neglected. A package for implementing the method is available.
papers.comment: Revised manuscript with expanded simulations, new real-data analyses
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出变系数混合专家模型（VCMoE），用于动态异质性群体中基因-基因关联的推断，避免因亚群组成变化导致的伪影。通过标签一致EM算法进行估计，并建立了可识别性和渐近理论，支持同时置信带和广义似然比检验。应用于胚胎小鼠皮层单核RNA测序数据，发现Satb2对Bcl11b的抑制在上层神经元出现初期尚未建立，而在分化过程中逐渐形成，这一动态被普通混合专家模型忽略。
Motivation: 细胞分化过程中，基因-基因关联可能变化，但亚群组成也在变化，难以区分真实调控变化和组成变化的伪影，需要形式化的推断方法。
Method: 提出VCMoE模型，其中门控函数和专家成分的系数随索引变量平滑变化，从而在不被亚群组成变化混淆的情况下推断亚群特异性关联。开发了标签一致EM算法，并建立了可识别性和渐近理论。
Result: 模拟实验显示准确估计和令人满意的覆盖概率。真实数据分析发现Satb2对Bcl11b的抑制在上层神经元出现初期尚未建立，而在分化过程中逐渐形成。
Conclusion: VCMoE能够动态揭示亚群特异性基因调控关系，避免了因组成变化导致的混淆，为发育生物学中动态异质性推断提供了有效工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fidelity Before Structure: Verbatim Chunks Beat Lossy Artifact Extraction in Long-Conversation LLM Memory
papers.abstract_en: A growing class of conversational-memory systems compresses dialogue history into structured artifacts (extracted facts, decisions, or events) on the premise that distilled structure retrieves better than raw text. We test this premise with a controlled ablation: within one fixed retrieval--rerank--reasoning pipeline, we swap only the stored representation (LLM-extracted typed artifacts versus verbatim conversation chunks), holding the model, retriever, reranker, and judge constant. Verbatim chunks win by 15.9 points on LoCoMo (43.9% vs. 28.0%) and 22.0 points on LongMemEval-S (67.4% vs. 45.4%); a 1-hop semantic graph does not recover the gap, and six confound controls reproduce the effect. The mechanism is lossy distillation, not structure per se: accuracy tracks how much source text survives in the store, and the extracted-artifact pipeline does not beat naive RAG in overall accuracy (though chunks abstain worse; see Limitations). For the extraction designs we test, structured memory should augment verbatim text rather than replace it: adding artifacts alongside chunks preserves accuracy; substituting them forfeits the gap. Code and data: https://github.com/tao-hpu/cog-canvas
papers.comment: v4: title and abstract aligned with ARR August 2026 submission; six confound controls; 34 pages, 6 figures. Code: https://github.com/tao-hpu/cog-canvas
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过受控消融实验，在固定检索-重排-推理流水线中对比了LLM提取的结构化人工制品（事实、决策等）与原始对话片段作为记忆存储表示的效果。结果表明，原始片段在两个长对话记忆基准（LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S）上分别高出15.9和22.0个百分点，原因在于有损蒸馏导致信息损失，而非结构本身。
Motivation: 现有对话记忆系统倾向于将对话历史压缩为结构化人工制品，认为结构化表示比原始文本检索效果更好。本文质疑这一前提，并通过控制实验检验结构化表示是否真的优于原始文本。
Method: 采用固定检索-重排-推理流水线，仅替换存储表示（LLM提取的类型化人工制品 vs. 原始对话片段），保持模型、检索器、重排器和评判器不变，并进行六种混杂控制。
Result: 原始片段在LoCoMo上取得43.9% vs. 28.0%（+15.9），在LongMemEval-S上取得67.4% vs. 45.4%（+22.0）；1跳语义图无法弥补差距。提取人工制品流水线整体准确率未超过朴素RAG。
Conclusion: 对于所测试的提取设计，结构化记忆应作为原始文本的补充而非替代：在片段旁添加人工制品可保持准确率，而替换则会导致性能下降。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Dominant vs. Dominated: Concept-Level Generative Collapse in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models have attracted significant attention for their ability to generate diverse, high-fidelity images. However, in multi-concept generation, one concept token often dominates the output while others are suppressed-a phenomenon we term the Dominant-vs-Dominated (DvD) imbalance. To systematically study this failure mode, we introduce DominanceBench and examine its underlying causes from both data and internal-mechanistic perspectives. Our controlled fine-tuning study, which mimics concept learning during diffusion-model training, shows that concepts learned from visually homogeneous (low-variation) concept-specific training images exhibit stronger dominance when composed with others. Cross-attention analysis indicates that dominant tokens concentrate attention in early denoising steps, followed by reduced representation of competing concepts. Head-ablation analysis further shows that this dominance is distributed across attention heads rather than localized. Overall, these findings characterize DvD as a systematic concept-level failure mode and provide a basis for more reliable and controllable multi-concept generation. DominanceBench will be released upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究文本到图像扩散模型在多概念生成时出现的一种概念级失效模式——主导-被主导（DvD）不平衡，即一个概念令牌主导输出而其他概念被抑制。通过引入DominanceBench基准和可控微调实验，发现从视觉同质性高的训练图像中学习的概念在组合时表现出更强的主导性。交叉注意力分析表明主导令牌在早期去噪步骤集中注意力，而头部消融分析显示这种主导性分布在多个注意力头部而非局部。
Motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型在多概念生成时常出现某个概念主导输出、其他概念被抑制的问题，现有研究对此系统性理解不足，缺乏标准化评估和机制分析。
Method: 构建DominanceBench基准进行系统评估；通过可控微调模拟概念学习过程，分析训练数据视觉多样性对概念主导性的影响；使用交叉注意力分析和头部消融实验探究内部机制。
Result: 概念从视觉同质性高的训练图像中学习时表现出更强的组合主导性；主导令牌在早期去噪步骤集中注意力且这种主导性分布在多个注意力头部。
Conclusion: DvD是扩散模型中系统性的概念级失效模式，研究结果为更可靠、可控的多概念生成提供了基础。DominanceBench将在发表后公开。

papers.title: Code-in-the-Loop Forensics: Agentic Tool Use for Image Forgery Detection
papers.abstract_en: Existing image forgery detection (IFD) methods either exploit low-level, semantics-agnostic artifacts or rely on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with high-level semantic knowledge. Although naturally complementary, these two information streams are highly heterogeneous in both paradigm and reasoning, making it difficult for existing methods to unify them or effectively model their cross-level interactions. To address this gap, we propose ForenAgent, a multi-round interactive IFD framework that enables MLLMs to autonomously generate, execute, and iteratively refine Python-based low-level tools around the detection objective, thereby achieving more flexible and interpretable forgery analysis. ForenAgent follows a two-stage training pipeline combining Cold Start and Reinforcement Fine-Tuning to enhance its tool interaction capability and reasoning adaptability progressively. Inspired by human reasoning, we design a dynamic reasoning loop comprising global perception, local focusing, iterative probing, and holistic adjudication, and instantiate it as both a data-sampling strategy and a task-aligned process reward. For systematic training and evaluation, we construct FABench, a heterogeneous, high-quality agent-forensics dataset comprising 100k images and approximately 200k agent-interaction question-answer pairs. Experiments show that ForenAgent exhibits emergent tool-use competence and reflective reasoning on challenging IFD tasks when assisted by low-level tools, charting a promising route toward general-purpose IFD. The code will be released after the review process is completed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ForenAgent，一种多轮交互式图像伪造检测框架，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）自主生成、执行和迭代优化基于Python的低层工具，融合低层伪影与高层语义知识。框架采用两阶段训练（冷启动与强化微调）并设计动态推理循环（全局感知、局部聚焦、迭代探测、整体裁决）。在构建的FABench数据集（10万图像、20万问答对）上，ForenAgent展现出涌现的工具使用能力和反思推理，为通用图像伪造检测提供了新方向。
Motivation: 现有图像伪造检测方法或仅利用低层语义无关伪影，或依赖高层语义知识的MLLM，二者互补但高度异构，难以统一建模跨层次交互。
Method: 提出ForenAgent框架，使MLLM能够围绕检测目标自主生成、执行并迭代优化Python低层工具。采用冷启动与强化微调的两阶段训练，并设计包含全局感知、局部聚焦、迭代探测和整体裁决的动态推理循环，同时将其作为数据采样策略和任务对齐的过程奖励。
Result: 在包含10万图像和约20万代理交互问答对的FABench数据集上，ForenAgent在挑战性伪造检测任务中表现出涌现的工具使用能力和反思推理能力。
Conclusion: 论文表明，借助低层工具辅助，MLLM可在图像伪造检测中实现灵活可解释的分析，为通用图像伪造检测开辟了新途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Enhancing next token prediction based pre-training for jet foundation models
papers.abstract_en: Next token prediction is an attractive pre-training task for jet foundation models, in that it is simulation free and enables excellent generative capabilities that can transfer across datasets. Here we study multiple improvements to next token prediction, building on the initial work of OmniJet-$α$. Instead of tokenizing particles and subsequently only using the token-ID as the model input for both the generative and the classification task, we adopt a hybrid setup, which allows us to use continuous feature vectors as model input while only using token-IDs in the next token prediction target. Secondly, we explore a combined pre-training strategy that combines masked particle modeling and generative learning objectives. Taken together, these changes greatly improve the performance in downstream classification tasks without any loss in generative performance.
papers.journal_ref: 2026 Mach. Learn.: Sci. Technol. 7 035042
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在OmniJet-α基础上改进喷注基础模型的下一token预测预训练，提出混合输入架构（连续特征向量输入+token-ID预测目标）并联合掩码粒子建模与生成式学习目标，提升下游分类性能且不损失生成能力。
Motivation: 现有基于下一token预测的喷注基础模型在分类任务上性能有限，且完全依赖token-ID输入限制了特征表达。
Method: 使用连续特征向量作为模型输入，仅在下个token预测目标中使用token-ID；结合掩码粒子建模和生成式学习目标的联合预训练策略。
Result: 摘要报告大幅提升下游分类任务性能，且未牺牲生成性能。
Conclusion: 混合输入和联合预训练策略可有效提升喷注基础模型的分类能力。

papers.title: The PAR dataset: Prostate biopsy whole slide images from an underrepresented Middle Eastern population
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in digital pathology. Publicly available histopathology datasets remain scarce, and those that do exist predominantly represent Western populations. Consequently, the generalizability of AI models to populations from less digitized regions, such as the Middle East, is largely unknown. This motivates the public release of our dataset to support the development and validation of pathology AI models across globally diverse populations. We present 1,017 whole slide images by digitizing 339 glass slides of prostate core needle biopsies from a consecutive series of 185 patients collected in Erbil, Iraq. The slides are associated with Gleason scores and International Society of Urological Pathology grades assigned independently by three pathologists. Scanning was performed using two high-throughput scanners (Leica and Hamamatsu) and one compact scanner (Grundium). All slides were de-identified and are provided in their native formats without further conversion. The dataset enables grading concordance analyses, color normalization, and cross-scanner robustness evaluations. The PAR dataset has been deposited to the BioImage Archive under accession number S-BIAD2323 (https:// doi.org/10.6019/S-BIAD2323).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文介绍了PAR数据集，包含来自伊拉克185名患者的339张前列腺穿刺活检玻片的1017张全切片图像，由三位病理学家独立标注Gleason评分和ISUP分级，使用三种扫描仪数字化，旨在支持病理AI模型在不同人群中的泛化性和鲁棒性研究。
Motivation: 公开可用的组织病理学数据集稀缺且主要代表西方人群，AI模型在中东等数字化不足地区的泛化性未知，因此需要发布来自这些地区的标注数据集。
Method: 收集伊拉克埃尔比勒185例连续患者的前列腺穿刺活检玻片，经三位病理学家独立标注后，使用Leica、Hamamatsu和Grundium三种扫描仪数字化，生成1017张全切片图像，以原生格式公开于BioImage Archive。
Result: 数据集包含339张玻片对应的1017张全切片图像，提供Gleason评分和ISUP分级标注，支持分级一致性分析、颜色归一化和跨扫描仪鲁棒性评估。
Conclusion: PAR数据集填补了中东人群前列腺病理数据的空白，有助于验证和开发适用于全球多样化人群的病理AI模型。

summary_sections.method: 收集伊拉克埃尔比勒185例连续患者的前列腺穿刺活检玻片，经三位病理学家独立标注后，使用Leica、Hamamatsu和Grundium三种扫描仪数字化，生成1017张全切片图像，以原生格式公开于BioImage Archive。
summary_sections.result: 数据集包含339张玻片对应的1017张全切片图像，提供Gleason评分和ISUP分级标注，支持分级一致性分析、颜色归一化和跨扫描仪鲁棒性评估。
summary_sections.conclusion: PAR数据集填补了中东人群前列腺病理数据的空白，有助于验证和开发适用于全球多样化人群的病理AI模型。

papers.title: WorldPack: Dynamic Frame Compression for Long-context Video World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Video world models have attracted significant attention for their ability to produce high-fidelity future visual observations conditioned on past observations and navigation actions. However, achieving temporally and spatially consistent generation over long horizons remains an open challenge: existing approaches either compress past frames using generic importance schedules that do not exploit 3D viewpoint geometry, or retrieve only a handful of spatially relevant frames without increasing the total amount of retained history. In this paper, we propose WorldPack, a video world model that introduces spatially-aware compressed memory to address both limitations simultaneously. The key insight is that compression rates should not be uniform or temporally determined, but should instead be dynamically allocated based on 3D spatial relevance to the current viewpoint.WorldPack achieves this through two tightly coupled mechanisms: trajectory packing, which fits substantially more historical frames into a fixed-length context through hierarchical frame compression, and geometric selection, which leverages camera pose information and field-of-view overlap to assign lower compression to spatially important frames and higher compression to less relevant ones. Together, these mechanisms expand the effective context from 4 to 22 frames with moderate computational overhead: trajectory packing increases diffusion-model inference time by 16%, while FoV-based geometric selection introduces an additional candidate-dependent cost. We evaluate WorldPack on LoopNav, a Minecraft benchmark for long-horizon spatial consistency, and conduct comprehensive experiments on the RECON, real-world navigation dataset, across multiple evaluation protocols. WorldPack outperforms strong baselines, Oasis, Mineworld, DIAMOND, NWM, with pronounced gains on spatial reasoning tasks requiring recall of distant observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WorldPack，一种视频世界模型，通过动态帧压缩扩展有效上下文长度。其核心思想是基于 3D 空间相关性动态分配压缩率，而非统一或时间依赖的压缩。方法包括轨迹打包（trajectory packing）和几何选择（geometric selection），在具体视点下对空间重要帧保留更多细节。在 Minecraft 的 LoopNav 基准和真实世界导航数据集 RECON 上，WorldPack 在空间推理任务上优于 Oasis、Mineworld 等基线。
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型在处理长序列时，要么使用不利用 3D 视点几何的通用重要性调度压缩历史帧，要么仅检索少量空间相关帧而不增加保留历史总量，导致时间与空间一致性不足。
Method: 提出两个紧密耦合的机制：轨迹打包通过分层帧压缩将更多历史帧放入固定长度的上下文；几何选择利用相机位姿和视场重叠，对空间重要的帧分配低压缩，对次要帧分配高压缩。
Result: 有效上下文从 4 帧扩展到 22 帧，仅增加 16% 的扩散模型推理时间；在 LoopNav 和 RECON 数据集上，空间推理任务性能显著优于多个强基线。
Conclusion: 基于 3D 空间相关性的动态帧压缩方案在长上下文视频世界建模中有效，但几何选择带来的额外成本依赖于候选帧数量。

papers.title: Glass Surface Detection: Leveraging Reflection Dynamics in Flash/No-flash Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Glass surfaces are ubiquitous in daily life, typically appearing colorless, transparent, and lacking distinctive features. These characteristics make glass surface detection a challenging computer vision task. Existing glass surface detection methods always rely on boundary cues (\textit{e.g.}, window and door frames) or reflection cues to locate glass surfaces, but they fail to fully exploit the intrinsic properties of the glass itself for accurate localization. We observed that in most real-world scenes, the illumination intensity in front of the glass surface differs from that behind it, which results in variations in the reflections visible on the glass surface. Specifically, when standing on the brighter side of the glass and applying a flash towards the darker side, existing reflections on the glass surface tend to disappear. Conversely, while standing on the darker side and applying a flash towards the brighter side, distinct reflections will appear on the glass surface. Based on this phenomenon, we propose \textit{NFGlassNet}, a novel method for glass surface detection that leverages the reflection dynamics present in flash/no-flash imagery. Specifically, we propose a Reflection Contrast Mining Module (RCMM) for extracting reflections, and a Reflection Guided Attention Module (RGAM) for fusing features from reflection and glass surface for accurate glass surface detection. For learning our network, we also construct a dataset consisting of $\sim$3.3$K$ no-flash and flash image pairs captured from various scenes with corresponding ground truth annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods. Our code, model, and dataset will be available upon acceptance of the manuscript.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NFGlassNet方法，利用闪光/非闪光图像中的反射动态进行玻璃表面检测。该方法包括反射对比挖掘模块（RCMM）和反射引导注意力模块（RGAM），并构建了约3.3K对闪光/非闪光图像的数据集。实验结果表明该方法优于现有技术。
Motivation: 现有玻璃表面检测方法依赖边界或反射线索，未能充分利用玻璃本身的固有属性（如前后照明差异导致的反射变化）进行精确定位。
Method: 基于玻璃表面在闪光/非闪光图像中反射动态变化的观察，提出NFGlassNet。包含提取反射的反射对比挖掘模块（RCMM）和融合反射与玻璃表面特征的反射引导注意力模块（RGAM）。
Result: 摘要声称在自建数据集上的实验优于现有最先进方法，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 闪光/非闪光反射动态是玻璃表面检测的有效线索，所提方法有望推广至其他透明物体检测任务。

papers.title: Geometry-Guided Generative Representation for Functional Brain Graphs
papers.abstract_en: In network neuroscience, functional brain systems are often characterized using separate yet related graph-theoretic or spectral descriptors, overlooking how these properties covary and partially overlap across individuals and conditions. We anticipate that dense, weighted functional connectivity graphs lie on a low-dimensional latent geometry along which both topological and spectral structures vary smoothly at the population level. Although graph-based deep learning offers a powerful framework for modeling these brain connectomes, supervised approaches are constrained by the limited availability of labeled data. Existing unsupervised graph representation methods also typically focus on node-level embeddings, which are limited in capturing compact graph-level representations that preserve information from dense functional connectomes. To address these gaps, we learn compact brain graph representations using a graph transformer autoencoder, where domain-specific, aligned functional gradient geometry provides an inductive bias to guide learning. Despite being trained in a fully unsupervised manner, our approach meaningfully separates cognitive states and enables decoding of visual stimuli, with performance further improved by incorporating neural dynamics. In parallel, to enable generation of synthetic brain graphs, we fit a diffusion model to the learned latent representation and decode samples back to dense connectomes.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种几何引导的生成式表示方法，用于学习功能脑图的紧凑图级表示。通过图变换器自编码器（graph transformer autoencoder）结合对齐的功能梯度几何作为归纳偏置，在无监督条件下分离认知状态并解码视觉刺激，同时利用扩散模型生成合成脑图。
Motivation: 现有方法忽略功能脑图中拓扑与谱属性的协变，且监督学习受限于标签稀缺，无监督图表示方法多聚焦于节点级嵌入，难以捕捉密集功能连接组的图级表示。
Method: 采用图变换器自编码器，以领域对齐的功能梯度几何（functional gradient geometry）作为归纳偏置，学习紧凑的图级表示；在潜在空间上拟合扩散模型以生成合成脑图。
Result: 在无监督训练下，该方法能有效分离认知状态并解码视觉刺激，融入神经动力学后性能进一步提升；扩散模型可解码生成密集连接组。
Conclusion: 本文展示了几何引导的无监督图表示方法在功能脑图分析中的潜力，支持认知状态解码和合成脑图生成。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PGTT: Phase-Guided Terrain Traversal for Perceptive Legged Locomotion
papers.abstract_en: State-of-the-art perceptive Reinforcement Learning controllers for legged robots typically either (i) impose oscillator-or IK-based gait priors that constrain the action space, bias policy optimization, and limit adaptability across robot morphologies, or (ii) operate "blind," making them unable to anticipate hind-leg terrain and brittle to observation noise. We propose Phase-Guided Terrain Traversal (PGTT), a perception-aware deep-RL approach that enforces gait structure through reward shaping, thereby reducing inductive bias compared to oscillator- or IK-conditioned action priors. PGTT encodes per-leg phase as a cubic Hermite spline, adapts swing height to local heightmap statistics, and adds a swing-phase contact penalty, while the policy acts directly in joint space for morphology-agnostic deployment. Trained in MuJoCo (MJX) on procedurally generated stair-like terrains with curriculum learning and domain randomization, PGTT achieves the highest success rate among the evaluated baselines under push disturbances (median +7.5% over the next-best baseline) and on discrete obstacles (+9%), while maintaining comparable velocity tracking. We validate PGTT on a Unitree Go2 using a real-time LiDAR elevation-to-heightmap pipeline and report preliminary results on ANYmal-C using the same hyperparameters. These results provide early evidence that terrain-adaptive, phase-guided reward shaping can transfer across platforms without platform-specific policy priors or extensive re-tuning.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 9 figures, 3 tables, Accepted at IROS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PGTT，一种基于相位引导的感知深度强化学习方法，用于腿式机器人的地形穿越。PGTT通过奖励塑形强制步态结构，减少对振荡器或逆运动学先验的依赖，将腿相位编码为Hermite样条，并根据高度图自适应摆腿高度。在MuJoCo仿真中，PGTT在推力扰动下成功率中位数比次优基线高7.5%，在离散障碍物上高9%，并在Unitree Go2和ANYmal-C机器人上进行了初步验证。
Motivation: 现有的感知腿式机器人控制器要么使用基于振荡器或逆运动学的步态先验，约束动作空间并限制跨形态适应性；要么是盲目的，无法预测后腿地形，对观测噪声脆弱。
Method: PGTT通过奖励塑形强制步态结构，编码每条腿的相位为三次Hermite样条，根据局部高度图统计自适应调整摆腿高度，并添加摆腿接触惩罚。策略直接作用于关节空间，实现形态无关的部署，并在MuJoCo中通过课程学习和域随机化训练。
Result: PGTT在程序生成的楼梯地形上，推力扰动下成功率中位数比次优基线高7.5%，离散障碍物场景高9%，同时保持可比的速度跟踪性能。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，地形自适应的相位引导奖励塑形方法可以跨平台迁移（Unitree Go2和ANYmal-C），无需特定平台策略先验或大量重新调整，但结果仍属初步阶段。

papers.title: Schrödinger Bridge Mamba for One-Step Speech Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: We present Schrödinger Bridge Mamba (SBM), a novel model for efficient speech enhancement by integrating the Schrödinger Bridge (SB) training paradigm and the Mamba architecture. Experiments of joint denoising and dereverberation tasks demonstrate SBM outperforms strong generative and discriminative methods on multiple metrics with only one step of inference while achieving a competitive real-time factor for streaming feasibility. Ablation studies reveal that the SB paradigm consistently yields improved performance across diverse architectures over conventional mapping. Furthermore, Mamba exhibits a stronger performance under the SB paradigm compared to Multi-Head Self-Attention (MHSA) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) backbones. These findings highlight the synergy between the Mamba architecture and the SB trajectory-based training, providing a high-quality solution for real-world speech enhancement. Demo page: https://sbmse.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Schrödinger Bridge Mamba (SBM)，融合 Schrödinger Bridge (SB) 训练范式与 Mamba 架构，用于单步推理的语音增强（联合去噪与去混响）。实验表明，在多个指标上 SBM 优于强生成与判别方法，且具有竞争力的实时因子。消融研究显示，SB 范式在不同架构上均优于传统映射，且 Mamba 在 SB 下表现优于多头自注意力 (MHSA) 和长短期记忆 (LSTM) 骨干。
Motivation: 现有语音增强方法通常需要多步推理或难以在效率与质量之间取得平衡，本文旨在通过单步推理实现高效且高质量的语音增强。
Method: 提出 SBM 模型，将 Schrödinger Bridge (SB) 轨迹训练范式与状态空间模型 Mamba 架构相结合，实现单步推理的语音增强。
Result: 在联合去噪和去混响任务上，SBM 以单步推理超越强生成与判别方法，并达到竞争性实时因子。消融实验表明 SB 范式提升多种架构性能，且 Mamba 在 SB 下优于 MHSA 和 LSTM。
Conclusion: Mamba 架构与 Schrödinger Bridge 训练范式具有协同效应，为实际语音增强提供了高质量的单步推理方案。

papers.title: One4Many-StablePacker: An Efficient Deep Reinforcement Learning Framework for the 3D Bin Packing Problem
papers.abstract_en: The three-dimensional bin packing problem (3D-BPP) is widely applied in logistics and warehousing. Existing learning-based approaches often neglect practical stability-related constraints and exhibit limitations in generalizing across diverse bin dimensions. To address these limitations, we propose a novel deep reinforcement learning framework, One4Many-StablePacker (O4M-SP). The primary advantage of O4M-SP is its ability to handle various bin dimensions in a single training process while incorporating support and weight constraints common in practice. Our training method introduces two innovative mechanisms. First, it employs a weighted reward function that integrates loading rate and a new height difference metric for packing layouts, promoting improved bin utilization through flatter packing configurations. Second, it combines clipped policy gradient optimization with a tailored policy drifting method to mitigate policy entropy collapse, encouraging exploration at critical decision nodes during packing to avoid suboptimal solutions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that O4M-SP generalizes successfully across diverse bin dimensions and significantly outperforms baseline methods. Furthermore, O4M-SP exhibits strong practical applicability by effectively addressing packing scenarios with stability constraints.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为One4Many-StablePacker (O4M-SP)的深度强化学习框架，用于解决三维装箱问题（3D-BPP）。该框架能够在单一训练过程中处理不同尺寸的箱子，并融入实际中常见的支撑和重量约束。通过加权奖励函数（结合装载率和新高度差指标）以及结合裁剪策略梯度优化与策略漂移方法来避免策略熵崩溃，该框架在多种箱子尺寸上泛化良好，显著优于基线方法，并展示了处理稳定性约束场景的实用能力。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的3D-BPP方法常忽略实际稳定性约束，且在泛化到不同箱子尺寸方面存在局限。
Method: 提出O4M-SP框架，采用加权奖励函数（整合装载率与高度差指标）以及结合裁剪策略梯度优化与策略漂移方法，以促进探索并避免次优解。
Result: 实验表明O4M-SP能成功泛化至不同箱子尺寸，并显著优于基线方法，同时能有效处理稳定性约束的实际情景。
Conclusion: O4M-SP通过单一训练过程适应多种箱子尺寸并纳入实际约束，为3D-BPP提供了高效且实用的深度学习解决方案。
Relevance: 0
