papers.title: In-the-Flow Agentic System Optimization for Effective Planning and Tool Use
papers.abstract_en: Outcome-driven reinforcement learning has advanced reasoning in large language models (LLMs), but prevailing tool-augmented approaches train a single, monolithic policy that interleaves thoughts and tool calls under full context; this scales poorly with long horizons and diverse tools and generalizes weakly to new scenarios. Agentic systems offer a promising alternative by decomposing work across specialized modules, yet most remain training-free or rely on offline training decoupled from the live dynamics of multi-turn interaction. We introduce AgentFlow, a trainable, in-the-flow agentic framework that coordinates four modules (planner, executor, verifier, generator) through an evolving memory and directly optimizes its planner inside the multi-turn loop. To train on-policy in live environments, we propose Flow-based Group Refined Policy Optimization (Flow-GRPO), which tackles long-horizon, sparse-reward credit assignment by converting multi-turn optimization into a sequence of tractable single-turn policy updates. It broadcasts a single, verifiable trajectory-level outcome to every turn to align local planner decisions with global success and stabilizes learning with group-normalized advantages. Across ten benchmarks, AgentFlow with a 7B-scale backbone outperforms top-performing baselines with average accuracy gains of 14.9% on search, 14.0% on agentic, 14.5% on mathematical, and 4.1% on scientific tasks, even surpassing larger proprietary models like GPT-4o. Further analyses confirm the benefits of in-the-flow optimization, showing improved planning, enhanced tool-calling reliability, and positive scaling with model size and reasoning turns.
papers.comment: 47 pages, 12 figures. ICLR 2026 Oral. Project website: https://agentflow.stanford.edu/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AgentFlow，一个可训练的在线式agentic框架，协调四个模块（规划器、执行器、验证器、生成器），并通过Flow-GRPO算法在多轮交互循环中直接优化规划器。在10个基准上，7B规模主干的AgentFlow平均提升14.9%（搜索）、14.0%（agentic）、14.5%（数学）和4.1%（科学），甚至超过GPT-4o等更大模型。
Motivation: 现有工具增强型强化学习方法训练单一策略，在长程和多样化工具下扩展性差且泛化弱；agentic系统虽然模块化，但大多无训练或离线训练，缺乏在线交互动态优化。
Method: 提出AgentFlow框架，包含四个专用模块和演化记忆，并通过Flow-GRPO算法进行在线策略优化，将多轮优化转化为连续的单轮策略更新，并广播轨迹级结果来对齐局部决策。
Result: 在10个基准上，7B主干的AgentFlow在搜索、agentic、数学和科学任务上分别平均提升14.9%、14.0%、14.5%和4.1%，超越GPT-4o等更大模型。
Conclusion: 分析证实在线优化的好处，包括改进规划、增强工具调用可靠性，以及随模型大小和推理步数的正向扩展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Toward a Vision-Language Foundation Model for Medical Data: Multimodal Dataset and Benchmarks for Vietnamese PET/CT Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Foundation Models (VLMs), trained on large-scale multimodal datasets, have driven significant advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI) by enabling rich cross-modal reasoning. Despite their success in general domains, applying these models to medical imaging remains challenging due to the limited availability of diverse imaging modalities and multilingual clinical data. Most existing medical VLMs are trained on a subset of imaging modalities and focus primarily on high-resource languages, thus limiting their generalizability and clinical utility. To address these limitations, we introduce a novel Vietnamese-language multimodal medical dataset consisting of 2,757 whole-body PET/CT volumes from independent patients and their corresponding full-length clinical reports. This dataset is designed to fill two pressing gaps in medical AI development: (1) the lack of PET/CT imaging data in existing VLMs training corpora, which hinders the development of models capable of handling functional imaging tasks; and (2) the underrepresentation of low-resource languages, particularly the Vietnamese language, in medical vision-language research. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first dataset to provide comprehensive PET/CT-report pairs in Vietnamese. We further introduce a training framework to enhance VLMs' learning, including data augmentation and expert-validated test sets. We conduct comprehensive experiments benchmarking state-of-the-art VLMs on downstream tasks. The experimental results show that incorporating our dataset significantly improves the performance of existing VLMs. We believe this dataset and benchmark will serve as a pivotal step in advancing the development of more robust VLMs for medical imaging, especially for low-resource languages and clinical use in Vietnamese healthcare. The source code is available at https://github.com/AIoT-Lab-BKAI/ViPET-ReportGen.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了首个越南语全身PET/CT影像-报告多模态数据集（2,757例独立患者），并提出训练框架用于增强视觉-语言基础模型（VLM）对医学影像的理解。实验表明加入该数据集可提升现有VLM在下游任务上的性能，填补了功能性影像数据和低资源语言在医学VLM研究中的空白。
Motivation: 现有医学VLM主要依赖少数成像模态且聚焦于高资源语言，缺乏PET/CT数据以及低资源语言（如越南语）的临床视觉-语言数据，限制了模型的泛化性和临床实用性。
Method: 构建包含2,757例独立患者全身PET/CT体积及其完整临床报告的越南语多模态数据集，并设计包括数据增强和专家验证测试集的训练框架来增强VLM学习。
Result: 在多个下游任务上对现有VLM进行基准测试，结果表明引入该数据集显著提升了模型的性能。
Conclusion: 该数据集和基准将推动更鲁棒的医学影像VLM发展，尤其针对低资源语言和越南医疗的临床应用。代码已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: On the Separability of Information in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models transform noise into data by injecting information that was captured in their neural network during the training phase. In this paper, we ask: \textit{what} is this information? We find that, in pixel-space diffusion models, (1) a large fraction of the total information in the neural network is committed to reconstructing small-scale perceptual details of the image, and (2) the correlations between images and their class labels are informed by the semantic content of the images, and are largely agnostic to the low-level details. We argue that these properties are intrinsically tied to the manifold structure of the data itself. Finally, we show that these facts explain the efficacy of classifier-free guidance: the guidance vector amplifies the mutual information between images and conditioning signals early in the generative process, influencing semantic structure, but tapers out as perceptual details are filled in.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究像素空间扩散模型中神经网络所捕获信息的性质。发现大部分信息用于重建图像的低级感知细节，而图像与类别标签之间的相关性由语义内容决定，与低级细节基本无关。这些性质源于数据本身的流形结构，并解释了无分类器引导的有效性：引导向量在生成早期放大图像与条件信号之间的互信息，影响语义结构，而后随着感知细节填充而逐渐减弱。
Motivation: 扩散模型在训练阶段将信息注入神经网络，但关于这些信息究竟是什么的理解尚不充分。
Method: 通过理论分析与实验，研究像素空间扩散模型中神经网络信息的可分性，涉及信息在感知细节与语义内容之间的分配，以及无分类器引导的作用机制。
Result: 发现大部分信息用于重建图像的感知细节；图像与类别标签的相关性由语义内容驱动，对低级细节不敏感；这些性质源于数据流形结构。
Conclusion: 这些发现解释了无分类器引导的有效性：引导在生成早期放大语义信息，后期对感知细节影响较小。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SciTrek: Evaluating and Improving Long-Context Numerical Reasoning over Scientific Articles
papers.abstract_en: We introduce SciTrek, a synthetic question-answering dataset for assessing and improving long-context numerical reasoning in large language models (LLMs). Existing long-context datasets with inputs beyond 64K tokens either target simple information retrieval or, when they do involve reasoning, rely on artificial contexts, while numerical reasoning remains largely overlooked in both cases. SciTrek addresses these limitations with questions that require numerical operations (e.g., counting, sorting, aggregation, and comparison) over collections of full-text scientific articles. Questions are generated automatically by formulating them as SQL queries over a database of article metadata (titles, authors, and references), and ground-truth answers are obtained by executing these queries. The underlying SQL provides a transparent, verifiable specification of the reasoning each question requires, enabling fine-grained error analysis, while the fully automated pipeline scales to arbitrary context lengths and dataset sizes with minimal human supervision, mitigating data contamination and supplying abundant data for post-training. Extensive experiments show that frontier open-weight and proprietary LLMs struggle even with ostensibly simple questions: the best-performing model achieves only 46.5% exact match at 128K tokens, and performance degrades steadily as contexts grow. Fine-grained analysis reveals systematic weaknesses on citation-related questions and on compound logical conditions, particularly those involving negation. Finally, post-training open-weight models on SciTrek improves their numerical reasoning in ways that generalise to out-of-domain long-context tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SciTrek，一个用于评估和改进大语言模型长上下文数值推理能力的合成问答数据集。SciTrek 的问题基于科学文章元数据，通过 SQL 查询自动生成，支持任意上下文长度。实验显示，即使是最佳模型在128K token 上仅达到46.5%精确匹配，且性能随上下文增长下降。后训练可提升模型在域外任务上的数值推理能力。
Motivation: 现有长上下文数据集要么只关注简单信息检索，要么依赖人工构建的推理上下文，而数值推理任务被忽视。SciTrek 旨在填补这一空白，提供可扩展、透明且可验证的数值推理评估基准。
Method: SciTrek 自动将数值推理问题表示为 SQL 查询，在科学文章元数据（标题、作者、参考文献）上执行获得答案；问题涉及计数、排序、聚合和比较等操作。全自动管线可扩展至任意上下文长度和数据集规模，减少数据污染。
Result: 最佳模型（前沿开源和专有 LLM）在128K token 下精确匹配仅46.5%；性能随上下文长度增加而下降；细粒度分析显示模型在引用相关问题和复合逻辑条件（尤其含否定）上存在系统性弱点。
Conclusion: 在 SciTrek 上对开源模型进行后训练可提升其数值推理能力，并泛化至域外长上下文任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interpretable Nanoporous Materials Design with Symmetry-Aware Networks
papers.abstract_en: Reticular frameworks hold promise for diverse sustainable applications, yet their immense chemical space limits efficient and systematic design. While machine learning provides a compelling pathway to accelerate exploration, existing approaches often lack either interpretability or fidelity in linking crystal geometry to emergent properties. Here, we introduce a site-resolved equivariant learning framework based on three-dimensional periodic space sampling, which decomposes reticular structures into local geometric environments for simultaneous property prediction and site-wise contribution analysis. Trained on a combination of constructed and retrieved datasets, the model achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and data efficiency across gas storage, gas separation, and electronic-property prediction tasks. Importantly, the framework reveals interpretable local structure-property relationships by identifying transferable high-contribution sites across diverse frameworks. Leveraging these learned motifs, we further demonstrate inverse design of new metal-organic frameworks exhibiting record-high N2 storage, strong CO2/N2 separation performance, and near-zero electronic band gaps, validated by physics-based simulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于三维周期空间采样的位点解析等变学习框架，将网状结构分解为局部几何环境，同时进行性能预测和位点贡献分析。在气体存储、分离和电子性质预测任务上达到最优精度，并揭示了可迁移的高贡献位点，进而实现具有创纪录N2存储、强CO2/N2分离性能和近零电子带隙的新型金属有机框架的逆向设计。
Motivation: 网状框架的化学空间巨大，现有机器学习方法在连接晶体几何与涌现性质方面缺乏可解释性或保真度。
Method: 引入基于三维周期空间采样的位点解析等变学习框架，将网状结构分解为局部几何环境，用于同步性质预测和位点重要性分析。
Result: 在气体存储、分离和电子性质预测任务上达到最先进精度和数据效率；逆向设计出具有创纪录N2存储、强CO2/N2分离性能和近零带隙的MOF。
Conclusion: 该框架可解释地揭示了局部结构-性质关系，并展示了通过学习到的模体进行逆向设计的能力，但需要进一步验证实际合成可行性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 引入基于三维周期空间采样的位点解析等变学习框架，将网状结构分解为局部几何环境，用于同步性质预测和位点重要性分析。
summary_sections.result: 在气体存储、分离和电子性质预测任务上达到最先进精度和数据效率；逆向设计出具有创纪录N2存储、强CO2/N2分离性能和近零带隙的MOF。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架可解释地揭示了局部结构-性质关系，并展示了通过学习到的模体进行逆向设计的能力，但需要进一步验证实际合成可行性。

papers.title: LC-SLab -- An object-based deep learning framework for large-scale land cover classification from satellite imagery and sparse in-situ labels
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale land cover maps generated using deep learning play a critical role across a wide range of Earth science applications. Open in-situ datasets from principled land cover surveys offer a scalable alternative to manual annotation for training such models. However, their sparse spatial coverage often leads to fragmented and noisy predictions when used with existing deep learning-based land cover mapping approaches. A promising direction to address this issue is object-based classification, which assigns labels to semantically coherent image regions rather than individual pixels, thereby imposing a minimum mapping unit. Despite this potential, object-based methods remain underexplored in deep learning-based land cover mapping pipelines, especially in the context of medium-resolution imagery and sparse supervision. To address this gap, we propose LC-SLab, the first deep learning framework for systematically exploring object-based deep learning methods for large-scale land cover classification under sparse supervision. LC-SLab supports both input-level aggregation via graph neural networks, and output-level aggregation by postprocessing results from established semantic segmentation models. Additionally, we incorporate features from a large pre-trained network to improve performance on small datasets. We evaluate the framework on annual Sentinel-2 composites with sparse LUCAS labels, focusing on the tradeoff between accuracy and fragmentation, as well as sensitivity to dataset size. Our results show that object-based methods can match or exceed the accuracy of common pixel-wise models while producing substantially more coherent maps. Input-level aggregation proves more robust on smaller datasets, whereas output-level aggregation performs best with more data. Several configurations of LC-SLab also outperform existing land cover products, highlighting the framework's practical utility.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LC-SLab，首个系统探索基于对象(object-based)深度学习方法用于稀疏监督下大规模土地覆盖分类的框架。框架支持通过图神经网络进行输入级聚合，以及通过后处理语义分割模型进行输出级聚合，并整合大型预训练网络特征提升小数据集性能。在年度Sentinel-2合成图像与稀疏LUCAS标签上评估，表明基于对象方法在保持或提升精度的同时生成更连贯的地图。
Motivation: 现有深度学习土地覆盖制图方法在稀疏标签下产生碎片化、噪声预测，而基于对象的分类（通过语义区域分配标签）能施加最小制图单元，但在深度学习管线中探索不足。
Method: 提出LC-SLab框架，包含两种基于对象策略：输入级聚合（利用图神经网络）和输出级聚合（后处理语义分割结果），并结合大规模预训练网络特征。
Result: 在Sentinel-2年度合成图像和稀疏LUCAS标签上，基于对象方法在精度上与像素级模型相当或更优，且生成更连贯的地图；输入级聚合在小数据集更鲁棒，输出级聚合在数据量大时更优；多个配置超越现有土地覆盖产品。
Conclusion: 基于对象深度学习在稀疏监督大规模土地覆盖分类中具有实用价值，框架LC-SLab提供了有效工具。

papers.title: Self-Explaining Reinforcement Learning for Mobile Network Resource Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) methods, though powerful, often lack transparency, which limits their adoption in critical domains. We apply Self-Explaining Neural Networks (SENNs) to RL by parametrizing the policy of a PPO agent with a SENN, producing intrinsic local explanations, and propose a method for aggregating them into global explanations. We evaluate our approach on a mobile network resource allocation problem, our approach performs within a small margin of the state-of-the-art deep learning method and significantly outperforms the best deployed heuristic, while the extracted global explanations correlate strongly with DeepLift and InputXGradient, making SENNs a promising candidate for high-stakes RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将自解释神经网络（SENN）用于强化学习，通过参数化PPO智能体的策略网络，产生局部的内在解释，并聚合为全局解释。在移动网络资源分配任务中，该方法性能接近最先进的深度学习方法，显著优于最佳部署启发式算法，且全局解释与DeepLift、InputXGradient高度相关。
Motivation: 深度强化学习方法尽管强大，但缺乏透明性，限制了其在关键领域的应用。
Method: 使用自解释神经网络（SENN）参数化PPO智能体的策略网络，生成局部解释，并通过聚合方法得到全局解释。
Result: 在移动网络资源分配问题上，该方法与最先进深度学习方法差距很小，并显著优于最佳部署启发式算法；提取的全局解释与DeepLift、InputXGradient高度相关。
Conclusion: SENN在高风险强化学习应用中是一个有希望的候选方法。

papers.title: Comparing Model-agnostic Feature Selection Methods through Relative Efficiency
papers.abstract_en: Feature selection and importance estimation in a model-agnostic setting is an ongoing challenge of significant interest. Wrapper methods are commonly used because they are typically model-agnostic. In this paper, we develop a general comparison framework for model-agnostic feature selection methods based on relative efficiency, using \emph{relative variability} $σ/μ$ to account for different statistics having different means. In particular we focus on state-of-the-art feature selection methods, the Generalized Covariance Measure (GCM) and Leave-One-Covariate-Out (LOCO) estimation. In particular, we present a theoretical comparison under three model settings: linear models, non-linear additive models, and single index models that mimic a single-layer neural network. We complement this with simulations and real data examples for the above models and mis-specified models. Our theoretical results, along with empirical findings, demonstrate that GCM-related methods generally out-perform LOCO under suitable regularity conditions defined by a suitably defined correlation quantity which quantifies the asymptotic relative efficiency of these approaches. Our simulations and real data analysis include widely used machine learning methods such as neural networks and gradient boosting trees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于相对效率的模型无关特征选择方法比较框架，使用相对变异性 σ/μ 来比较不同统计量。在三种模型设定（线性、非线性加性、单指标模型）下，理论上和实证上比较了广义协方差度量（GCM）和留一协变量估计（LOCO），发现GCM方法在适当正则条件下通常优于LOCO。
Motivation: 现有特征选择方法中，包装方法通常模型无关，但在一个统一比较框架下评估其相对效率仍是一个挑战。
Method: 定义相对效率比较框架，以相对变异性 σ/μ 为核心指标；在三种模型（线性、非线性加性、单指标）下理论分析GCM与LOCO的渐近相对效率，并通过模拟和真实数据实验验证。
Result: 理论和实验表明，GCM相关方法在合适的正则条件下（由定义的相关系数量化）通常优于LOCO。
Conclusion: GCM方法在模型无关特征选择中具有更好的相对效率，但结论依赖于一定的正则条件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BKP: An R Package for Beta Kernel Process Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Estimating input-dependent probability surfaces from binary, binomial, categorical, or multinomial response data is a common task in statistics and machine learning. Latent Gaussian process classifiers provide flexible nonparametric models for such problems, but posterior inference with discrete responses typically requires approximation or simulation. We discuss an implementation of probability-scale beta and Dirichlet kernel models in the \pkg{BKP} package for \proglang{R}. The package implements the Beta Kernel Process (BKP), which uses kernel-weighted pseudo-count aggregation and beta-binomial conjugacy to obtain closed-form conjugate posterior summaries and posterior predictive distributions for binomial probabilities. It also implements the Dirichlet Kernel Process (DKP) for multi-class responses, together with TwinBKP and TwinDKP, scalable twinning-based global-local approximations for larger datasets. The resulting workflow supports transparent kernel-weighted evidence borrowing, several kernel families, fixed and data-adaptive priors, effective-sample-size calibration, loss-based hyperparameter tuning, and standard S3 methods for fitting, prediction, simulation, visualization, and extraction of posterior summaries. Reproducible examples demonstrate probability-surface estimation, binary and multi-class classification, computational comparison, and real-data applications to \emph{Loa loa} infection prevalence mapping and Mourning Warbler distribution modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍R包BKP，实现了Beta核过程（BKP）和Dirichlet核过程（DKP），用于基于二进制、二项、分类或多分类响应数据的概率面估计。该包通过核加权伪计数聚合和beta-二项共轭性得到封闭形式的共轭后验摘要和后验预测分布，并提供了TwinBKP和TwinDKP可扩展近似方法。
Motivation: 处理离散响应数据的概率面估计通常需要近似或模拟，而现有的高斯过程分类器在计算上存在挑战。BKP包旨在提供一种基于核方法的、具有封闭形式后验的替代方案。
Method: 引入Beta核过程，利用核加权伪计数聚合和beta-二项共轭性实现后验推断；扩展至Dirichlet核过程用于多类问题；提出TwinBKP和TwinDKP作为大规模数据的可扩展全局-局部近似。
Result: 摘要展示了在概率面估计、二分类和多分类任务上的应用，并与Loa loa感染流行率映射和Mourning Warbler分布建模等实际数据案例进行了比较。
Conclusion: BKP包提供了一种透明的核加权证据借用框架，支持多种核函数、自适应先验、有效样本量校准和损失函数超参数调优，并通过S3方法实现拟合、预测、模拟和可视化。

papers.title: Label-Noise Resistant Learning via Optimal Brain Damage Masking
papers.abstract_en: Noisy labels are inevitable in real-world multimedia applications. Due to the strong memorization capacity of deep neural networks, these noisy labels cause significant performance degradation. Existing noise-robust methods have mainly focused on robust loss functions and sample selection strategies, with comparatively limited exploration of dynamic architectural adaptation. In this paper, we rethink the role of classifier connectivity under label noise. Intuitively, performance degradation stems from the backpropagation of noisy gradients. Since the final classifier layer acts as the primary gateway for this error propagation, selectively discarding redundant connections can restrict the backpropagation pathways of noisy gradients. Consequently, to identify redundant connections, we leverage the seminal Optimal Brain Damage (OBD) theory from model compression, which posits that parameters causing negligible loss perturbation can be removed. Guided by this principle, we show that masking low-activation edges limits the estimated loss perturbation to preserve the model's fitting capacity, while tightening a derived upper bound on noise-induced gradient error. To bridge this theoretical insight with practical training, we propose a novel Selective Edge Masking (SEM) mechanism for the fully connected (FC) layer to enhance noise robustness. It can adaptively retain critical edges for information propagation while suppressing gradient errors caused by noisy labels. As a plug-and-play component, SEM can be seamlessly integrated into various noise-robust methods. Additionally, we validate SEM's applicability by applying it to the newly emerged Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) employed as a classifier. Extensive evaluations on synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度神经网络在标签噪声下的性能退化问题，提出一种基于最优脑损伤（OBD）理论的选择性边缘掩码（SEM）机制。该方法通过丢弃全连接层中冗余的连接，限制噪声梯度的反向传播路径，并理论推导了噪声诱导梯度误差的上界。在合成和真实噪声基准上，SEM作为即插即用组件取得了最先进性能，并验证了其在Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）中的适用性。
Motivation: 现有噪声鲁棒方法主要聚焦于鲁棒损失函数和样本选择策略，对动态架构适应的探索有限。噪声梯度通过分类器层反向传播是性能下降的关键，因此选择性丢弃冗余连接可以阻断噪声传播路径。
Method: 利用OBD理论识别对损失变化影响小的冗余连接，提出选择性边缘掩码（SEM）机制，在训练中自适应地保留关键边并抑制噪声梯度误差，可无缝集成到已有噪声鲁棒方法中。
Result: 在多个合成和真实噪声基准上，SEM提升了分类准确率，达到了最先进的性能，并展示了在KAN分类器中的有效性。
Conclusion: 本文验证了基于OBD的架构动态调整在标签噪声鲁棒性中的有效性，SEM提供了一种轻量级、可插拔的解决方案，适用于多种网络架构。

papers.title: STEMTOX: From Collaborative Tags to Fine-Grained Toxic Meme Detection via Entropy-Guided Multi-Task Learning
papers.abstract_en: Memes, as a widely used mode of online communication, often serve as vehicles for spreading harmful content. However, limitations in data accessibility and the high costs of dataset curation hinder the development of robust meme moderation systems. To address this challenge, in this work, we introduce a first-of-its-kind dataset - TOXICTAGS consisting of 6,300 real-world meme-based posts annotated in two stages: (i) binary classification into toxic and normal, and (ii) fine-grained labelling of toxic memes as hateful, dangerous, or offensive. A key feature of this dataset is that it includes collaborative tags associated with the original posts, enhancing the context of each meme. In addition, we propose a novel entropy-guided multi-tasking framework -- STEMTOX -- that leverages these collaborative tags alongside visual and textual inputs within a robust classification framework. Experimental results show that incorporating these tags substantially enhances the performance of state-of-the-art VLMs in toxicity detection tasks. Our contributions offer a novel and scalable foundation for improved content moderation in multimodal online environments. Warning: Contains potentially toxic contents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对网络模因毒性检测中数据稀缺和标注成本高的问题，构建了首个包含协同标签（collaborative tags）的细粒度有毒模因数据集 TOXICTAGS（6300条帖子，二分类+细粒度标注），并提出熵引导多任务学习框架 STEMTOX，融合协同标签、视觉和文本特征。实验表明协同标签能显著提升主流视觉语言模型（VLM）的毒性检测性能，为多模态内容审核提供了可扩展的基础。
Motivation: 现有模因审核系统受限于数据可访问性差和数据集构建成本高，缺乏鲁棒且细粒度的检测方法。
Method: 提出 TOXICTAGS 数据集（6300条真实模因帖子，含二分类和细粒度标签）以及 STEMTOX 框架，通过熵引导多任务学习将协同标签与视觉、文本特征相结合进行毒性分类。
Result: 实验结果显示，融入协同标签后，SOTA VLM 在毒性检测任务上的性能显著提升。
Conclusion: 该工作为多模态环境下的内容审核提供了一个新颖且可扩展的基础。

papers.title: NeuCoReClass AD: Redefining Self-Supervised Time Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Time series anomaly detection plays a critical role in a wide range of real-world applications. Among unsupervised approaches, self-supervised learning has gained traction for modeling normal behavior without the need of labeled data. However, many existing methods rely on a single proxy task, limiting their ability to capture meaningful patterns in normal data. Moreover, they often depend on handcrafted transformations tailored specific domains, hindering their generalization accross diverse problems. To address these limitations, we introduce NeuCoReClass AD, a self-supervised multi-task time series anomaly detection framework that combines contrastive, reconstruction, and classification proxy tasks. Our method employs neural transformation learning to generate augmented views that are informative, diverse, and coherent, without requiring domain-specific knowledge. We evaluate NeuCoReClass AD across a wide range of benchmarks, demonstrating that it consistently outperforms both classical baselines and most deep-learning alternatives. Furthermore, it enables the characterization of distinct anomaly profiles in a fully unsupervised manner.
papers.journal_ref: Neural Networks, Volume 205, Part A, 2027, 109375,
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NeuCoReClass AD，一种自监督多任务时间序列异常检测框架，结合对比、重构和分类代理任务，并采用神经变换学习生成增强视图，无需领域特定知识。在多个基准上，该方法一致优于经典基线和大多数深度学习替代方法，并能以完全无监督方式刻画不同异常特征。
Motivation: 现有自监督时间序列异常检测方法多依赖单一代理任务，且需手工设计领域特定变换，限制了通用性和模式捕获能力。
Method: 提出三任务联合框架：对比学习、重构和分类代理任务，并采用神经变换学习自动生成信息丰富且一致的增强视图。
Result: 摘要声称在多个基准上一致超越经典基线和大多数深度学习方法，并实现无监督异常特征刻画。
Conclusion: 多任务自监督学习与神经变换结合能有效提升时间序列异常检测的通用性和性能。

papers.title: Toward Adaptable Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning: An Assumption-Aware Review
papers.abstract_en: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) has achieved strong performance in simulated benchmarks, yet real deployments often violate the assumptions under which algorithms are designed and evaluated. Agent populations may change, objectives may shift, centralized information may be unavailable, execution may become asynchronous, and partner policies may be unfamiliar. Existing surveys discuss related desiderata such as scalability, robustness, generalization, and transferability, but these terms often refer to different objects of analysis and different kinds of distributional or structural shift. This survey proposes \textit{adaptability} as an assumption-aware taxonomy for organizing these shifts, rather than as a universal requirement that every MARL algorithm should succeed in every setting. We distinguish three dimensions: \textit{learning adaptability}, which concerns the applicability of learning paradigms under changed training or system assumptions; \textit{policy adaptability}, which concerns the reuse or adaptation of learned policies under deployment-time changes; and \textit{scenario-driven adaptability}, which concerns whether benchmarks and evaluation protocols expose controlled, diagnostically useful shifts. By separating what changes, when the change occurs, what adaptation is allowed, and what success means, the framework clarifies how established concepts fit together and identifies where current MARL evaluation remains underspecified.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于假设的分类法来梳理多智能体强化学习（MARL）中的可适应性（adaptability），将其分为学习可适应性、策略可适应性和场景驱动可适应性三个维度，旨在澄清现有概念之间的关系并指出当前评估的不足。
Motivation: 现有MARL在模拟环境中表现良好，但实际部署常违反算法设计时的假设（如智能体数量变化、目标转移、信息不可用等）。现有综述虽讨论了可扩展性、鲁棒性等需求，但术语指向不同且混淆。
Method: 提出可适应性作为组织这些变化的分类法，区分三个维度：学习可适应性（学习范式在训练假设变化下的适用性）、策略可适应性（策略在部署时变化下的重用或适应）和场景驱动可适应性（基准和评估协议是否暴露可控的诊断性变化）。
Result: 该框架通过分离变化对象、变化时机、允许的适应方式以及成功的定义，澄清了已知概念之间的关系，并识别了当前MARL评估中未充分规范的部分。
Conclusion: 分类法本身并非要求所有MARL算法在所有场景下成功，而是提供一个组织视角，有助于未来研究设计更适配的算法和评估协议。

papers.title: A Novel Hybrid Deep Learning Technique for Speech Emotion Detection using Feature Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Nowadays, speech emotion recognition (SER) plays a vital role in the field of human-computer interaction (HCI) and the evolution of artificial intelligence (AI). Our proposed DCRF-BiLSTM model is used to recognize seven emotions: neutral, happy, sad, angry, fear, disgust, and surprise, which are trained on five datasets: RAVDESS (R), TESS (T), SAVEE (S), EmoDB (E), and Crema-D (C). The model achieves high accuracy on individual datasets, including 97.83% on RAVDESS, 97.02% on SAVEE, 95.10% for CREMA-D, and a perfect 100% on both TESS and EMO-DB. For the combined (R+T+S) datasets, it achieves 98.82% accuracy, outperforming previously reported results. To our knowledge, no existing study has evaluated a single SER model across all five benchmark datasets (i.e., R+T+S+C+E) simultaneously. In our work, we introduce this comprehensive combination and achieve a remarkable overall accuracy of 93.76%. These results confirm the robustness and generalizability of our DCRF-BiLSTM framework across diverse datasets.
papers.journal_ref: HHAI-WS 2025 Workshops at the Fourth International Conference on Hybrid Human-Artificial Intelligence (HHAI), June, 2025, Pisa, Italy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为DCRF-BiLSTM的混合深度学习模型用于语音情感识别（SER），识别七种基本情感。该模型在RAVDESS、TESS、SAVEE、EmoDB和Crema-D五个基准数据集上单独训练，分别达到97.83%、100%、97.02%、100%和95.10%的准确率；在RAVDESS+TESS+SAVEE组合数据集上达到98.82%；首次在全部五个数据集联合训练中取得93.76%的准确率，验证了模型的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有语音情感识别研究通常仅在单一或少量数据集上评估模型，缺乏跨多个基准数据集的统一验证，难以体现模型的泛化性能。
Method: 提出DCRF-BiLSTM混合深度学习架构，结合特征工程（如梅尔频率倒谱系数等）和双向长短期记忆网络（BiLSTM）与条件随机场（CRF）层，以捕捉语音信号中的时序依赖和情感上下文。
Result: 模型在五个独立数据集上均取得高准确率，其中TESS和EmoDB达到100%；在RAVDESS+TESS+SAVEE联合数据集上准确率为98.82%；在全部五个数据集联合训练上达到93.76%，据称是首个在如此多数据集上统一评估的SER模型。
Conclusion: DCRF-BiLSTM框架在不同数据集上表现出一致的鲁棒性和泛化能力，表明该方法适用于多场景语音情感识别任务。

papers.title: OrbitAll: A Unified Quantum Mechanical Representation Deep Learning Framework for All Molecular Systems
papers.abstract_en: We introduce OrbitAll, a geometry- and physics-informed deep learning framework that encodes any molecular system with arbitrary charges, spins, and environmental effects using electronic structure information. It utilizes spin-polarized orbital features from the underlying quantum mechanical method and combines them with SE(3)-equivariant graph neural networks. OrbitAll demonstrates superior performance and generalization in predicting charged, open-shell, and solvated molecules, and robustly extrapolates to molecules significantly larger than the training data. OrbitAll achieves chemical accuracy using 10 times fewer training data than competing AI models, with approximately $10^3$ - $10^4$ speedup compared to density functional theory. Trained on a chemically diverse dataset, OrbitAll performs robustly on challenging molecular systems, and outperforms the foundational machine-learned interatomic potential, UMA, for highly charged species, despite using 35 times less molecular data and a 50-times-smaller model. After learning solvent effects, it accurately predicts solvent-dependent reaction pathways at about 100 times lower cost than explicit-solvation simulations using UMA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OrbitAll，一个基于几何与物理信息的深度学习框架，利用电子结构信息编码任意电荷、自旋和环境效应的分子系统。它结合自旋极化轨道特征与 SE(3)-等变图神经网络，在带电、开壳和溶剂化分子预测中展现优越性能，并以十分之一于竞争 AI 模型的数据量达到化学精度，相比密度泛函理论加速约 10^3-10^4 倍。
Motivation: 现有机器学习力场对带电、开壳或溶剂化等复杂分子系统预测能力有限，且依赖大量训练数据，亟需一种能统一处理各类分子系统且数据高效的框架。
Method: 从量子力学方法提取自旋极化轨道特征，结合 SE(3)-等变图神经网络，构建端到端深度学习框架 OrbitAll。
Result: 在带电、开壳和溶剂化分子预测上超越基础机器学习势 UMA，即使模型小 50 倍、数据少 35 倍；训练数据量仅为竞争 AI 模型的 1/10 即达化学精度，并实现约 10^3-10^4 倍于 DFT 的加速。
Conclusion: OrbitAll 在挑战性分子系统上鲁棒，且学习溶剂效应后能以约 1/100 于显式溶剂化模拟的成本准确预测溶剂依赖的反应路径。

papers.title: CreatiPoster: Towards Editable and Controllable Multi-Layer Graphic Design Generation
papers.abstract_en: Graphic design plays a crucial role in both commercial and personal contexts, yet creating high-quality, editable, and aesthetically pleasing graphic compositions remains a time-consuming and skill-intensive task, especially for beginners. Current AI tools automate parts of the workflow, but struggle to accurately incorporate user-supplied assets, maintain editability, and achieve professional visual appeal. Commercial systems, like Canva Magic Design, rely on vast template libraries, which are impractical for replicate. In this paper, we introduce CreatiPoster, a framework that generates editable, multi-layer compositions from optional natural-language instructions or assets. A protocol model, an RGBA large multimodal model, first produces a JSON specification detailing every layer (text or asset) with precise layout, hierarchy, content and style, plus a concise background prompt. A conditional background model then synthesizes a coherent background conditioned on this rendered foreground layers. We construct a benchmark with automated metrics for graphic-design generation and show that CreatiPoster surpasses leading open-source approaches and proprietary commercial systems. To catalyze further research, we release a copyright-free corpus of 100,000 multi-layer designs. CreatiPoster supports diverse applications such as canvas editing, text overlay, responsive resizing, multilingual adaptation, and animated posters, advancing the democratization of AI-assisted graphic design. Project homepage: https://github.com/graphic-design-ai/creatiposter
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CreatiPoster 是一个可编辑的多层图形设计生成框架，通过 RGBA 大语言模型（RGBA large multimodal model）生成每个层（文本或资产）的 JSON 规范，再使用条件背景模型合成与前景一致的背景。在自动指标上超越开源和商业系统，并发布了一个含 10 万版权免费多层设计的数据集。
Motivation: 现有 AI 工具难以准确整合用户提供的资产、保持编辑性和专业视觉吸引力，商业系统依赖大量模板库，缺乏灵活性和可复制性。
Method: 提出两阶段流水线：协议模型（protocol model）输出包含每层布局、层级、内容和样式的 JSON 规范及背景提示；条件背景模型基于渲染的前景层生成连贯背景。
Result: 在新建的图形设计生成基准上，CreatiPoster 的自动指标超过领先的开源方法和 Canva Magic Design 等商业系统。
Conclusion: 该框架支持画布编辑、文本叠加、响应式缩放、多语言适配和动画海报等多种应用，推进了 AI 辅助图形设计的民主化。

papers.title: Membership Inference Attacks for Unseen Classes
papers.abstract_en: A key tool in developing safe AI models is \emph{data auditing}, i.e., using statistical tools to determine whether harmful content may have been used in the training data of a black-box model. Unfortunately, most \emph{membership inference attacks} (MIAs) used to perform this type of auditing themselves assume \emph{access} to examples of harmful content from the same distribution as the query data. In real-world auditing scenarios, auditors often face legal and ethical restrictions preventing them from accessing a representative set of samples of harmful content to train MIA models effectively. We abstract and formalize this setting into a new data access model, the ``unseen class'' setting, and show that the state of the art MIAs fail due to the lack of access to the full target distribution. We show in this setting, \emph{quantile regression attacks} outperform approaches typically considered to be SoTA. We demonstrate this both empirically and theoretically, showing that quantile regression attacks achieve up to \textbf{11$\times$ the TPR} of shadow model-based approaches in practice, and providing a theoretical model that outlines the generalization properties required for this approach to succeed. Our work identifies an important failure mode in existing MIAs and provides a cautionary tale for practitioners that aim to directly use existing tools for real-world applications of AI safety.

papers.title: Contour Errors: Ego-Centric Matching for 3D Multi-Object Tracking Performance Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Open-loop performance evaluation of 3D multi-object tracking in autonomous driving requires matching criteria that effectively penalize translational, shape, and orientation errors from the ego vehicle perspective. The prevailing criteria for determining true positives are Intersection over Union (IoU) and Centre-Point Distances (CPD). When IoU is extended from the 2D image plane to 3D volumetric overlap, it often falls below its acceptance threshold even with minor yaw misalignments, whereas CPD disregards orientation entirely. To address this limitation, we propose Contour Errors (CE) as an ego-centric criterion that employs Hausdorff-type reasoning to sparse bounding-box corner geometry by selecting the k-nearest ego-centric corners. This method provides a graded orientation sensitivity between the extremes of IoU, which overpenalizes, and CPD, which is orientation-blind. We evaluate Contour Errors against six baselines using the HOTA evaluation protocol on the nuScenes dataset, conditioned on proximity, yaw error, and a confidence threshold. At the standard IoU vehicle threshold, 47% of car and 75% of pedestrian CE-valid matches are rejected by IoU despite close contour proximity, while fewer than 0.1% of IoU-valid matches fail CE. These results establish the ego-centric matching criterion as a primary factor for improving open-loop perception evaluation in safety-critical autonomous driving.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026

Method: 提出Contour Errors，采用Hausdorff型推理，对稀疏边界框角点选择k个最近的自车角点，实现分级方向敏感性。
Result: 在nuScenes数据集上，标准IoU车辆阈值下47%的汽车和75%的行人CE有效匹配被IoU拒绝，而少于0.1%的IoU有效匹配未能通过CE。
Conclusion: 该自车匹配准则可作为改进安全关键自动驾驶中开环感知评价的关键因素。

papers.title: Streaming Sliced Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Sliced optimal transport (SOT), or sliced Wasserstein (SW) distance, is widely recognized for its statistical and computational scalability. In this work, we further enhance computational scalability by proposing the first method for estimating SW from sample streams, called streaming sliced Wasserstein (Stream-SW). To define Stream-SW, we first introduce a streaming estimator of the one-dimensional Wasserstein distance (1DW). Since the 1DW has a closed-form expression, given by the integral of the absolute difference between the quantile functions of the compared distributions, we leverage quantile approximation techniques for sample streams to define a streaming 1DW estimator. By applying the streaming 1DW to all projections, we obtain Stream-SW. The key advantage of Stream-SW is its low memory complexity while providing theoretical guarantees on the approximation error. We demonstrate that Stream-SW achieves a more accurate approximation of SW than random subsampling, with lower memory consumption, when comparing Gaussian distributions and mixtures of Gaussians from streaming samples. Additionally, we conduct experiments on point cloud classification, point cloud gradient flows, and streaming change point detection to further highlight the favorable performance of the proposed Stream-SW.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026, 21 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出流式切片Wasserstein距离（Stream-SW），用于从样本流中估计切片Wasserstein距离。通过流式估计一维Wasserstein距离并利用分位数近似，Stream-SW在低内存消耗下提供理论误差保证。实验表明，在流式高斯分布和混合高斯分布的比较中，Stream-SW比随机子采样更准确且内存更少，并在点云分类、梯度流和流式变化点检测中表现良好。
Motivation: 现有切片最优传输（SOT）方法需要一次性访问全部数据，无法高效处理流式数据。本文旨在提出首个从流数据中估计SOT的方法，同时保持统计和计算的可扩展性。
Method: 提出流式切片Wasserstein距离（Stream-SW）方法。通过一维Wasserstein距离的闭式表达式（分位数函数绝对差的积分），结合分位数近似技术实现流式估计，再将其应用于所有投影方向。
Result: 理论分析证明了近似误差的界限。数值实验显示，在流式高斯分布和混合高斯分布比较中，Stream-SW比随机子采样更准确且内存更低。在点云分类、梯度流和流式变化点检测任务上验证了其性能。
Conclusion: Stream-SW为流式数据下的切片Wasserstein估计提供了首个高效方案，兼具低内存消耗和理论保证。未来可扩展到更复杂的分布和实际应用。

papers.title: AuditVotes: Elevating Provable Defense for GNNs with Efficient Augmentation and Conditional Smoothing
papers.abstract_en: Despite advancements in Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), adaptive attacks continue to challenge their robustness. Certified robustness via randomized smoothing offers provable guarantees but suffers from a severe accuracy-robustness trade-off, limiting its practical use. To bridge this gap, we introduce AuditVotes, the first framework that simultaneously achieves high clean accuracy and strong certified robustness. AuditVotes seamlessly integrates two novel components into the randomized smoothing pipeline: (1) graph rewiring augmentation, which denoises randomized graphs to recover data quality, and (2) conditional smoothing, which filters low-confidence votes to ensure prediction consistency. We establish a novel theoretical result, proving that certified robustness is preserved under arbitrary filtering functions. Designed for inductive learning, our framework generalizes to unseen nodes and applies broadly to other smoothing schemes, including de-randomized smoothing for graphs and Gaussian smoothing for images. Extensive experiments show AuditVotes delivers substantial gains: on Cora-ML under 20-edge attacks, it improves clean accuracy by 437.1% and certified accuracy by 409.3%, while maintaining comparable runtime to vanilla smoothing. As a widely applicable and efficient plug-in, AuditVotes offers higher accuracy and stronger guarantees, enabling the practical and certifiably robust GNNs in security-sensitive domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AuditVotes框架，通过图重连增广（graph rewiring augmentation）和条件平滑（conditional smoothing）两个组件，在随机平滑管道中同时提高干净准确率和认证鲁棒性。理论证明了认证鲁棒性在任意过滤函数下保持不变。实验表明，在Cora-ML上针对20边攻击，干净准确率提升437.1%，认证准确率提升409.3%，运行时间与原始平滑相当。
Motivation: 现有GNN在自适应攻击下鲁棒性不足，随机平滑存在准确率-鲁棒性权衡问题，限制了实用化。
Method: 将图重连增广和条件平滑无缝集成到随机平滑流程中：图重连增广用于去噪以恢复数据质量，条件平滑用于过滤低置信度投票以确保预测一致性。
Result: 在Cora-ML上针对20边攻击，干净准确率提升437.1%，认证准确率提升409.3%，运行时间与原始平滑相当。
Conclusion: 该框架作为广泛适用的即插即用模块，能实现安全敏感领域中实用且可认证鲁棒的GNN。

papers.title: Towards Practical Emotion Recognition: An Unsupervised Source-Free Approach for EEG Domain Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Emotion recognition is crucial for advancing mental health, healthcare, and technologies such as brain-computer interfaces. EEG-based models, however, struggle in cross-domain settings due to the high cost of labeled data and signal variability across individuals and recording conditions. Unsupervised domain adaptation typically requires access to source data, which is often infeasible because of privacy and computational constraints. Source-free unsupervised domain adaptation (SF-UDA) removes this requirement, but it has not yet been applied to emotion recognition. We propose an SF-UDA approach for cross-domain EEG emotion classification, built on a multi-stage framework that adapts to the target domain without source data. Dual-Loss Adaptive Regularization (DLAR) minimizes prediction discrepancies on confident samples and aligns predictions with expected pseudo-labels. Localized Consistency Learning (LCL) enforces local consistency by promoting similar predictions among reliable neighbors. Together, these components address domain shift and reduce the impact of noisy pseudo-labels, a key challenge in SF-UDA. Experiments on DEAP, SEED, and DREAMER show that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, reaching 65.84% and 58.87% accuracy on SEED and DREAMER when trained on DEAP, and 58.99% and 67.08% on DEAP and DREAMER when trained on SEED. It detects both positive and negative emotions well, making it suitable for practical emotion recognition applications. Code available at: https://github.com/RyersonMultimediaLab/EmotionRecognitionSF-UDA
papers.comment: Accepted: IEEE Transactions on Affective Computing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将无源无监督域自适应（SF-UDA）应用于跨域EEG情绪识别，提出多阶段框架，包含双损失自适应正则化（DLAR）和局部一致性学习（LCL），在DEAP、SEED、DREAMER数据集上显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 跨域EEG情绪识别中，标注数据昂贵且个体差异大，无监督域自适应通常需要源数据，但隐私和计算限制使其不可行。SF-UDA此前未用于情绪识别。
Method: 提出SF-UDA方法，采用多阶段框架：DLAR通过最小化置信样本预测差异并与伪标签对齐，LCL通过促进可靠邻居间相似预测来强制局部一致性，共同处理域偏移和噪声伪标签。

Conclusion: 方法有效检测正负情绪，适合实际情绪识别应用，代码已开源。

papers.title: SEED: Towards More Accurate Semantic Evaluation for Visual Brain Decoding
papers.abstract_en: We present SEED (Semantic Evaluation for Visual Brain Decoding), a novel metric for evaluating the semantic decoding performance of visual brain decoding models. It integrates three complementary metrics, each capturing a different aspect of semantic similarity between images inspired by neuroscientific findings. Using carefully crowd-sourced human evaluation data, we demonstrate that SEED achieves the highest alignment with human evaluation, outperforming other widely used metrics. Through the evaluation of existing visual brain decoding models with SEED, we further reveal that crucial information is often lost in translation, even in the state-of-the-art models that achieve near-perfect scores on existing metrics. This finding highlights the limitations of current evaluation practices and provides guidance for future improvements in decoding models. Finally, to facilitate further research, we open-source the human evaluation data, encouraging the development of more advanced evaluation methods for brain decoding. Our code and the human evaluation data are available at https://github.com/Concarne2/SEED.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SEED 是一种新的视觉脑解码模型语义评估指标，整合了三种互补的相似度度量，旨在更准确地对齐人类评估。实验表明，SEED 比现有指标更符合人类判断，并揭示了当前最优模型在语义信息保留上的不足。
Motivation: 现有视觉脑解码评估指标无法充分反映语义相似性，导致模型性能被高估。
Method: 提出 SEED，整合三种基于神经科学发现的语义相似度度量，并通过众包人类评估数据验证其对齐性。
Result: SEED 在人类对齐度上优于其他广泛使用的指标；现有最优模型在 SEED 上得分远低于传统指标，表明关键语义信息丢失。
Conclusion: SEED 揭示了当前评估实践的局限性，并为改进解码模型提供了方向。数据集和代码已开源。

papers.title: Leveraging ChatGPT's Multimodal Vision Capabilities to Rank Satellite Images by Poverty Level: Advancing Tools for Social Science Research
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates the novel application of Large Language Models (LLMs) with vision capabilities to analyze satellite imagery for village-level poverty prediction. Although LLMs were originally designed for natural language understanding, their adaptability to perform multimodal tasks, including geospatial analysis, has opened new frontiers in data-driven research. By leveraging advancements in vision-enabled LLMs, we assess their ability to provide interpretable, scalable, and reliable insights into human poverty from satellite images. Using a pairwise comparison approach, we demonstrate that ChatGPT can rank satellite images based on poverty levels with accuracy comparable to domain experts. These findings highlight both the promise and the limitations of LLMs in socioeconomic research, providing a foundation for their integration into poverty assessment workflows. This study contributes to the ongoing exploration of unconventional data sources for welfare analysis and opens pathways for cost-effective, large-scale poverty monitoring. Our results also put forward the question of how reliable the anonymized public datasets, such as DHS, are for retrieving wealth indices.

papers.title: Distributed Optimization via Energy Conservation Laws in Dilated Coordinates
papers.abstract_en: Continuous-time models can reveal accelerated structures in distributed optimization, but their rates need not survive direct discretization. We introduce a second-order primal--dual flow for smooth convex distributed optimization and construct an exactly conserved energy that yields an $\mathcal O(t^{-2})$ rate for both the aggregate objective gap and the squared consensus error. We then prove a horizon-wise $Ω(k^{-1})$ lower bound for a broad class of single-loop finite-memory primal--dual discretizations, ruling out a $\mathcal O(k^{-2})$ aggregate-objective guarantee within this class. Motivated by this barrier, we develop a double-loop method that combines finite-step polynomial consensus with an accelerated outer update. It uses one gradient evaluation and at most $m-1$ communication rounds per outer iteration, $m$ being the number of agents, maintains exact consensus and achieves an $\mathcal O(k^{-2})$ aggregate-objective rate. Numerical comparisons with representative distributed methods support the theory and quantify the communication cost of acceleration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对光滑凸分布式优化问题，提出一种连续时间二阶原始-对偶流，并证明存在精确守恒能量，从而得到目标函数间隙和一致性误差的 O(t^{-2}) 收敛率。同时，作者证明了一类单循环有限内存原始-对偶离散化的 Ω(k^{-1}) 下界，并开发了一种双循环方法，使用一次梯度计算和最多 m-1 轮通信，实现 O(k^{-2}) 速率。数值实验支持理论。
Motivation: 连续时间模型可以揭示分布式优化中的加速结构，但直接离散化后加速率可能无法保持。本文针对这一差距，研究是否可以构造一种离散化后仍保持加速收敛率的方法。
Method: 提出二阶原始-对偶连续时间流，推导其守恒能量；证明单循环离散化无法突破 O(k^{-1}) 下界；设计双循环方法，内循环实现多项式精度一致，外循环采用加速更新，确保精确一致性和 O(k^{-2}) 速率。
Result: 证明连续时间流下 O(t^{-2}) 收敛，单循环离散化 Ω(k^{-1}) 下界，双循环方法实现 O(k^{-2}) 收敛。数值比较验证了理论并量化了通信代价。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了分布式优化中加速与通信代价之间的权衡，双循环方法在保持低通信成本的同时实现了加速收敛。

papers.title: A Confidence Interval for the $\ell_2$ Expected Calibration Error
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in machine learning have significantly improved prediction accuracy in various applications. However, ensuring the calibration of probabilistic predictions remains a significant challenge. Despite efforts to enhance model calibration, the rigorous statistical evaluation of model calibration remains less explored. In this work, we develop confidence intervals the $\ell_2$ Expected Calibration Error (ECE). We consider top-1-to-$k$ calibration, which includes both the popular notion of confidence calibration as well as full calibration. For a debiased estimator of the ECE, we show asymptotic normality, but with different convergence rates and asymptotic variances for calibrated and miscalibrated models. We develop methods to construct asymptotically valid confidence intervals for the ECE, accounting for this behavior as well as non-negativity. Our theoretical findings are supported through extensive experiments, showing that our methods produce valid confidence intervals with shorter lengths compared to those obtained by resampling-based methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对机器学习模型校准的统计评估问题，开发了ℓ2期望校准误差（ECE）的置信区间方法。作者考虑了top-1到top-k校准，包括置信度校准和完全校准。对于ECE的无偏估计量，证明了渐近正态性，但校准和未校准模型的收敛速度和渐近方差不同。他们提出了构建渐近有效置信区间的方法，处理了非负性等问题。实验表明，该方法产生的置信区间长度短于基于重采样的方法。
Motivation: 机器学习模型校准的严格统计评估尚不充分，现有方法缺乏可靠的置信区间用于ECE的推断。
Method: 提出基于去偏估计量的ECE置信区间构建方法，证明了渐近正态性，并针对校准和未校准模型的不同收敛行为设计了修正策略，同时考虑估计量的非负性。
Result: 实验显示所提方法产生的置信区间有效且长度短于重采样方法。
Conclusion: 该工作为ℓ2 ECE提供了统计上严格的置信区间，适用于多种校准评估场景，但未讨论其他校准度量或高维问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Differentially Private Neural Network Training Under the Hidden State Assumption
papers.abstract_en: Current differentially private learning paradigms face a severe utility bottleneck: DP-SGD degrades performance through noise accumulation over training steps, while aggregation-based approaches such as PATE suffer from data inefficiency due to disjoint data partitioning. We propose \textbf{Differentially Private Decoupled Training (DP-DT)}, a framework that decouples representation learning from privacy enforcement. DP-DT confines noise injection to the weight aggregation stage and employs auxiliary models, continuously synchronized with a global model, to perform noise-free feature extraction on private data shards. We prove that DP-DT converges globally to a limit point under non-convex objectives, via a Lyapunov potential analysis combined with the Kurdyka--Łojasiewicz property. Under the Hidden State Assumption, where adversaries observe only the final published model, we further prove that DP-DT's privacy loss can converge to a constant bound rather than accumulating with iterations. Empirical results across vision and language benchmarks confirm that DP-DT significantly mitigates utility degradation, achieving state-of-the-art privacy-utility trade-offs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出差分隐私解耦训练（DP-DT），将表示学习与隐私执行解耦，只在权重聚合阶段注入噪声，并利用辅助模型在私有数据分片上无噪声提取特征。理论证明了非凸目标下的全局收敛性，并在隐藏状态假设下证明隐私损失可收敛到常数界。实验表明DP-DT显著缓解效用下降，达到最先进的隐私-效用权衡。
Motivation: 现有差分隐私学习方法面临严重的效用瓶颈：DP-SGD因噪声积累导致性能下降，PATE等聚合方法因数据分区不连续导致数据效率低下。
Method: 提出DP-DT框架，解耦表示学习与隐私执行，仅在权重聚合阶段注入噪声，使用连续同步全局模型的辅助模型在私有数据分片上进行无噪声特征提取；通过Lyapunov势分析与Kurdyka–Łojasiewicz性质证明收敛性。
Result: 在视觉和语言基准上显著缓解效用下降，实现了最先进的隐私-效用权衡。
Conclusion: DP-DT通过解耦策略有效缓解了差分隐私训练中的效用退化，隐私损失在隐藏状态假设下可收敛到常数。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LaSEr-Edit: Localized Span-level Error Editing with Energy-based Localization
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) are widely adopted in real-world applications, it has become critical to ensure LLMs satisfy safety constraints, such as non-toxicity and logical consistency, as well as task- and situation-specific constraints. Controlling the output through instructions is a simple and tempting approach; however, it remains brittle, is opaque in how it influences model behavior, and thus cannot reliably ensure constraint satisfaction. Moreover, most recent controlled text generation (CTG) methods require access to the internal components of language models--such as weights or logits--making them incompatible with popular API-based LLMs. In this work, we propose LaSEr-Edit, a constraint-satisfying text revision method that can be applied to any LLMs, black- or white-box. We first find that lightweight, task-specific energy-based models (EBMs) achieve error-localization performance competitive with or even better than that of much larger LLMs, while operating substantially faster. Based on this finding, we propose two variants of text revision methods that incorporate energy-based error localization: LaSEr-LLM Edit, which instructs an LLM to edit text given EBM-predicted error spans, and LaSEr-EBM Edit, which uses the EBM not only for localization but also for editing by reranking edit candidates. Through experiments in diverse single-constraint control tasks, we show that LaSEr-LLM Edit controls text better than plain LLM-based editing in most of the tasks. We also find that LaSEr-EBM Edit further improves the control performance of LaSEr-LLM Edit and achieves among the strongest controllability across all tasks. Furthermore, we find that LaSEr-Edit, especially LaSEr-EBM Edit, performs well even when multiple constraints are controlled simultaneously.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LaSEr-Edit，一种基于能量模型的约束满足文本修正方法，适用于任意 LLM（黑盒或白盒）。通过轻量级任务特定 EBM 定位错误跨度，再结合 LLM 或 EBM 进行编辑，在单约束和多约束控制任务中实现强控制性能。
Motivation: 现有指令控制不可靠且不透明，而多数受控文本生成方法需访问模型内部，无法用于 API 型 LLM。
Method: 提出两阶段方法：先用轻量级 EBM 定位错误跨度，然后通过 LaSEr-LLM Edit（EBM 定位后 LLM 编辑）或 LaSEr-EBM Edit（EBM 同时定位和重排候选编辑）进行修正。
Result: 摘要显示 LaSEr-LLM Edit 在单约束任务中多数优于纯 LLM 编辑，LaSEr-EBM Edit 进一步改进控制性能，并在多约束任务中表现良好。
Conclusion: 摘要强调轻量级 EBM 能有效定位错误，且 LaSEr-Edit 适用于黑盒或白盒 LLM，为受控文本生成提供可行方案。

papers.title: Any-Time Regret-Guaranteed Algorithm for Control of Linear Quadratic Systems
papers.abstract_en: We propose a computationally efficient algorithm that achieves anytime regret of order $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{t})$, with explicit dependence on the system dimensions and on the solution of the Discrete Algebraic Riccati Equation (DARE). Our approach builds on the SDP-based framework of \cite{cohen2019learning}, using an appropriately tuned regularization and a sufficiently accurate initial estimate to construct confidence ellipsoids for control design. A carefully designed input-perturbation mechanism is incorporated to ensure anytime performance. We develop two variants of the algorithm. The first enforces a notion of strong sequential stability, requiring each policy to be stabilizing and successive policies to remain close. However, enforcing this notion results in a suboptimal regret scaling. The second removes the sequential-stability requirement and instead requires only that each generated policy be stabilizing. Closed-loop stability is then preserved through a dwell-time-inspired policy-update rule, adapting ideas from switched-systems control to carefully balance exploration and exploitation. This class of algorithms also addresses key shortcomings of most existing approaches including certainty-equivalence-based methods which typically guarantee stability only in the Lyapunov sense and lack explicit uniform high-probability bounds on the state trajectory expressed in system-theoretic terms. Our analysis explicitly characterizes the trade-off between state amplification and regret, and shows that partially relaxing the sequential-stability requirement yields optimal regret. Finally, our method eliminates the need for any a priori bound on the norm of the DARE solution, an assumption required by all existing computationally efficient optimism in the face of uncertainty (OFU) based algorithms, and thereby removes the reliance of regret guarantees on such external inputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种计算高效的算法，用于线性二次系统控制，实现了在任意时刻的后悔界为O(√t)，依赖于系统维度和离散代数Riccati方程的解。算法基于SDP框架，通过适当正则化和初始估计构建置信椭球，并引入输入扰动机制以保证任意时刻性能。开发了两种变体：一种强制强序列稳定性，但导致次优后悔缩放；另一种移除序列稳定性要求，通过驻留时间策略更新规则保持闭环稳定性。该方法无需对DARE解范数进行先验假设，解决了现有确定性等价方法的不足。
Motivation: 现有基于乐观面对不确定性（OFU）的算法需要DARE解范数的先验边界，且确定性等价方法通常只能保证Lyapunov意义上的稳定性，缺乏明确的统一高概率状态轨迹界。
Method: 基于SDP框架，使用正则化和初始估计构造置信椭球，结合输入扰动机制，并设计两种变体：一种强制序列稳定性，另一种通过驻留时间策略更新规则放松该要求。
Result: 实现了任意时刻后悔界O(√t)，且部分放松序列稳定性要求可实现最优后悔。无需DARE解范数的先验边界。
Conclusion: 所提算法在保证稳定性的同时达到理论上最优的后悔界，并消除了对DARE解外部输入的依赖。

papers.title: A Survey on Semantic Modeling for Building Energy Management
papers.abstract_en: Building Energy Management (BEM) is central to reducing energy use and CO2 emissions in the building sector. Although IoT technologies now provide extensive operational data, heterogeneous data models, device descriptions, and contextual representations continue to limit semantic interoperability, limiting the development of generalisable, autonomous, context-aware BEM applications. Ontologies address this challenge by providing structured, machine-interpretable representations of building data, systems, and operational context. This survey examines semantic modelling for BEM during the building operational phase. It reviews 60 semantic models and analyses more than 20 ontology-based BEM use cases. It further quantifies Ontology Instantiation Rates (OIR) and missing concepts across those use cases. To support evidence-based assessment of ontology use, we introduce the notion of Ontology Evidence Completeness (OEC), a measure of whether studies explicitly map operational concepts to the ontology classes used to represent them. Findings show that current semantic models more consistently represent physical building structure, technical systems, sensing devices, and observable operational data than abstract and dynamic operational concepts. Concepts such as key performance indicators, assessments, services, control logic, optimisation tasks, and computational workflows remain less consistently covered. Applied BEM studies therefore frequently depend on ontology reuse, integration, specialisation, external inheritance, or application-specific extension to address coverage and interoperability gaps across BEM. By synthesising these patterns, this survey clarifies the capabilities of existing semantic models and identifies directions for more interoperable, generalisable, and context-aware BEM systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了建筑能源管理（BEM）中的语义建模，回顾了60个语义模型并分析了20多个基于本体的BEM用例。介绍了本体证据完整性（OEC）概念，发现现有模型在表示物理结构、技术系统和传感器数据方面较为一致，但在关键绩效指标、控制逻辑、优化任务等抽象动态概念方面覆盖不足。
Motivation: 建筑能源管理中物联网数据异构性导致语义互操作性受限，阻碍了通用自主上下文感知BEM应用的发展。本体可以解决此问题，但需要系统评估现有模型的覆盖范围和完整性。
Method: 对60个语义模型进行综述，分析超过20个基于本体的BEM用例，量化本体实例化率（OIR）和缺失概念，并提出本体证据完整性（OEC）度量。
Result: 现有语义模型在表示物理建筑结构、技术系统、传感设备和可观测操作数据方面较为一致，但在关键绩效指标、评估、服务、控制逻辑、优化任务和计算工作流等抽象动态概念方面覆盖不足。应用研究常依赖本体重用、集成、专门化、外部继承或特定扩展来弥补缺口。
Conclusion: 综述阐明了现有语义模型的能力，并指出了更可互操作、可泛化和上下文感知的BEM系统的方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A convergence result of a continuous model of deep learning via a Łojasiewicz--Simon inequality
papers.abstract_en: We study an idealized training process for deep neural networks in a continuous-depth, mean-field model in which each layer is parameterized by a probability measure on a Euclidean parameter space. The training dynamics are formulated as a Wasserstein-type gradient flow of an objective with a fixed $L^2$-regularization. Under suitable analyticity and growth assumptions, together with a coercivity assumption and sufficient regularity of the initial data, we prove that every curve of maximal slope converges to a single critical point of the objective as the training time tends to infinity. The proof combines compactness of the curve with a Łojasiewicz--Simon inequality for the metric slope. To establish the inequality, we lift the objective to a Hilbert space of random variables and use the analyticity of the lifted gradient in a stronger $L^\infty$ topology to overcome its lack of continuous differentiability in the Hilbert-space topology. Our convergence result does not require global displacement convexity, a Polyak--Łojasiewicz-type condition, or initialization near a minimizer; the objective may remain genuinely nonconvex.
papers.comment: 33 pages, add details of the proof and examples
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究连续深度平均场深度学习模型的训练动力学，在目标函数满足解析性和增长条件、初始数据足够正则的假设下，证明Wasserstein梯度流的每条最大斜率曲线在训练时间趋于无穷时收敛到目标的单个临界点。证明结合了曲线紧致性与Łojasiewicz-Simon不等式，不依赖于全局位移凸性或初始化靠近最小值等条件。
Motivation: 深度学习训练动力学缺乏严格的收敛性保证，尤其是在非凸目标下，现有结果通常需要凸性或其他强条件。
Method: 将训练建模为Wasserstein梯度流，通过曲线紧致性和Łojasiewicz-Simon不等式证明收敛。关键步骤是将目标提升到随机变量的Hilbert空间，利用提升梯度在L∞拓扑下的解析性弥补Hilbert空间中连续可微性的不足。
Result: 在解析性、增长性、强制性及初始数据正则性假设下，证明了每条最大斜率曲线收敛到目标函数的单一临界点。
Conclusion: 该收敛结果无需全局位移凸性、Polyak-Łojasiewicz条件或接近最小值的初始化，目标函数可保持非凸。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Kernel Ridge Regression Inference
papers.abstract_en: We provide uniform confidence bands for kernel ridge regression (KRR), a widely used nonparametric regression estimator for nonstandard data such as preferences, sequences, and graphs. Despite the prevalence of these data--e.g., student preferences in school matching mechanisms--the inferential theory of KRR is not fully known. We construct valid and sharp confidence sets that shrink at nearly the minimax rate, allowing nonstandard regressors. Our bootstrap procedure uses anti-symmetric multipliers for computational efficiency and for validity under mis-specification. We use the procedure to develop a test for match effects, i.e. whether students benefit more from the schools they rank highly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为核岭回归（KRR）提供了均匀置信带，适用于偏好、序列和图等非标准数据。作者构造了以近似最小最大速率收缩的有效且尖锐的置信集，并使用反对称乘子的自助法以提高计算效率并在误设定下保持有效性。该方法被用于检验匹配效应，即学生是否从他们排名高的学校中获得更多收益。
Motivation: 尽管核岭回归在非标准数据（如学校匹配机制中的学生偏好）中广泛应用，但其推断理论尚未完全明确，缺乏有效的置信区间方法。
Method: 提出了基于反对称乘子的自助法（bootstrap procedure），用于构建核岭回归的均匀置信带，该方法在计算上高效且在模型误设定下依然有效。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但声称置信集以近似最小最大速率收缩，并且自助法具有计算效率和稳健性。
Conclusion: 本文填补了核岭回归推断理论的空白，为非标准数据提供了实用的统计推断工具，并通过匹配效应检验展示了其应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Auto-adaptive Resonance Equalization using Dilated Residual Networks
papers.abstract_en: In music and audio production, attenuation of spectral resonances is an important step towards a technically correct result. In this paper we present a two-component system to automate the task of resonance equalization. The first component is a dynamic equalizer that automatically detects resonances and offers to attenuate them by a user-specified factor. The second component is a deep neural network that predicts the optimal attenuation factor based on the windowed audio. The network is trained and validated on empirical data gathered from an experiment in which sound engineers choose their preferred attenuation factors for a set of tracks. We test two distinct network architectures for the predictive model and find that a dilated residual network operating directly on the audio signal is on a par with a network architecture that requires a prior audio feature extraction stage. Both architectures predict human-preferred resonance attenuation factors significantly better than a baseline approach.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 20th ISMIR Conference, Delft, Netherlands, November 4-8, 2019. Pp. 405-411. https://archives.ismir.net/ismir2019/paper/000048.pdf
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个两组件系统用于音频共振均衡的自动化：一个动态均衡器自动检测共振并由用户设定衰减因子，一个深度神经网络预测最佳衰减因子。网络在声音工程师为音轨选择衰减因子的实验数据上训练验证。实验表明，直接处理音频信号的膨胀残差网络与需要预提取特征的网络架构性能相当，且均显著优于基线方法。
Motivation: 音乐和音频制作中，衰减频谱共振是实现技术正确结果的重要步骤，但手动调整费时费力，需要自动化方法。
Method: 提出两组件系统：动态均衡器自动检测共振并允许用户指定衰减因子；深度神经网络预测最优衰减因子。测试两种网络架构：一是直接操作音频信号的膨胀残差网络，二是需要预提取特征的网络。
Result: 膨胀残差网络与需预提取特征的网络在预测人类偏好的共振衰减因子上性能相当，且两者均显著优于基线方法。
Conclusion: 基于膨胀残差网络的端到端方法可有效替代依赖手工特征的模型，实现音频共振均衡的自动化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptive Capitulation: A Structural Failure Mode of LLM Responses in Vulnerability Contexts
papers.abstract_en: Large language models operating in emotionally sensitive contexts face a structural trilemma: when users in vulnerable states request information that may reinforce maladaptive attribution, current response architectures resolve the tension through protective restriction, uninflected facilitation, or unintegrated co-presence of both imperatives -- each preserving one objective at the cost of the other. Administering a three-turn escalating vulnerability vignette to three commercial LLMs (900 sessions across material, relational, and somatic status-proxy variants) and coding responses with two binary indices (VCC/VCI), we characterize a previously undocumented failure mode we term adaptive capitulation: the model validates the social injustice underlying the user's distress before pivoting to detailed facilitation of the very acquisition it nominally discouraged. We show that the trilemma is structural rather than incidental, and propose Minimal Reattributive Sufficiency (MRS), an architecture-neutral design principle that embeds a single reattributive cue within an otherwise validating response, preserving a pathway toward autonomous reattribution without contesting the user's stated goal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型在情感敏感上下文中的结构三难困境，通过对三种商业LLM进行900次会话，发现一种之前未记录的失败模式“adaptive capitulation”：模型先验证用户痛苦背后的社会不公，然后转向详细促进它本不鼓励的获取行为。作者证明该三难困境是结构性的，并提出最小重新归因充分性（Minimal Reattributive Sufficiency, MRS）设计原则。
Motivation: 现有LLM在面对脆弱用户请求信息时，其回应架构面临保护性限制、无差别促进或未整合共存的三难困境，每种都以牺牲其他目标为代价。需要识别这种结构性的失败模式并提出缓解方法。
Method: 采用三轮逐步升级的脆弱场景小插曲（vulnerability vignette），对三种商业LLM进行900次会话（涉及物质、关系和身体状态代理变体），并用两个二元索引（VCC/VCI）对回应编码。提出MRS设计原则，在验证性回应中嵌入一个重新归因线索。
Result: 识别出“adaptive capitulation”失败模式：模型先验证用户痛苦背后的社会不公，然后促进其本不鼓励的获取行为。实验证明三难困境是结构性的而非偶然的。
Conclusion: 提出架构无关的MRS设计原则，通过嵌入单个重新归因线索，在不挑战用户明确目标的前提下，保留自主重新归因的途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HypEMBER: Hypernetwork-based Ensemble for Robust Policy Learning of Parametrized Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract_en: In this work we investigate reinforcement learning (RL) as a framework for the robust control of parametrized dynamical systems in presence of measurements and model uncertainties. High-dimensional state spaces, expensive numerical solvers, the partial knowledge of the governing equations, and the dependence on physical parameters that may be uncertain or difficult to estimate accurately, make the use of standard RL approaches computationally unfeasible. Indeed, lack of robustness and poor generalization across parameter variations are further amplified in presence of noisy or incomplete measurements, ultimately hampering control performance. To address these challenges, we introduce HypEMBER, a novel RL framework based on the combination of hypernetworks and ensemble learning. In the proposed approach, both the policy and value functions are represented through hypernetworks that generate the weights of the underlying models conditioned on the physical parameters of the system, thereby enabling parametric generalization across different dynamical regimes. In addition, an ensemble of policy and value approximators is employed to quantify epistemic uncertainty, leading to improved exploration strategies and enhanced robustness during and after training. The performance of the proposed framework is assessed on two representative parametrized control problems: (i) the one-dimensional Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation and (ii) a particle-navigation task in a two-dimensional time-dependent gyre flow, focusing on robustness with respect to measurement noise and parameter misspecification. Numerical results demonstrate that HypEMBER consistently improves training stability and sample efficiency, while achieving superior robustness to uncertainties affecting both the system dynamics and the available observations, in comparison with state-of-the-art RL methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HypEMBER，一种结合超网络与集成学习的强化学习框架，用于参数化动力系统的鲁棒控制。超网络根据物理参数生成策略和价值网络的权重，实现参数泛化；集成学习估计认知不确定性，改进探索和鲁棒性。在Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程和粒子导航任务上验证，相比基线方法提升了训练稳定性和样本效率，且对测量噪声和参数错配具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 参数化动力系统的高维状态空间、数值求解器昂贵、部分未知的动力学方程以及对物理参数的依赖使得标准强化学习方法计算不可行且鲁棒性差，尤其在噪声或不完整测量下泛化能力弱。
Method: 提出HypEMBER框架，使用超网络生成条件权重，使策略和价值函数参数化于物理参数；同时采用集成学习（policy和value的集成）来量化认知不确定性，以指导探索并增强鲁棒性。
Result: 在一维Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程和二维时变环流中的粒子导航任务上，HypEMBER在训练稳定性和样本效率上优于现有强化学习方法，并且对测量噪声和参数不确定性表现出更强的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要指出该框架通过超网络实现参数泛化，集成学习提升鲁棒性，适用于参数化动力系统的鲁棒控制。

papers.title: Pathologist Attention-Aligned Report Generation for Prostate Histopathology
papers.abstract_en: The allocation of visual attention by pathologists during cancer diagnosis is a highly selective process that critically shapes the information extracted from whole-slide images (WSIs). Human attention helps medical imaging tasks such as classification and segmentation, and becomes a strong semantic cue for identifying diagnostically informative regions for report generation. In this paper, we introduce human attention into the training of pathologist report generation models. To this end, we collected a multimodal human-attention dataset of 121 prostate WSIs annotated with pathologists' multi-scale viewport trajectories synchronized with the pathologists' verbal descriptions and cursor movements for five clinically relevant components (e.g., Gleason patterns). Using this dataset, we finetune two report generation models with an attention-alignment loss that regularizes the model attention over image patches to match the distribution of pathologist attention. We evaluate our approach on prostate cancer report generation and visual question answering using two models with different internal attention mechanisms (i.e., how image tokens are integrated into the language decoder). Experiments show average gains of 10.9% on NLP-based metrics and 19.3% in accuracy across five clinically relevant report components. Further, model attention maps extracted at inference time, with minimal computational overhead, align more closely with pathologist attention, providing stronger visual support for the generated reports by highlighting the regions that most influence the output.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, accepted for publication at the 29th International Conference on Medical Image Computing and Computer-Assisted Intervention (MICCAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将病理学家的视觉注意力引入前列腺全切片图像的报告生成模型。通过收集多模态注意力数据集（包含121例WSI的视口轨迹、口头描述和光标运动），使用注意力对齐损失微调两个报告生成模型，使其注意力分布匹配病理学家的注意力。在报告生成和视觉问答任务上，NLP指标平均提升10.9%，临床组件准确率提升19.3%，且推理时注意力图与病理学家更一致。
Motivation: 病理学家诊断时的视觉注意力高度选择性，现有报告生成模型未利用这一信息，导致生成报告缺乏对关键区域的语义引导。
Method: 收集病理学家在诊断前列腺WSI时的多模态注意力数据集（视口轨迹、口头描述、光标运动），使用注意力对齐损失微调报告生成模型，正则化模型在图像块上的注意力分布以匹配病理学家的注意力分布。
Result: 实验在两个模型上显示，NLP指标平均提升10.9%，五个临床相关报告组件的准确率平均提升19.3%；模型注意力图与病理学家注意力对齐度更高，且计算开销小。
Conclusion: 引入人类注意力能显著提升报告生成的质量和可解释性，为临床报告提供更强的视觉支持。

papers.title: From Bit-Position Sensitivity to Unequal Error Protection for DNN Inference Memory
papers.abstract_en: We characterize per-bit-position fault sensitivity in ML inference across 16 workloads -- spanning transformer-based models and attention-free CNNs -- and across three floating-point formats. Our central empirical finding is a sharp bit-sensitivity transition: flipping any of the least-significant fraction bits up to a data-type-specific threshold, Xsafe, degrades task metrics by less than 1% under deterministic single-bit stress tests. Sensitivity rises through the upper fraction bits and spikes at the exponent-mantissa boundary, where a single-bit flip causes catastrophic collapse. Because low-order bits are largely inconsequential while high-order and exponent bits are critical, uniform SECDED protection -- which guards every bit equally at 12.5% storage overhead -- is unnecessarily conservative. We derive per-data-type Xsafe floors (FP16: 6, BF16: 4, FP32: 15) and workload-aware tiers that widen the unprotected region for resilient model classes, raising ECC savings to 37.5-62.5% without retraining. Text-conditioned diffusion models dictate the conservative floor; vision encoders, NLU models, and resilient LLMs tolerate wider bypass regions. These floors and tiers drive an Unequal Error Protection (UEP) codec with per-cacheline data-type tags and a dual-partition SRAM architecture for ML accelerators. Validation across 870+ fault-injection runs confirms selective protection holds under contiguous 2- and 3-bit upsets. The codec reduces ECC area by 27.8% relative to uniform SECDED; dual-voltage operation of the non-critical partition lowers gross BF16 read energy by about 17%, with a roughly 4% dual-partition macro-area overhead.
papers.comment: Accepted to appear at the 59th IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Microarchitecture (MICRO 2026). 14 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过分析16种深度学习模型（包括Transformer和CNN）在不同浮点格式下的比特位故障敏感性，发现低阶有效位故障对任务影响很小，而高阶位和指数位故障会导致灾难性性能下降。据此提出非均匀错误保护（UEP）方案，通过仅保护关键比特位，将ECC存储开销降低37.5%-62.5%，并采用双分区SRAM架构和电压调节，减少BF16读取能量约17%，面积开销约4%。
Motivation: 统一的SEC/DED ECC对所有比特位提供相同保护，但低阶比特位故障对推理精度影响很小，导致不必要的存储和能量开销。
Method: 通过系统性故障注入实验确定各数据类型（FP16/BF16/FP32）的安全比特位阈值Xsafe，并针对不同模型类别（如扩散模型、视觉编码器、NLU模型、鲁棒LLM）设计分层的非保护区域，驱动实现带数据类型标签的UEP编解码器和双分区SRAM架构。
Result: 在870+次故障注入验证中，选择性保护在2/3比特连续翻转下仍然有效。相比均匀SEC/DED，UEP减少27.8%的ECC面积；非关键分区双电压操作降低BF16读取能量约17%，双分区宏单元面积开销约4%。
Conclusion: 通过利用比特位敏感性差异，可以大幅降低ECC开销，同时保持推理精度，适用于多种深度学习工作负载。

papers.title: Understanding Developer Pain Points in Federated Learning: Insights from Stack Overflow and GitHub
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative model training without centralizing raw data, but building and operating FL systems remains difficult due to distributed execution, rapidly evolving frameworks, and privacy and governance requirements. In this paper, we present an empirical study of FL developer challenges by independently analyzing 495 Stack Overflow posts and 9,116 GitHub issues and pull requests from 92 FL-related projects. Using BERTopic-based topic modeling and difficulty indicators such as unresolved rates and median resolution time, we characterize recurring problem areas and compare how they manifest across the two support platforms, Stack Overflow and GitHub. Our analysis surfaces nine dominant Stack Overflow topics and thirteen GitHub topics, with persistent difficulties concentrated in environment setup and dependency compatibility, API breakages and migration, training instability under non-IID data, evaluation and metric correctness, and the integration of privacy-preserving mechanisms. We also categorize posts by question intent to understand the kinds of help developers seek; this intent analysis shows that "How"-type questions dominate, reflecting strong demand for procedural guidance. Several topics, such as "TFF Installation and Environment Compatibility" and "Federated Feature Engineering and SecureBoost Issues," exhibit high unresolved rates and long resolution times, suggesting shortcomings in tooling, documentation, and debugging support. Based on these findings, we provide actionable implications for FL framework designers, documentation authors, and educators. Although our results are constrained to public discussions and a subset of widely discussed frameworks, the study offers a scalable method for continuously monitoring developer pain points and improving the usability, reliability, and deployability of FL systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过分析495个Stack Overflow帖子和92个FL相关项目的9,116个GitHub议题及拉取请求，使用BERTopic主题建模和难度指标（如未解决率和中位解决时间），识别了联邦学习开发者的常见痛点，涵盖环境设置、API变更、非独立同分布数据训练稳定性、评估指标正确性及隐私机制集成等问题。
Motivation: 联邦学习系统开发和运维存在分布式执行、框架快速演变及隐私治理要求等挑战，但开发者实际遇到的困难缺乏系统性实证研究，现有工具和文档支持不足。
Method: 独立分析两个不同平台（Stack Overflow和GitHub）的FL相关讨论，采用BERTopic进行主题建模，结合未解决率、解决时间等指标量化痛点，并按问题意图分类。
Result: 发现Stack Overflow上9个主要主题，GitHub上13个主题；持续困难集中在环境与依赖兼容性、API断裂与迁移、非IID训练不稳定、评估指标正确性、隐私机制集成；“How”类问题占比高，表明对程序性指导需求大；某些主题（如TFF安装与兼容性、联邦特征工程与SecureBoost）未解决率高、解决时间长。
Conclusion: 研究揭示了FL框架设计者、文档作者和教育者应重点改进的领域；虽然结果限于公开讨论和主流框架，但提供了一种可扩展的持续监测开发者痛点的方法。

papers.title: SCPP: A Unified Python Library for Soft Clustering
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we present SCPP (Soft Clustering Python Package), an open-source Python framework for soft clustering. SCPP establishes a canonical, scikit-learn-compatible estimator interface that standardizes model training, prediction, membership representation, evaluation, and benchmarking across heterogeneous soft clustering methods, including fuzzy, probabilistic, graph-based, matrix factorization, and deep learning methods. The framework currently integrates 40 representative algorithms together with a comprehensive benchmarking comprising datasets, clustering quality metrics, and standardized runtime, memory, and scalability evaluation. SCPP further provides extensive documentation, practical examples, automated testing, and seamless integration with the scientific Python ecosystem, enabling reproducible experimentation and straightforward extension with new algorithms. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/soft-clustering/soft-clustering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCPP是一个开源的Python软聚类库，提供了与scikit-learn兼容的统一接口，集成了40种代表性算法，包括模糊、概率、基于图、矩阵分解和深度学习方法，并附带综合基准测试工具。
Motivation: 当前软聚类方法缺乏标准化的编程接口和统一的基准测试框架，导致算法比较和复现困难。
Method: 设计scikit-learn风格的估计器接口，统一训练、预测、成员表示、评估和基准测试流程，并集成多种软聚类算法及自动化测试。
Result: 框架集成了40种算法，提供了包括数据集、聚类质量指标和运行时/内存/可扩展性评估的标准化基准。
Conclusion: SCPP旨在简化软聚类算法的比较和复现，并支持新算法的扩展。

papers.title: Causal dictionary learning reveals and validates transcription-factor binding features in genomic language models
papers.abstract_en: Genomic language models achieve strong performance across regulatory-genomics tasks, yet what these models internally represent remains opaque, and the field lacks a principled procedure for verifying that an apparent ``concept'' inside a model is real rather than an artifact of sequence composition. We introduce a framework that combines sparse dictionary learning with causal intervention to extract, validate, and causally test interpretable features in genomic foundation models. Training top-$k$ sparse autoencoders on the hidden activations of two architecturally distinct models, Nucleotide Transformer ($6$-mer tokenization) and DNABERT-2 (byte-pair encoding), we recover thousands of monosemantic features that map to transcription-factor (TF) sequence motifs. We show that the naive validation of such features against position weight matrices is severely confounded by GC composition and repetitive elements, producing hundreds of spurious ``TF features'', and we develop a composition-matched, binding-resolved protocol that removes these confounds. Critically, we move beyond correlation: by ablating individual dictionary directions during the model's forward pass and measuring the induced shift in the model's own predictive distribution, we establish that specific features are \emph{causally} used to represent cell-type-specific TF binding, not merely motif presence. Across three transcription factors (CTCF, GATA1, REST) and both architectures, causally validated binding features emerge reproducibly ($7$--$14$ of $15$ tested features per condition), while two classes of negative control, scrambled binding labels and randomly selected features, yield no detectable signal. The framework is purely computational, uses only public data, and provides a reusable standard for interpretability claims in genomic deep learning.

papers.title: EGRNet: A Lightweight Semantic Segmentation Network with Edge-Gated Refinement and Adversarial Sensing
papers.abstract_en: As autonomous systems and smart cities continue to evolve, the demand for efficient and robust scene understanding becomes increasingly critical. Semantic segmentation plays a key role in enabling autonomous vehicles to comprehend complex urban environments. However, achieving high accuracy with minimal computational cost remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we present Edge-Gated Refinement Network (EGRNet), a lightweight and efficient deep learning model designed for real-time semantic segmentation in urban scenarios. The model incorporates depthwise separable convolutions to reduce computational complexity and dilated residual blocks for capturing rich multi-scale contextual information. Additionally, we introduce a novel Edge-Gated Refinement (EGR) module, which adaptively fuses original and refined features through a learnable gating mechanism, enhancing boundary preservation and edge-sensitive regions. To further improve feature representation, Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) attention is applied across the network. With only 0.46M parameters, EGRNet achieves state-of-the-art performance while maintaining low computational overhead. When evaluated on the Cityscapes dataset, the model attains a mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) of 65.28%, demonstrating strong accuracy with minimal resource consumption. Moreover, we introduce a lightweight adversarial attack detection strategy, ensuring robustness against adversarial inputs without compromising real-time performance. By combining efficiency, accuracy, and resilience, EGRNet is well-suited for deployment on edge devices in safety-critical real-time applications.
