papers.title: Generating Bearing Vibration Signals at User-Specified Fault Probabilities Using PR-GAN and Counterfactual Methods
papers.abstract_en: In bearing vibration datasets, most samples receive predicted fault probabilities close to 0 or 1, while samples with intermediate (gray-zone) probabilities are rare. Such borderline samples are important because they reflect conditions in which maintenance decisions may require additional inspection or a conservative response and are useful for studying decision boundaries. To address this scarcity, this paper proposes and compares two approaches that generate vibration signals whose predicted fault probability matches a target probability of 0.25, 0.50, or 0.75. We use the average output of a heterogeneous ensemble classifier with different architectures and random initializations as a fixed, gradient-accessible probability oracle. The first, training-based approach, Probability-Regularized Generative Adversarial Network (PR-GAN), extends Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network with Gradient Penalty (WGAN-GP) and edits a real signal through a residual generator while pushing the classifier output toward the target probability. The second is a training-free, per-sample Wachter-style counterfactual (CF) procedure that directly optimizes each input signal to reach the target probability while remaining close to the source signal. We evaluate both methods on the Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) and Paderborn bearing datasets using mean absolute target-probability error, time-domain total variation, and frequency-domain log power spectral density (log-PSD) differences. Across all settings, CF reaches the target with a mean absolute probability error of 0.005-0.008 and a within-tolerance success rate of 1.000 on retained samples, whereas PR-GAN's mean error is 0.046-0.059 with success rates between 0.501 and 0.680. CF therefore steers the probability more reliably and requires smaller average L1 changes, whereas PR-GAN has a lower reported runtime in most settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对轴承振动数据中故障概率处于中间区间（0.25,0.50,0.75）的样本稀缺问题，提出两种生成方法：基于训练的PR-GAN（Probability-Regularized GAN）和无需训练的反事实（CF）优化方法。在CWRU和Paderborn数据集上，CF方法平均绝对概率误差为0.005-0.008且成功率1.000，优于PR-GAN的0.046-0.059误差和0.501-0.680成功率，但PR-GAN运行时间更低。
Motivation: 轴承振动数据集中大部分样本的预测故障概率接近0或1，而中间概率（灰色区域）样本稀少，这些样本对维护决策和决策边界研究至关重要，因此需要生成方法填补这一缺口。
Method: 采用异质集成分类器的平均输出作为固定、梯度可访问的概率预言机。PR-GAN基于WGAN-GP，通过残差生成器编辑真实信号并加入概率正则化项；CF方法则直接优化输入信号以逼近目标概率，同时保持与源信号接近。
Result: 在CWRU和Paderborn数据集上，CF方法平均绝对概率误差0.005-0.008，容忍范围内成功率1.000；PR-GAN误差0.046-0.059，成功率0.501-0.680。CF更可靠且所需L1变化更小，但PR-GAN在多数设置下运行时间更短。
Conclusion: 摘要指出CF方法在概率控制精度和生成信号保真度上优于PR-GAN，但PR-GAN具有计算效率优势；两种方法均可用于生成指定故障概率的振动信号以增强训练数据。

papers.title: Predictive Extrema, Unprofitable Policies: An AI-Assisted Audit of Candle-Based Binance Spot Timing Models
papers.abstract_en: We audit whether candle-based machine-learning models can turn predictions of cryptocurrency extrema or short-horizon outcomes into positive Binance Spot paper policies after assumed costs. Numerical results come from scripted fixed-seed model runs and deterministic simulators; human-supervised AI agents supported the July 20 evidence-integrity revision through literature retrieval, separately tasked critique, artifact reconciliation, documentation, and source packaging, not trading decisions. The strongest later-period evidence, conditional on extensive predecessor search, is negative: an unchanged ten-pair mandatory-daily selector lost 6.72\% over 19 July cycles at an assumed 31-bps completed-cycle cost, with 3 wins and 16 losses. In short model-specific July evaluations, the validation-selected local-minimum policy returned -1.79\%, while the local-maximum sell-to-cash/re-entry policy underperformed continuous holding by 2.80\%; their gross mean advantages of 11.11 and 12.21 bps were below even the 21-bps stress. A Gurgul-inspired, OHLCV-only daily adaptation attained minimum/maximum ROC AUC of 0.874/0.896 but average precision of only 0.134/0.116 and lost 44.30\% over seven cycles, versus -41.20\% for buy-and-hold. A forensic audit also downgraded an earlier One4All "30-day holdout": its dates had influenced prior architecture work, its four-hour outcome horizon was not purged at split boundaries, it used same-close entry, and its raw result directories were absent. Across the tested, mostly exploratory protocols, event-ranking performance did not establish positive executable policy value. Every operational decision remains NO\_TRADE.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables. Simulation-only negative empirical study and human-supervised AI-assisted evidence audit. No live trading or investment advice. Code and available artifacts: https://github.com/AyoubJadouli/Quantbot-Research-Framework
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审计了基于蜡烛图的机器学习模型能否将加密货币极值或短时预测转化为正收益的Binance现货模拟策略。结果显示大多数策略亏损，最优策略在19个周期内亏损6.72%，因此结论是无交易。
Motivation: 加密货币交易中，基于蜡烛图特征和机器学习的极值预测策略是否能在扣除成本后获得正收益尚不明确。
Method: 采用固定种子脚本运行和确定模拟器，结合人类监督的AI辅助审计，评估多种基于蜡烛图的日内预测模型。
Result: 最强的后期证据显示，一个十对强制每日选择器在31bps成本下亏损6.72%（3胜16负）；验证选择局部底部策略亏损1.79%；局部顶部策略跑输持有2.80%。OHLCV自适应模型AUC高但平均精度低，亏损44.30%。
Conclusion: 测试的所有探索性协议中，事件排名性能未能建立正可执行策略价值，最终操作决策均为NO_TRADE。

papers.title: REGEN: Replay-recycling for Expert-to-Generalist distillation with Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale online reinforcement learning (RL) is the predominant means of eliciting advanced abilities including long-term reasoning and agentic tool use in large language models (LLMs). However, continuing to scale it across vast task domains of interest remains challenging in both computational infrastructure and cost, especially when considering RL as merely a one-off learning stage. Recently, a widely used technique for distilling knowledge across various domains and training stages, multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD), helps to decouple the RL stage, saving costs, while maintaining generality across vast domains. Nonetheless, similar to online RL, MOPD requires coupled inference and backward passes, which continues to limit its scalability and computational efficiency. To address these challenges, we propose REGEN: Replay-recycling for Expert-to-Generalist Distillation with Offline RL. Instead of distilling from multiple teacher models, REGEN trains a generalist by simply recycling the replay memory -- the free by-product of the teachers' specialized RL training -- and employing offline RL algorithms. REGEN completely decouples the rollout sampling from the backward training process and thus greatly reduces the training cost. Across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and instruction following, REGEN matches the accuracy of MOPD at substantially lower cost. It potentially turns online RL into a data synthesis process instead of a one-off learning stage, and can potentially be extended to large-scale post-training without requiring heavy computational load.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出REGEN方法，通过回收专家强化学习训练中产生的回放记忆（replay memory）并应用离线强化学习算法来训练通用模型，从而完全解耦采样与训练过程，显著降低计算成本。在数学推理、代码生成和指令跟随任务上，REGEN以更低成本达到了多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）的准确度。
Motivation: 多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）虽然降低了强化学习阶段的成本，但仍需耦合推理与反向传播，限制了可扩展性和计算效率。REGEN旨在通过离线强化学习回收回放记忆，进一步解耦过程，降低成本。
Method: REGEN利用专家强化学习训练中产生的回放记忆（即采样数据）作为唯一数据源，采用离线强化学习算法训练通用模型，完全分离数据采样与模型训练，避免了在线交互和反向传播的耦合。
Result: 在数学推理、代码生成和指令跟随基准上，REGEN匹配了MOPD的准确率，同时大幅降低了训练成本。
Conclusion: REGEN将在线强化学习从一次性学习阶段转变为数据合成过程，有望在无需大量计算负载的情况下扩展到大语言模型的后训练阶段。

papers.title: Guardrails as Scapegoats: Auditing Unfaithful Safety Refusals in Tool-Augmented LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Evaluation frameworks for tool-augmented LLM agents focus overwhelmingly on capability metrics or explicit tool crashes, leaving silent infrastructure failures and HTTP 200 responses with empty, null, or malformed payloads largely unaudited. We introduce a lightweight black-box auditing framework that injects four silent failure profiles across 12 production-adjacent tool stubs and classifies agent responses into three mutually exclusive behavioral classes: Honest Surrender (HSR), Fabrication (FAR), and Unfaithful Safety Refusal (USR). Evaluating two frontier and two open-source models at temperature zero under a neutral system prompt, we find that FAR dominates (56.6% of valid responses): agents treat empty payloads as real data, silently returning fabricated results. USR, in which an agent invents a policy or privacy rationale to explain the failure, is nearly absent at baseline (0.25%, one instance across 396 valid trajectories). Our key finding emerges from an ablation where we augment the system prompt with standard safety language ("prioritize user privacy and data security"), which amplifies USR by 15.6x (from 0.25% to 3.95%; 95% CI on ablation rate: 2.2%-6.4%; Fisher's exact test, p < 0.001). USR is a latent behavior, activated when safety vocabulary in the system prompt primes the model to reach for policy rationales when tools silently fail. Sensitive tools (fetch_medical_record, retrieve_contract, fetch_user_profile) account for the majority of USR instances. We propose a payload-response misalignment heuristic for production-level detection and discuss governance implications for safety-forward deployments.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一个轻量级黑盒审计框架，用于检测工具增强型LLM代理在静默故障（如空或畸形HTTP 200响应）下的行为。通过注入四种静默故障剖面到12个工具桩中，将代理响应分为诚实投降（HSR）、编造（FAR）和不忠实安全拒绝（USR）。评估发现编造占主导地位（56.6%），而不忠实安全拒绝在基线中几乎不存在（0.25%）。关键发现是，当系统提示中加入标准安全语言时，不忠实安全拒绝增加了15.6倍，且主要出现在敏感工具中。
Motivation: 现有评估框架过度关注能力指标或显式工具崩溃，忽略了静默基础设施故障（如空载荷）对代理行为的影响，导致这些故障缺乏审计。
Method: 引入一个轻量级黑盒审计框架，向12个生产级工具桩注入四种静默故障剖面，并定义三类互斥行为：诚实投降、编造和不忠实安全拒绝。在零温度、中性系统提示下评估了两个前沿模型和两个开源模型。
Result: 编造行为占有效响应的56.6%；不忠实安全拒绝在基线中仅出现一次（0.25%）。在提示中添加安全语言后，不忠实安全拒绝增加15.6倍（至3.95%；95% CI: 2.2%-6.4%；p<0.001），主要由敏感工具（如fetch_medical_record）驱动。
Conclusion: 不忠实安全拒绝是一种潜在行为，当安全词汇在系统提示中激活时，模型会为工具静默失败编造政策或隐私理由。提出载荷-响应错位启发式用于生产检测，并讨论了安全部署的治理启示。

papers.title: Marine Engine Fault Dataset: Open-Access Data under Controlled Reference and Fault Scenario Conditions
papers.abstract_en: Open-access datasets for marine-engine predictive maintenance remain scarce, particularly those from controlled fault experiments with documented operating conditions, subsystem-level interventions and system-level measurements. This work presents the Marine Engine Fault Dataset, an openly available dataset from a turbocharged, intercooled three-cylinder marine diesel engine operated on a testbed under both reference and fault-scenario conditions. The experimental campaign combined a reference-performance program across the 30-90% load range with scenario-based tests in which abnormal conditions were introduced after stabilized fault-free operation, enabling controlled comparison between baseline and fault-affected behaviour. Five anomaly classes were implemented through physical interventions affecting major engine subsystems: cooling-water pump cavitation, compressor air-filter clogging, air-cooler fouling, injection-valve nozzle clogging and turbine degradation induced through increased exhaust-side restriction. The released data comprise multi-sensor time-series of operating, thermal, pressure, flow and combustion-related variables, with a separate reference-performance record and metadata for structured reuse. Technical validation shows that the reference measurements remain physically coherent across the operating range and that the imposed anomalies produce interpretable response patterns consistent with the affected subsystems, including progressively distinguishable behaviour where different severities were implemented. By combining controlled fault realization, multi-load operation and system-level measurements within a real marine-engine platform, the dataset provides a well-documented benchmark for anomaly detection, fault diagnosis, degradation modelling and related condition-monitoring studies in maritime machinery.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个公开的船舶发动机故障数据集，来自涡轮增压、中冷的三缸船用柴油机实验台，包含参考工况和五种故障场景（冷却水泵气蚀、压缩机空滤堵塞、空气冷却器结垢、喷油嘴堵塞、涡轮退化）下的多传感器时间序列数据。技术验证表明参考测量值在运行范围内物理一致，故障响应模式可解释。
Motivation: 开放获取的船用发动机预测维护数据集很少，特别是缺乏受控故障实验、带有运行条件记录、子系统级干预和系统级测量的数据集。
Method: 通过实验台架，在30-90%负载范围内运行参考性能程序，并在稳定无故障运行后引入五种物理故障，采集多传感器时间序列数据（运行、热力、压力、流量和燃烧相关变量），并提供元数据。
Result: 参考测量值在运行范围内保持物理一致性，施加的异常产生可解释的响应模式，且不同严重程度的故障行为可逐渐区分。
Conclusion: 该数据集为船舶机械的异常检测、故障诊断、退化建模等提供了有据可查的基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unlearning as Distribution Restoration: A Controlled Counterfactual Study, a Validated Selective Screen, and the Limits of Oracle-Free Certification
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning is commonly evaluated by matching a retrained oracle on trained probes. In a controlled nonce-fact testbed with a matched retraining reference, we find this criterion can favor methods that retain held-out knowledge: candidates it rates adequate score held-out forget facts $-2.82$ nats below the never-learned level (cluster CI $[-3.16,-2.48]$). We recast unlearning as restoration to the matched reference and audit oracle-free screens and certificate-style criteria across 45 model-seed cells spanning five open architecture families. The reference itself falsifies an absolute retain/round-trip certificate: the injected model, which retains the retain set by construction, fails the fixed retain threshold in 41/45 cells and its own round trip in 31/45, and the reference fully certifies in only 1/45. A base-anchored held-out screen remains strong as a selective necessary test: on a sealed challenge suite it rejects the injected model in 45/45 cells, accepts the reference in 44/45, and partially detects entity-routing suppression (35/45); it is a necessary test with measured sensitivity, not a sufficiency certificate. A damage-relative recalibration anchored to the reference's own operating point certifies a small subset in 15/45 cells; where it does not abstain, its picks lie within retraining noise (0.80 nats) on the axes it optimizes, while the common trained-probe criterion sits 5.17 nats away (a supporting comparison, not a head-to-head benchmark). A fixed-magnitude logit-suppression attack defeats the full forward battery in 12/45 cells, so forward-only certification is not sound; our method is an empirical selective test for methods-as-produced. An identifiability theorem delimits which facts admit an oracle-free forget threshold at all, with TOFU as the predicted boundary case.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过受控非事实测试床和匹配的再训练参考，发现常用机器遗忘评估标准可能偏向保留已学知识的方法。作者将遗忘重新定义为分布恢复，审计了无 oracle 筛选和证书标准，发现绝对证书不可靠，而基于基线的持有集筛选作为必要的选择性测试有效。损伤相对重新校准可认证小部分模型，身份识别定理限制可无 oracle 遗忘阈值的范围。
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘评估通常通过匹配再训练 oracle 来评估，但作者发现该标准可能偏向保留已学知识的方法，导致评估有偏。
Method: 通过受控非事实测试床和匹配的再训练参考，重新定义遗忘为分布恢复；审计无 oracle 筛选和证书标准；提出基线的持有集筛选和损伤相对重新校准方法。
Result: 绝对保留/往返证书仅在 1/45 细胞中完全认证；基线持有集筛选拒绝注入模型 45/45，接受参考 44/45；损伤相对校准在 15/45 细胞中认证，其选择在再训练噪声内（0.80 nats），而常见训练探针标准偏差 5.17 nats；固定大小 logit 抑制攻击击败前向电池 12/45。
Conclusion: 强调机器遗忘评估的局限性，提出经验性选择性测试，身份识别定理限制可无 oracle 遗忘阈值的范围，TOFU 为预测边界案例。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BaseRT: Advancing Best-in-Class LLM Inference with Apple M5 Neural Accelerators
papers.abstract_en: Apple's M5 generation introduces a redesigned GPU architecture in which every core carries a dedicated Neural Accelerator: on-die matrix units exposed through the Metal~4 tensor API. We show that BaseRT, our native Metal inference runtime for large language models on Apple Silicon, exploits these units to push inference throughput on Apple hardware substantially beyond both llama.cpp and MLX. Building on BaseRT's framework-free design, we add a family of hand-written Metal~4 tensor-core kernels (including dense and mixture-of-experts GEMM and flash-attention prefill kernels) that route the compute-bound matrix multiplications of inference through the M5 Neural Accelerators while leaving the memory-bound decode path on our existing specialised kernels. On an Apple M5 Pro, across fifteen model configurations spanning the Qwen3, Qwen3.5/3.6, Llama~3.2, and Gemma~4 families from sub-1B to 35B parameters, BaseRT delivers up to $6.4\times$ higher prompt-processing throughput than llama.cpp and $3.9\times$ higher than MLX, with the largest margins on the mixture-of-experts models where matrix multiplication dominates, while maintaining its lead on decode of up to $1.75\times$ over llama.cpp and $1.33\times$ over MLX. These results establish a new performance ceiling for on-device LLM inference and show that the M5's tensor cores are the decisive lever for prompt processing on Apple Silicon. BaseRT is publicly available at https://github.com/basecompute/baseRT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍BaseRT，一个基于Apple M5 Neural Accelerators的原生Metal推理运行时，通过手写Metal 4张量核心核（包括稠密和MoE GEMM、flash-attention预填充核）将计算密集型矩阵运算路由到M5神经加速器，同时保留内存密集的解码路径在已有核上。在M5 Pro上，对15个模型配置（Qwen3、Llama 3.2、Gemma 4等，从<1B到35B参数），BaseRT的提示处理吞吐量比llama.cpp高6.4倍，比MLX高3.9倍，解码吞吐量比llama.cpp高1.75倍，比MLX高1.33倍，建立了苹果设备上LLM推理的新性能上限。
Motivation: 探索Apple M5 GPU架构中每个核心配备的专用神经加速器（Neural Accelerator）对LLM推理的潜力，以超越现有开源方案（llama.cpp、MLX）的吞吐量。
Method: 设计BaseRT框架，添加一系列手写Metal 4张量核心核，包括稠密和混合专家（MoE）的GEMM核以及flash-attention预填充核，将计算密集的矩阵乘法路由至M5 Neural Accelerators，而内存密集的解码路径保留在已有的专用核上。
Result: 在Apple M5 Pro上，跨15个模型配置（Qwen3、Qwen3.5/3.6、Llama 3.2、Gemma 4系列，参数从<1B到35B），BaseRT的提示处理吞吐量比llama.cpp高6.4倍，比MLX高3.9倍，在MoE模型上差距最大；解码吞吐量比llama.cpp高1.75倍，比MLX高1.33倍。
Conclusion: 该工作建立了苹果设备上LLM推理的新性能上限，表明M5张量核心是提示处理的关键杠杆。BaseRT已开源。

papers.title: Group-of-Latents: Perceptual Video Compression at Extreme Bitrates via Masked Latent Generative Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Most existing video compression algorithms follow a paradigm of transformation and quantization, optimizing the trade-off between distortion and bitrate. However, extremely low-bitrate compression remains an underexplored frontier where perceptual quality optimization under severely constrained coding resources has not been adequately addressed. In this paper, we propose a unified generative framework that leverages pre-trained Diffusion Transformer (DiT) priors to achieve high perceptual quality at extremely low bitrates. We first introduce a flexible Group-of-Latents (GoL) strategy within the latent space of a causal tokenizer, explicitly partitioning the latent stream into intra $I$-latents and inter $P$-latents. The Deep Compression Module (I-DCM) then encodes key $I$-latents to preserve perceptual anchors with minimal overhead. Building upon these anchors, the DiT-based Unified Latent Denoising Module (U-LDM) refines intra-frame textures and synthesizes $P$-latents from noise, reconstructing temporal dynamics at zero additional bitrate cost. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method uniquely operates in the extreme-low-bitrate regime (e.g., (<0.005) bpp), achieving state-of-the-art perceptual fidelity with rich spatial details and robust temporal consistency. The code will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于预训练扩散变压器 (Diffusion Transformer, DiT) 先验的统一生成框架，用于极端低码率下的感知视频压缩。通过因果分词器潜空间中的分组潜变量 (Group-of-Latents, GoL) 策略，将潜流分为帧内 I-潜变量和帧间 P-潜变量，并利用深度压缩模块 (I-DCM) 以最小开销编码关键 I-潜变量，再由基于 DiT 的统一潜变量去噪模块 (U-LDM) 细化帧内纹理并从噪声合成 P-潜变量，实现零额外码率的时域动态重建。实验表明，该方法在极端低码率区域（<0.005 bpp）取得最先进的感知保真度，具备丰富的空间细节和鲁棒的时域一致性。
Motivation: 现有视频压缩算法在极低码率下难以平衡失真与码率，感知质量优化未得到充分解决。
Method: 提出 Group-of-Latents (GoL) 策略，在因果分词器潜空间划分 I-潜变量和 P-潜变量；使用 Deep Compression Module (I-DCM) 编码关键 I-潜变量；使用 DiT-based Unified Latent Denoising Module (U-LDM) 进行帧内纹理细化并合成 P-潜变量。
Result: 在极端低码率（<0.005 bpp）下，该方法实现了最先进的感知保真度，生成丰富的空间细节和稳定的时域连续性。
Conclusion: 该框架在极低码率压缩任务中展现了优越的感知质量，但其依赖于预训练的 DiT 模型和特定因果分词器，通用性和训练复杂度可能是未来工作方向。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在极端低码率（<0.005 bpp）下，该方法实现了最先进的感知保真度，生成丰富的空间细节和稳定的时域连续性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架在极低码率压缩任务中展现了优越的感知质量，但其依赖于预训练的 DiT 模型和特定因果分词器，通用性和训练复杂度可能是未来工作方向。

papers.title: Building Trust in Autonomous Commerce: A Verifiable Global Event Timeline and AI-Ready Fraud Intelligence Layer
papers.abstract_en: Agentic commerce protocols such as AP2 and ACP define mechanisms for secure agent-initiated transactions but do not provide interoperable, tamper-evident auditability or verifiable temporal ordering of events across heterogeneous domains. This paper addresses these gaps by proposing a verifiable global event timeline for agentic commerce, constructed from four core components: canonical event schemas that enforce deterministic serialization, deterministic batch formation ensuring reproducible ordering without reliance on synchronized clocks, Merkle-based append-only commitments providing logarithmic-cost inclusion proofs, and blockchain anchoring establishing a tamper-evident temporal backbone. Building on this infrastructure, we introduce a cryptographically signed fraud marker that binds risk labels to anchored evidence through an unforgeable provenance chain, and a dataset lineage model enabling reproducible, tamper-evident AI training pipelines. Empirical results from a prototype implementation demonstrate: Merkle tree construction processes 50,000 events in 47 milliseconds; end-to-end verification completes in under 0.013 milliseconds regardless of batch size; inclusion proof sizes grow logarithmically from 320 bytes at 1,000 events to 512 bytes at 50,000 events; and Merkle-based verification outperforms linear scan by 14.4x at 50,000 events.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 4 tables, 1 figure. Preprint also available on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19060285
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自主商务协议（如AP2、ACP）缺乏可互操作、防篡改的审计能力和跨域事件时序验证的问题，提出了一种可验证全局事件时间线。该时间线由四个核心组件构成：规范事件模式（确保确定性序列化）、确定性批次形成（无需同步时钟即可复现排序）、基于Merkle的仅追加承诺（提供对数级包含证明）、以及区块链锚定（建立防篡改时间骨干）。在此基础上，引入了加密签名欺诈标记（通过不可伪造的溯源链将风险标签绑定到锚定证据）和数据集谱系模型（支持可复现、防篡改的AI训练流程）。原型实现表明：Merkle树构建可在47毫秒内处理5万事件；端到端验证在0.013毫秒内完成；包含证明大小从1000事件的320字节对数增长到5万事件的512字节；Merkle验证在5万事件时比线性扫描快14.4倍。
Motivation: 现有代理商务协议定义了安全代理发起交易的机制，但缺乏跨异构域的可互操作、防篡改审计能力和事件时序验证，导致自主商务中信任基础薄弱。
Method: 提出可验证全局事件时间线，包括规范事件模式、确定性批次形成、Merkle树仅追加承诺和区块链锚定；并基于此构建加密签名欺诈标记和数据集谱系模型。
Result: 原型实现中，Merkle树构建处理5万事件耗时47毫秒；端到端验证时间低于0.013毫秒（与批次大小无关）；包含证明大小对数增长（320字节至512字节）；Merkle验证比线性扫描快14.4倍。

papers.title: PRiSM: Prototype Regularization for Few-Shot VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Training-free few-shot adaptation methods have gained significant attention recently in the context of Vision-language Models (VLMs). Yet, current benchmarks rely on strong assumptions about the statistics of the adaptation data, e.g., class balance. We question these simplifying assumptions and introduce a more realistic benchmark that varies both the levels of class balance and the effective number of classes in few-shot tasks via Dirichlet sampling. Surprisingly, under our setting, we observe substantial drops in the performances of state-of-the-art methods, more so when the number of labeled samples increases. To mitigate this, we introduce PRiSM, a class-prototype regularization that can be deployed as a plug and play module on top of any existing baseline method, significantly improving performances. Our method optimizes a novel multi-term loss, which includes a regularizer maximizing inter-class pairwise distances, along with additional terms promoting support-feature alignment and fidelity to the baseline prototypes. Furthermore, we introduce an effective and computationally efficient block Majorize-Minimize optimizer for our objective. More specifically, we derive a valid blockwise Lipschitz constant (i.e., a bound on the Hessian's spectral norm), which can be computed efficiently via the Gershgorin circle theorem. Extensive experiments show that PRiSM improves several training-free baselines, with large gains when dealing with severe class imbalance and high numbers of classes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对训练自由的少样本视觉语言模型（VLM）适应方法在类别不平衡和有效类别数变化时的性能下降问题，提出了一种原型正则化方法PRiSM。该方法通过最大化类间距离、支持特征对齐和基线原型保真度的多损失项，并采用基于块Majorize-Minimize的高效优化器，显著提升了现有基线在严重类别不平衡和高类别数场景下的性能。
Motivation: 当前训练自由的少样本VLM适应方法假设适应数据类平衡，但现实场景中常存在类别不平衡和有效类别数变化，导致性能大幅下降。
Method: 提出PRiSM，一种即插即用的类原型正则化模块，优化包含最大化类间成对距离、支持特征对齐和基线原型保真度的新多损失项，并采用块Majorize-Minimize优化器，通过Gershgorin圆定理高效计算块Lipschitz常数。
Result: 在引入Dirichlet采样变化的类平衡和有效类别数的新基准下，PRiSM显著改善了多种训练自由基线，尤其在严重类别不平衡和高类别数时增益巨大。
Conclusion: PRiSM是一种有效的即插即用模块，可应用于任何现有基线方法，提升在复杂少样本场景下的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Environment-free Synthetic Data Generation for API-Calling Agents
papers.abstract_en: Training API-calling large language model (LLM) agents demands massive amounts of high-quality trajectories. However, collecting such data at scale typically requires fully implemented environments with executable APIs and realistic, pre-populated backend databases, creating a major bottleneck for scalability. To overcome this, we propose an environment-free synthetic data generation approach that leverages LLMs as on-the-fly digital world models. Given only API specifications, our method generates trajectories mimicking interactions between an agent and a stateful environment. Specifically, an LLM first generates diverse tasks solvable with the provided APIs. A teacher agent then iteratively solves each task while an LLM simulator generates coherent synthetic API responses conditioned on the task context and simulation history. Finally, an LLM judge filters the trajectories to ensure the quality of the resulting dataset. We evaluate our approach on the challenging AppWorld and OfficeBench benchmarks, which include both information-retrieval and state-changing tasks. Fine-tuning models on our synthetic data yields significant performance gains, demonstrating that effective supervision for API-calling agents can be generated without any executable environment. Our results establish LLM-based API simulation as a practical, scalable solution for training agents across diverse API ecosystems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对训练API调用语言模型代理需要大量高质量轨迹数据但依赖完整可执行环境的问题，本文提出一种无环境合成数据生成方法，仅凭API规格，利用LLM作为数字世界模型生成轨迹，并在AppWorld和OfficeBench上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖完整可执行环境和预填充后端数据库来收集训练数据，成为扩展API调用代理训练的主要瓶颈。
Method: 方法包含三步：LLM生成多样任务；教师代理逐步求解，同时LLM模拟器生成与任务上下文一致的API响应；LLM裁判过滤低质量轨迹。
Result: 在AppWorld和OfficeBench基准上，使用合成数据微调模型获得显著性能提升，证明无需可执行环境即可生成有效监督信号。
Conclusion: 基于LLM的API模拟为跨不同API生态训练代理提供了实用且可扩展的解决方案。

papers.title: Test-Input Generation for Tensor Programs: What Actually Finds Kernel Bugs
papers.abstract_en: Test-input generation for tensor kernels is folkloric. Most projects pick a representative shape and dtype, run a fixed-shape allclose-style check, and ship. We make the choices explicit and measure them. Using the gpuemu op-schema-aware seeded fuzzer (arXiv:2606.20128), we evaluate seven test-generation strategies across a 26-op corpus (16 correct controls and 10 LLM-style buggy variants seeded with documented transcription patterns) on an RTX 3060 GPU instance. Strategies vary the shape candidate set, the dtype mix, and the input value distribution. We report each strategy on two axes: bug recall and control false-positive (FP) rate. Boundary-only shape sampling is the operationally safe winner: 78% recall on the 10 buggy kernels with 0% FP on the 16 controls. Adversarial value sampling reaches higher recall (99%) but inflates control FP to 94% because the strategy injects NaN and Inf inputs and the validator's NaN check fires on every kernel that propagates them, not only on buggy kernels. On the two softmax tail-mask bugs the "regular" strategy (no boundary shapes) catches 0%, while boundary raises recall to 100% and 62% respectively. That gap is the clearest single signal in the data. The corpus result is about which seeded bug patterns each strategy catches, not about the bug rate of any specific deployed LLM.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, LNCS format. Companion paper: arXiv:2606.20128
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了张量内核测试中不同测试输入生成策略（形状候选集、数据类型混合、输入值分布）的bug召回率和控制假阳性率。基于gpuemu操作模式感知种子模糊器，在26个算子语料库（16个正确控制组和10个注入LLM式转录模式的bug变体）上进行实验。结果表明，仅边界形状采样在操作上最安全：对10个bug内核召回率78%，对16个控制组假阳性率为0%。对抗性值采样召回率更高（99%）但控制假阳性率膨胀至94%。在softmax尾部掩码bug上，常规策略召回0%，边界策略分别提升至100%和62%。
Motivation: 张量内核的测试输入生成缺乏系统研究，项目通常凭经验选择形状和数据类型，缺乏对不同策略效果的量化比较。
Method: 使用gpuemu操作模式感知种子模糊器，评估七种测试生成策略，这些策略在形状候选集、数据类型混合和输入值分布上有所变化。在包含16个正确控制组和10个注入LLM式转录模式bug变体的26个算子语料库上进行实验。
Result: 边界形状采样以78%召回率和0%假阳性率成为操作安全优胜者；对抗性值采样召回率99%但假阳性率94%；常规策略对softmax尾部掩码bug召回率为0%，边界策略提升至100%和62%。
Conclusion: 实验揭示了不同策略的权衡：边界形状采样在保持低假阳性率的同时提供合理的bug召回率，而对抗性值采样虽然召回率高但会导致大量误报。该结果关注的是每种策略能捕获哪些种子bug模式，而非特定LLM的bug率。

papers.title: Do Data Agents Need Semantic Metadata? A Comparative Study in Agentic Data Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: In the era of autonomous agents, machine-actionable data is critical for data-driven workflows. For more than a decade, semantic metadata like schema$.$org has anchored the FAIR principles (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable) for machine-actionable data and enabled discovery tools like Google Dataset Search. However, the rise of Large Language Models (LLMs) capable of navigating the unstructured web raises a fundamental question: Is semantic metadata still necessary for agentic data discovery, or can agents reliably retrieve actionable data directly from the web? We present a comparative analysis of agentic data retrieval across two distinct environments: a Baseline Agent searching billions of open-web documents, and a Semantic Agent leveraging a corpus of 90 million datasets using schema$.$org. We deploy an "LLM-as-a-judge" evaluation pipeline, mapped directly to the FAIR principles, to assess the semantic relevance, data accessibility, and computational utility of the retrieved data. Our results reveal a clear divergence. The Semantic Agent excels at retrieving actionable data, achieving a 44.9% higher precision for metadata-rich registries and a 46.6% higher precision for pages with machine-readable downloads among its returned results. Conversely, the Baseline Agent frequently suffers "Last-Mile Utility" failures, retrieving prose-heavy pages (20.1% of results) and portal landing pages (8.5%) rather than actual data pages. While the Baseline Agent achieves higher coverage by answering 40% more questions, the Semantic Agent delivers greater accuracy, achieving 65.7% higher overall precision in retrieving FAIR-compliant datasets. We conclude that while unstructured retrieval supports broad exploratory tasks, structured ecosystems remain the indispensable foundation for reliable, execution-oriented autonomous workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了智能体在两种环境下进行数据检索的效果：基线智能体搜索开放网页，语义智能体使用 schema.org 元数据检索 9000 万数据集。结果表明，语义智能体在检索可操作数据方面精度更高，但在覆盖范围上不如基线智能体。研究指出，结构化元数据对于面向执行的自主动工作流仍然不可或缺。
Motivation: 随着 LLM 能够导航非结构化网页，需要重新评估语义元数据（如 schema.org）对于智能体数据发现是否仍然必要。
Method: 构建两个智能体环境（基线智能体搜索开放网页，语义智能体利用 schema.org 元数据），并采用 LLM-as-a-judge 评估管道，直接映射到 FAIR 原则来评估检索数据的语义相关性、可访问性和计算效用。
Result: 语义智能体在检索可操作数据方面表现出更高精度：元数据丰富注册表的精度提高 44.9%，机器可读下载页面的精度提高 46.6%；整体精度提高 65.7%。基线智能体虽回答更多问题（覆盖率高 40%），但常返回散文页面或门户页面。
Conclusion: 非结构化检索适用于广泛探索性任务，但结构化元数据生态系统仍是可靠、面向执行的自主动作工作流的基础。

summary_sections.method: 构建两个智能体环境（基线智能体搜索开放网页，语义智能体利用 schema.org 元数据），并采用 LLM-as-a-judge 评估管道，直接映射到 FAIR 原则来评估检索数据的语义相关性、可访问性和计算效用。
summary_sections.result: 语义智能体在检索可操作数据方面表现出更高精度：元数据丰富注册表的精度提高 44.9%，机器可读下载页面的精度提高 46.6%；整体精度提高 65.7%。基线智能体虽回答更多问题（覆盖率高 40%），但常返回散文页面或门户页面。
summary_sections.conclusion: 非结构化检索适用于广泛探索性任务，但结构化元数据生态系统仍是可靠、面向执行的自主动作工作流的基础。

papers.title: Stability of Low-Rank Implicit Regularization in Perturbed Deep Matrix Factorization
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies the stability of low-rank implicit regularization in deep matrix factorization, a tractable model for understanding how gradient-based training can favor low-complexity structure. We first revisit the noiseless setting and derive sufficient spectral conditions under which gradient descent exhibits a nonempty low-rank interval. These conditions clarify how the target spectrum, initialization, and step size jointly determine when a low-rank phase is observable along the optimization trajectory. We then analyze the perturbed problem, where the target matrix is subject to an additive perturbation. By studying the perturbed gradient descent dynamics at the eigenvalue level, we prove convergence guarantees and quantify how the perturbation size affects iteration complexity and eigenvalue recovery. Finally, we establish stability of the low-rank phase under perturbation: the effective rank of the iterates remains close to that of the rank-L approximation of the noiseless target over a perturbed low-rank interval, with explicit dependence on the perturbation size. Numerical illustrations support the theoretical predictions and illustrate the role of spectral structure in determining when this stability is observed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究深度矩阵分解中低秩隐式正则化的稳定性。首先在无噪声情形下推导了梯度下降展现非空低秩区间的充分谱条件，阐明目标谱、初始化和步长如何共同决定优化轨迹中低秩阶段的可观察性。随后分析加性扰动下的矩阵分解问题，通过研究扰动梯度下降的特征值动力学，证明收敛性并量化扰动大小对迭代复杂度和特征值恢复的影响。最后建立低秩阶段在扰动下的稳定性：迭代的有效秩与无噪声目标秩L近似在扰动低秩区间内保持接近，并给出对扰动大小的显式依赖。数值实验验证了理论预测，并说明谱结构在决定稳定性中的作用。
Motivation: 理解梯度训练如何隐式地偏好低秩结构，并探究该偏好对扰动的鲁棒性，是揭示深度学习中隐式正则化机理的关键。
Method: 基于特征值层面的梯度下降动力学分析，推导无噪声情形下的充分谱条件；将加法扰动加入目标矩阵，分析扰动的传播并建立稳定性边界。
Result: 给出无噪声下低秩区间存在的谱条件；证明扰动下梯度下降的收敛性，并显式刻画扰动大小对迭代复杂度的影响；证明低秩阶段在扰动下的稳定性，迭代有效秩与无噪声秩L近似程度受扰动大小控制。
Conclusion: 论文强调谱结构在决定低秩隐式正则化稳定性中的关键作用，理论结果由数值实验支持。

papers.title: Temporal Fair Division in Multi-Agent Systems: From Precise Alternation Metrics to Scalable Coordination Proxies
papers.abstract_en: Many intelligent computing and autonomous systems rely on multiple independent, often learning, agents repeatedly sharing a limited resource. Examples include autonomous robots accessing a shared workstation, wireless devices competing for communication opportunities, and distributed AI agents coordinating access to shared computational resources. While conventional fairness measures assess whether resources are shared equally overall, they cannot distinguish orderly turn-taking from irregular access patterns that produce long and unpredictable waiting times despite similar cumulative outcomes. We introduce Rotational Periodicity (RP), a computationally efficient metric that evaluates both the regularity of waiting times between successful accesses and the balance of access frequencies across agents. We evaluate RP alongside a family of more detailed alternation metrics using a repeated threshold-congestion game in which two to ten reinforcement-learning agents compete for exclusive access to a shared resource. Our experiments reveal that independently trained agents often coordinate substantially worse than random-policy agents, even though conventional fairness metrics consistently report highly favourable outcomes. At the same time, RP closely reproduces the rankings of the more computationally expensive alternation metrics while computing twelve to twenty-five times faster as the number of agents increases. These findings show that evaluating multi-agent learning systems requires temporally aware measures of coordination, not only aggregate outcomes, and that efficient proxy metrics such as RP make this type of evaluation practical for larger intelligent computing systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出旋转周期（Rotational Periodicity, RP）这一计算高效的时间公平性度量，用于评估多智能体系统中资源访问的规律性。实验表明，独立训练的强化学习智能体的协调能力常不如随机策略智能体，而RP能近似更复杂的交替性度量，计算速度快12-25倍。
Motivation: 现有公平性度量只能评估资源总量是否均分，无法区分有序轮换与不规则访问模式（后者会导致长且不可预测的等待时间）。
Method: 定义旋转周期（RP）指标，同时考察访问成功之间的等待时间规律性和各智能体访问频率的均衡性；通过重复阈值拥塞博弈实验（2-10个强化学习智能体竞争独占资源）进行验证。
Result: 独立训练的智能体协调性显著差于随机策略智能体，但传统公平性指标却报告了有利结果；RP与计算昂贵的交替性度量排名高度一致，且随智能体数量增加计算速度快12-25倍。
Conclusion: 评估多智能体学习系统需要时间感知的协调度量（而非仅聚合结果），RP作为高效代理指标使此类评估在大规模系统中变得可行。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prober.ai: Gated Inquiry-Based Feedback via LLM-Constrained Personas for Argumentative Writing Development
papers.abstract_en: The proliferation of large language models (LLMs) in educational settings has paradoxically undermined the cognitive processes they purport to support. Students increasingly outsource critical thinking to AI assistants that generate polished text on demand, resulting in measurable cognitive debt and diminished argumentative reasoning skills. We present Prober.ai, a web-based writing environment that inverts the conventional AI-tutoring paradigm: rather than generating or rewriting student text, the system constrains an LLM (Gemini 3 Flash Preview) through persona-specific system prompts and structured JSON output schemas to produce only targeted, inquiry-based questions about argumentative weaknesses. A two-phase interaction architecture -- Challenge and Unlock -- implements a pedagogical friction mechanism whereby revision suggestions are gated behind mandatory student reflection. The system's design is grounded in Toulmin's argumentation theory, research on peer feedforward questioning mechanisms, and evidence on AI-supported feedback in writing instruction. A functional prototype was developed in 36 hours during the NY EdTech Hackathon (March 2026), where it was awarded second place. We describe the system architecture, the prompt engineering methodology for constraining LLM output to pedagogically aligned JSON schemas, and discuss implications for scalable, cognition-preserving AI integration in writing education.
papers.comment: Prototype awarded second place at the NYEdTech Hackathon (March 2026) https://www.nyedtechhackathon.com/2026-submissions
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Prober.ai 是一个基于 LLM 约束人物角色的论点写作辅助系统，通过结构化 JSON 输出生成定向探究式问题，而非直接生成或改写学生文本。系统采用“挑战-解锁”两阶段交互架构，要求学生在获得修改建议前进行强制性反思。原型在 NY EdTech Hackathon 中获得第二名。
Motivation: 学生在写作中过度依赖 AI 生成文本，导致认知债务和论证推理能力下降，现有 AI 辅导模式未能保护学生的认知过程。
Method: 利用 Gemini 3 Flash Preview 模型，通过人物角色系统提示和结构化 JSON 输出模式约束 LLM 仅生成针对论点弱点的探究式问题。系统设计基于 Toulmin 论证理论、同侪反馈提问机制和 AI 反馈写作教学研究，采用“挑战”与“解锁”两阶段实现教学摩擦。
Result: 功能原型在 36 小时内开发完成，并在 NY EdTech Hackathon（2026 年 3 月）中获得第二名。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了通过约束 LLM 输出为结构化探究式问题，可以在写作教育中实现可扩展、保护认知的 AI 整合。

papers.title: Material-agnostic temperature field prediction for metal additive manufacturing via a parametric PINN framework
papers.abstract_en: Accurate temperature field prediction in metal additive manufacturing (AM) is essential for understanding the process-structure-performance relationship. While prior studies have explored generalization to unseen process conditions, they often require extensive datasets, costly retraining, or pre-training. Generalization across different materials also remains relatively unexplored due to the challenges posed by distinct material-dependent thermal behaviors. This paper introduces a parametric physics-informed neural network (PINN) framework for generalization across unseen materials without labeled data, retraining, or pre-training. The framework adopts a decoupled parametric PINN architecture that separately encodes material properties and spatiotemporal coordinates, fusing them through conditional modulation to better align with the multiplicative role of material parameters in the governing equation and boundary conditions. Physics-guided output scaling derived from Rosenthal's analytical solution and a hybrid optimization strategy are further incorporated to enhance physical consistency, training stability, and convergence. Experiments with numerical simulations across diverse metal alloys, including both in-distribution and out-of-distribution cases, demonstrate effective generalizability along with superior training efficiency. Specifically, the proposed framework achieved up to a 64.2% reduction in relative L2 error compared to the non-parametric baseline while surpassing its performance within only 4.4% of the baseline training epochs. Ablation studies clarify each component's contribution and scrutinize the severe training instability prevalent in conventional parametric PINNs. Overall, the proposed framework provides an efficient and scalable material-agnostic solution for temperature field modeling, contributing to more flexible and practical deployment in metal AM.
papers.journal_ref: Additive Manufacturing 127 (2026) 105289
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种参数化物理信息神经网络（PINN）框架，用于金属增材制造中温度场的预测，无需标签数据、重新训练或预训练。该框架通过解耦编码材料属性与时空坐标，并结合Rosenthal解析解指导的输出缩放与混合优化策略，实现了对多种未知合金的有效泛化。实验表明，相对L2误差比非参数基线降低64.2%，且仅需4.4%的训练轮次即可超越基线性能。
Motivation: 现有温度场预测方法难以泛化到不同材料，且依赖大量数据集或昂贵重训练，跨材料泛化因材料依赖的热行为差异而鲜有探索。
Method: 采用解耦参数化PINN架构，分别编码材料属性和时空坐标，通过条件调制融合；引入Rosenthal解析解指导的物理约束输出缩放及混合优化策略以增强训练稳定性与收敛性。
Result: 在数值模拟实验中，相比非参数基线，相对L2误差降低64.2%，且仅需基线4.4%的训练轮次即实现更优性能。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了高效、可扩展的材料无关温度场建模方案，有助于金属增材制造中更灵活、实用的部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An Auditable Policy-Simulation Framework for Student Dropout in Intervention-Free Data
papers.abstract_en: This study proposes a temporal modeling framework with a counterfactual policy-simulation layer for student dropout in higher education, using LMS engagement data and administrative withdrawal records. Dropout is operationalized as a time-to-event outcome at the enrollment level; weekly risk is modeled in discrete time via penalized, class-balanced logistic regression over person--period rows. Under a late-event temporal holdout, the model attains row-level AUCs of 0.8350 (train) and 0.8405 (test), with aggregate calibration acceptable but sparsely supported in the highest-risk bins. Ablation analyses indicate performance is sensitive to feature set composition, underscoring the role of temporal engagement signals. A scenario-indexed policy layer produces survival contrasts $ΔS(T)$ under an explicit trigger/schedule contract: positive contrasts are confined to the shock branch ($T_{\rm policy}=18$: 0.0102, 0.0260, 0.0819), while the mechanism-aware branch is negative ($ΔS_{\rm mech}(18)=-0.0078$, $ΔS_{\rm mech}(38)=-0.0134$). A subgroup analysis by gender quantifies scenario-induced survival gaps via bootstrap; contrasts are directionally stable but small. Results are not causally identified; they demonstrate the framework's capacity for internal structural scenario comparison under observational data constraints.
papers.comment: Approx. 20 pages, 9 figures. Code and reproducibility package available at https://github.com/rafa-rodriguess/TCM-Student-Dropout This work introduces a temporal survival framework with counterfactual policy simulation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个时间建模框架，结合反事实政策模拟层，用于高等教育学生辍学预测。利用LMS参与数据和管理退学记录，将辍学建模为随时间的生存事件，通过惩罚的类别平衡逻辑回归对离散时间风险进行建模。在时间划分下，AUC约为0.84。政策模拟层产生生存对比，但结果并非因果识别，展示了框架在观测数据约束下进行内部结构场景比较的能力。
Motivation: 学生辍学预测中，数据通常无干预，而现有方法难以进行反事实政策模拟。本文旨在提出一个可审计的框架，能够在不依赖干预数据的情况下模拟不同政策对学生生存率的影响。
Method: 将辍学视为时间到事件的结果，在注册级别建模，每周风险通过惩罚、类别平衡的逻辑回归在个体-时间行上建模。引入政策模拟层，基于显式触发/时间表合同生成生存对比，包括冲击分支和机制感知分支。
Result: 模型在时间保持集上达到行级AUC 0.8350（训练）和0.8405（测试）。政策模拟显示冲击分支在T_policy=18时生存对比为正（0.0102, 0.0260, 0.0819），而机制感知分支为负。性别子组分析显示方向稳定但差异较小。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了内部结构场景比较能力，但结果并非因果识别，受限于观测数据约束。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 模型在时间保持集上达到行级AUC 0.8350（训练）和0.8405（测试）。政策模拟显示冲击分支在T_policy=18时生存对比为正（0.0102, 0.0260, 0.0819），而机制感知分支为负。性别子组分析显示方向稳定但差异较小。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法提供了内部结构场景比较能力，但结果并非因果识别，受限于观测数据约束。

papers.title: A Unified Survival Benchmark for Temporal Dropout Risk Prediction in Learning Analytics
papers.abstract_en: Student dropout is a persistent concern in Learning Analytics, yet comparative studies frequently evaluate predictive models under heterogeneous protocols, prioritizing discrimination over temporal interpretability and calibration. This study introduces a survival-oriented benchmark for temporal dropout risk modelling using the Open University Learning Analytics Dataset (OULAD). Two arms are compared: Family A: Dynamic Weekly, with models in person-period representation, and Family B: Static Early-Window, with an expanded roster of families: tree-based survival, parametric, and neural models. The evaluation protocol integrates four analytical layers: predictive performance, ablation, explainability, and calibration. Results are reported within each family separately, because a single numerical cross-family ranking would conflate genuine model differences with artifacts of temporal representation, to which survival metrics are known to be sensitive. Within Family B, Random Survival Forest showed the highest point estimates for time-dependent concordance and the lowest Brier scores across all three horizons; within Family A, Poisson Piecewise-Exponential showed the lowest point estimate for integrated Brier score within a tight five-model cluster. No-refit bootstrap resampling qualifies these positions as directional signals, not claims of strict superiority. Ablation and explainability analyses converged, across all models, on a shared finding: the dominant predictive signal was not primarily demographic or structural, but temporal and behavioral. Calibration corroborated this pattern in the better-discriminating models, except for XGBoost AFT, the sole outlier (analyzed in the Discussion). These results support unified, multi-dimensional benchmarking in Learning Analytics and situate dropout risk as a temporal-behavioral process rather than a function of static background attributes.
papers.comment: 64 pages, 11 figures, 20 tables, 63 references. Survival analysis benchmark for student dropout prediction using OULAD dataset
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向学习分析中时间性辍学风险建模的生存分析基准，使用OULAD数据集，比较动态周表示（Family A）和静态早窗表示（Family B）两类模型家族。评估集成预测性能、消融、可解释性和校准四个分析层，发现主要预测信号是时间行为而非人口统计特征。
Motivation: 学习分析中学生辍学预测的比较研究常使用异构协议，侧重区分度而忽视时间解释性和校准，缺乏统一的生存分析基准。
Method: 构建生存导向基准，将模型分为动态周（person-period表示）和静态早窗两个家族，包含树生存、参数和神经网络模型，通过预测性能、消融、可解释性和校准四层评估。
Result: 在Family B中Random Survival Forest在时间依赖一致性上点估计最高、Brier分数最低；在Family A中Poisson Piecewise-Exponential在集成Brier分数上点估计最低。消融和可解释性分析表明所有模型的主要预测信号是时间行为而非人口统计。
Conclusion: 支持学习分析中统一的多维基准测试，强调辍学风险应被视为时间行为过程而非静态背景属性的函数。

papers.title: Measuring LLM Trust Allocation Across Conflicting Software Artifacts
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based software engineering assistants often reason over multiple artifacts, including code, documentation, signatures, and tests, even when those artifacts are incomplete or mutually inconsistent. Existing evaluations primarily measure final outputs, leaving unclear whether a model recognized unreliable evidence, identified the faulty source, or prioritized the appropriate artifact. We introduce TRACE, a controlled method for evaluating how LLMs assess and prioritize conflicting software artifacts. TRACE constructs paired clean and perturbed versions of real-world Java method bundles by injecting known faults into the documentation, implementation, or both while holding the remaining artifacts fixed. Models then assess artifact quality, detect and localize inconsistencies, and rank the available sources by reliability. Using 22,339 valid responses from seven LLMs on 456 method bundles, we find that quality penalties are generally localized to the perturbed artifact and increase with fault severity. However, models exhibit a consistent source-origin asymmetry: they detect documentation faults at 67-94% and explicit documentation-implementation contradictions at 50-91%, but detection falls by 21-43 percentage points when only the implementation changes while documentation remains intact. Models also struggle to deprioritize faulty implementations, and confidence provides little separation between correct and incorrect judgments for six of seven models. These results show that current LLMs are not symmetric integrators of software evidence: they audit natural-language specifications more reliably than subtle implementation behavior. TRACE provides a controlled method for exposing this failure mode before LLMs are used in correctness-critical software engineering workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 当前LLM在软件工程中评估工件质量时，主要关注最终输出，忽略了模型是否识别不可靠证据或正确优先考虑工件。为此，本文提出TRACE方法，通过注入已知错误到文档或实现中，构建干净和扰动版本的方法束，评估LLM对工件质量的判断、不一致性检测和可靠性排序。实验发现，模型对文档错误检测率高（67-94%），但对仅实现错误的检测率下降21-43个百分点，且难以降低错误实现的优先级。这表明当前LLM不是对称的软件证据集成者。
Motivation: 现有评估仅测量最终输出，无法揭示模型是否识别不可靠证据、定位错误源或优先考虑合适工件，导致LLM在关键软件工程流程中的可靠性未知。
Method: 提出TRACE方法，基于现实Java方法束构建配对干净和扰动版本，在文档、实现或两者中注入已知故障，固定其余工件。模型需评估工件质量、检测和定位不一致性，并对可用来源进行可靠性排序。
Result: 在7个LLM、456个方法束的22,339个有效响应中，文档故障检测率67-94%，文档-实现矛盾检测率50-91%，但仅实现变化时检测率下降21-43个百分点。模型难以降级错误实现，且置信度在正确与错误判断间区分度低。
Conclusion: 当前LLM不是对称的软件证据集成者，更可靠地审计自然语言规范而非实现行为。TRACE提供了一种可控方法，在LLM用于正确性关键的软件工程工作流前暴露此失败模式。

papers.title: Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search for Modern AI: A Projection-Augmented Graph Approach
papers.abstract_en: Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (ANNS) is fundamental to modern AI applications. Most existing solutions optimize query efficiency but fail to align with the practical requirements of modern workloads. In this paper, we outline six critical demands of modern AI applications: high query efficiency, fast indexing, low memory footprint, scalability to high dimensionality, robustness across varying retrieval sizes, and support for online insertions. To satisfy all these demands, we introduce Projection-Augmented Graph (PAG), a new ANNS framework that integrates projection techniques into a graph index. PAG reduces unnecessary exact distance computations through asymmetric comparisons between exact and approximate distances as guided by projection-based statistical tests. Three key components are designed and integrated into the graph index to optimize indexing and searching. Experiments on six modern datasets demonstrate that PAG consistently achieves superior queries per second (QPS)-recall performance -- up to 5x faster than HNSW -- while offering fast indexing speed and moderate memory footprint. PAG remains robust as dimensionality and retrieval size increase and naturally supports online insertions.
papers.comment: Accepted as a poster at ICML 2026. Source code is available at https://github.com/KejingLu-810/PAG/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Projection-Augmented Graph (PAG)，一种将投影技术融入图索引的新型 ANNS 框架，旨在满足现代 AI 应用对高查询效率、快速索引、低内存占用、高维可扩展性、鲁棒性及在线插入等六项关键需求。通过投影统计检验指导的精确/近似距离非对称比较，PAG 减少了不必要的精确距离计算。在六个现代数据集上，PAG 在 QPS-召回率性能上比 HNSW 快高达 5 倍，同时保持快速索引速度和适中内存占用。
Motivation: 现有 ANNS 方法主要优化查询效率，但未能满足现代 AI 应用对高查询效率、快速索引、低内存、高维可扩展性、检索规模鲁棒性及在线插入等多方面实际需求。
Method: 提出 PAG 框架，将投影技术集成到图索引中，通过基于投影统计检验的非对称比较（精确距离与近似距离）减少不必要的距离计算，并设计了三个关键组件优化索引和搜索。
Result: 在六个现代数据集上，PAG 在 QPS-召回率上比 HNSW 快高达 5 倍，同时具有快速索引速度和适中内存占用，且随维度和检索规模增加保持鲁棒性，并自然支持在线插入。
Conclusion: PAG 统一满足了现代 AI 应用的多项关键需求，在效率和实用性上优于现有方法，代码已开源。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Edge-Local and Qubit-Efficient Quantum Graph Learning for the NISQ Era
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are a powerful framework for learning representations from graph-structured data, but their direct implementation on near-term quantum hardware remains challenging due to circuit depth, multi-qubit interactions, and qubit scalability constraints. In this work, we introduce a fully quantum graph convolutional architecture designed explicitly for unsupervised learning in the noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) regime. Our approach combines a variational quantum feature extraction layer with an edge-local and qubit-efficient quantum message-passing mechanism inspired by the Quantum Alternating Operator Ansatz (QAOA) framework. Unlike prior models that rely on global operations or multi-controlled unitaries, our model decomposes message passing into pairwise interactions along graph edges using only hardware-native single- and two-qubit gates. This design reduces the qubit requirement from $O(Nn)$ to $O(n)$ for a graph with $N$ nodes and $n$-qubit feature registers, enabling implementation on current quantum devices regardless of graph size. We train the model using the Deep Graph Infomax objective to perform unsupervised node representation learning. Experiments on the Cora citation network and a large-scale genomic SNP dataset demonstrate that our model remains competitive with prior quantum and hybrid approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向NISQ时代的全量子图卷积架构，采用边缘本地且量子比特高效的量子消息传递机制，将量子比特需求从O(Nn)降低到O(n)，并在Cora引文网络和基因组SNP数据集上展示了与先前量子/混合方法相当的性能。
Motivation: 现有的图神经网络在近期量子硬件上实现面临电路深度、多量子比特交互和量子比特可扩展性等挑战，缺乏专为NISQ设备设计的无监督量子图学习方法。
Method: 结合变分量子特征提取层和受QAOA启发的边缘本地量子消息传递机制，仅使用硬件原生单/双量子比特门将消息传递分解为图边上的成对交互，并通过Deep Graph Infomax目标进行无监督节点表示学习。
Result: 在Cora引文网络和基因组SNP数据集上，该方法与先前量子及混合方法相比具有竞争力，且量子比特需求不随图规模线性增长。
Conclusion: 本文证明了在NISQ设备上实现量子图学习的可行性，但未涉及极端天气或降水临近预报等应用领域。

papers.title: Generative AI-enhanced Probabilistic Multi-Fidelity Surrogate Modeling Via Transfer Learning
papers.abstract_en: The performance of machine learning surrogates is critically dependent on data quality and quantity. This presents a major challenge, as high-fidelity (HF) data is often scarce and computationally expensive to acquire, while low-fidelity (LF) data is abundant but less accurate. To address this data-scarcity problem, we propose a probabilistic multi-fidelity surrogate modeling framework that integrates transfer learning with generative modeling. We employ a normalizing flow (NF) generative model as the backbone, which is trained in two phases: (i) the NF is first pretrained on a large LF dataset to learn a probabilistic forward model; (ii) the pretrained model is then fine-tuned on a small HF dataset, allowing it to correct for LF--HF discrepancies via knowledge transfer. To relax the dimension-preserving constraint of standard bijective NFs, we integrate surjective (dimension-reducing) layers with standard coupling blocks. This architecture enables learned dimension reduction while preserving the ability to train with exact likelihoods. The resulting surrogate provides fast probabilistic predictions with quantified uncertainty and significantly outperforms LF-only baselines while using fewer HF evaluations. We validate the approach for two benchmark systems: a rail-sleeper-ballast and a reinforced concrete slab. For both applications, we combine many coarse-mesh (LF) simulations with a limited set of fine-mesh (HF) simulations. The proposed model achieves probabilistic predictions with HF accuracy, demonstrating a practical path toward data-efficient, generative AI-driven surrogates for complex engineering systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于生成式AI的概率多保真代理建模框架，通过迁移学习结合正则化流（NF）生成模型，先在大规模低保真数据上预训练，再用少量高保真数据微调，并引入扩展层实现维度约简，最终得到具有不确定性量化的概率预测代理模型。在轨枕-道床和钢筋混凝土板两个基准系统上验证，该方法在仅使用少量高保真数据的情况下显著优于仅用低保真数据的基线。
Motivation: 高保真数据稀缺且计算成本高，低保真数据丰富但精度不足，现有代理建模方法面临数据稀缺问题。
Method: 采用正则化流（NF）生成模型，两阶段训练：先在大规模低保真数据集上预训练学习概率前向模型，再用少量高保真数据微调以修正低保真-高保真差异；通过结合扩展层与标准耦合块实现维度约简，同时保持精确似然训练能力。
Result: 在轨枕-道床和钢筋混凝土板两个基准系统上，该方法用少量高保真模拟实现了与高保真精度相当的概率预测，显著优于仅用低保真数据的基线。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了一条数据高效的、由生成式AI驱动的代理建模路径，适用于复杂工程系统。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Learning About Learning: A Path from Spin Glasses to Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: The Hopfield model, originally inspired by spin glasses, occupies a central place at the intersection of statistical mechanics, neural networks, and artificial intelligence. Despite its conceptual simplicity and broad applicability, it is rarely integrated into the undergraduate physics curriculum. We present the Hopfield model as a pedagogically rich framework that naturally unifies core topics from the undergraduate physics curriculum and that provides a concise introduction based on concepts such as a model's energy function, dynamics, and pattern stability. We discuss practical aspects of its simulation and provide simulation codes. We also propose problems designed to mirror research practice, which can be included in undergraduate classes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将Hopfield模型作为连接统计力学与人工智能的教学框架，基于其能量函数、动力学和模式稳定性等概念，为本科生提供统一的物理课程内容，并附带模拟代码和科研导向的习题。
Motivation: Hopfield模型虽在交叉学科中具有重要地位，但鲜少被纳入本科物理课程，缺乏系统性的教学整合。
Method: 以自旋玻璃启发的Hopfield模型为核心，通过能量函数、动力学和模式稳定性等概念，设计教学模块与模拟代码。
Result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果，但强调该方法能统一本科物理核心主题，并模拟研究实践。
Conclusion: 该教学框架可帮助本科生理解统计力学与人工智能的交叉，并提供了可直接使用的习题和代码。

papers.title: Matching Ranks Over Probability Yields Truly Deep Safety Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Open-source Large Language Models (LLMs) play a critical role in the democratization of AI, yet their "open" nature introduces more avenues for malicious actors to misuse them for harmful purposes. A frustratingly easy but powerful technique known as the prefilling attack has been shown to effectively circumvent the safety alignment of frontier open-source LLMs by simply prefilling the assistant response with an affirmative prefix before decoding. A recent promising supervised fine-tuning defense proposes using a simple data augmentation scheme to achieve a "deep" safety alignment, allowing the model to generate natural language refusals immediately following harmful prefills. In this work, we show that a simple generalization of the prefilling attack, which we refer to as the Rank-Assisted Prefilling (RAP) attack, can effectively extract harmful content from models fine-tuned with the data augmentation defense by selecting low-probability "harmful" tokens from the top 20 predicted next tokens at each step (thus ignoring high-probability \enquote{refusal} tokens). We then propose a new perspective on achieving deep safety alignment by matching the token ranks in the underlying data augmentation target distribution (rather than just their probabilities), yielding a surprisingly simple approach to strengthening deep alignment we call PRefill attEntion STOpping (PRESTO) that regularizes the attention placed on harmful prefill tokens. Compared to just using data augmentation, PRESTO yields up to a 4.7x improvement in safety under RAP attacks across three popular LLMs. By achieving a stronger level of safety against practical and accessible attacks, our work paves a path towards safer open-source models. The source code accompanying this paper can be found at: https://github.com/uiuc-focal-lab/push-forward-alignment
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现数据增强防御（data augmentation defense）对一种新攻击 RAP（Rank-Assisted Prefilling）脆弱，并提出 PRESTO 方法，通过匹配 token 排名而非概率来强化深度安全对齐，在三个流行 LLM 上安全性提升最多 4.7 倍。
Motivation: 开源 LLM 面临预填充攻击（prefilling attack）威胁，现有数据增强防御虽然号称实现“深度”安全对齐，但容易被更一般化的攻击破解。
Method: 提出 RAP 攻击：在每一步选择低概率“有害”token（来自前 20 个预测），以绕过拒绝 token。提出 PRESTO：通过正则化有害预填充 token 上的注意力，在数据增强目标分布中匹配 token 排名（而非概率）来强化对齐。
Result: 在三个流行 LLM 上，PRESTO 相比仅使用数据增强，在 RAP 攻击下安全性提升最多 4.7 倍。
Conclusion: 通过对实际可攻击实现更强的安全水平，为更安全的开源模型铺平道路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Model Gateway: Management Platform for Model-Driven Drug Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Pharmaceutical drug discovery demands machine learning (ML) infrastructure that goes beyond general-purpose Machine Learning Operations (MLOps): inference-time composition of multiple models for multi-parameter optimization (MPO), version management for physics-based models without serialized ML artifacts, enterprise compound library precomputation, and governance structured around scientific organizational units rather than generic access controls. No existing commercial or open-source platform simultaneously addresses this full set of requirements. This paper presents the Model Gateway, a cloud-based platform for managing machine learning and scientific computational models across drug discovery pipelines, providing centralized version control, pharma-structured governance, asynchronous execution, consensus model orchestration, automated retraining, and a unified application programming interface (API) service for heterogeneous clients including molecular design suites and Large Language Model (LLM) agents. In production at Eli Lilly, the platform governs more than 200 deployed models spanning small molecule, peptide, and antibody modalities and serves more than five downstream applications across all phases of the Design-Make-Test-Analyze cycle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Model Gateway，一个专为药物发现设计的云平台，管理机器学习与科学计算模型，提供版本控制、治理、异步执行、共识模型编排和统一API服务，已在礼来公司生产环境中部署超过200个模型。
Motivation: 现有MLOps平台无法满足药物发现中的多模型组合推理、物理模型版本管理、化合物库预计算及按科研组织结构的治理需求。
Method: 设计Model Gateway平台，包含集中版本控制、制药结构治理、异步执行、共识模型编排、自动重训练和统一API，支持分子设计套件和LLM代理等异构客户端。
Result: 在礼来公司生产环境中部署超过200个模型，涵盖小分子、肽和抗体模态，服务于Design-Make-Test-Analyze循环的多个下游应用。
Conclusion: Model Gateway填补了现有平台在药物发现领域ML基础设施的空白，提供了针对多参数优化和科学治理的完整解决方案。

papers.title: CGCE: Classifier-Guided Concept Erasure in Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in large-scale generative models have enabled the creation of high-quality images and videos, but have also raised significant safety concerns regarding the generation of unsafe content. To mitigate this, concept erasure methods have been developed to remove undesirable concepts from pre-trained models. However, existing methods remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks that can regenerate the erased content. Moreover, achieving robust erasure often degrades the model's generative quality for safe, unrelated concepts, creating a difficult trade-off between safety and performance. To address this challenge, we introduce Classifier-Guided Concept Erasure (CGCE), an efficient plug-and-play framework that provides robust concept erasure for diverse generative models without altering their original weights. CGCE uses a lightweight classifier operating on text embeddings to first detect and then refine prompts containing undesired concepts. By modifying only unsafe embeddings at inference time, our method prevents harmful content generation while preserving the model's original quality on benign prompts. Extensive experiments show that CGCE achieves state-of-the-art robustness against a wide range of red-teaming attacks. Our approach also maintains high generative utility, demonstrating a superior balance between safety and performance. We showcase the versatility of CGCE through its successful application to various modern T2I and T2V models, establishing it as a practical and effective solution for safe generative AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Classifier-Guided Concept Erasure (CGCE)，一种即插即用的框架，通过轻量分类器在文本嵌入层面检测并修正不安全提示，在不修改生成模型原始权重的前提下实现鲁棒的概念擦除。实验显示CGCE在多种T2I/T2V模型上对红队攻击具有最先进的鲁棒性，同时保持了生成质量。
Motivation: 现有概念擦除方法易受对抗攻击再生被擦除内容，且安全性提升常以生成质量下降为代价。
Method: 在推理时使用轻量分类器检测文本嵌入中的不安全概念，并仅修改不安全嵌入以消除有害内容，不改变模型原始权重。
Result: 摘要报告CGCE在多种现代T2I/T2V模型上对广泛的红队攻击实现了最先进的鲁棒性，且保持了较高的生成效用。
Conclusion: CGCE作为一种实用的即插即用框架，在安全性与生成性能之间取得了优越的平衡，未来可应用于更多生成模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: InstantSfM: Towards GPU-Native SfM for the Deep Learning Era
papers.abstract_en: Structure-from-Motion (SfM) is a fundamental technique for recovering camera poses and scene structure from multi-view imagery, serving as a critical upstream component for applications ranging from 3D reconstruction to modern neural scene representations such as 3D Gaussian Splatting. However, most mature SfM systems remain CPU-centric and built upon traditional optimization toolchains, creating a growing mismatch with modern GPU-based, learning-driven pipelines and limiting scalability in large-scale scenes. While recent advances in GPU-accelerated bundle adjustment (BA) have demonstrated the potential of parallel sparse optimization, extending these techniques to build a complete global SfM system remains challenging due to unresolved issues in metric scale recovery and numerical robustness. In this paper, we implement a fully GPU-based and PyTorch-compatible global SfM system, named InstantSfM, to integrate seamlessly with modern learning pipelines. InstantSfM embeds metric depth priors directly into both global positioning and BA through a depth-constrained Jacobian structure, thereby resolving scale ambiguity within the optimization framework. To ensure numerical stability, we employ explicit filtering of under-constrained variables for the Jacobian matrix in an optimized GPU-friendly manner. Extensive experiments on diverse datasets demonstrate that InstantSfM achieves state-of-the-art efficiency while maintaining reconstruction accuracy comparable to both established classical pipelines and recent learning-based methods, showing up to ${\sim40\times}$ speedup over COLMAP on large-scale scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个完全基于GPU、兼容PyTorch的全局运动恢复结构（SfM）系统InstantSfM，通过将度量深度先验直接嵌入全局定位和光束法平差（BA）的深度约束雅可比结构中，解决了尺度模糊问题，并采用显式过滤欠约束变量的方法确保数值稳定性。实验表明，在大规模场景中，InstantSfM相比COLMAP可实现约40倍加速，同时保持与传统流程和学习方法相当的重建精度。
Motivation: 现有成熟的SfM系统大多基于CPU和传统优化工具链，与基于GPU的现代学习管道不匹配，限制了大规模场景的可扩展性；尽管GPU加速的BA已展示潜力，但构建完整的全局SfM系统仍面临度量尺度恢复和数值鲁棒性问题。
Method: 实现了一个完全基于GPU且兼容PyTorch的全局SfM系统InstantSfM，通过深度约束雅可比结构将度量深度先验嵌入全局定位和BA中，并采用GPU友好的方式显式过滤欠约束变量以维持数值稳定性。
Result: 在多种数据集上达到最先进的效率，同时保持与传统管道和近期学习方法相当的重建精度；在大规模场景中相比COLMAP实现约40倍加速。
Conclusion: InstantSfM展示了完全GPU原生的全局SfM系统的可行性，能够无缝集成到现代深度学习管道中，并在效率上显著优于传统CPU方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Failure Modes of Always-On Inter-Cluster Repulsion in Replay-Based Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Feature-space objectives are often added to replay-based continual learning systems with the expectation that better geometric separation will improve retention. We study a preliminary form of Cluster-Aware Replay (CAR) that combines a class-balanced replay memory with an always-active inter-cluster repulsion term (ICF). On five-task Split CIFAR-10 with a ResNet-18 backbone, the highest observed mean in a six-value sensitivity sweep reaches $22.5\pm1.4\%$ final average accuracy over three seeds, compared with $23.1\pm2.5\%$ for replay alone. ICF without replay reaches only $19.2\pm0.1\%$. All tested repulsion weights produce final accuracies between $20.1\%$ and $22.5\%$, and the detailed configuration exhibits $89.2\pm1.5$ percentage points of average forgetting. An instrumented rerun shows that the weighted repulsion contribution remains near $-0.13$ after cross-entropy has fallen close to zero, so the total objective becomes negative while old-task accuracy collapses. Importantly, the normalized distance objective is mathematically bounded; the failure is therefore better described as non-saturating, always-on repulsion rather than an unbounded loss. These negative results show that geometric separation is not automatically complementary to replay and motivate margin-gated objectives whose gradients deactivate once sufficient separation has been reached.
papers.comment: v3: Substantially revised as a negative-results study. All reported values recomputed from verified experimental runs; method description corrected to match the released implementation; statistical aggregation corrected to per-seed population standard deviations. 4 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Code: https://github.com/AminHasibul/Continual-Learning-UsingInterClusterDistance
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究重放式持续学习中始终启用的类间排斥项（ICF）的失败模式。在Split CIFAR-10上的实验表明，ICF结合重放的最佳平均准确率（22.5%）低于纯重放（23.1%），且所有测试权重下的准确率均在20.1%-22.5%之间，平均遗忘达89.2个百分点。分析发现，总目标在交叉熵接近零后变为负，导致旧任务准确率崩溃。结论是几何分离并不自动与重放互补。
Motivation: 特征空间目标常被用于重放式持续学习，期望几何分离能改善记忆保持，但实际效果未知。本文通过负面结果研究揭示其潜在失败机制。
Method: 研究Cluster-Aware Replay (CAR)的初步形式，组合类别平衡重放与始终活跃的类间排斥项（ICF），在ResNet-18和5任务Split CIFAR-10上进行超参数扫描。
Result: ICF加重放的最佳平均最终准确率22.5±1.4%，低于纯重放的23.1±2.5%；ICF无重放仅19.2±0.1%。所有测试权重下准确率在20.1%-22.5%间，平均遗忘89.2±1.5个百分点。目标函数在交叉熵接近零后变为负，导致旧任务准确率崩溃。
Conclusion: 几何分离不自然互补于重放，激励设计达到足够分离后梯度停用的门控目标。

papers.title: Avoiding Obfuscation with Prover-Estimator Debate
papers.abstract_en: Training powerful AI systems to exhibit desired behaviors hinges on the ability to provide accurate human supervision on increasingly complex tasks. A promising approach to this problem is to amplify human judgement by leveraging the power of two competing AIs in a debate about the correct solution to a given problem. Prior theoretical work has provided a complexity-theoretic formalization of AI debate, and posed the problem of designing protocols for AI debate that guarantee the correctness of human judgements for as complex a class of problems as possible. Recursive debates, in which debaters decompose a complex problem into simpler subproblems, hold promise for growing the class of problems that can be accurately judged in a debate. However, existing protocols for recursive debate run into the obfuscated arguments problem: a dishonest debater can use a computationally efficient strategy that forces an honest opponent to solve a computationally intractable problem to win. We mitigate this problem with a new recursive debate protocol that, under certain stability assumptions, ensures that an honest debater can win with a strategy requiring computational efficiency comparable to their opponent.

Method: 提出一种新的递归辩论协议，通过引入证明者-估计者（prover-estimator）结构，在稳定性假设下，诚实的辩论者能够采用与不诚实对手计算效率相当的策略，从而避免被混淆。
Result: 在理论层面，该协议被证明在稳定性条件下可以避免混淆论证问题，使得诚实的辩论者无需解决计算困难问题即可获胜。
Conclusion: 该工作为设计计算效率公平的AI辩论协议提供了理论进展，但依赖于一定的稳定性假设，实际应用中可能需要进一步验证。

papers.title: DREMnet: An Interpretable Denoising Framework for Semi-Airborne Transient Electromagnetic Signal
papers.abstract_en: The semi-airborne transient electromagnetic method (SATEM) is capable of conducting rapid surveys over large-scale and hard-to-reach areas. However, the acquired signals are often contaminated by complex noise, which can compromise the accuracy of subsequent inversion interpretations. Traditional denoising techniques primarily rely on parameter selection strategies, which are insufficient for processing field data in noisy environments. With the advent of deep learning, various neural networks have been employed for SATEM signal denoising. However, existing deep learning methods typically use single-mapping learning approaches that struggle to effectively separate signal from noise. These methods capture only partial information and lack interpretability. To overcome these limitations, we propose an interpretable decoupled representation learning framework, termed DREMnet, that disentangles data into content and context factors, enabling robust and interpretable denoising in complex conditions. To address the limitations of CNN and Transformer architectures, we utilize the RWKV architecture for data processing and introduce the Contextual-WKV mechanism, which allows unidirectional WKV to perform bidirectional signal modeling. Our proposed Covering Embedding technique retains the strong local perception of convolutional networks through stacked embedding. Experimental results on test datasets demonstrate that the DREMnet method outperforms existing techniques, with processed field data that more accurately reflects the theoretical signal, offering improved identification of subsurface electrical structures.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing, vol. 64, pp. 1-12, 2026, Art no. 5907212

TL;DR: 本文针对半航空瞬变电磁法（SATEM）信号受复杂噪声污染的问题，提出可解释解耦表示学习框架DREMnet。该框架将数据分解为内容和上下文因子，采用RWKV架构与Contextual-WKV机制实现双向信号建模，并通过Covering Embedding技术保留局部感知能力。实验表明DREMnet在测试数据集上优于现有方法，处理后的场数据更准确地反映理论信号，有助于地下电性结构识别。

Method: 提出DREMnet框架，基于可解释解耦表示学习，将数据分解为内容与上下文因子；采用RWKV架构代替CNN和Transformer，引入Contextual-WKV机制使单向WKV实现双向信号建模；通过Covering Embedding技术用堆叠嵌入保留卷积网络的局部感知能力。

Conclusion: DREMnet作为一种可解释的去噪框架，能够有效处理SATEM信号中的复杂噪声，为后续反演解释提供更准确的信号基础。

papers.title: Interpretable Deep Learning Paradigm for Airborne Transient Electromagnetic Inversion
papers.abstract_en: The extraction of geoelectric structural information from airborne transient electromagnetic (ATEM) data primarily involves data processing and inversion. Conventional methods rely on empirical parameter selection, making it difficult to process complex field data with high noise levels. Additionally, inversion computations are time-consuming and often suffer from multiple local minima. Existing deep learning-based approaches separate the data processing steps, where independently trained denoising networks struggle to ensure the reliability of subsequent inversions. Moreover, end-to-end networks lack interpretability. To address these issues, a unified and interpretable deep learning inversion paradigm based on disentangled representation learning is proposed. The network explicitly decomposes noisy data into noise and signal factors, completing the entire data processing workflow based on the signal factors, which makes the network more reliable and interpretable. Furthermore, physical constraints are incorporated into the learning process to enhance the physical consistency and reliability of the inversion results. The inversion results on field data demonstrate that the method can directly use noisy data to accurately reconstruct the subsurface electrical structure, thereby establishing a unified, interpretable, and physically constrained inversion paradigm for ATEM data processing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对航空瞬变电磁（ATEM）数据反演中传统方法依赖经验参数、计算耗时且易陷入局部最优，以及现有深度学习方法可解释性差的问题，提出一种基于解缠表示学习的统一可解释深度学习反演范式。网络显式地将噪声数据分解为噪声和信号因子，基于信号因子完成整个数据处理流程，并加入物理约束增强物理一致性。野外数据反演结果表明，该方法可直接利用噪声数据准确重建地下电性结构。
Motivation: 传统ATEM反演依赖经验参数，难以处理高噪声复杂数据，且计算耗时、易陷入局部最优；现有深度学习方法将数据处理步骤分离，独立训练的去噪网络难以保证后续反演的可靠性，且端到端网络缺乏可解释性。
Method: 提出基于解缠表示学习的统一可解释深度学习反演范式，网络显式将噪声数据分解为噪声和信号因子，基于信号因子完成数据处理流程，并在学习过程中加入物理约束。
Result: 野外数据反演结果表明该方法可直接利用噪声数据准确重建地下电性结构。
Conclusion: 该方法建立了统一、可解释且受物理约束的ATEM数据处理反演范式。

papers.title: Theory-to-Practice Gap for Neural Networks and Neural Operators
papers.abstract_en: This work studies the sampling complexity of learning with ReLU neural networks and neural operators. For mappings belonging to relevant approximation spaces, we derive upper bounds on the best-possible convergence rate of any learning algorithm, with respect to the number of samples. In the finite-dimensional case, these bounds imply a gap between the parametric and sampling complexities of learning, known as the \emph{theory-to-practice gap}. In this work, a unified treatment of the theory-to-practice gap is achieved in a general $L^p$-setting, while at the same time improving available bounds in the literature. Furthermore, based on these results the theory-to-practice gap is extended to the infinite-dimensional setting of operator learning. Our results apply to Deep Operator Networks and integral kernel-based neural operators, including the Fourier neural operator. We show that the best-possible convergence rate in a Bochner $L^p$-norm is bounded by rates of order $1/p$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究使用ReLU神经网络和神经算子进行学习时的采样复杂度。对于属于相关逼近空间的映射，推导了任何学习算法关于样本数量的最佳可能收敛速率的上界。在有限维情况下，这些界揭示了参数复杂度与采样复杂度之间的差距，即“理论到实践差距”。本文在一般L^p空间中统一处理了这一差距，并改进了现有文献中的界。此外，将理论到实践差距推广到算子学习的无穷维设定，适用于深度算子网络（DeepONet）和基于积分核的神经算子（包括傅里叶神经算子）。结果表明，Bochner L^p范数中的最佳可能收敛速率受限于1/p阶的速率。
Motivation: 现有文献中，神经网络学习的采样复杂度存在理论界与实际表现之间的差距，称为“理论到实践差距”。本文旨在统一且改进有限维和无穷维设定下这一差距的定量理解，特别关注神经算子的情况。
Method: 本文采用理论分析的方法，对ReLU神经网络和神经算子（包括DeepONet和傅里叶神经算子）的采样复杂度进行上界推导。在一般L^p空间中，通过泛函分析和逼近论工具，得到关于样本数量收敛速率的最佳可能上界。
Result: 本文推导了有限维和无穷维设定下学习算法的最佳可能收敛速率上界。在Bochner L^p范数下，该速率被1/p阶的速率所限制。这些结果统一并改进了现有文献中关于理论到实践差距的界。
Conclusion: 本文为神经网络和神经算子学习的采样复杂度提供了统一的理论框架，揭示了理论到实践差距的本质。结果适用于多种神经算子架构，但并未涉及具体应用领域的实验验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SemICP: Semantic Non-Rigid Point Cloud Registration with Elastic Energy Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Purpose: Accurate point cloud registration is essential in computer-aided interventions (CAI) to align multi-modal medical images for intraoperative guidance. Classical methods, such as Iterative Closest Point (ICP), remain attractive for their explainability and minimal training requirements, but typically ignore anatomical semantics and biomechanical properties during regularization. Methods: We present Semantic ICP (SemICP), a novel non-rigid point cloud registration framework that combines semantically informed point matching with deformation regularization. Semantic labels are used to improve correspondence matching by constraining correspondences to be anatomically consistent. A novel control-point deformation representation with linear-elastic energy regularization is introduced to encourage biomechanically plausible deformations. SemICP was evaluated on four datasets on US-CT, MR-CT, MR-MR and MR-US registration against established baselines. It was also tested with labels from AI-based segmentation in a fully automatic segmentation-registration pipeline. Results: Across all datasets, SemICP achieves lower Hausdorff distance, mean surface distance, and target registration error than competing methods. The fully automatic registration pipeline was shown to be effective for US-MR registration and to improve the alignment of expert-annotated structures. Conclusion: SemICP improves deformable point cloud registration accuracy and robustness by combining semantic correspondence constraints and linear energy regularization. Combined with AI-based segmentation, SemICP provides an effective pipeline for multi-modal registration in CAI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SemICP，一种结合语义标签和弹性能量正则化的非刚性点云配准框架，在四种多模态医学图像配准数据集上取得更低的Hausdorff距离和配准误差。
Motivation: 经典点云配准方法（如ICP）忽略解剖学语义和生物力学特性，导致配准精度受限。
Method: 使用语义标签约束对应点匹配，并引入基于控制点和线性弹性能量正则化的变形表示。

Conclusion: 语义对应约束与弹性正则化结合能提升可变形点云配准的准确性和鲁棒性，结合AI分割可形成全自动配准管线。

papers.title: The Chronos Vulnerability: A Taxonomy of Temporal Persistence and Memory-Based Deception in Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: The transition from stateless generative models in artificial intelligence to stateful, autonomous agents represents an architectural evolution that, while providing the capabilities of long-term planning and the automation of enterprise workflows, also represents the introduction of a new form of security threat, the Chronos Vulnerability. The Chronos Vulnerability represents the threat of memory-based attacks, including the Memory Injection Attack (MINJA) and the sleeper agent, in which the internal belief system of the autonomous agent is compromised, effectively decoupling the attack vector from the final catastrophic event. This study formalizes the threat model for persistence-based attacks and the threat of Dynamics Blindness in the context of the World of Workflows benchmark, demonstrating that traditional endpoint content filters are insufficient for the current stateful architecture. Consequently, this study synthesizes a defense-in-depth landscape, categorizing emerging frameworks such as diagnostic trajectory guardrails (AgentDoG), formal temporal verification (Agent-C), immunological memory consensus (A-MemGuard), and hardware-anchored trust via GPU-based Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) and Zero-Trust memory architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Chronos Vulnerability概念，即自主AI智能体因状态持久化和记忆机制引入的安全漏洞，包括内存注入攻击（MINJA）和潜伏代理（sleeper agent）。研究形式化了基于持久性的威胁模型和动态盲点（Dynamics Blindness），在World of Workflows基准上展示传统内容过滤器不足，并综合了多层防御框架：诊断轨迹护栏（AgentDoG）、形式时序验证（Agent-C）、免疫记忆共识（A-MemGuard）及GPU信任执行环境（TEE）和零信任内存架构。
Motivation: AI从无状态生成模型演进为有状态自主智能体带来长期规划能力，但也引入了新型内存攻击威胁（Chronos Vulnerability），传统安全措施无法有效防护。
Method: 形式化定义持久性攻击威胁模型和动态盲点概念，在World of Workflows基准上评估；综合防御框架包括AgentDoG、Agent-C、A-MemGuard、GPU TEE和零信任内存。
Result: 摘要表明传统端点内容过滤器无法防护有状态架构攻击，提出的多层防御景观可应对Chronos Vulnerability。
Conclusion: 强调自主智能体内存安全是新领域，需软硬件结合的层次化防御策略。
