summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出Chronos Vulnerability概念，即自主AI智能体因状态持久化和记忆机制引入的安全漏洞，包括内存注入攻击（MINJA）和潜伏代理（sleeper agent）。研究形式化了基于持久性的威胁模型和动态盲点（Dynamics Blindness），在World of Workflows基准上展示传统内容过滤器不足，并综合了多层防御框架：诊断轨迹护栏（AgentDoG）、形式时序验证（Agent-C）、免疫记忆共识（A-MemGuard）及GPU信任执行环境（TEE）和零信任内存架构。
summary_sections.motivation: AI从无状态生成模型演进为有状态自主智能体带来长期规划能力，但也引入了新型内存攻击威胁（Chronos Vulnerability），传统安全措施无法有效防护。
summary_sections.method: 形式化定义持久性攻击威胁模型和动态盲点概念，在World of Workflows基准上评估；综合防御框架包括AgentDoG、Agent-C、A-MemGuard、GPU TEE和零信任内存。
summary_sections.result: 摘要表明传统端点内容过滤器无法防护有状态架构攻击，提出的多层防御景观可应对Chronos Vulnerability。
summary_sections.conclusion: 强调自主智能体内存安全是新领域，需软硬件结合的层次化防御策略。

papers.title: ChainWatch: A Kill Chain-Aligned Sequential Detection Framework for Multi-Step Attacks in MCP-Based AI Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open-source standard that allows AI agents to connect to external tools, databases, and services. While this connectivity enables powerful agent capabilities, it also introduces multi-step attacks that existing per-call defenses cannot reliably detect. Attackers can compose individually benign tool invocations into malicious sequences that evade isolated inspection. This paper presents ChainWatch, a sequential detection framework for identifying multi-step attacks in MCP-based AI agent systems. ChainWatch models attack progression using a six-stage kill chain and applies a Hidden Markov Model (HMM) to classify tool-call sequences. Detection rules are triggered when a session exhibits suspicious progression across multiple stages. The framework is supported by a structured threat model covering direct sequential attacks, indirect prompt injection chains, and hybrid multi-stage attacks. A 20-dimensional feature extraction schema captures behavioral signals from tool interactions. We demonstrate the approach using five representative attack scenarios from the security literature, showing how ChainWatch detects attack chains that evade traditional per-call security mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对MCP协议下AI智能体系统面临的多步攻击，提出ChainWatch框架，利用六阶段杀伤链模型和隐马尔可夫模型对工具调用序列进行检测，覆盖直接序列攻击、间接提示注入攻击和混合多阶段攻击，实验表明能检测到传统逐调用防御无法发现的攻击链。
Motivation: MCP协议使AI智能体可连接外部工具，但攻击者可通过组合多个看似无害的调用构成恶意序列，现有逐调用防御机制无法可靠检测此类多步攻击。
Method: 提出ChainWatch框架，采用六阶段杀伤链建模攻击进程，利用隐马尔可夫模型分类工具调用序列，当会话在多个阶段表现出可疑进程时触发检测规则；支持直接序列攻击、间接提示注入链和混合多阶段攻击三种威胁模型，并设计了20维特征提取方案。
Result: 通过安全文献中的五个代表性攻击场景演示，表明ChainWatch能检测到传统逐调用安全机制无法防御的攻击链。
Conclusion: ChainWatch为MCP智能体系统提供了有效的多步攻击检测框架，填补了现有逐调用防御的空白。

papers.title: BRIM: Workload-Balanced Dual-Sided Bit-Serial Sparse Inference Accelerator
papers.abstract_en: Bit-serial accelerators exploit bit-level sparsity to reduce DNN inference cost, but existing designs exploit sparsity on only one operand, bounding the speedup. Extending sparsity exploitation to both operands simultaneously yields compounding reductions in partial products but introduces a critical new bottleneck: workload imbalance. Because each concurrent weight - activation pair's execution cost depends on the product of two independently varying operand non-zero bit counts, pairs that must complete together finish at vastly different times, leaving faster computations idle. We show this limits PE utilization to 56 - 64% in existing dual-sided designs. We present BRIM, a hardware - software co-designed dual-sided bit-serial sparse accelerator that directly targets this bottleneck. BRIM combines two integrated mechanisms: 1) Cyclic-Balanced Pruning (CBP), a post-training weight optimization that reshapes weight representations based on profiled activation statistics to equalize expected workloads across concurrently processed pairs offline; and 2) Pairwise Slot Donation, a lightweight hardware mechanism that absorbs residual runtime imbalance with negligible area overhead. Evaluated across CNNs, ViTs, and LLMs under iso-area constraints, BRIM achieves over 90% PE utilization, up to 2.37x speedup, and up to 1.63x energy efficiency improvement over prior dual-sided designs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BRIM是一个硬件-软件协同设计的双端位串行稀疏推理加速器，针对现有双端设计中因工作负载不平衡导致PE利用率低（56-64%）的问题，提出Cyclic-Balanced Pruning和Pairwise Slot Donation机制，在CNN、ViT和LLM上实现超过90%的PE利用率，最高2.37倍加速和1.63倍能效提升。
Motivation: 现有位串行加速器只利用单端稀疏性，而扩展到双端时因权重和激活的非零比特数独立变化导致工作负载不平衡，PE利用率仅56-64%。
Method: 提出Cyclic-Balanced Pruning（CBP）后训练权重优化，根据激活统计重塑权重表示以均衡离线工作负载；以及Pairwise Slot Donation轻量级硬件机制吸收运行时残余不平衡。
Result: 在等面积约束下，BRIM在CNN、ViT和LLM上实现>90% PE利用率，相对先前的双端设计最高2.37倍加速和1.63倍能效提升。
Conclusion: BRIM通过软硬件协同设计有效解决了双端位串行稀疏推理中的工作负载不平衡瓶颈，显著提升了PE利用率和加速比。

papers.title: ChannelGuard: Safe Models Do Not Compose into Safe Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM applications chain a planner, worker agents, a verifier, and a synthesizer, and every hop between agents is an unmonitored channel through which an adversary can smuggle instructions. Existing defenses guard only the input boundary (IBProtector, Llama Guard, perplexity filters, SmoothLLM) or run outside the application as opaque, stochastic provider-side filters. We show this gap carries a consequence rarely measured: on a 2,100-trace evaluation across eight attack families, five defenses, and three model backends, an undefended pipeline that appears fully safe under standard reporting (attack success 0.000 on tool- and memory-poisoning) owes that safety almost entirely to the cloud provider's server-side filter (54 of 60 blocks on Azure GPT-5), and silently shifts to the agent model's own alignment on a backend without such a filter. Outcome-only reporting hides this dependence. We present ChannelGuard, a training-free defense-in-depth framework placing information-bottleneck gates on every inter-agent channel; each scores channel text against an adversarial phrase bank by embedding similarity and deterministically passes, compresses, or blocks it, adding no LLM call, while an attribution method records which layer stopped each attack. ChannelGuard's tool-output gate blocks Tool Poisoning 30 of 30 at the application layer, identically across Azure GPT-5, Anthropic Sonnet 4.5, and Anthropic Haiku 4.5, whereas the undefended pipeline shifts entirely across backends; it also lowers Prompt Injection attack success by half (0.333 to 0.167) and preserves GSM8K accuracy exactly (0.867). White-box adaptive paraphrase evades every embedding gate, where a perturb-and-vote baseline does better. An extended appendix adds baselines, ablations, sweeps, a benign-preservation analysis, and a judge audit (kappa = 0.900), at a total cost of 47.36 USD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现多智能体LLM应用中的信道安全漏洞：在标准报告下看似安全的流水线（攻击成功率0.000），实际安全完全依赖云提供商服务器端过滤器（Azure GPT-5上54/60次拦截），后端切换后安全消失。为此提出ChannelGuard，一种无训练的深度防御框架，在智能体间信道上设置信息瓶颈门，通过嵌入相似度对抗短语库进行评分，并决定传递、压缩或阻塞，不增加LLM调用。评估表明，ChannelGuard的工具输出门在三个后端上一致阻止工具投毒30/30，而未防御流水线后端切换后安全性能漂移；提示注入攻击成功率从0.333降至0.167，GSM8K准确率保持0.867。白盒自适应旁路攻击可绕过所有嵌入门。
Motivation: 现有防御仅保护输入边界或在外部运行随机过滤器，忽视了智能体间信道是未监控的通道，攻击者可通过此注入指令。标准结果报告仅关注最终输出，隐藏了安全依赖外部过滤器的事实，导致安全评估不可靠。
Method: 提出ChannelGuard，一种无训练的深度防御框架，在每对智能体间信道上设置信息瓶颈门。每个门通过嵌入相似度将信道文本与对抗短语库比对，然后决定传递、压缩或阻塞，同时记录停止攻击的层。
Result: 在2100条trace、8种攻击族、5种防御、3种后端上的评估显示：未防御流水线在标准报告下攻击成功0.000，但完全依赖外部过滤器；ChannelGuard的工具输出门在三个后端一致阻止工具投毒30/30，提示注入攻击成功率从0.333降至0.167，GSM8K准确率保持0.867。白盒自适应旁路攻击可绕过所有嵌入门。
Conclusion: 本文强调多智能体安全评估必须跨后端进行，避免仅依赖外部过滤器。ChannelGuard提供了无训练、跨后端一致的防御，但面临白盒自适应旁路攻击的挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptive Multi-Expert Graph Transformer for Interpretable EEG-Based Diagnostics
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalographic (EEG) abnormalities arise from dynamic changes in neural synchrony across spatial and temporal scales, yet many computational approaches reduce these dynamics to static features. We present a Spatial Multi-Expert Graph Transformer that models each EEG recording as a sequence of dynamic functional connectivity graphs. Time-resolved connectivity is estimated using the weighted Phase Lag Index (wPLI), and hierarchical graph encoding aggregates information from electrode to regional and global levels. A multi-expert transformer architecture enables subtype-aware reasoning, with a gating mechanism adaptively fusing expert outputs for global abnormality prediction. Experiments on the TUAB dataset show competitive abnormal EEG detection performance and demonstrate the potential of dynamic graph modeling with adaptive expert fusion for interpretable, subtype-aware spatial--temporal analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对EEG异常检测中忽略时空动态和亚型差异的问题，提出一种空间多专家图Transformer，将EEG记录建模为动态功能连接图序列，使用加权相位滞后指数（wPLI）估计时间分辨连接，并通过层次图编码从电极到全局聚合信息。多专家变换器架构支持亚型感知推理，门控机制自适应融合专家输出以预测全局异常。在TUAB数据集上展示了竞争性的异常EEG检测性能。
Motivation: 现有方法将EEG动态简化为静态特征，缺乏对时空动态和亚型差异的建模，限制了诊断的准确性和可解释性。
Method: 提出Spatial Multi-Expert Graph Transformer，将每个EEG记录建模为动态功能连接图序列；使用wPLI估计时间分辨连接；通过层次图编码从电极到区域再到全局聚合信息；采用多专家变换器进行亚型感知推理，门控机制自适应融合专家输出。
Result: 在TUAB数据集上，该方法在异常EEG检测任务中取得了竞争性性能，验证了动态图建模和自适应专家融合的有效性。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了动态图建模与自适应专家融合在可解释、亚型感知的时空分析方面的潜力，但未提及在真实临床中的部署或相比其他方法的显著优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Making Single-Cell Data Distillation Auditable: Traceable Real-Cell Coresets via Discrete Min-Max Selection
papers.abstract_en: Single-cell datasets are increasingly costly to store, audit, and reuse for model training. Dimensionality reduction and dataset distillation can reduce this burden, but conventional distillation methods often produce synthetic expression profiles that cannot be traced to an assayed cell. We formulate traceable single-cell data distillation as retaining original cell identifiers and gene symbols under fixed cell and gene budgets. The resulting training subset remains connected to measured counts, labels, and assay metadata, so unexpected predictions can be checked against their source data. We propose two real-cell selectors. Fixed-CF uses static characteristic-function matching. Minmax-CF solves an entropy-regularized discrete min--max problem that upweights poorly preserved directions and adds only observed cells. Across donor-, technology-, and perturbation-level shifts on three datasets, Minmax-CF retains 96.52% of Full balanced accuracy on MS, approximately matches Full on average on hPancreas with a median $2.55\times$ GPU speedup in the all-gene setting, and obtains the lowest pathway error among compressed methods on Norman. Performance remains weaker for rare states, some technology shifts, unseen perturbation components, and settings where fidelity is weakly associated with downstream utility. Because the selected IDs refer to measured cells, these cases can be investigated by inspecting the corresponding training support, labels, and assay metadata. Minmax-CF consistently reduces worst-direction discrepancy, while downstream utility and cost vary across datasets and tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对单细胞数据蒸馏后无法追溯原始细胞的问题，提出可追溯的实细胞选择方法，通过保留原始细胞标识符和基因符号，使训练子集保持与测量数据、标签和元数据的连接。作者提出两个选择器：Fixed-CF和Minmax-CF，后者通过熵正则化的离散min-max优化来保留难以对齐的方向。在三个数据集上，Minmax-CF在MS上保留96.52%的全量平衡准确率，在hPancreas上达到中位2.55倍GPU加速，在Norman上获得最低通路误差，但在稀有状态、技术偏移等场景下性能较弱。
Motivation: 单细胞数据集存储和审计成本高，传统数据蒸馏方法生成合成表达谱，无法追溯到真实细胞，导致预测异常难以溯源。
Method: 提出两种实细胞选择器：Fixed-CF使用静态特征函数匹配；Minmax-CF求解熵正则化的离散min-max问题，通过提升难以保留的方向的权重，仅选择原始测量细胞。
Result: Minmax-CF在MS数据集上保持96.52%的全量平衡准确率，在hPancreas上平均性能与全量相当并实现中位2.55倍GPU加速，在Norman上获得最低通路误差；但在稀有状态、某些技术偏移和未扰动组分上性能较弱。
Conclusion: 可追溯蒸馏使异常预测可溯源至原始细胞、标签和元数据；Minmax-CF一致减少最差方向差异，但下游效用和成本因数据集和任务而异。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对单细胞数据蒸馏后无法追溯原始细胞的问题，提出可追溯的实细胞选择方法，通过保留原始细胞标识符和基因符号，使训练子集保持与测量数据、标签和元数据的连接。作者提出两个选择器：Fixed-CF和Minmax-CF，后者通过熵正则化的离散min-max优化来保留难以对齐的方向。在三个数据集上，Minmax-CF在MS上保留96.52%的全量平衡准确率，在hPancreas上达到中位2.55倍GPU加速，在Norman上获得最低通路误差，但在稀有状态、技术偏移等场景下性能较弱。
summary_sections.motivation: 单细胞数据集存储和审计成本高，传统数据蒸馏方法生成合成表达谱，无法追溯到真实细胞，导致预测异常难以溯源。
summary_sections.method: 提出两种实细胞选择器：Fixed-CF使用静态特征函数匹配；Minmax-CF求解熵正则化的离散min-max问题，通过提升难以保留的方向的权重，仅选择原始测量细胞。

papers.title: JailMeter: An Evidence-Based Evaluation Framework for Jailbreak Attacks on Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The assessment of jailbreak attacks against large language models currently suffers from inconsistent evaluation criteria and methods, leading to unreliable estimates of attack success rates. We propose JailMeter, an evidence-based evaluation framework designed to more faithfully measure jailbreak effectiveness. Inspired by the Information Bottleneck theory, JailMeter applies dual-feedback optimization to filter jailbreak noise from model responses while preserving content relevant to the original malicious question. This process produces concise evidence for a rigorous assessment under which an attack is validated only when the response captures the malicious intent and delivers a complete answer, thereby signaling a substantive bypass of model safety alignment. We evaluate JailMeter on JailMeter-Eva, a challenging benchmark containing 330 human-labeled, non-rejected jailbreak instances. JailMeter achieves an accuracy of 97.27%, substantially outperforming existing evaluation methods. To support large-scale evaluation, we further distill JailMeter into a small language model, JailMeter\textsubscript{SLM}, which maintains comparable reliability with significantly reduced computational costs. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Magi2B0y/JailMeter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 JailMeter，一个基于信息瓶颈理论的证据评估框架，用于更忠实地衡量大语言模型越狱攻击的有效性。该框架通过双反馈优化过滤响应中的噪声，保留与原始恶意问题相关的内容，生成简洁证据进行严格评估。在包含330个人工标注样本的 JailMeter-Eva 基准上，JailMeter 达到了97.27%的准确率，显著优于现有方法。此外，作者将 JailMeter 蒸馏成一个小语言模型 JailMeter_SLM，在保持可靠性的同时大幅降低计算成本。
Motivation: 当前对越狱攻击的评估标准和方法不一致，导致攻击成功率的估计不可靠，亟需一个更统一的评估框架。
Method: 受信息瓶颈理论启发，JailMeter 采用双反馈优化，从模型响应中过滤越狱噪声，同时保留与原始恶意问题相关的内容，从而生成简洁证据，并在攻击验证时要求响应同时捕捉恶意意图并提供完整答案。
Result: 在 JailMeter-Eva 基准上，JailMeter 的准确率达 97.27%，大幅超越现有评估方法；蒸馏模型 JailMeter_SLM 在保持相近可靠性的同时显著降低了计算开销。
Conclusion: JailMeter 为越狱攻击评估提供了基于证据的客观框架，并支持大规模高效评估，有助于更准确地衡量模型安全对齐被突破的程度。

papers.title: Opto-ViT-v2: Noise-Resilient On-Chip Fine-Tuning for Photonic Near-Sensor Vision Transformer Accelerators
papers.abstract_en: Silicon-photonic (SiPh) accelerators have emerged as a promising platform for Vision Transformer (ViT) inference by performing matrix multiplications on microring-resonator (MRR) banks with high throughput and energy efficiency. Extending these platforms to support on-chip fine-tuning remains challenging because backpropagation requires large activation storage, frequent weight write-back to MRRs, and tolerance to device-level noise. We present Opto-ViT-v2, the first framework for parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) on a near-sensor SiPh ViT accelerator. Our tensorized low-rank decomposition separates pretrained optical weights from a small set of trainable electronic factors (as few as 8K parameters for ViT-Base), greatly reducing activation storage and weight updates while enabling practical on-chip training. We further introduce a gradient-accumulated sparse classifier that freezes low-importance weights through one-shot top-k gradient masking, reducing classifier training cost by about 40 percent. We also develop the first system-level noise model for photonic on-chip training, capturing the effects of MRR crosstalk, thermal drift, and laser amplitude noise during both forward and backward propagation. Calibrated using measurements from more than 200 fabricated MRR devices, the model shows that low-rank factor updates are more robust than full fine-tuning and conventional layer-wise low-rank adaptation under identical noise conditions. Experiments on VTAB-1K (19 tasks) and FGVC few-shot benchmarks demonstrate that Opto-ViT-v2 recovers within 0.3 to 0.8 percent of clean software accuracy under measured photonic noise while achieving more than 100 KFPS/W, enabling practical on-chip domain adaptation for photonic edge vision systems.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 8 figures. Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the IEEE/ACM International Conference on Computer-Aided Design (ICCAD 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Opto-ViT-v2，首个支持硅光子近传感器ViT加速器上参数高效微调（PEFT）的框架。通过张量化低秩分解分离预训练光学权重与可训练电子因子（ViT-Base仅需8K参数），大幅减少激活存储和权重更新。引入梯度累积稀疏分类器，通过一次性top-k梯度掩码冻结低重要性权重，降低约40%分类器训练成本。开发首个光子片上训练系统级噪声模型，经200多个制造的MRR器件校准，表明低秩因子更新比全微调和传统逐层低秩适应在相同噪声下更鲁棒。在VTAB-1K（19任务）和FGVC少样本基准上，在实测光子噪声下恢复至干净软件精度的0.3%-0.8%以内，同时实现超过100 KFPS/W能效。
Motivation: 硅光子加速器虽在ViT推理中具有高吞吐量和能效，但扩展支持片上微调面临反向传播需要大量激活存储、频繁权重写回MRR以及对器件级噪声的容忍度等挑战。
Method: 提出张量化低秩分解（将预训练光学权重与少量可训练电子因子分离）、梯度累积稀疏分类器（冻结低重要性权重），并开发首个光子片上训练系统级噪声模型（包含MRR串扰、热漂移和激光振幅噪声）。
Result: 在VTAB-1K和FGVC基准上，在实测光子噪声下恢复至干净软件精度的0.3%-0.8%以内，分类器训练成本降低约40%，能效超过100 KFPS/W。
Conclusion: Opto-ViT-v2在光子噪声下实现接近软件精度的性能，且能效极高，为光子边缘视觉系统的实际片上领域自适应提供了可行方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Torque-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Quadruped Locomotion
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) for legged robots is advancing locomotion, demonstrating its ability to adapt to new and challenging terrain. Traditionally, these RL locomotion frameworks are position-based, making the policy less adaptable to terrain types and requiring state estimation techniques in the observation space, i.e., linear velocity. Moreover, these RL frameworks often use small, lightweight quadrupeds that are limited in their viability for high-complexity tasks due to hardware constraints. This work explores an RL torque control framework for heavyweight high-torque quadrupeds. The RL framework in this paper can traverse rough terrain and effectively track a desired linear velocity without requiring knowledge of the agent's current velocity. Using Nvidia's Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab, simulation results of the RL torque control policy are shown on the Unitree B1 quadruped, achieving speeds of 3.5 m/s and 1.5 rad/s. In addition, the quadruped can walk up and down stairs without the aid of an exteroceptive sensor.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. Accepted manuscript. Published in the 2026 IEEE/SICE International Symposium on System Integration (SII), pp. 1259-1264
papers.journal_ref: 2026 IEEE/SICE International Symposium on System Integration (SII), pp. 1259-1264 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对重型高扭矩四足机器人，提出一种基于扭矩控制的强化学习（RL）框架，使机器人无需当前速度估计即可在粗糙地形上行走并跟踪期望线速度。在Nvidia Isaac Sim和Isaac Lab中仿真Unitree B1四足机器人，达到3.5 m/s线速度和1.5 rad/s角速度，并能不依赖外部传感器上下楼梯。
Motivation: 现有RL四足 locomotion 框架多为位置控制，适应性差且需要状态估计（如线速度），同时多用于小型轻量机器人，受硬件限制难以完成高复杂度任务。
Method: 提出一种扭矩控制RL框架，直接输出关节扭矩，无需状态估计提供速度信息；在仿真环境中使用Nvidia Isaac Sim和Isaac Lab训练。
Result: 仿真中Unitree B1四足机器人达到3.5 m/s线速度和1.5 rad/s角速度，并能不借助外部传感器上下楼梯。
Conclusion: 该扭矩驱动RL框架可在重型四足机器人上实现鲁棒的粗糙地形行走和速度跟踪，减少对状态估计的依赖。

papers.title: Isaac Sim-to-Real: Reinforcement Learning based Locomotion for Quadrupeds
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based approaches to locomotion have risen in popularity in recent years, showing the capability for complex legged locomotion and whole-body control. Reinforcement learning (RL), the primary learning-based approach for locomotion, often utilizes a high-performance simulation tool, providing a controlled and efficient training and development environment. However, policies that perform well in simulation frequently encounter unexpected challenges when deployed on a physical system, known as the sim-to-real gap. This work presents a robust RL locomotion framework capable of whole-body control. The proposed RL framework utilizes Nvidia's new set of simulation tools, Isaac Sim, and its companion RL framework, Isaac Lab, for training, achieving a zero-shot sim-to-real policy. The performance of our policy is validated on physical hardware using the Unitree Go1, with experimental results showing similar velocity tracking performance to the quadruped's integrated controller, with a greater ability to recover from large disturbances, and achieve linear velocities of 2.0 m/s and angular velocities of 1.8 rad/s.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted manuscript. Published in the 2025 IEEE 21st International Conference on Automation Science and Engineering (CASE), pp. 2194-2199
papers.journal_ref: 2025 IEEE 21st International Conference on Automation Science and Engineering (CASE), pp. 2194-2199 (2025)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于强化学习的四足机器人全身运动控制框架，利用Nvidia Isaac Sim和Isaac Lab进行训练，实现了从仿真到真实环境的零样本迁移。在Unitree Go1机器人上验证了该策略，结果显示与机器人内置控制器速度跟踪性能相当，但具有更强的抗干扰能力，并能达到2.0 m/s的线速度和1.8 rad/s的角速度。
Motivation: 强化学习训练的运动策略在仿真中表现良好，但部署到物理系统时常遇到仿真到现实（sim-to-real）的差距问题。本文旨在开发一个能够实现零样本迁移的鲁棒运动控制框架。
Method: 使用Nvidia Isaac Sim和Isaac Lab作为训练环境，设计了一个基于强化学习的全身控制框架，直接在仿真中训练策略，然后零样本部署到真实机器人上。
Result: 在Unitree Go1四足机器人上，该策略实现了与内置控制器相似的线速度跟踪性能，但具备更强的抗干扰能力，并达到2.0 m/s线速度和1.8 rad/s角速度。
Conclusion: 本文展示了利用Isaac Sim仿真工具训练的强化学习策略可以成功迁移到真实四足机器人，实现鲁棒的运动控制，且性能优于或等于传统控制器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Auditing Retrieval-Augmented LLM Hypotheses for Longitudinal Cell Painting Morphology
papers.abstract_en: High-content morphological profiling (Cell Painting) yields sensitive, high-dimensional signatures of cellular state, but translating longitudinal morphology trajectories into interpretable biology remains difficult, especially for weak, chronic perturbations such as low-dose-rate ionizing radiation. Large language models (LLMs) can synthesize heterogeneous evidence into biological narratives, yet their scientific use requires quantitative auditing. We present an evaluation-first, retrieval-augmented interpretation framework for longitudinal Cell Painting morphology, applied to a 9-week RPE-1 time course across five dose rates (0.003--6.0 mGy/hr). Week-matched treated-control morphology deltas are combined with retrieved perturbation neighbors, pathway context, and literature evidence through stable evidence identifiers, enabling an LLM to generate structured, evidence-linked hypotheses that are hierarchically summarized while preserving provenance. We introduce two quantitative auditing tests: V1 citation validity, which verifies that cited evidence identifiers exist in the prompt, and V2 proxy-based morphology compatibility, which evaluates consistency between predicted biological processes and the most altered morphology features. In our experiments, V1 detected no invalid evidence references, while V2 showed meaningful morphology compatibility that increased with perturbation strength and was positively associated with an independent morphology drift summary. The framework produces auditable, falsifiable biological hypotheses, including an adaptive phenotype involving metabolic reprogramming and proteostatic stress at lower dose rates (0.003--0.3 mGy/hr). Current limitations include proxy-based evaluation and the lack of ground-truth mechanism labels.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at ACM BCB 2026. This is the author's version. The definitive Version of Record is available at [https://doi.org/10.1145/3807503.3819448](https://doi.org/10.1145/3807503.3819448)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向纵向细胞绘画形态学的检索增强解释框架，用于审计LLM生成的生物学假设。框架结合周匹配的处理-对照形态差异、检索的扰动邻居、通路背景和文献证据，通过稳定证据标识使LLM输出结构化假设，并引入V1(引用有效性)和V2(形态兼容性)两个定量审计测试。实验应用于9周RPE-1时间序列(五个剂量率)，V1未发现无效引用，V2显示形态兼容性随扰动强度增加并与独立形态漂移摘要正相关。框架生成可审计的假设，如低剂量率下的代谢重编程和蛋白稳态应激适应性表型；局限性包括代理评估和缺乏真实机制标签。
Motivation: 高内涵形态学特征(细胞绘画)能产生敏感的高维细胞状态信号，但将纵向形态轨迹转化为可解释生物学仍困难，尤其对于慢性弱扰动(如低剂量率电离辐射)。LLM可综合异质证据生成生物学叙述，但其科学使用需要定量审计。
Method: 提出评估优先的检索增强解释框架：将周匹配的处理-对照形态差值结合检索的扰动邻居、通路上下文和文献证据，通过稳定证据标识使LLM生成结构化、带证据链接的假设，并层次化总结同时保留来源。引入两个审计测试：V1检查引用标识是否存在于提示中，V2通过代理评估预测生物学过程与最显著形态特征的一致性。
Result: V1检测未发现无效证据引用；V2显示有意义的形态兼容性，该得分随扰动强度增加，并与独立的形态漂移摘要正相关。
Conclusion: 该框架能产生可审计、可证伪的生物学假设，包括低剂量率(0.003–0.3 mGy/hr)下涉及代谢重编程和蛋白稳态应激的适应性表型。当前局限性包括代理基础的评价和缺乏真实机制标签。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FORCE-Bench: A Benchmark, Dataset, and Evaluation Harness for Agentic AI in Enterprise Finance
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models have accelerated deployment of agentic systems in operational finance. Existing benchmarks emphasize measuring general capabilities, instruction following, or safety, but few directly address the operational finance workflows that agentic systems are now being deployed to automate. Finance professionals require agents to not only provide factually sound and properly grounded information, but also ensure that this information is verifiable and consistently adheres to rules and constraints of the operational finance domain. We introduce FORCE-Bench, which contains 251 expert-annotated queries and evaluates responses using a rubric-based framework calibrated to the requirements of the operational finance domain, across eight dimensions: accuracy, citations, clarity, depth, groundedness, recency, relevance, and structure. FORCE-Bench assesses agentic systems on three task types: financial obligation research (querying ERP systems for accounts receivable and payable data), financial entity performance research (answering time-bound questions from public filings and market data), and business brief generation (synthesising multi-source company intelligence reports). To reflect real deployment conditions, we evaluate our purpose-built agent, as well as the general-purpose agentic systems, under common tool access and latency-bounded settings. Results show that general-purpose agentic systems do not consistently meet finance-domain quality requirements under operational constraints, while the purpose-built Finance Agent for Microsoft 365 Copilot is more reliable across dimensions. We release the dataset, rubrics, harness, and analysis code as open-source to support reproducible comparison and adaptation to other enterprise finance environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FORCE-Bench，一个针对企业金融中代理AI (agentic AI) 的基准测试、数据集和评估框架。包含251条专家标注的查询，从准确性、引用、清晰度、深度、根基性、时效性、相关性和结构八个维度评估代理系统。在三种任务（财务义务研究、财务实体绩效研究、业务简报生成）上测试通用代理系统和专门构建的 Finance Agent for Microsoft 365 Copilot，发现通用代理在运营约束下无法持续满足金融领域质量要求，而定制代理更可靠。数据集和评估代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有基准主要衡量通用能力或安全性，缺少针对运营金融工作流的评估，而金融领域要求信息不仅准确且可验证，并遵守领域规则和约束。
Method: 构建 FORCE-Bench，包含251条专家标注查询和基于评分标准 (rubric) 的评估框架，覆盖八个质量维度。评估三类任务：财务义务研究、财务实体绩效研究、业务简报生成，在工具访问受限和延迟约束的部署条件下测试。
Result: 通用代理系统在运营约束下未持续满足金融领域质量要求，而专门构建的 Finance Agent for Microsoft 365 Copilot 在多数维度上更可靠。
Conclusion: 开源数据集、评分标准、评估工具和分析代码，支持可重复比较并适配其他企业金融环境。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reward-Aware Population Scaling of Evolutionary Strategies in LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Using Evolutionary Strategies (ES) for fine-tuning large language models is attractive because it is memory-efficient, parallel, and compatible with black-box or discrete rewards. Yet its population-size conclusions conflict sharply: fine-tuning with cross-entropy (CE) reward succeeds with $N=1$, while binary-reward training often needs $N \approx 30$. We show this gap is largely about reward design and normalization, not population size. In the capable-model regime we study, z-score advantage normalization can cause $N=2$ to fail. Disabling normalization lets binary-reward ES with $N=2$ improve on GSM8K and TREC across capable models spanning 0.5B-7B, where the normalized variant collapses or degrades. This small-$N$ risk is set by reward granularity: binary accuracy reward induces a zero-advantage probability $q$ that depends in closed form on base accuracy, batch size, and intra-pair correctness correlation; a zero-training probe on Qwen2.5-Instruct/GSM8K matches the formula with mean absolute error 0.020 across 12 configurations and finds the availability threshold $N_{\mathrm{avail}}$ to be small in this capable-model regime. The implication is not that $N=2$ is universally sufficient, but that small-population failure in capable-model binary ES can be an implementation artifact rather than an intrinsic population limit.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the 4th HiLD (High-dimensional Learning Dynamics) Workshop, ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究使用进化策略（ES）微调大语言模型时奖励设计对种群规模的影响。作者发现，在能力较强的模型上，二进制奖励的ES使用z-score优势归一化会导致小种群（如N=2）失败，而禁用归一化后小种群也能取得改进。通过分析奖励粒度，推导出零优势概率的闭式表达式，并证明了小种群失败可能源于实现细节而非内在限制。
Motivation: 现有研究对ES微调LLM的种群规模需求存在矛盾：交叉熵奖励成功时N=1，而二进制奖励需要N≈30。本文旨在解释这一矛盾，并指出奖励设计与归一化是关键因素。
Method: 作者通过实验对比z-score优势归一化与无归一化的ES，分析二进制奖励的粒度，推导了零优势概率的闭式表达式，并基于真实模型进行验证。
Result: 禁用归一化后，二进制奖励ES在N=2时即可在GSM8K和TREC上提升0.5B-7B模型的性能，而归一化变体则退化或崩溃。零优势概率公式与Qwen2.5-Instruct/GSM8K的实验匹配，平均绝对误差0.020，且找到可用性阈值N_avail很小。
Conclusion: 在能力较强的模型上，二进制奖励ES的小种群失败可能源于实现伪影（artifact）而非内在种群限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ITPEval: Benchmarking Formal Translation Across Interactive Theorem Provers
papers.abstract_en: Formal theorem proving has emerged as a frontier challenge for machine learning, yet the ecosystem is fragmented: proofs remain siloed across incompatible systems, limiting both training data for learning-based provers and the portability of verified results. We present ITPEval, the first benchmark for evaluating automated formal proof translation across four major ITPs (Lean 4, Rocq, Isabelle, and HOL Light), spanning two distinct logical foundations. Our benchmark comprises 1,560 source files and 6,848 theorems organized into a controlled tier of axiomatized files that isolates foundational translation difficulty, and an ecosystem tier drawn from real libraries that exposes API and proof-style mismatches. We release itpeval, a unified multi-ITP verification infrastructure with state-isolated warm backends that preserve per-artifact native checking semantics. We evaluate both statement and proof translation across five frontier and open-weight LLMs on 12 directed translation pairs: statement translation peaks at 29.1% pass@1 and proof translation at 10.5%; controlled theorems reach 29.7% proof pass@1 versus 5.2% for ecosystem-level translations, confirming that library mismatch is the dominant bottleneck. In addition to pass@k evaluation, a deterministic Lean 4 BEq check establishes equivalence for 54.0% of verified source-to-Lean 4 miniF2F statement translations, showing that native type-checking alone can substantially overestimate semantic fidelity; in an autoformalization/auto-informalization round-trip study, Rocq and HOL Light are easier formalization targets than Lean 4 and Isabelle, while multi-ITP context improves pooled Lean 4 success from 4.8% to 10.6%. Our benchmark, verification infrastructure, and evaluation pipelines are publicly released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ITPEval是首个跨交互式定理证明器（Lean 4、Rocq、Isabelle、HOL Light）的形式化证明翻译基准，包含6,848条定理和统一验证基础设施。评测发现语句翻译最高pass@1为29.1%，证明翻译最高10.5%，库不匹配是主要瓶颈。
Motivation: 形式化定理证明生态碎片化，证明在不同系统间无法互通，限制了基于学习的证明器的训练数据和验证结果的移植性。
Method: 构建跨四个主要ITP的基准，包含控制层（公理化文件）和生态层（真实库），并开发统一多ITP验证基础设施（itpeval）。
Result: 语句翻译峰值29.1% pass@1，证明翻译10.5%；控制层定理证明pass@1达29.7%，生态层仅5.2%。Lean 4 BEq检查表明原生类型检查会高估语义保真度。
Conclusion: 库不匹配是翻译的主要瓶颈，统一基础设施有助于不同ITP间的验证；罗克、HOL Light比Lean 4和Isabelle更容易作为形式化目标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NMR Elucidation as an Agentic Search Problem, Not a Modeling Problem
papers.abstract_en: Structural elucidation from Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) data remains a fundamental bottleneck across chemistry, materials science, and biology. We demonstrate that an agentic AI system can perform this task at a level comparable to graduate-level chemistry students. Instead of training a model to directly map spectra to structures, we build a single autonomous agent, backed by a frozen LLM, that interacts with a curated environment with access to domain-specific processing tools, validation checks, tabulated chemical shifts, and instructions that outline the stepwise nature of a chemist's thinking process. On the Alberts dataset, our agent elucidates structures with a top-1 accuracy of 71%, comparable to the performance of graduate students at 66% top-1 accuracy. On the van Bramer and AstraZeneca datasets, our agent achieved 80% and 20% top-1 accuracy respectively, outperforming zero-shot end-to-end deep learning models which were trained on large datasets of simulated spectra. These results show that reframing NMR elucidation as an LLM-guided constrained search, rather than a modeling task, yields substantial gains and suggests a path toward multi-step orchestration frameworks that integrate a variety of tools, models, and domain knowledge to assist in automating spectroscopic analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将核磁共振（NMR）数据解析重新定义为智能体搜索问题，而非传统建模任务。他们构建了一个由冻结LLM驱动的自主智能体，与包含领域专用工具和化学家逐步推理指令的环境交互，在多个数据集上取得了与研究生相当或更优的结构解析准确率。
Motivation: 从NMR数据解析化学结构是化学、材料科学和生物学中的基础瓶颈，现有直接映射模型效果有限。
Method: 构建单一自主智能体，后端使用冻结LLM，与包含领域专用处理工具、验证检查、表格化化学位移和逐步推理指令的环境交互，以引导结构搜索。
Result: 在Alberts数据集上top-1准确率71%（研究生66%），van Bramer数据集80%，AstraZeneca数据集20%，超过在模拟谱上训练的零样本端到端深度学习模型。
Conclusion: 将NMR解析重新定义为LLM引导的约束搜索而非建模任务能显著提升性能，并为多步骤编排框架集成工具和领域知识自动化光谱分析提供了路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reproducing Recurrent Transformers: The CoTFormer
papers.abstract_en: The CoTFormer architecture formalizes Chain-of-Thought as a form of recurrent latent computation, preserving intermediate states as attendable representations to mimic explicit reasoning traces. In this work, we evaluate CoTFormer and its structural variants across perplexity and compute efficiency metrics. Furthermore, we extend evaluation to controlled algorithmic settings to determine whether this recurrent framework improves out-of-distribution generalisation on inductive reasoning tasks.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, reproducibility report submitted to University of Southampton
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对 CoTFormer 架构的复现评估，该架构将思维链定义为递归潜在计算，保留中间状态作为可注意表示以模拟显式推理轨迹。作者评估了 CoTFormer 及其结构变体在困惑度和计算效率上的表现，并扩展到可控的算法设置中以检验其在归纳推理任务上的分布外泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有方法中思维链通常作为显式步骤，CoTFormer 试图将其形式化为递归潜在计算，以更高效地保留推理中间状态。
Method: 评估 CoTFormer 原始版本及其结构变体，在语言建模和算法推理任务上比较困惑度与计算效率。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值，仅说明在困惑度和计算效率方面进行了评估，并在归纳推理任务上检验了分布外泛化。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确总结结论，但表明该递归框架在算法推理性任务上的分布外泛化表现是关注重点。

papers.title: Structured Latent Space Modeling over Multi-Scale Temporal Patches for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate time series encode structural patterns that unfold across multiple temporal scales, yet most forecasting backbones treat learned representations as transient byproducts of prediction, leaving the organizational geometry of these patterns underexploited. We introduce M2Patch, a CNN-based forecasting architecture that maps channel-independent multivariate observations into a structured latent space through two complementary differentiable constraints. Multi-scale patching decomposes the input into overlapping temporal granularities; depthwise separable convolutions with progressive dilation extract scale-specific features in linear time; and per-scale learned projections compress these features into a compact latent representation. The latent space is organized by an intra-scale smoothness constraint that enforces temporal continuity between adjacent patches, and an inter-scale alignment constraint, realized through learnable cross-scale mappings, that restores cross-granularity interaction within the channel-independent design, ensuring that all scales encode mutually consistent representations of the underlying dynamics. Experiments on ten real-world benchmarks show that M2Patch achieves 57 best and 34 second-best results across 40 forecasting settings, matching or exceeding representative baselines on most benchmarks while maintaining linear computational complexity and robustness to patch-level input corruption.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: M2Patch 是一种基于 CNN 的多变量时间序列预测架构，通过多尺度时间分片和结构化潜在空间建模，引入帧内平滑约束和跨尺度对齐约束，实现线性复杂度下的高效预测。在 10 个真实基准上的 40 个设置中，取得了 57 个最佳和 34 个次佳结果，并对输入块破坏具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有预测模型将学习到的表示视为预测的暂态副产品，未能充分利用时间序列中跨多尺度的结构几何信息。
Method: 采用多尺度分片将输入分解为重叠的时间粒度；使用深度可分离卷积与渐进膨胀在线性时间内提取尺度特定特征；通过每尺度学习投影压缩为紧凑的潜在表示；利用帧内平滑约束和跨尺度对齐约束组织潜在空间。
Result: 在 10 个真实世界基准上的 40 个预测设置中，M2Patch 获得 57 个最佳和 34 个次佳结果，匹配或超过代表性基线，并保持线性计算复杂度和对输入块破坏的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: M2Patch 证明了结构化潜在空间建模能够有效利用多尺度时间模式，为多变量时间序列预测提供了一种高效且鲁棒的解决方案。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Recovering Clinical Utility Under Differential Privacy: Empirical Validation of Adaptive Federated Aggregation on Heterogeneous Cardiovascular Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Validating federated learning frameworks on real clinical data is an essential step between proof-of-concept demonstrations in controlled synthetic environments and deployment in real multicenter healthcare settings. A prior architectural study by the same authors (Tertulino and Alencar, 2026) demonstrated, on a synthetic six-feature benchmark, that server-side adaptive optimization acts as a temporal denoiser for Differential Privacy noise, answering an open challenge identified in the original pipeline work (Tertulino, 2025). That study used synthetically generated data and explicitly identified real-world validation as a priority future direction. The present work addresses this gap by validating the FedCVR framework on five publicly available real cardiovascular datasets (Framingham, Cleveland, Hungarian, Switzerland, and Long Beach VA), harmonized to the 13-attribute UCI Heart Disease schema and configured as a heterogeneous federated scenario with leave-one-institution-out cross-validation. Results demonstrate that FedCVR preserves its adaptive advantage on real data, achieving an F1-Score of 79.2% and AUC of 0.96 under the operational privacy budget (noise multiplier = 0.8, privacy budget epsilon approximately 4.2), while statistically outperforming standard FedAvg on all evaluated metrics (paired t-tests, all p <= 0.003, significant under the Bonferroni-corrected threshold). The measured privacy cost on real data confirms the graceful degradation pattern observed in the synthetic experiments, providing empirical evidence of the framework's clinical viability in genuine multicenter contexts.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to the Journal of the Brazilian Computer Society (JBCS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文验证了FedCVR联邦学习框架在五个真实心血管数据集上的效果，在差分隐私预算（ε≈4.2）下实现F1分数79.2%、AUC 0.96，并显著优于标准FedAvg。
Motivation: 此前在合成数据上证明有效的自适应联邦聚合方法需要在实际临床数据上验证，以证明其临床可行性。
Method: 使用五组心血管数据集（Framingham等），按UCI心脏疾病模式统一为13个特征，采用留一机构交叉验证的异质性联邦场景，结合差分隐私（噪声乘数0.8）。
Result: FedCVR在真实数据上获得F1 79.2%、AUC 0.96，统计显著优于FedAvg（配对t检验，p≤0.003，经Bonferroni校正）。
Conclusion: 框架在真实多中心场景中表现出临床可行性，隐私成本呈现与合成实验一致的优雅退化模式。

papers.title: When Does Consensus Beat Voting? A Critical Analysis of Statistical Label Fusion in Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: This paper provides a rigorous, self-contained investigation of consensus segmentation. We derive the mathematical foundations from first principles -- the generative model, EM algorithm, Van Leemput's marginalization analysis, identifiability conditions, Spatial STAPLE, and deep variational formulations -- and validate each theoretical prediction through controlled experiments. The central finding is sobering: under common conditions, STAPLE reduces to thresholded majority voting, suffers 95% EM suboptimality, and collapses under class imbalance. These are not edge cases but typical scenarios in medical imaging. Majority voting -- simple, non-parametric, and robust -- is a surprisingly strong baseline that the field has perhaps too hastily dismissed in favor of more "sophisticated" methods. At the same time, the deep consensus model demonstrates that the consensus problem is not inherently difficult -- it becomes tractable when the image is used alongside the labels. And conformal prediction shows that formal uncertainty guarantees are achievable and practical. We hope this work encourages practitioners to critically evaluate their consensus methods rather than applying STAPLE by default, and provides the mathematical and empirical foundation for more principled approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对医学图像分割中的共识分割（consensus segmentation）进行严格的理论分析，推导了从生成模型、EM算法到深度变分公式的数学基础，并通过受控实验验证理论预测。主要发现是：在常见条件下，STAPLE退化为阈值多数投票，存在95%的EM次优性，且在不平衡类别下崩溃；多数投票实际上是一个被低估的强基线，而深度共识模型表明共识问题在结合图像信息后变得可解；同时，共形预测可提供形式化的不确定性保证。
Motivation: 医学图像分割中，共识方法（如STAPLE）被广泛使用但缺乏严格的数学分析，其实际性能与简单多数投票的比较未被充分理解。
Method: 从第一原理出发推导共识分割的数学基础，包括生成模型、EM算法、Van Leemput的边缘化分析、可辨识性条件、Spatial STAPLE和深度变分公式，并通过受控实验进行验证。
Result: STAPLE在常见条件下退化为阈值多数投票，EM优化次优性高达95%，并在类别不平衡时崩溃；多数投票是强大的基线，深度共识模型在利用图像信息后表现更优，共形预测可实现形式化不确定性保证。
Conclusion: 作者希望实践者批判性评估共识方法，而非默认使用STAPLE，并提供更严谨方法的数学与实证基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Predictive single cell foundation model for gene regulation and aging with privacy-preserving tabular learning
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained foundation models (FMs) have begun transforming single-cell genomics, but scaling them raises privacy concerns. Moreover, unlike text data, single-cell data is unordered and exhibits a unique tabular structure that current single-cell FMs overlook. We introduce Tabula, a privacy-preserving FM designed with federated learning (FL) that explicitly models the tabular structure of single-cell data. To deploy Tabula, we further developed Chiron, a decentralized AI agent-enabled platform for collaborative training across institutions without sharing raw data. Beyond strong performance across downstream benchmarks, Tabula reveals combinatorial regulatory logic across diverse biological systems, including hematopoiesis, pancreatic endogenesis, neurogenesis, and cardiogenesis. Using a new scRNA-seq dataset of paired young and aged human fibroblasts, Tabula nominates rejuvenation factors through age- and identity score-guided in silico prioritization, outperforming conventional approaches. Thus, Tabula represents an important advance in single-cell foundation modeling by integrating tabular learning with FL, paving the way toward privacy-preserving virtual cells for human health.
papers.comment: 98 pages, 4 main figures, and 15 supplementary figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Tabula，一种基于联邦学习的隐私保护单细胞基础模型，显式建模单细胞数据的表格结构。通过开发 Chiron 平台实现跨机构协作训练，不共享原始数据。Tabula 在多个下游基准上表现优异，揭示了造血、胰腺发育、神经发生和心脏发生中的组合调控逻辑。利用配对年轻和衰老人类成纤维细胞的 scRNA-seq 数据集，Tabula 通过年龄和身份评分引导的计算机优先排序提名了重编程因子，优于传统方法。
Motivation: 预训练基础模型在单细胞基因组学中显示出潜力，但扩展时存在隐私问题。此外，单细胞数据具有无序的表格结构，当前模型未充分利用这一结构。
Method: 提出 Tabula 模型，结合联邦学习与表格学习。开发 Chiron 平台，支持去中心化 AI 代理的协作训练，无需共享原始数据。
Result: Tabula 在下游基准任务上表现优异，并揭示了多种生物系统中的组合调控逻辑。在配对年轻和衰老人类成纤维细胞数据上，通过年龄和身份评分指导的 in silico 优先排序，提名了有效的重编程因子。
Conclusion: Tabula 通过将表格学习与联邦学习相结合，代表了单细胞基础建模的重要进展，为人类健康的隐私保护虚拟细胞铺平了道路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Leveraging Offline Supervision for Efficient and Generalizable Reinforcement Learning in Large-Scale Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: It is commonly observed that online reinforcement learning (RL) produces better-performing strategies than offline methods across a broad range of performance measures. In particular, RL-trained policies exhibit stronger out-of-distribution (OOD) behavior, where models trained only with imitation learning approaches often struggle. A recent study introduced an OOD-focused benchmark and reported that RL-trained vision-language-action (VLA) policies achieve noticeably better OOD performance and slightly better in-distribution (IND) performance than their counterparts trained with supervised fine-tuning (SFT). In this work, we investigate whether hybrid offline-online training can combine the advantages of both approaches. Specifically, we study RL methods regularized by offline supervision via either offline data or an offline-trained reference policy. We evaluate these approaches on the OOD benchmark and compare them with both offline-only training and standard RL. Our results show that although offline training achieves limited OOD performance by itself, incorporating offline supervision into RL preserves strong OOD capability while substantially improving training efficiency. In particular, the guided methods reach performance close to that of standard RL while requiring roughly half of the training budget. Rather than producing a trade-off between speed and OOD performance, the hybrid approach retains strong OOD capability while achieving this efficiency gain. Project page: https://alstar8.github.io/offline-supervision-vla-rl
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在大型视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）中，通过离线监督（离线数据或离线参考策略）正则化强化学习（RL），以结合在线RL的强泛化能力和离线训练的高效率。在OOD基准上，混合方法达到接近标准RL的性能，同时训练预算减半，且保持强大OOD能力。
Motivation: 在线RL策略OOD性能更好，但训练效率低；离线方法效率高但OOD性能有限。旨在结合两者优势，实现高效且泛化性强的训练。
Method: 在RL训练中引入离线监督正则化，具体包括利用离线监督数据或离线参考策略对RL进行约束。评估了多种混合方法并与纯离线训练和标准RL对比。
Result: 混合方法在OOD基准上性能接近标准RL，但训练预算减半（约一半训练步数即达到相近性能），同时OOD泛化能力未下降。
Conclusion: 离线监督可以高效提升RL训练效率，同时保持强大的OOD泛化能力，并非简单的速度-性能折中。

papers.title: HyGRL: Adaptive Hybrid Graph Reasoning for Multi-Entity Questions
papers.abstract_en: Multi-entity compositional questions pose significant challenges to existing retrieval-augmented language models. Conventional methods fall into a dilemma: standard RAG lacks dynamic reasoning, traditional Graph-RAG is limited by structural sparsity, and LLM-constructed Graph-RAG incurs prohibitive costs. We propose \textbf{\fwa}, a unified framework that embeds unstructured text into structured knowledge graphs, creating a heterogeneous network for flexible evidence retrieval. Reasoning is formulated as adaptive structure induction, learned via a robust two-stage process: (1) imitation learning distills heuristic expert signals, and (2) reinforcement learning refines the policy using LLM-driven preference rewards. Experiments demonstrate that {\fwa} effectively merges textual richness with structural knowledge, outperforming SOTA baselines in answer accuracy and reasoning fidelity while maintaining extremely low token costs and near real-time inference((code available at https://github.com/wjywjy123/HyGRL) .
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 现有检索增强语言模型（RAG）缺乏动态推理，传统Graph-RAG受限于结构稀疏性，而LLM构建的Graph-RAG成本过高，亟需一种兼顾文本丰富性和结构知识的统一框架。

Conclusion: HyGRL有效融合文本丰富性和结构知识，为多实体问题提供高效、低成本的推理方案。

papers.title: Memory Merge DQN: Sensitivity Weighted Target Updates for Stable Value Learning
papers.abstract_en: Deep Q-networks use target networks to stabilise bootstrapped value learning, but the standard hard copy update also introduces a tradeoff. Holding the target network fixed, improves short term stability, yet each hard update abruptly replaces the target parameters with the newest online network and discards recent parameter history. This can produce sudden changes in the bootstrap target and may remove value function structure that remains useful later in training. This paper introduces Memory Merge DQN, a target network update mechanism that maintains a short memory of recent historical online network copies and constructs the target network by merging network parameters based on the Q-value sensitivity rather than copying only the newest online network. Memory Merge gives greater influence to parameters that remain locally important for current Q-value behaviour, while using a recency prior to keep the merged target close to the latest online parameters. The method is inspired by Fisher Weight Model Merging, but uses Q-value sensitivity rather than Fisher information as the weighting signal. This paper evaluates Memory Merge DQN on Atari environments against DQN, Averaged DQN, DQN with layer normalisation, and PQN (with gradient clipping). The results show that Memory Merge DQN is highly competitive and it achieves the largest number of first place final performance results among the evaluated methods, beats DQN, Averaged DQN, and PQN (with gradient clipping), and produces substantial gains in several games where preserving useful value-function parameters appears beneficial. These findings suggest that selectively merging recent parameter weights and history can improve the stability and final performance of DQN agents, and that target network design is an important mechanism for preserving useful value function structure during long horizon value learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Memory Merge DQN，一种基于Q值敏感性的权重合并目标网络更新机制，通过维护近期历史在线网络副本并选择性合并参数，以改善深度Q网络的价值学习稳定性。在Atari环境上评估，相比于DQN、Averaged DQN、Layer Norm DQN和PQN（带梯度裁剪），Memory Merge DQN获得最多的第一名最终性能，并在多个游戏中显著提升。
Motivation: 标准硬拷贝目标网络更新方式在短期稳定性和长期参数利用率之间存在权衡，频繁替换可能丢弃有用的价值函数结构。
Method: Memory Merge DQN维护一个短期记忆，存储最近的在线网络副本，然后基于Q值敏感性（而非Fisher信息）合并参数，同时使用近期性先验保持靠近最新参数。
Result: 在Atari环境上，Memory Merge DQN获得最多的第一名最终性能，击败了DQN、Averaged DQN、Layer Norm DQN和PQN（带梯度裁剪），在多个需要保留有用价值函数参数的游戏中取得显著提升。
Conclusion: 选择性合并近期参数权重和历史可以提升DQN的稳定性和最终性能，目标网络设计是在长时序价值学习中保留有用价值函数结构的重要机制。

papers.title: CrackedPDFs: A Controlled Benchmark for Hidden Prompt Injection in PDFs
papers.abstract_en: Document-based LLM systems often flatten a PDF before guardrails inspect it. That step can discard evidence that an instruction was never visible to the user. We introduce CrackedPDFs, a controlled benchmark for hidden prompt injection in PDFs. The benchmark contains 29,322 generated PDFs from 4,983 base docu ments. It includes 9,774 injected files and 19,548 benign or matched-confounder files. We evaluate PromptGuard and a rule baseline. We also evaluate structural only learned models and a sanitized hybrid detector. The evaluation uses held-out provenance splits and paired benign-confounder controls. It also uses label-shuffle checks and shortcut audits. On a 2,919-document held-out test set, the hybrid de tector reaches 0.960 F1. ROC-AUC is 0.998 and PR-AUC is 0.997. It also ranks injected files above matched benign confounders in 95.9% of 973 pairs. Prompt Guard has low recall when given extracted text only. Structural-only learned mod els are weak under paired controls. A text-only TF-IDF model reaches perfect held-out scores but fails shortcut audits. These results show that document-aware hybrid detection is useful under controlled paired evaluation. They do not show broad real-world robustness or reliable cross-family generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了CrackedPDFs基准，用于评估LLM系统在PDF中隐藏提示注入的检测能力。基准包含29,322个PDF文件，涵盖注入、良性及混淆对照样本。评估了多种检测器，混合检测器在留出测试集上达到0.960 F1，但作者强调结果不表示广泛的实际鲁棒性或跨族泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有文档型LLM系统在安全检测前通常将PDF扁平化，可能丢失用户不可见指令的证据。缺乏针对PDF隐藏提示注入的受控基准。
Method: 构建了包含29,322个PDF的基准，来自4,983个基础文档，包括注入文件、良性文件和匹配混淆文件。评估了PromptGuard、规则基线、纯结构学习模型以及混合检测器，使用留出来源划分、配对对照、标签洗牌检查和捷径审计。
Result: 混合检测器在2,919个文档的留出测试集上达到0.960 F1，ROC-AUC为0.998，PR-AUC为0.997，并在95.9%的配对中将注入文件排名高于良性混淆文件。文本提取情况下Prompt Guard召回率低，纯结构模型在配对对照下表现弱，纯TF-IDF模型虽在留出集上完美但未通过捷径审计。
Conclusion: 文档感知的混合检测在受控配对评估中有用，但结果不证明广泛的实际鲁棒性或可靠跨族泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Trajectories to Prefixes: Reusing Teacher Trajectories via Replayed Prefixes and Online Continuation
papers.abstract_en: Small language models are attractive backbones for interactive agents, but direct distillation from strong teacher trajectories often turns rich multi-turn behavior into one-shot imitation targets. This is inefficient in long-horizon environments, where early decisions shape later states and rewards. We propose Prefix-GRPO, a reinforcement learning framework that decomposes teacher trajectories into replay-aligned prefix queries and online continuations. Each prefix is replayed in the environment to recover a valid intermediate state, after which the student continues online interaction and receives task reward. Unlike response-only GRPO, Prefix-GRPO also applies clipped policy updates to historical assistant tokens inside the replayed prefix, using a policy-distilled SFT checkpoint to estimate their old log-probabilities. This unifies prefix learning and continuation learning within the same policy-optimization form. Experiments on TextCraft, BabyAI, and ALFWorld show that Prefix-GRPO improves small-model agents over distillation and standard RL baselines, while ablations show that replay alone is insufficient without explicit prefix-token optimization. The implementation and reproduction scripts are available at https://github.com/HappynessI/Prefix_GRPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Prefix-GRPO，一种将教师轨迹分解为重放对齐前缀和在线延续的强化学习框架，用于小语言模型在长周期环境中的多轮交互学习。通过重放前缀恢复中间状态并让模型继续在线交互，同时对前缀中的历史token进行裁剪策略更新，统一了前缀学习和延续学习。在TextCraft、BabyAI和ALFWorld上的实验表明，Prefix-GRPO优于蒸馏和标准RL基线。
Motivation: 直接蒸馏教师轨迹将丰富的多轮行为转化为一次性模仿目标，在长周期环境中效率低下，因为早期决策影响后续状态和奖励。现有方法缺乏对前缀本身的有效优化。
Method: 将教师轨迹分解为前缀和后续部分：在环境中重放前缀恢复有效中间状态，学生从该状态继续在线交互并获得奖励；对前缀中的历史助手token进行裁剪策略更新，利用策略蒸馏的SFT检查点估计旧对数概率，统一前缀学习和延续学习。
Result: 在TextCraft、BabyAI和ALFWorld任务上，Prefix-GRPO改进了小模型智能体性能，优于蒸馏和标准RL基线；消融实验表明仅重放而不优化前缀token是不够的。
Conclusion: Prefix-GRPO通过显式优化前缀token和统一学习目标，提升了教师轨迹的利用效率，适用于长周期交互任务。代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cross-Subject Semantic Decoding with Shared-Space Alignment for Generalized Neural Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Generalizing across subjects remains challenging in invasive neural recordings because electrode configurations, anatomical structures, and neural signal patterns vary substantially across individuals. To investigate such inter-subject variability, we propose a cross-subject semantic decoding framework that aligns neural responses to speech perception from multiple subjects into a shared latent space and learns a mapping from the aligned neural representations to contextual embeddings. More specifically, using electrocorticography data collected during natural language comprehension, we estimate the shared space using the shared response model and train a decoder to predict contextual semantic embeddings from projected neural responses. For a held-out subject, we estimate a subject-specific projection into the predefined shared space, and directly apply the pretrained decoder without any retraining. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently outperforms baseline methods across evaluation settings and exhibits a reduced performance drop from source subject to held-out subject testing, indicating improved cross-subject generalization. These results suggest that aligning neural activity into a shared latent space, while decoding in a semantic embedding space, provides an effective strategy for improving cross-subject generalization by reducing subject-specific differences in neural responses while effectively capturing shared stimulus-related representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对侵入式神经记录中跨被试泛化困难的问题，提出一个跨被试语义解码框架。该框架利用共享响应模型将多个被试对自然语言理解的ECoG神经反应对齐到共享潜在空间，并学习从对齐神经表征到上下文语义嵌入的映射。对于新被试，仅需估计其到共享空间的投影，即可直接应用预训练解码器而无需重新训练。实验显示，该方法在评估中持续优于基线，且从源被试到留出被试的性能下降更小，表明跨被试泛化能力提升。
Motivation: 侵入式神经记录中，电极配置、解剖结构和神经信号模式在个体间差异大，导致跨被试泛化困难。
Method: 提出跨被试语义解码框架：先使用共享响应模型将多个被试对语音感知的神经反应对齐到共享潜在空间，再训练解码器从对齐的神经表征预测上下文语义嵌入。对新被试，仅需估计其到共享空间的投影，然后直接应用预训练解码器。
Result: 实验表明，该框架在所有评估设置中一致优于基线方法，从源被试到留出被试测试的性能下降更小，表明跨被试泛化能力提高。
Conclusion: 将神经活动对齐到共享潜在空间并结合语义嵌入空间解码，可有效减少被试特异性差异，同时保留共享刺激表征，从而提升跨被试泛化。

papers.title: Decodable but Not Detectable: A Leakage Fingerprint for Near-OOD Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: While auditing a perturbation-based OOD detector on a document benchmark, we recorded an AUROC of 0.326 -- well below the 0.5 chance level. The cause is a benchmark leak: the designated "OOD" class is one the model was trained on, so its examples sit inside the in-distribution fit set and the detector is penalized for correctly ranking them as familiar. Deleting the class and retraining 35 models across two domains raises the score to 0.911. We distill the contamination into a leak fingerprint -- near-perfect supervised decodability (AUROC approximately 1) coupled with unsupervised detection collapsed below 0.65 -- and validate it on a controlled battery of 52 settings (20 leaked, 32 clean) across ResNet-50 and ViT-B/16 on CIFAR-10/100, achieving sensitivity 18/20 and specificity 31/32 in embedding space; the matched fit-set-exclusion controls are perfect at 20/20. An in-the-wild audit of 24 standard near/far OOD benchmark pairs fires on exactly one (the intrinsically hard CIFAR-100 vs CIFAR-10 pair) and on no far-OOD pair, confirming specificity and that standard cross-dataset construction is clean. Under the corrected protocol, perturbation signals are decodable but not detectable: a supervised reader recovers the OOD signal (AUROC 0.87-1.00) while no unsupervised detector does, and the perturbation method does not improve on plain Mahalanobis distance. We provide a theoretical account of why and, for transparency, retract an earlier circular correlation. The contributions are a corrected protocol and a validated leak diagnostic, not a new OOD method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现并诊断了扰动式OOD检测基准中的一个泄漏问题：被标记为OOD的类别实际上在训练集中出现过，导致检测器AUROC低至0.326。通过删除该类别并重新训练模型，AUROC提升至0.911。作者提出了一种泄漏指纹（leak fingerprint）：在监督任务中几乎完美可解码（AUROC约1），但在无监督检测中性能低于0.65。在52个受控设置中验证了该指纹，灵敏度18/20，特异性31/32。对24个标准近/远OOD基准对的审计只触发了一个泄漏（CIFAR-100 vs CIFAR-10），证实了其他基准的清洁性。论文还提供了理论解释，并修正了之前的错误相关性。
Motivation: 现有的OOD检测基准可能存在泄漏问题，导致检测器性能评估失真。作者在实际审计中发现一个文档基准的AUROC异常低（0.326），低于随机水平，这促使他们系统性地研究并诊断泄漏问题。
Method: 作者通过删除泄漏类别并重新训练模型来修复基准，并提出了一个泄漏指纹：在嵌入空间中，泄漏数据在监督任务中几乎完美可解码（AUROC约1），但在无监督检测（如基于距离的检测）中性能低于0.65。该方法在CIFAR-10/100上使用ResNet-50和ViT-B/16进行验证。
Result: 在52个受控设置（20个泄漏，32个清洁）中，泄漏指纹的灵敏度为18/20，特异性为31/32。匹配的fit-set-exclusion控制完全正确（20/20）。对24个标准基准对的审计只发现一个泄漏（CIFAR-100 vs CIFAR-10），且没有发现远OOD对泄漏。在修正协议下，扰动信号可解码但不可检测：监督方法AUROC为0.87-1.00，而无监督方法均低于0.65，且扰动方法并未优于普通的马氏距离。
Conclusion: 论文贡献了一个修正后的OOD检测协议和一个验证过的泄漏诊断方法，而非提出新的OOD方法。作者强调，泄漏问题会导致对OOD检测器性能的误导性评估，并提供了理论解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Predicting Groundwater Arsenic Concentrations Using Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Arsenic contamination in groundwater presents a longstanding public health crisis in the United States, especially for households depending on private wells. Accurate and spatially informed prediction of arsenic concentration is vital to identify high-risk areas and focus mitigation efforts. However, there is a lack of generalizable models for representing continuous variation in arsenic concentrations across regions. In this work, we pose arsenic prediction as a regression task and construct a spatially integrated dataset to aggregate over 74,000 arsenic samples from the Water Quality Portal (WQP), Mineral Resources Data System (MRDS), and Gridded National Soil Survey Geographic Database (gNATSGO). Specifically, we use a variety of techniques including kNearest Neighbors (k-NN) and Geographic Information Systems (GIS) to join arsenic measurement points from across the United States by location. Building on this dataset, we evaluate a diverse suite of machine learning models, including tree-based ensemble approaches, multilayer perceptrons, and spatially aware graph neural networks (GNN). Our findings show that while gradient-boosted trees are still considered state-of-the-art in the field of tabular data, GNNs are able to further account for spatial dependence to match or outperform the results of gradient-boosted trees. These results demonstrate that graph-based and spatially informed learning can enhance environmental prediction and provide a foundation for improved groundwater risk mapping and monitoring.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, 1 table, AAAI '26 AI4ES workshop acceptance
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将地下水砷浓度预测建模为回归任务，构建了包含超过74,000个样本的空间集成数据集，并评估了多种机器学习模型，包括基于树的集成方法、多层感知机和图神经网络（GNN）。结果表明，GNN能够进一步利用空间依赖性，达到或超过梯度提升树的性能，为地下水风险制图提供了基础。
Motivation: 美国地下水砷污染是长期公共卫生问题，尤其影响依赖私人水井的家庭，但缺乏可泛化的模型来表示砷浓度的连续空间变化。
Method: 从水质门户、矿产资源数据系统和网格化国家土壤调查地理数据库收集砷样本，使用k-NN和GIS方法按位置关联数据，构建空间集成数据集；评估了多种模型，重点比较梯度提升树和GNN。
Result: GNN能够进一步利用空间依赖性，匹配或优于梯度提升树的结果，而梯度提升树此前被视为表格数据领域的state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: 基于图的空间感知学习可以增强环境预测，为改进地下水风险制图和监测提供基础。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: LAARA: Layer-Aware Adaptive Rank Allocation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Low-Rank Adaptation is widely used for parameter-efficient fine-tuning, yet existing methods typically assign the same adapter rank to every transformer layer despite their heterogeneous adaptation requirements. In this work, we show theoretically and empirically that uniform rank allocation is fundamentally suboptimal. Motivated by this observation, we propose LAARA (Layer Aware Adaptive Rank Allocation framework), a search-free framework that dynamically allocates ranks using lightweight diagonal Fisher estimates computed during training. LAARA combines projection-wise normalization, logarithmic compression, blended adapter importance estimation, and a vote-to-change dampening mechanism to produce stable and efficient rank adaptation. Experiments on GLUE and MathInstruct benchmark demonstrate that LAARA consistently matches or outperforms popular state of the art approaches such as LoRA, AdaLoRA, DyLoRA, and Bitfit while using significantly fewer trainable parameters. Our results show that Fisher-guided rank allocation provides a principled and effective foundation for adaptive parameter-efficient fine-tuning. The code is publicly available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LAARA-D305/LAARA.py
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LAARA框架，一种无搜索的层感知自适应秩分配方法，用于参数高效微调（PEFT）。它利用轻量级对角Fisher信息估计动态分配适配器秩，通过投影归一化、对数压缩、混合适配器重要性估计和投票改变阻尼机制实现稳定高效的秩适应。在GLUE和MathInstruct基准上，该方法在显著减少可训练参数的同时匹配或超越LoRA、AdaLoRA等现有方法。
Motivation: 现有低秩适配方法通常对所有transformer层分配相同秩，忽略了各层不同的适配需求，理论上和经验上证明均匀秩分配是次优的。
Method: 提出LAARA框架，利用训练过程中计算的对角Fisher信息估计动态分配秩，结合投影归一化、对数压缩、混合适配器重要性估计和投票改变阻尼机制。
Result: 在GLUE和MathInstruct基准上，LAARA匹配或超越LoRA、AdaLoRA、DyLoRA、Bitfit等最先进方法，同时使用更少的可训练参数。
Conclusion: Fisher指导的秩分配为自适应参数高效微调提供了原则性和有效的基础。代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Orthogonalized Read Is a Removable Training Scaffold for Recurrent Memory
papers.abstract_en: A recent report finds that orthogonalizing the mLSTM memory matrix at read time (five Newton-Schulz iterations, trained through) substantially improves noisy associative recall. The effect replicates, but it is not a memory improvement. Training on this task is a long chance plateau followed by a sharp escape, and the orthogonalized read acts by re-conditioning the learning problem during the plateau. Three properties establish this. It must be self-consistent: an exact recursive least-squares read (the Mesa layer) reproduces it, while straight-through halves, delta-rule writes, frozen random keys, and plain normalization all fail. It is uniform: across a learning-rate x hardness grid it multiplies the escape hazard roughly six-fold with no detectable hardness dependence, widening the workable learning-rate corridor that narrows for the baseline. And it is removable: applied to failed models at inference it rescues none, and annealed away on an escape-triggered schedule it leaves numerically stock mLSTMs at full accuracy. Much of the published gain needs no architecture at all -- solved-rate at a fixed budget measures escape hazard, which follows a heat/noise law (learning-rate elasticity +3.0, gradient-noise elasticity -1.65) under which the original vocab-96 result is a large-batch noise condition rather than a capacity one. Decoding the memory state directly shows failed models carry roughly half their associations in linearly recoverable form: the plateau is a readout failure over half-written storage. Two conclusions travel beyond the intervention: recall benchmarks used for architecture selection partly measure trainability, and the system is a fully instrumented model organism of "emergence," in which a sharp behavioral threshold demonstrably arises from a censored metric over gradually accumulating structure.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 8 figures. Code, per-seed results, and checkpoints: https://github.com/no-way-labs/recurrent-memory-scaffold
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了对mLSTM记忆矩阵进行正交化读操作（通过牛顿-舒尔茨迭代）对噪声联想召回任务的影响。发现该操作并非真正改善记忆，而是通过重新调整训练条件（逃逸率）来提升训练效果。通过精确递归最小二乘读复制效果、均匀性测试及可移除性实验，作者论证了正交化读是一种可移除的训练脚手架，而非架构改进。
Motivation: 现有工作认为正交化读能改善mLSTM的记忆性能，但本文质疑其是否真正提升记忆容量，试图揭示其作用机制是训练动态而非记忆本身。
Method: 使用精确递归最小二乘读（Mesa层）作为对比，测试不同变体（直通半精度、delta规则写入、冻结随机键、普通归一化）的效果；在超参数网格上测量逃逸风险；通过推理时移除或退火验证其可移除性。
Result: 正交化读使逃逸风险增加约六倍，且不随任务难度变化；推理时对失败模型无改善作用；退火后模型恢复为标准mLSTM且精度不变。训练增益主要源于训练热度/噪声定律（学习率弹性+3.0，梯度噪声弹性-1.65）。
Conclusion: 联想召回基准部分衡量的是可训练性而非记忆容量；该系统可作为研究“涌现”现象的模型有机体，展示尖锐行为阈值源于对逐渐累积结构的截断度量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Simulating Eutopia: Revisiting Long-term Fairness with Outcomes, Performativity, and Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: As AI-driven Decision Makers (ADMs) influence our socioeconomic reality, their roles in both enhancing efficiency and amplifying the social biases have drawn attention. In this paper, we revisit the nuances of long-term `fairness' achievable by an ADM, specifically in the context of a credit lending induced wealth process. The literature on long-term fairness mostly (a) considers passive environments, i.e. the outcome of a predictor does not change the population's behaviour, and (b) measures bias in terms of disparity in instantaneous predictions rather than the downstream equity. These are not true for modern ADMs, like credit lenders. To address these caveats, we first formalise the wealth dynamics induced by a loan approving ADM interacting with a multi-demographic population as a performative Markov Decision Process with ADM level and social outcome level reward functions. Then, we mitigate the absence of such a performative test-bed by developing Eutopia: a lending-process simulator enabled with a novel performative data generator to learn long-term fair strategies. Finally, we test performative and classical RL algorithms with different fairness-aware and utilitarian utilities. Experimental results show that (a) learning with performative dynamics lead to better long-term efficiency and equity, and (b) learning with well-designed fairness-aware utility evaluated on social outcomes induces better efficiency, equity, and inclusivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了AI决策者（ADM）在长期公平性中的细微差别，特别是在信用贷款引发的财富过程中。针对现有长期公平性文献忽略环境表演性（performativity）和下游权益的缺陷，作者将ADM与多人口群体交互的财富动态形式化为表演性马尔可夫决策过程（performative MDP），并开发了名为Eutopia的贷款过程模拟器，包含新颖的表演性数据生成器。实验表明，学习表演性动态可提升长期效率和公平性，而基于社交结果评估的公平感知效用函数可同时改善效率、公平性和包容性。
Motivation: 现有长期公平性研究大多假设被动环境（即预测结果不改变人群行为），且仅关注瞬时预测差异而非下游权益，这不符合现代ADM（如信用贷款）的实际表现。本文旨在解决这些缺陷。
Method: 首先将贷款批准ADM与多人口群体交互的财富动态形式化为表演性马尔可夫决策过程（performative MDP），包含ADM层面和社交结果层面的奖励函数；然后开发Eutopia模拟器，配备新颖的表演性数据生成器以学习长期公平策略；最后测试表演性RL算法和经典RL算法，结合不同的公平感知和功利主义效用函数。
Result: 实验结果显示：（a）学习表演性动态比传统方法带来更好的长期效率和公平性；（b）基于社交结果评估的精心设计的公平感知效用函数能同时提升效率、公平性和包容性。
Conclusion: 本文强调了在长期公平性中考虑表演性动态和社交结果评估的重要性，Eutopia模拟器为相关研究提供了可用的测试平台。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 本文强调了在长期公平性中考虑表演性动态和社交结果评估的重要性，Eutopia模拟器为相关研究提供了可用的测试平台。

papers.title: Neural Operator Surrogates for Two-Dimensional Neutron Flux Estimation
papers.abstract_en: This work extends our one-dimensional single-sweep neural-operator studies to two dimensions. We consider one-group transport with isotropic scattering. As in the one-dimensional work, we use Fourier neural operators (FNOs) to approximate the high-fidelity scalar flux. Additionally, we also investigate U-shaped neural operators (UNOs) in this study. We consider three surrogates. The first two map the material and source fields directly to the flux, one using an FNO and one using a UNO. The third is an FNO that additionally takes the scalar flux after one source iteration, the single-sweep approximation, as an input. Each case is solved to high fidelity with a verified discrete-ordinates solver, and an average relative L_2 error norm is used to characterize the quality of the inferred maps. We train every surrogate over three random seeds so that differences between them can be assessed against run-to-run variability. Two questions guide the study: whether the single-sweep input improves accuracy over the direct maps, and whether training on the logarithm of the flux improves accuracy in the strongly attenuated regions relevant to shielding.

papers.summary_zh:

Conclusion: 该方法有望为二维中子通量估计提供高效代理，但具体精度提升和适用性需待实验结果验证。

papers.title: Scale-Aware Learning of Chaotic Dynamics on Unstructured Meshes via Binned Spectral Losses
papers.abstract_en: Surrogate modeling for high-dimensional nonlinear dynamical systems that exhibit chaos requires mechanisms that preserve not only pointwise accuracy but also the scale-dependent structure of physical fields. Bandwise spectral power losses, such as the binned spectral loss function, provide such supervision on structured grids, where Fourier modes define a standard frequency decomposition. On irregular meshes, however, no canonical Fourier basis exists, and spectral representations must be constructed from graph operators induced by mesh connectivity and geometry. In this study, we extend the binned spectral power loss for application to unstructured-mesh surrogate modeling of nonlinear dynamical systems. This is obtained by replacing Fourier bands with graph-Laplacian frequency bands, and we provide scalable Chebyshev and multilevel approximations for improving long-horizon rollout fidelity. In its full-spectrum form, our approach uses graph Laplacian eigenspaces to provide a graph analogue of Fourier band-power matching, but incurs the high cost of spectral decomposition. As a scalable approximation, we replace exact band projectors with sparse Chebyshev polynomial graph filters, avoiding explicit eigendecomposition. When utilizing multilevel graph architectures, we introduce Graph Laplacian Energy Alignment for Meshes (GLEAM), which applies retained-subspace scale-aware supervision across graph hierarchies so that coarse and fine representations are regularized during autoregressive rollout. Our results show that the proposed spectral losses improve long-horizon rollout fidelity and preserve statistical invariants for the forecasting of turbulent flows on unstructured meshes, compared to deterministic baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非结构化网格上混沌动力系统的代理建模，提出基于图拉普拉斯频带的分箱谱损失（binned spectral loss）方法，替代传统傅里叶频带损失。通过切比雪夫多项式滤波和层级图拉普拉斯能量对齐（GLEAM）实现可扩展近似，在湍流预测任务上提升了长程滚动保真度和统计不变性。
Motivation: 现有谱损失方法依赖于结构化网格上的傅里叶分解，无法直接应用于非结构化网格；而直接图拉普拉斯特征分解计算成本过高，限制了长程预测的保真度。
Method: 将傅里叶频带替换为图拉普拉斯频带，提出全谱图频带损失；为降低计算成本，采用稀疏切比雪夫多项式图滤波器近似频带投影；进一步提出GLEAM，在多层级图架构中对粗细表示施加保留子空间的尺度感知监督。
Result: 在非结构化网格的湍流预测任务上，所提谱损失相比确定性基线提升了长程滚动保真度，并更好地保持了统计不变量。
Conclusion: 基于图拉普拉斯的频带损失能有效推广谱损失到非结构化网格，为混沌动力系统代理建模提供了新范式。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Building Fast, Evaluating Slow: Pipeline Choices Dominate Autointerpretability Score Variance
papers.abstract_en: Cross-paper comparison of sparse autoencoder (SAE) interpretability often relies on autointerpretability scores. In this evaluation pipeline, a language model (LM) explains each feature, and another LM scores the explanation. For these comparisons to be meaningful, scores must reflect stable properties of the features rather than confounding aspects of the evaluation pipeline. Through systematic experiments across four metrics (simulation, detection, fuzzing, purity), two models (Pythia-160M, Apertus-8B), and four axes of methodological variation, we show that this assumption does not hold. Specifically, we find that R1) methodological variance collectively exceeds architectural variance across all metrics and tested models; R2) each metric exhibits a distinct instability profile, with detection being the most stable and fuzzing unreliable across all conditions; R3) top-k feature rankings do not stay consistent across corpus and draw conditions, masking per-feature instability behind stable mean scores; a failure that cannot be detected by monitoring explanation similarity alone. These findings suggest that cross-paper comparisons based on autointerpretability scores may reflect pipeline differences rather than architectural differences, with implications for the ongoing debate on SAE utility. More broadly, unreliable evaluation slows progress in interpretability research at a time when reliable tools for understanding AI systems are needed. To support evaluation, we contribute a variance decomposition approach, a Stability Check, and a Minimum Reporting Checklist.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了稀疏自编码器（SAE）可解释性的自动评估流程，发现方法学方差（如语料库、提示等）超过架构方差，导致不同论文间的可解释性分数比较可能反映的是流程差异而非架构差异。实验覆盖四个指标、两个模型和四个方法论变化轴，揭示了指标不稳定性和特征排名不可靠等问题。
Motivation: 现有论文常使用自动可解释性分数（autointerpretability scores）比较不同SAE，但假设分数反映特征稳定属性而非评估流程的混淆因素，该假设未经验证。
Method: 通过系统实验，在四个指标（simulation, detection, fuzzing, purity）、两个模型（Pythia-160M, Apertus-8B）和四个方法论变化轴（语料库、提示、模型、随机种子）上量化方差来源，并贡献了方差分解方法、稳定性检查（Stability Check）和最低报告检查表。
Result: 方法学方差在所有指标和模型上均超过架构方差；detection最稳定，fuzzing最不可靠；top-k特征排名在语料库和随机种子条件下不一致，且仅靠解释相似性无法检测该问题。
Conclusion: 论文指出基于自动可解释性分数的跨论文比较可能反映流程差异，影响SAE效用的辩论，并呼吁更可靠的评估工具。

papers.title: STN-TGAT: Top-K Portfolio Construction via Prior-Guided Graph Attention with Learnable Soft-Threshold Sparsification
papers.abstract_en: This paper tackles the problem of stock ranking and portfolio construction under realistic investment settings by jointly modeling temporal dynamics and cross-sectional dependencies. We propose the Soft-Threshold NMI-prior Transformer Graph Attention Network (STN-TGAT), which integrates a temporal Transformer with a Graph Attention Network to capture long-horizon sequential patterns and dynamic inter-stock relationships. An NMI-based prior graph combined with a soft-threshold sparsification mechanism enhances structural robustness by mitigating noisy correlations while preserving informative connections. The portfolio formation process incorporates practical considerations, including Top-5 selection within the Top-50 $S\&P$ 500 constituents, explicit weight allocation, and transaction cost adjustment, thereby aligning the evaluation with real-world trading conditions. Empirical results on real-world data demonstrate that STN-TGAT consistently outperforms benchmark models from predictive accuracy and investment profitability measured by portfolio returns. These findings suggest that combining decision-aligned training with adaptive relational modeling provides a coherent and practically effective framework for data-driven portfolio construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出STN-TGAT模型，结合时序Transformer和图注意力网络，用于股票排序和投资组合构建。通过基于NMI的先验图和软阈值稀疏化机制增强结构鲁棒性，并纳入实际交易约束（如Top-5选择、权重分配和交易成本调整）。实证表明该模型在预测精度和投资收益上优于基准。
Motivation: 现有股票排序方法难以同时建模时序动态和横截面依赖性，且缺乏对真实交易条件的考虑，导致理论与实际脱节。
Method: 提出STN-TGAT，整合时序Transformer捕捉长期序列模式与图注意力网络建模动态股票间关系；引入基于NMI的先验图并通过软阈值稀疏化剔除噪声连接；投资组合构建包含Top-5选择、显式权重分配和交易成本调整。
Result: 在S&P 500真实数据上，STN-TGAT在预测精度和投资回报率上一致优于对比模型。
Conclusion: 决策对齐训练与自适应关系建模相结合，为数据驱动的投资组合构建提供了连贯且实用的框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SUM: Unified Geometric Surgery on Spatio-Temporal Adaptation Vectors for Federated Class Incremental Learning
papers.abstract_en: Real-world intelligent systems often require both distributed collaboration across data-isolated clients and continual adaptation to evolving tasks. This setting naturally gives rise to Federated Class Incremental Learning (FCIL), which combines Federated Learning (FL) and Continual Learning (CL). However, their combination introduces two coupled sources of interference: spatial interference from heterogeneous clients and temporal interference from sequential tasks, jointly leading to Spatial-Temporal Catastrophic Forgetting (ST-CF). Existing approaches typically address spatial and temporal interference with separate mechanisms, often incurring additional client-side computation or communication, while leaving directional interactions among updates during aggregation unregulated. In this paper, we reinterpret FCIL as a unified multi-task learning problem, where both client and task updates are represented as adaptation vectors in a shared parameter space. Based on this view, we propose Unified Geometric Surgery on Spatio-Temporal Adaptation Vectors (SUM), a purely server-side framework that performs geometric surgery on adaptation vectors during aggregation. Spatial SUM mitigates client-level interference within each round, while causal online temporal SUM removes cross-task interference over time without additional client-side computation, communication, or memory beyond standard federated training. Empirically, SUM achieves up to 22% improvement over prior FCIL methods across diverse vision and language benchmarks while remaining robust to unreliable clients and maintaining computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SUM，一个纯服务端的框架，通过对适应向量（adaptation vectors）进行几何手术（geometric surgery）来统一处理联邦类增量学习（FCIL）中的空间干扰（客户端间）和时间干扰（任务间），从而缓解时空灾难性遗忘（ST-CF）。在多个视觉和语言基准上，SUM相比现有FCIL方法提升高达22%，且无需额外的客户端计算、通信或存储。
Motivation: FCIL中客户端异质性与连续任务学习共同导致时空灾难性遗忘（ST-CF），现有方法通常用分离机制处理空间和时间干扰，带来额外开销且未规范聚合时的方向交互。
Method: 将FCIL重新解释为统一的多任务学习问题，客户端和任务更新表示为共享参数空间中的适应向量，然后提出SUM：在聚合时对适应向量执行几何手术，包括空间SUM（减轻每轮内客户端干扰）和因果在线时间SUM（随时间消除跨任务干扰），完全在服务端进行。
Result: 摘要报告SUM在多种视觉和语言基准上相比先前FCIL方法提升高达22%，同时对不可靠客户端具有鲁棒性并保持计算效率。
Conclusion: SUM表明纯服务端的几何手术可以有效统一处理FCIL中的空间和时间干扰，避免增加客户端负担。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Trend strength predicts when generative foundation models win: a power-controlled benchmark, a mechanism, and an actionable selection rule
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained generative foundation models cast forecasting as conditional generation from a learned predictive distribution and forecast unseen series zero-shot. We establish three results that turn their reported success into an actionable, mechanistic understanding. First (a positive benchmark result): on a power-controlled study of 1728 rolling-origin forecasts over 36 series from 19 datasets spanning the full range of STL trend strength (F_T in [0.17, 1.00]), a zero-shot Chronos model significantly outperforms four strong classical baselines -- drift, seasonal-naive, Theta, and additive Holt-Winters/ETS -- with the best mean MASE (1.187 vs. Theta 1.337, ETS 1.656; Friedman chi^2 = 46.08, p = 8.75e-09; Holm-corrected Wilcoxon p <= 0.015 against every baseline; a Nemenyi critical difference separating it from the classical pack). Second (a novel, quantified mechanism): a controlled synthetic experiment with a known trend-generating process shows why -- and reveals that the win does not come from better trend extrapolation. When the true trend is linear, damped, or exponential, additive ETS tracks the slope (slope-tracking ratio 1.02, 1.34, 0.98) whereas Chronos systematically under-extrapolates, behaving as a trend-shrinkage estimator (ratio 0.80, 0.49, 0.36). Third (an actionable selection rule): because the advantage is a shrinkage effect, it is predictable from trend strength alone -- the generative model wins 78% of low-trend series but only 44% of high-trend ones, and its edge over ETS is significant on the low-trend stratum (0.982 vs. 1.671, p = 0.002) yet a tie on the high-trend stratum (p = 0.18). Trend strength, computable before forecasting from the training context alone, is therefore a practical a-priori indicator of when to deploy a foundation model. We additionally document a calibration shortfall (80% intervals cover 0.77).

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过1728个滚动预测的功率控制基准实验，发现零样本Chronos生成模型在时间序列预测中显著优于四个经典基线（如Theta、ETS），但其优势并非来自更好的趋势外推，而是表现为趋势收缩。合成实验显示Chronos对线性、阻尼和指数趋势均系统性低估趋势斜率。基于此，作者提出一个可操作的规则：仅凭训练数据可计算的趋势强度（STL的F_T）即可预测生成模型的胜率——在低趋势序列中胜率78%，高趋势中仅44%。此外，模型校准存在不足（80%区间覆盖率0.77）。
Motivation: 现有研究报告了生成基础模型在零样本时间序列预测中的成功，但缺乏对其何时有效及背后机制的量化理解。本文旨在提供可操作的机制性解释。
Method: 采用STL趋势强度（F_T）对19个数据集、36个序列进行滚动预测（1728个原点），对比Chronos与漂移、季节朴素、Theta、加性Holt-Winters/ETS基线；通过已知趋势生成过程的合成实验量化Chronos的趋势外推行为；使用Friedman检验、Holm修正Wilcoxon检验和Nemenyi临界差进行统计比较。
Result: Chronos的最佳平均MASE为1.187，优于Theta（1.337）和ETS（1.656）；趋势强度可预测胜负：低趋势序列中Chronos胜率78%，高趋势中仅44%；合成实验中Chronos的趋势斜率比仅为0.80（线性）、0.49（阻尼）和0.36（指数），表明其系统性低外推；模型80%预测区间实际覆盖率为0.77。
Conclusion: 生成基础模型的时间序列优势本质是趋势收缩效应，趋势强度可作为实用的先验选择指标。这一机制解释和可操作规则有助于实践者决定何时部署生成模型。
