papers.title: Challenges of Explainability in Continual Learning for Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models have shown strong potential for time series forecasting, yet their deployment in real-world environmental monitoring remains challenging due to non-stationary dynamics and limited explainability. In this work, we investigate explainability as a central tool for understanding continual learning in adaptive time series forecasting, with Experience Replay strategies. We study neural forecasting architectures such as PatchMixer, PatchTST and DLinear, augmented with attention-based sampling mechanisms to support model adaptation over time. Explainability is leveraged through attention rollout and gradient-based attribution methods (Grad-CAM) to analyze both predictive behavior and sampling strategies within a continual learning framework. Experiments conducted on real-world piezometric time series exhibiting heterogeneous patterns and regime shifts show that analyzing model and sampling behaviors provides valuable insights into the dynamics of the continual learning framework. Beyond predictive performance, our results highlight the challenges and opportunities of using explainability to understand continual learning behaviors, revealing how attribution patterns evolve over time and how they can inform data selection and adaptation strategies in non-stationary forecasting scenarios.
papers.journal_ref: EDBT/ICDT 2026 Joint Conference, Mar 2026, Tampere, Finland
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究时间序列预测中持续学习的可解释性，使用Experience Replay策略，增强基于注意力的采样机制，通过注意力展开和Grad-CAM解释模型行为。在真实压电水位时间序列上实验，表明可解释性有助于理解持续学习动态，但面临挑战。
Motivation: 深度学习在时间序列预测中表现良好，但部署在非平稳环境监测中缺乏可解释性，尤其是持续学习场景。
Method: 采用PatchMixer、PatchTST和DLinear等架构，结合基于注意力的采样机制和Experience Replay，通过注意力展开和Grad-CAM进行归因分析。
Result: 在具有异质模式和机制转换的压电水位时间序列上，可解释性分析揭示了模型和采样行为随时间演变的归因模式，有助于数据选择和适应策略。
Conclusion: 可解释性可以帮助理解持续学习行为，但在非平稳预测场景中仍面临挑战，需进一步探索。

papers.title: Air Quality Arena: A Large-Scale Multi-Region Ground Monitoring Dataset and Benchmark for Air Quality Forecasting with Time-Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Air pollution causes an estimated 7.9 million premature deaths annually, making accurate forecasting a critical public health priority. Machine learning is increasingly being applied to forecast air pollution levels, yet existing benchmarks remain narrow in both geographic scope and pollutant coverage, and fail to evaluate the latest generation of time series foundation models (TSFMs) on real world, large scale data. We present Air Quality Arena (AQA), a large scale multi-country and multi-pollutant dataset (AQA-Data) and benchmark (AQA-Bench) to address this gap. AQA covers 6 major pollutants over a three year period across 7 diverse countries and 4 continents, with more than 14,000 station-pollutant series, aiming to provide a comprehensive benchmark for air quality tasks. We benchmark this dataset across 11 leading time series foundation models and classical baselines to assess performance on short-term air quality forecasting. Our results demonstrate that TSFMs are effective zero-shot forecasters and consistently outperform classical baselines, with our top-performing model employing a cross-modal architecture that leverages a vision foundation model for time series forecasting. AQA is publicly released at AirQualityArena.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个大规模多区域地面监测数据集和基准（Air Quality Arena），覆盖6种主要污染物、7个国家、4大洲，超过14000个站点-污染物序列。作者在11个时间序列基础模型和经典基线上评估短期空气质量预报，发现时间序列基础模型作为零样本预报器一致优于经典基线，其中最佳模型采用跨模态架构利用视觉基础模型进行时间序列预测。
Motivation: 现有空气质量预报基准在地理范围和污染物覆盖上狭窄，未能评估最新时间序列基础模型在真实大规模数据上的性能。
Method: 构建了大规模多国多污染物数据集AQA-Data和基准AQA-Bench，覆盖6种污染物、3年时间、7个国家、4大洲、超过14000个序列，并基准测试了11个时间序列基础模型和经典基线。
Result: 时间序列基础模型作为零样本预报器一致优于经典基线，最佳模型采用跨模态架构利用视觉基础模型进行时间序列预测。
Conclusion: 该工作为空气质量预报提供了大规模基准，验证了时间序列基础模型的有效性，并公开了数据集。

papers.title: CruiseBench: A Real-Flight-Aligned N-CMAPSS Benchmark for Engine RUL Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Remaining useful life (RUL) prediction estimates how long an engine can continue safe operation and is central to maintenance planning. N-CMAPSS extends C-MAPSS by simulating run-to-failure aero-engine trajectories using recorded real-flight profiles and retaining complete within-flight time series rather than cycle-level snapshots. However, this added realism reduces evaluation control because full-flight records increase data volume and entangle degradation cues with operating-regime variation, complicating preprocessing choices and direct comparisons of RUL modeling performance. To mitigate this issue, this paper proposes CruiseBench, a cruise-stage RUL benchmark derived from N-CMAPSS. It introduces CPM-N-CMAPSS (Cruising-Period Mask for N-CMAPSS), a mask artifact that stores cycle-local cruising intervals identified by the common-altitude method for the nine accessible subdatasets. CruiseBench applies a fixed protocol to the masked rows, using scenario descriptors and measured sensors as inputs while excluding virtual sensors, health parameters, and auxiliary metadata from the feature tensor, preserving native-resolution windows, and applying dataset-wise RUL caps. Experiments with LSTM, GRU, TCN, and TSMixer provide baseline results for this setting. Under CruiseBench-eta5-W256-S10, TSMixer obtains the lowest average RMSE, $3.4\pm1.71$, and Saxena score, $(2.50\pm2.99)\times 10^{4}$. Ablation studies show that flight-stage selection, temporal downscaling method, and RUL-cap threshold affect reported results. With its fixed cruise-stage protocol, CruiseBench provides a reproducible sub-benchmark for controlled RUL model comparison and CPM-N-CMAPSS provides a stage-specific data foundation for future transfer-learning and domain-adaptation studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对N-CMAPSS全航程数据中工况变化与退化信号纠缠导致RUL建模评估困难的问题，本文提出基于巡航阶段的基准CruiseBench，通过CPM-N-CMAPSS掩码提取巡航段，固定预处理协议（排除虚拟传感器、健康参数等），提供可复现的子基准。实验在LSTM、GRU、TCN和TSMixer上给出基线，TSMixer取得最低平均RMSE 3.4±1.71和Saxena分数(2.50±2.99)×10^4。
Motivation: N-CMAPSS包含完整航程时间序列，数据量大且退化与工况变化混杂，阻碍了RUL模型间的公平比较，需要一种控制变量更强的评估设置。
Method: 提出CPM-N-CMAPSS掩码标记巡航段，对掩码行施加固定协议：使用场景描述符和实测传感器作为输入，排除虚拟传感器、健康参数和辅助元数据，保留原始分辨率窗口，并应用数据集级RUL上限。
Result: 在CruiseBench-eta5-W256-S10设置下，TSMixer获得最低平均RMSE 3.4±1.71和Saxena分数(2.50±2.99)×10^4；消融实验表明航段选择、时间降尺度方法和RUL上限阈值影响结果。
Conclusion: CruiseBench为可控的RUL模型对比提供了可复现的子基准，CPM-N-CMAPSS为迁移学习和领域自适应研究提供了阶段特定数据基础。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Bayesian Wind Tunnels for Model Selection
papers.abstract_en: Prior work has shown that transformers can perform exact Bayesian filtering within a fixed hypothesis class. Can they also perform Bayesian model selection -- identifying the correct hypothesis class from data? We introduce model-selection Bayesian wind tunnels: controlled environments where ground-truth posteriors over hypothesis classes are available in closed form. Using fixed-point-free involutions -- whose defining property f(f(x))=x is purely relational -- a 2.8M-parameter transformer achieves 0.01-bit entropy agreement with the Bayesian optimum (3 seeds), with both integer tokens and opaque symbols whose meanings change every episode. This extends to non-nested comparisons: involutions vs. 3-cycles (where neither class is a subset of the other) achieve class-posterior MAE under 0.001, demonstrating genuine model selection beyond simplicity/subset bias. We then identify a sharp perceptual access condition: when the discriminative statistic requires arithmetic -- modular addition (rotations) or multiplication (f(x)=cx mod p) -- model selection succeeds with integer tokens but fails completely with opaque symbols, and this boundary persists under 112x scaling (2.8M to 316M parameters). A stationarity control confirms the operative factor: opaque tokens with a fixed relabeling succeed (0.009-bit MAE), showing that stable semantics, not integer identity, enable circuit compilation. Header subtask diagnostics localize the failure to the composition of header inversion with arithmetic rather than header parsing itself. Probing frontier LLMs on the same tasks shows qualitative Bayesian behavior but a large calibration gap (~55x), measured through lossy probes and therefore directional rather than exact.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Transformer能否执行贝叶斯模型选择，即从数据中识别正确的假设类别。通过引入模型选择贝叶斯风洞（可控环境，可解析计算后验），使用固定点自由对合（f(f(x))=x）作为测试任务，发现2.8M参数的Transformer在整数token和语义不透明符号上均与贝叶斯最优达到0.01-bit熵一致，并能处理非嵌套类别比较（如对合vs三循环）。进一步揭示了一个锐利感知访问条件：当判别统计量需要算术运算（如模加法或乘法）时，模型选择在整数token上成功，但在不透明符号上完全失败，且该边界在112倍参数缩放（2.8M至316M）下持续存在。前沿LLM在相同任务上表现出定性贝叶斯行为但校准差距较大（约55倍）。
Motivation: 先前工作表明Transformer能在固定假设类别内执行精确贝叶斯滤波，但能否执行贝叶斯模型选择（识别正确的假设类别）尚未明确。
Method: 提出模型选择贝叶斯风洞，即控制环境，其中关于假设类别的真实后验有闭合形式。使用固定点自由对合（纯关系性质）和非嵌套类别（对合vs三循环）作为任务，并设计感知访问条件实验：算术（模加法或乘法）与不透明符号对比。
Result: 2.8M参数Transformer在整数token和语义不透明符号上均与贝叶斯最优达到0.01-bit熵一致（3种子）；非嵌套类别比较的类别后验MAE低于0.001。算术任务下，整数token成功但符号token完全失败，且该边界在参数缩放至316M时不变；控制实验表明稳定的语义（而非整数身份）使电路编译成为可能。前沿LLM表现出定性贝叶斯行为，但校准差距约55倍。
Conclusion: Transformer能够执行贝叶斯模型选择，但依赖感知访问条件：当判别统计量需要算术运算时，不透明符号导致失败，且该失败在参数缩放下持续存在。这揭示了语义稳定性对Transformer编译电路的重要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Native Multi-Dimensional Subquadratic Operators via Input Dependent Long Convolutions
papers.abstract_en: Subquadratic alternatives to attention require compromises when applied to multi-dimensional data: standard convolutions lack global receptive fields and input dependency, while recurrent models require rasterizing data such as images, volumes, and partial differential equation (PDE) into an ad-hoc $1\rm D$ scan order that violates their spatial structure. We introduce \textit{HyenaND}, a subquadratic, global, input-dependent operator that acts directly on the native geometry of multidimensional data through convolutions with implicitly parametrized global, input-dependent multi-dimensional convolutional kernels. Our CUDA implementation, \texttt{nSubQ}, fuses the FFT-convolution path to turn HyenaND's $\mathcal{O}(L \log L)$ scaling into wall-clock speedups. Across long-context genomics, computer vision, medical imaging, and PDE modeling, pure HyenaND stacks match the accuracy of strong attention baselines, while hybrid configurations that interleave HyenaND and attention layers outperform both pure attention and strong recurrence-based hybrids.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyenaND，一种原生支持多维数据的子二次、全局、输入依赖的算子，通过隐式参数化的全局输入依赖多维卷积核实现。其 CUDA 实现 nSubQ 融合 FFT-卷积路径，将 O(L log L) 缩放转化为实际加速。在长上下文基因组学、计算机视觉、医学影像和 PDE 建模中，纯 HyenaND 堆栈匹配强注意力基线准确率，而混合配置（HyenaND 与注意力层交错）则优于纯注意力和基于递归的强混合模型。
Motivation: 现有注意力机制的次二次替代方案在处理多维数据时需要折衷：标准卷积缺乏全局感受野和输入依赖性，而递归模型需要将图像、体积和 PDE 等数据栅格化为违反空间结构的临时 1D 扫描顺序。
Method: HyenaND 通过隐式参数化的全局输入依赖多维卷积核，直接作用于多维数据的原生几何结构，实现子二次、全局、输入依赖的算子。其 CUDA 实现 nSubQ 融合 FFT-卷积路径以加速。
Result: 实验显示，纯 HyenaND 堆栈在长上下文基因组学、计算机视觉、医学影像和 PDE 建模基准上匹配强注意力基线的准确率，而混合配置（HyenaND 与注意力层交错）则优于纯注意力和强递归基线的混合模型。
Conclusion: HyenaND 提供了一种无需牺牲全局感受野和输入依赖性的多维数据子二次算子，实际加速显著，且混合配置可进一步提升性能。

papers.title: Reliability-Aware Hard--Soft Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Robust Learning of Challenging Partial Differential Equations
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) provide a mesh-free framework for solving partial differential equations, but their training is often affected by loss imbalance, optimization stiffness, and difficulty in capturing localized or multi-mode solution structures. Hard-soft PINNs (HSPINN) alleviate part of this difficulty by embedding Dirichlet or periodic constraints directly into the trial space, but the resulting fixed admissible representation can still be poorly conditioned for sharp or heterogeneous residual fields. This paper proposes a reliability-aware hard-soft PINN (RA-HSPINN) that preserves exact embedded constraints while introducing a bounded learnable reliability field to modulate the interior representation. The method combines this reliability-aware ansatz with inverse-EMA global loss balancing and lightweight regularization, while retaining the standard mean-square residual form. The reliability field is a numerical modulation variable, not a physical parameter or calibrated probability. RA-HSPINN is evaluated on nonlinear Burgers equations, periodic convection, a mixed-boundary Poisson problem, and a mixed first-order Poisson system. Compared with HSPINN, it reduces the relative error by $98.65%$ for sharp-gradient Burgers, $72.42%$ for Burgers data with noisy and incompatible initial conditions, $61.18%$ for smooth periodic convection, $60.02%$ for localized periodic convection, $29.36%$ for mixed-boundary Poisson, and $82.17%$ for a multi-mode mixed first-order Poisson system. The results show that reliability-aware modulation is most beneficial when hard-soft trial spaces are admissible but difficult to optimize, especially in localized, unreliable-data, and multi-mode PDE regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可靠性感知硬-软物理信息神经网络（RA-HSPINN），通过引入有界可学习可靠性场来调制内部表示，结合逆EMA全局损失平衡和轻量正则化，解决PINNs在困难偏微分方程中的训练不稳定性。在非线性Burgers方程、周期对流、混合边界Poisson问题等测试中，相比HSPINN显著降低相对误差，尤其适用于局部化、不可靠数据和多模态PDE场景。
Motivation: 现有PINNs存在损失不平衡、优化刚度及难以捕捉局部或多模态解结构的问题，而硬-软PINNs虽嵌入边界约束但固定表示在尖锐或异质残差区域条件不佳。
Method: 提出RA-HSPINN，在保留精确嵌入约束的同时引入有界可学习可靠性场调制内部表示，并组合逆EMA全局损失平衡与轻量正则化，保持标准均方残差形式。
Result: 相比HSPINN，RA-HSPINN在锐梯度Burgers方程上相对误差降低98.65%，含噪声和不兼容初值的Burgers降低72.42%，光滑周期对流降低61.18%，局部化周期对流降低60.02%，混合边界Poisson降低29.36%，多模态混合一阶Poisson系统降低82.17%。
Conclusion: 可靠性感知调制在硬-软试验空间可容许但优化困难时最有效，尤其适用于局部化、不可靠数据和多模态PDE场景。

papers.title: Refnd: Preventing Data Leakage in Relational Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models trained on biochemical data are routinely evaluated using splits that fail to account for relational structure, causing information leakage and over-optimistic performance estimates. Existing splitting methods lack theoretical grounding and scale at best quadratically. We introduce the Relational Generative Process (RGP), a mathematical formalization explaining why relational structure arises in biochemical datasets, and Refnd, a splitting algorithm that leverages a proximity graph computed in loglinear time using Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW). We validate on an antimicrobial peptide dataset, showing that Refnd splits yield lower but more realistic evaluation performance than traditional splits. Refnd is applicable to any dataset arising from an RGP such as protein sequences and structures, small molecules, and nucleotide sequences, and is openly available as a Rust accelerated Python package: pip install refnd.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生化数据集中因关系结构未在数据划分中被考虑而导致的信息泄露问题，提出了关系生成过程（RGP）的形式化框架，并开发了Refnd分割算法。该算法利用层次可导航小世界图（HNSW）在对数线性时间内构建邻近图，从而生成更真实的数据划分。在抗菌肽数据集上的验证表明，Refnd分割得到的评估性能虽然更低，但更贴近实际。
Motivation: 现有机器学习模型评估中常用的数据划分方法忽略数据间的关联结构，导致信息泄露和过于乐观的性能估计，且已有分割方法缺乏理论支撑且复杂度至少为二次。
Method: 提出Relational Generative Process (RGP) 数学形式化来解释生化数据集中关系结构的成因，并设计Refnd算法，利用Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) 在对数线性时间内计算邻近图，基于该图进行数据划分。
Result: 在抗菌肽数据集上，Refnd分割产生的评估性能低于传统分割方法，但更接近真实泛化性能。
Conclusion: Refnd适用于任何源自RGP的数据集（如蛋白质序列、小分子、核苷酸序列等），并以Rust加速的Python包形式开源。

papers.title: Economic Evaluations of Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Language models perform economically valuable work, yet they are not currently assessed for how well they perform every economically valuable task. We introduce EconEvals as an open-source evaluation suite to measure capabilities relevant to tasks, work activities, and occupations in the US labor economy. We ground the evaluation suite in real user queries to language models where possible, and supplement these with synthetic data. Our evaluations improve coverage over OpenAI's GDPval benchmark, which is the existing state-of-the-art that covers 5% of US occupations, at 500x lower cost. Alongside benchmarks, we also introduce a simulation-based exposure measure to estimate how much time current language model capabilities could save across all tasks belonging to all US occupations, with detailed accounting for each estimate. Our estimates indicate that current models could save workers substantial time on at least half of their tasks in 47% of occupations. However, for 79% of tasks where we predict substantial time savings, observed Claude usage is low, suggesting that existing usage lags potential. Beyond inherent constraints of language model chatbots, our data identifies privacy and proprietary systems as the principal bottlenecks limiting further time savings from AI. Overall, we introduce adaptable infrastructure that grounds inferences about language models' labor-market impact in their current capabilities, which can be continually updated as capabilities improve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EconEvals，一个开源评估套件，用于衡量语言模型在美国劳动经济中任务、工作活动和职业相关的能力。该套件基于真实用户查询和合成数据，相比现有最优基准 GDPval（覆盖 5% 美国职业）覆盖更广，且成本降低 500 倍。同时引入模拟曝光度量，估计当前语言模型能力可节省的时间，发现 47% 的职业中模型可节省大量时间，但 79% 的任务实际使用率偏低，隐私和专有系统是主要瓶颈。
Motivation: 语言模型执行经济上有价值的工作，但目前缺乏系统评估其在所有经济任务上的表现，现有基准覆盖范围有限。
Method: 构建 EconEvals 评估套件，收集真实用户查询并补充合成数据；设计基于模拟的曝光度量，估算模型能力在所有美国职业任务中的潜在时间节省。
Result: EconEvals 以降低 500 倍成本实现比 GDPval 更广的职业覆盖；估计当前模型可在 47% 职业中节省大量时间，但 79% 的预测可节省任务中实际使用率低。
Conclusion: 该工作提供可更新的基础设施，基于现有能力推断语言模型对劳动力市场的影响，并指出隐私和专有系统是进一步节省时间的主要障碍。

papers.title: Euclean: Automated Geometry Problem Formalization with Unified Verification in Lean
papers.abstract_en: Recent formal reasoning systems have reached IMO-level performance, yet they leave a fragmented landscape: algebra and number theory are handled in Lean, while geometry still relies on domain-specific languages with limited formal guarantees. This split increases the trusted computing base and hinders unified model development. Existing geometry-in-Lean efforts (LeanEuclid, LeanGeo) introduce custom axiom systems incompatible with standard Mathlib, and their small scale ($<$ 1,100 problems) limits large-scale training. Native Mathlib autoformalization of geometry, however, poses distinct challenges: implicit diagrammatic assumptions (e.g., topological configuration and non-degeneracy) must be made explicit rather than deferred to external solvers, and models must adapt to Mathlib's small, rapidly evolving geometry infrastructure. We present Euclean, a four-stage framework - constraint explication, configuration anchoring, formalization mapping, and iterative repair - for automatically formalizing geometry in native Mathlib. We construct OMNI-Geometry (768 competition problems) and Numina-Geometry (177,597 problems), the largest geometry formalization dataset in Lean. Human evaluation shows 48.89% TOP1 and 73.33% TOP5 accuracy. Training Goedel v2 on our formalizations improves proof success from 13.6% to 15.1%, validating dataset quality for unified neural theorem proving. Code and datasets: https://github.com/tlb-22/Euclean.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Euclean，一个四阶段框架（约束阐明、配置锚定、形式化映射、迭代修复），用于在原生Mathlib中自动形式化几何问题。构建了OMNI-Geometry（768竞赛问题）和Numina-Geometry（177,597问题），这是Lean中最大的几何形式化数据集。人类评估显示TOP1准确率48.89%，TOP5准确率73.33%；训练Goedel v2后证明成功率从13.6%提升至15.1%，验证了数据集质量。
Motivation: 现有几何形式化系统（如LeanEuclid、LeanGeo）使用自定义公理系统，与标准Mathlib不兼容，且规模小（<1100问题），限制了大规模训练。原生Mathlib自动形式化面临隐式图表假设需显式化、模型需适应Mathlib小型几何基础设施的挑战。
Method: 提出Euclean四阶段框架：约束阐明（显式化隐式假设）、配置锚定（确定几何配置）、形式化映射（将问题映射到Mathlib API）、迭代修复（自动修复形式化错误）。
Result: 构建了768个竞赛问题（OMNI-Geometry）和177,597个问题（Numina-Geometry）的数据集。人类评估TOP1准确率48.89%，TOP5准确率73.33%。训练Goedel v2后，证明成功率从13.6%提升至15.1%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明Euclean能够有效生成大规模、高质量的形式化几何问题，支持统一的神经定理证明训练。

papers.title: Mitigating Scaffolding Collapse in Socratic Tutors via Representation Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based Socratic tutors increasingly guide students through multi-turn questioning, but they can suffer from scaffolding collapse: under sustained student pressure, a tutor gradually abandons guided inquiry and reveals solutions directly. Prior defenses primarily constrain observable responses through prompting, preference optimization, or filtering, leaving the internal representation drift that precedes trajectory-level collapse largely unaddressed. We propose Scaffold-Preserving Representation Alignment, a two-stage framework that first warms up a Socratic tutor with supervised fine-tuning, then combines trajectory-weighted direct preference optimization with a margin-preserving representation loss anchored to frozen reference states. Our method is designed to maintain separation between scaffold-preserving and collapse-inducing hidden states across dialogue turns. We evaluate our method across five STEM disciplines and five red-teaming attack strategies. On Qwen3-8B, our method lowers Collapse Rate to 32%, delays average collapse onset beyond nine turns, and keeps over-refusal low, suggesting that representation-level alignment can improve the robustness of long-horizon Socratic tutoring under our red-teaming protocol.

papers.title: Aircast-Mars: A Mars Foundation Model for Global Weather Forecasting with HEALPix-Aware Convolutions
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models for planetary atmospheres promise fast, lightweight surrogates of expensive general circulation models (GCMs) for mission planning and scientific inquiry. Here we present Aircast-Mars, a deep-learning weather prediction system for Mars trained on the Ensemble Mars Atmosphere Reanalysis System (EMARS) v1.0. We regrid temperature, zonal wind, and meridional wind fields across 28 vertical levels onto a hierarchical equal-area isolatitude pixelization (HEALPix) mesh at Nside = 64 (~110 km resolution) and train a HEALPix-aware 2D U-Net inspired by the DLESyM architecture to predict the next hourly atmospheric state. The model employs custom inter-face padding that respects the topology of the 12-face HEALPix sphere and modern ConvNeXt residual blocks with capped Gaussian Error Linear Unit (GELU) activations. While containing 4.3 million trainable parameters, a compact size compared to terrestrial weather foundation models, the network achieves a best validation Mean Squared Error (MSE) of 1.58e-5 in normalized units. Recursive autoregressive rollouts remain stable and physically coherent for 25 hours (one Martian sol), with Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) growing monotonically from ~0.004 at t + 1 h to ~0.031 at t + 25 h without divergence. Compared to a baseline 3D U-Net, the HEALPix-aware architecture reduces validation loss by more than an order of magnitude while using fewer parameters. The model generates a one-hour forecast in approximately 0.5 seconds on a single GPU, offering several orders-of-magnitude speedup over traditional numerical GCMs. These results demonstrate that parsimonious, geometry-respecting neural architectures can capture synoptic-scale Martian atmospheric dynamics and provide a foundation for planetary-scale weather forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Aircast-Mars，一个基于深度学习的火星全球天气预报模型，使用HEALPix感知卷积和ConvNeXt残差块，在EMARS数据集上训练。模型以4.3M参数实现稳定25小时递归预测，比传统3D U-Net提升一个数量级以上精度，且推理速度比传统GCM快数个数量级。
Motivation: 现有火星天气预报依赖昂贵的通用环流模型（GCM），缺乏快速、轻量的替代方案，而地球天气基础模型因几何复杂度难以直接迁移。
Method: 将火星温度、纬向风和经向风场重新网格化到HEALPix网格（Nside=64，~110km分辨率），采用HEALPix感知的2D U-Net架构（基于DLESyM），包含自定义界面填充和ConvNeXt残差块，使用capped GELU激活函数。
Result: 验证集归一化MSE为1.58e-5，递归25小时RMSE从0.004单调增长至0.031且不发散；相比3D U-Net基线，验证损失降低一个数量级以上，参数更少；单GPU上单步预测约0.5秒。
Conclusion: 几何感知的轻量神经架构能够捕捉火星尺度的天气动力学，为行星尺度天气预报提供高效基础模型。

papers.title: Beyond Tracking or Shortcut: Composition-Bounded Predictive States in Poker Autoregressive Models
papers.abstract_en: Hidden-state probes often recover latent labels in imperfect-information sequence models, but this alone does not establish that a model maintains a posterior belief distribution over hidden states. This paper studies this ambiguity in a no-range Limit Hold'em autoregressive model trained only on action and value targets, not on an opponent's hand or range. Opponent-range probes are positive after action/value controls in two of three seeds, and the behavior head predicts held-out actions about five percentage points above a baseline using only observable public history. However, visible public betting composition explains more opponent-range signal than residual hidden states, suggesting that most recoverable information comes from betting summaries. Action/value+composition baselines reach 16.5-16.7% top-10 accuracy while composition-residual hidden probes fall to 11.4-12.2%, and matched-composition comparisons are negative in every seed. We call this evidence pattern composition-bounded predictive support: hidden states remain behavior-predictive and opponent-range correlated, but most recoverable range information is explained by visible betting composition rather than residual hidden-state structure. This is a case-study claim about opponent-range representational evidence, not exact Bayesian posterior tracking or a causal belief mechanism. Synthetic control and oracle validations show that the same diagnostics accept posterior-sensitive states and reject raw composition states under matched controls. Thus positive belief probes should be interpreted through targeted alternatives before being treated as evidence of belief tracking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究不完全信息序列模型中隐藏状态探针（hidden-state probes）的歧义，以有限注德州扑克自回归模型为例。探针显示对手手牌范围可恢复，但大部分信号可由可见的投注组合（betting composition）解释，残差隐藏状态贡献较小，表明模型并非真正追踪贝叶斯后验信念，而是利用投注摘要的捷径（shortcut）。
Motivation: 隐藏状态探针常被用来证明模型维持了对隐藏状态的后验信念分布，但这种相关性可能来自表面特征而非真正的信念追踪。本文旨在通过严格的消融实验，区分真正的信念追踪与投注组合捷径。
Method: 在有限注Limit Hold'em自回归模型上，训练对手范围探针，并控制动作/价值及投注组合（composition）变量，比较全隐藏状态、组合残差隐藏状态、组合基线的预测准确率，以及合成控制（synthetic control）和oracle验证。
Result: 在三个种子中，两个种子显示对手范围探针在动作/价值控制后为正；行为头预测留出动作比仅用公开历史基线高约5个百分点。但投注组合解释了大部分对手范围信号：动作/价值+组合基线达到16.5-16.7% top-10准确率，而组合残差隐藏探针降至11.4-12.2%，匹配组合时每种子均为负值。
Conclusion: 证据模式为组合有界预测支持（composition-bounded predictive support）：隐藏状态对行为有预测性且与对手范围相关，但可恢复的范围信息主要来自可见投注组合而非残差隐藏结构。这是一个案例研究，不能作为精确贝叶斯后验追踪或因果信念机制的证据。

papers.title: Spectral-LSH: Sub-Quadratic Prompt Compression via Krylov-Projected Locality-Sensitive Hashing
papers.abstract_en: Long-prompt inference remains expensive because prefill attention scales quadratically with sequence length. We propose Spectral-LSH, a training-free prompt compression method that operates before the prompt enters the language model. Spectral-LSH approximates the dominant components of an implicit attention-kernel operator using a Krylov subspace method together with random features, avoiding explicit $O(N^2)$ attention-kernel materialization. It then applies SimHash in the resulting attention eigenspace to group similar tokens and aggregate them into macro-tokens with causal positional assignments. We evaluate Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, and Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct on C4. Our experiments reveal a compression-ratio phase transition. Below $ρ= 4 \times$, local token redundancy is low enough that lightweight chunking typically provides the best latency--quality trade-off. Above $ρ= 8 \times$, the spectral path preserves quality that chunking loses. At $ρ= 16 \times$, Qwen2.5-7B (adaptive) reduces the PPL ratio from 353.409 to 196.963, while Qwen2.5-14B (adaptive) reduces it from 9.533 to 3.427. On a small long-context structured stress test containing JSON-like, code-like, and table-like inputs, local LSH also improves every metric over chunking at $8 \times$. The adaptive backend captures both regimes by using the chunk path at low compression and spectral clustering at high compression, although chunking remains the fastest backend in total latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Spectral-LSH，一种无需训练的提示压缩方法，在提示进入语言模型前通过Krylov子空间方法和随机特征近似隐式注意力核的主要成分，然后在注意力特征空间中用SimHash对相似token分组并聚合为宏token。实验在C4上评估Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct，发现压缩比存在相变：低压缩比（ρ<4×）时轻量级分块效果最佳，高压缩比（ρ≥8×）时谱方法保留质量更好。在ρ=16×下，Qwen2.5-7B（自适应）将PPL比从353.409降至196.963，Qwen2.5-14B从9.533降至3.427。在包含JSON、代码、表格的小型长上下文结构压力测试中，局部LSH在8×压缩下改善所有指标。
Motivation: 长提示推理成本高昂，因为预填充注意力随序列长度二次缩放，需要一种无需训练的方法压缩提示以降低推理开销。
Method: 提出Spectral-LSH，使用Krylov子空间方法和随机特征近似注意力核的主要成分，免去显式O(N^2)注意力核计算，然后在注意力特征空间中用SimHash进行token分组聚合，生成带有因果位置分配的宏token。
Result: 在C4上，压缩比存在相变：ρ<4×时轻量级分块最佳；ρ≥8×时谱方法优于分块。ρ=16×时，Qwen2.5-7B（自适应）将PPL比从353.409降至196.963，Qwen2.5-14B从9.533降至3.427。在JSON/代码/表格压力测试中，局部LSH在8×压缩下改善所有指标。
Conclusion: 自适应后端通过低压缩时使用分块路径、高压缩时使用谱聚类来捕获两种场景，但分块在总延迟上仍是最快后端。

papers.title: Rethinking Uncertainty Evaluation in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Calibration is the primary criterion for evaluating LLM confidence, but it is insufficient: it admits trivially incoherent estimators, depends on the evaluation distribution, and does not test the extent to which the estimation can be interpreted as a consistent, underlying probability function. What we actually need is for LLM confidence estimates to satisfy the conditions required of coherent probabilistic beliefs. We formalize these conditions along three axes (structural coherence, faithfulness, and usefulness) and operationalize them as the C1 metrics. Widely used estimators systematically violate these conditions despite appearing well-calibrated: models assign lower confidence to logically easier questions 31\% of the time, and common interventions reducing RMSCE leave structural violations unchanged, suggesting that calibration is orthogonal to probabilistic validity. RLHF and chain-of-thought improve usefulness metrics without restoring coherence. Our results show current LLM confidence estimates cannot be interpreted as coherent probabilities; our framework provides the tools to measure and close this gap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文批判了当前仅用校准（calibration）评估大语言模型置信度的做法，指出校准不足以保证置信度估计满足概率一致性条件。作者形式化定义了结构一致性（structural coherence）、忠实性（faithfulness）和有用性（usefulness）三个维度，并提出C1指标。实验表明，广泛使用的置信度估计器在校准良好时仍系统性违反这些条件，如模型在逻辑更简单的问题上给出更低置信度的概率达31%，且降低RMSCE的常见干预不影响结构违反。RLHF和思维链（chain-of-thought）改善有用性指标但无法恢复一致性。结论是当前LLM置信度估计不能视为一致概率，框架提供了衡量和弥合这一差距的工具。
Motivation: 校准作为置信度评估的主要标准存在不足：允许平凡非一致的估计器、依赖评估分布、且不能测试估计能否解释为一致的概率函数。实际需要的是满足概率一致条件的置信度估计。
Method: 提出三个评估轴：结构一致性、忠实性和有用性，并操作化为C1指标。通过实验测试多种常见置信度估计器（包括校准、RLHF、思维链等）是否违反这些条件。
Result: 常用估计器在校准良好时仍系统性违反条件：模型在逻辑更简单的问题上赋值更低置信度占31%；降低RMSCE的干预不改变结构违反。RLHF和思维链改善有用性但未恢复一致性。
Conclusion: 当前LLM置信度估计不能解释为一致概率，校准与概率有效性正交；本文框架提供了衡量和改善这一差距的工具。

summary_sections.motivation: 校准作为置信度评估的主要标准存在不足：允许平凡非一致的估计器、依赖评估分布、且不能测试估计能否解释为一致的概率函数。实际需要的是满足概率一致条件的置信度估计。
summary_sections.method: 提出三个评估轴：结构一致性、忠实性和有用性，并操作化为C1指标。通过实验测试多种常见置信度估计器（包括校准、RLHF、思维链等）是否违反这些条件。
summary_sections.result: 常用估计器在校准良好时仍系统性违反条件：模型在逻辑更简单的问题上赋值更低置信度占31%；降低RMSCE的干预不改变结构违反。RLHF和思维链改善有用性但未恢复一致性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 当前LLM置信度估计不能解释为一致概率，校准与概率有效性正交；本文框架提供了衡量和改善这一差距的工具。

papers.title: Geometry-Guided Constraint Learning for LLM Safety Classification
papers.abstract_en: Safety as Polytope (SaP) learns linear half-space constraints in LLM hidden space but requires per-category tuning of the constraint count K. We show that sparse autoencoder (SAE) feature extraction resolves this: K=2 becomes optimal for 12/14 categories on Qwen3.5-9B, achieving 96-99% accuracy per category on our BeaverTails classification benchmark, largely eliminating the need for exhaustive sweeps (K=4-25 with random initialization). This convergence to two planes is consistent with the Linear Representation Hypothesis, providing suggestive evidence that safety boundaries in this setting admit a low-dimensional linear description in the SAE feature space. Building on this geometric perspective, we introduce a cone constraint whose learnable aperture adapts to each category's cluster concentration, stabilized by a three-phase training
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出几何引导的约束学习用于大语言模型（LLM）安全分类。通过稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征提取，将每个安全类别的约束数量K优化至2（12/14类别），在BeaverTails基准上达到96-99%准确率，消除了对K的广泛搜索。这支持了线性表示假说，即安全边界在SAE特征空间中具有低维线性描述。进一步引入锥形约束，其可学习孔径适应每个类别的簇集中度。
Motivation: 现有安全分类方法（如SaP）需要为每个类别手动调整约束数量K，效率低且不通用。
Method: 利用SAE提取的稀疏特征，自动确定每个安全类别的最优约束数量（K=2），并引入具有可学习孔径的锥形约束，通过三阶段训练稳定优化。
Result: 在Qwen3.5-9B模型上，12/14类别的最优K为2，在BeaverTails分类基准上每类准确率96-99%，无需K的穷举搜索（此前需K=4-25）。
Conclusion: 该工作表明LLM安全边界在SAE特征空间中可被低维线性描述，锥形约束进一步提升了适应性。

papers.title: Logic-Guided Data Extraction with Answer Set Programming and Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: When Large Language Models (LLMs) are used for semantic data extraction from unstructured text, producing candidate relational facts from natural language, they may remain unreliable for tasks requiring complex combinatorial reasoning and global consistency. This paper proposes a logic-guided data extraction framework combining LLM-based extraction with Answer Set Programming (ASP). The LLM produces candidate facts, whereas ASP performs validation, inference, consistency checking, and control. Unlike existing pipelines that query the LLM independently for all target predicates, the proposed approach uses ASP reasoning to identify which predicates are logically admissible at each stage and to guide extraction queries. By interleaving LLM calls with ASP derivation, the framework infers logically implied facts without further extraction and detects inconsistencies early. We formalize the pipeline and prove that, under mild assumptions, it is equivalent to the baseline approach with respect to the final extracted facts, while requiring fewer LLM calls. We also introduce a caching mechanism for logic-based control queries, exploiting monotonicity of conjunctive queries over incrementally constructed fact sets to reduce solver invocations. Experiments on ASP-derived benchmarks show that the framework reduces LLM calls and improves extraction quality by mitigating spurious outputs, demonstrating the value of non-monotonic logic programming for controlled semantic extraction.
papers.comment: 42nd International Conference on Logic Programming, to appear in Theory and Practice of Logic Programming (TPLP)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）在非结构化文本语义数据提取中不可靠的问题，提出一个结合答案集编程（ASP）的引导式提取框架。LLM生成候选事实，ASP进行验证、推理、一致性检查并控制提取过程。通过交替调用LLM与ASP推导，框架无需额外提取即可推断逻辑蕴含的事实，并能及早检测不一致。实验表明该方法在减少LLM调用次数的同时提升了提取质量。
Motivation: LLM在语义数据提取任务中因缺乏复杂组合推理和全局一致性保证而产生不可靠输出，现有管线为所有目标谓词独立查询LLM，效率低且易出错。
Method: 提出一个逻辑引导的提取框架，将LLM生成的候选事实与ASP的推理验证交替进行。ASP基于当前已知事实确定逻辑上可接受的谓词，只对必要谓词引导LLM查询；同时利用单调性缓存机制减少ASP求解器调用。
Result: 在ASP衍生基准上，该框架减少了LLM调用次数，并通过抑制虚假输出提升了提取质量。
Conclusion: 非单调逻辑编程（ASP）能够有效用于受控语义提取，提升了LLM在复杂任务上的可靠性与效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Statistically Grounded Sparse-Feature Interventions for Activation-Space Control in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering offers a lightweight alternative to fine-tuning for behavioral control of large language models, but SAE-based steering methods often rely on learned steering objectives or single-criterion feature selection. We introduce a transparent SAE-feature steering pipeline that first applies a six-condition reliability filter, then ranks sparse features through an unweighted Borda consensus over three complementary statistics: $F$-test, KSG mutual information, and Cohen's $d$. The resulting steering direction is constructed as a Cohen's-$d$-weighted combination of SAE decoder rows, providing an optimization-free direction motivated by Fisher-LDA under approximate SAE-feature decorrelation. Across three Gemma-family models, four behavioral domains, and 356 layer-strength configurations, the method produces measurable domain-specific shifts while revealing a substantial gap between raw attribute movement and quality-preserving generation. In the strongest configuration, logical-correctness steering reaches a primary-score delta of $+1.16$ in Gemma~2 9B; however, our broader finding is that usable steering is highly localized by model, domain, layer, and strength. These results argue that activation-steering evaluations should report quality-conditioned success alongside raw behavioral shift. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/Oshayer-Siddique/LLM-Steering-Using-SAE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于统计的稀疏特征干预方法，用于大语言模型的激活空间控制。该方法通过六条件可靠性过滤和无权重Borda共识（基于F检验、KSG互信息和Cohen's d）选择稀疏特征，并利用Cohen's d加权构建干预方向。在Gemma系列模型、四个行为域和356种配置上测试，发现有效干预高度依赖于模型、域、层和强度，并建议评估时应报告质量条件成功率和原始行为偏移。
Motivation: 现有的基于SAE的激活干预方法通常依赖学习得到的干预目标或单一准则特征选择，缺乏透明性和统计支持。
Method: 提出透明SAE特征干预流程：先应用六条件可靠性过滤器，然后通过未加权Borda共识（使用F检验、KSG互信息和Cohen's d三个统计量）对稀疏特征排序，最后用Cohen's d加权组合SAE解码器行构建干预方向，该方向在近似SAE特征去相关下类似于Fisher-LDA方向。
Result: 在Gemma 2 9B的最强配置中，逻辑正确性干预达到主要分数变化+1.16；但更广泛的发现是可用干预高度局部化，取决于模型、域、层和强度。
Conclusion: 激活干预评估应同时报告质量条件成功率和原始行为偏移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AdaRoPE: Not All Attention Heads Should Rotate and Scale Equally
papers.abstract_en: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) is widely adopted in Transformers to encode positional information, yet standard implementations enforce a uniform frequency schedule and scaling across all attention heads. Using simplified retrieval tasks and length generalization scenarios, we show -- both empirically and theoretically -- that heads with different functional roles require distinct frequency ranges and attention scaling factors to operate effectively. Ignoring this structure leads to suboptimal utilization of embedding dimensions and degraded performance, particularly under long-context settings. To address these limitations, we propose AdaRoPE, which equips each attention head with learnable rotation frequencies and attention scaling factors. Pretrained LLMs with AdaRoPE consistently outperform existing RoPE variants, including partial RoPE and NoPE baselines. For context extension, we further show that uniform frequency and attention scaling, used in methods such as YaRN, are suboptimal. By applying head-specific scaling, AdaRoPE enables better context extension while better preserving short-context performance in both the extrapolation setting and the long-context continued pretraining setting. These results highlight the importance of optimizing rotary position embedding at the level of individual attention heads.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AdaRoPE，通过为每个注意力头（attention head）分配可学习的旋转频率和注意力缩放因子，替代标准RoPE的均匀频率和缩放。在简化检索任务和长度泛化场景下，理论和实验表明不同功能角色的头需要不同的频率范围和缩放因子。AdaRoPE在预训练和上下文扩展中均优于现有RoPE变体，特别是在长上下文设置下。
Motivation: 标准RoPE对所有注意力头施加统一的频率调度和缩放，忽略了不同头在功能角色上的差异，导致嵌入维度利用不足和性能下降，尤其在长上下文场景中。
Method: 提出AdaRoPE，为每个注意力头引入可学习的旋转频率和注意力缩放因子，通过端到端训练优化这些参数，替代统一的RoPE配置。
Result: 预训练LLM在多种基准上优于部分RoPE和NoPE基线；在上下文扩展中，头特定缩放相比YaRN等均匀缩放方法取得更好的长上下文性能，同时更好保持短上下文性能。
Conclusion: 优化旋转位置编码应在单个注意力头级别进行，而不是全局统一，此举可改善模型在不同上下文长度下的表现。

papers.title: GraphContainer: A Unified Platform for Comparing and Debugging Graph RAG Methods
papers.abstract_en: Graph RAG mitigates hallucinations and stale knowledge in LLMs, particularly for multi-hop question answering. However, existing approaches remain highly fragmented and incompatible. The structural heterogeneity of graph formats across different frameworks and the lack of granular visualization tools make it exceedingly difficult to evaluate and compare retrieval behaviors. To bridge this gap, we propose GraphContainer, a novel platform designed to unify and visualize diverse graph RAG workflows. GraphContainer features two key components: (1) a Unified Graph Representation (UGR) layer that seamlessly standardizes multi-format graphs, and (2) a Graph Recorder that tracks and visually renders the step-by-step retrieval process. Through an interactive web interface, we demonstrate GraphContainer's ability to import heterogeneous graphs and perform live, traceable visual debugging of graph RAG methods. Ultimately, we show how GraphContainer enables controlled comparisons of various graph formats and retrieval strategies, lowering the barrier for researchers and practitioners to design optimal graph RAG pipelines. A demonstration video is available at https://youtu.be/O02eNJLwkU0.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GraphContainer，一个统一平台，用于比较和调试图RAG方法。它通过统一图表示层（UGR）标准化多格式图，并利用图记录器（Graph Recorder）可视化逐步检索过程。旨在解决图RAG方法碎片化、图格式异构和缺乏可视化工具的问题。
Motivation: 现有图RAG方法高度碎片化且不兼容，不同框架的图格式异构，缺乏细粒度可视化工具，导致难以评估和比较检索行为。
Method: 提出GraphContainer平台，包含两个关键组件：（1）统一图表示层（UGR），将多格式图标准化；（2）图记录器（Graph Recorder），跟踪并可视化逐步检索过程。通过交互式网页界面实现。
Result: 摘要声称能够导入异构图，进行实时可追溯的可视化调试，并支持控制比较不同图格式和检索策略。
Conclusion: GraphContainer降低了研究人员和从业者设计最优图RAG管线的门槛。

papers.title: Stateful Guardrails for Multi-Turn LLM Systems: A Conversational Risk Accumulation Framework
papers.abstract_en: Most safety guardrails for large language models (LLMs) evaluate each prompt-response pair in isolation, which misses failures that arise only over a dialogue as benign turns compose into harm. We term this Conversational Risk Accumulation (CRA): gradual intent drift, fragmented assembly of prohibited instructions, and sensitivity build-up from repeated disclosures. We propose a session-layer CRA Framework that tracks three trajectory signals: semantic drift from a session anchor, a sensitivity-weighted information accumulation graph over extracted entities, and a compliance-gradient signal capturing increasing willingness to comply. For scoring, we provide (i) an unsupervised convex fusion for attribution and ablations, and (ii) CRA-Net DA, a compact learned trajectory model trained with family-adversarial objectives to reduce length and topic-coverage confounds. To benchmark CRA, we release CRA-Bench v0.1 (1,200 eight-turn sessions across three threat families with topic-matched benign twins), CRA-Bench v0.2 (LLM-paraphrased variants to reduce template artifacts), and an extended 5-family set (2,000 sessions adding persona priming and context stuffing). We introduce a trajectory-native evaluation protocol with session-level splits, mixed-set threshold calibration, Trajectory AUROC, turns-to-detection, calibrated false-positive metrics, bootstrap confidence intervals, leave-one-family-out diagnostic stress tests, and synthetic-to-human transfer checks. Claims focus on within-distribution session scoring on CRA-Bench and human-transfer subsets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文定义并解决了多轮LLM对话中的对话风险积累（CRA）问题，即无害的交互逐渐组合成有害行为。提出会话层CRA框架，跟踪语义漂移、敏感加权信息图和合规梯度信号，并提供无监督融合评分方法CRA-Net DA。同时发布CRA-Bench基准数据集（1,200-2,000个会话）和轨迹原生评估协议。
Motivation: 现有LLM安全护栏只孤立评估每个提示-响应对，无法捕捉多轮对话中逐渐累积的风险，如意图漂移、碎片化指令组装和敏感性累积。
Method: 提出CRA框架，跟踪三个轨迹信号：会话锚点的语义漂移、提取实体上的敏感加权信息积累图、以及合规梯度信号。评分方面提供无监督凸融合归因与消融，以及CRA-Net DA紧凑学习模型，采用家族对抗目标以减少长度和主题覆盖混淆。
Result: 发布了CRA-Bench v0.1（1,200个八轮会话，三个威胁家族及良性孪生）、v0.2（LLM改写变体）和扩展5家族集（2,000个会话）。引入轨迹原生评估协议，包括会话级分割、混合集阈值校准、轨迹AUROC、检测轮数、校准假阳性指标、自助置信区间、留一族诊断压力测试和合成到人工迁移检查。
Conclusion: 摘要强调声明的重点是在CRA-Bench和人工迁移子集上的分布内会话评分。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lifted Representation Hypothesis in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) often answer queries by mapping individual observations to more general rule-like structures. However, it remains unclear how these structures are stored, selected, and revised. To study this process, we propose thelifted representation hypothesis: LLMs update memory through shared latent structures rather than isolated instance-level facts. This view frames lifting as an efficient use of symmetry across instances, and shattering as the refinement of coarse lifted structures into more specific subtypes. We evaluate LLMs' lifting and shattering through controlled exception-learning experiments across in-context learning, LoRA, and full fine-tuning. We find that LLMs are vulnerable to shattering failures when data are governed by nested rules and exceptions, while lifting often occurs prematurely. These results highlight the need to study the relation between data and rule structures in LLMs.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, ICML 2026 Workshop: Philosophy Meets Machine Learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出大语言模型（LLM）中的“提升表示假说”（lifted representation hypothesis），认为LLM通过共享潜在结构（而非孤立实例）更新记忆，并通过“提升”（lifting）和“破碎”（shattering）两种机制分别实现结构的泛化和细化。在嵌套规则与例外数据的控制实验中，LLM容易过早提升，且在数据受嵌套规则和例外支配时出现破碎失败。
Motivation: 现有研究不清楚大语言模型如何存储、选择和修正类规则的通用结构，本文旨在探索模型通过共享潜在结构而非孤立事实进行记忆更新的内在机制。
Method: 通过受控的例外学习实验，在上下文学习、LoRA和全微调三种设置下评估LLM的“提升”和“破碎”行为。
Result: 发现LLM在数据受嵌套规则和例外支配时容易出现破碎失败，而提升往往过早发生。
Conclusion: 强调需要进一步研究LLM中数据与规则结构之间的关系。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Profile-Graph Memory for LLM Agents: Implicit Cross-Entity Traversal through Narrative Profiles
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory is essential for LLM agents that interact across sessions, yet current memory benchmarks primarily evaluate single-hop recall, leaving multi-hop association largely unmeasured. We make three contributions. First, we introduce MemHop, a multi-hop memory benchmark of 1,000 questions at hop depths 1-5 across 10 social-network scenarios, with per-hop evidence annotations. Second, we present Profile-Graph Memory (ProGraph), a two-layer memory architecture combining (i) profile expansion -- substring-matched traversal of entity names that naturally appear in LLM-written profile narratives, a minimal alternative to explicit knowledge-graph construction -- and (ii) compression residuals -- exact dates, quantities, and named items co-extracted with each profile update at zero extra API cost. Third, a full-grid ablation shows cross-benchmark mechanism specialization: profile expansion drives multi-hop reasoning (-22.6pp on MemHop when removed) while compression residuals drive precision recall (-8.6pp on LoCoMo when not co-extracted), with cross-effects under 3pp within a single architecture. ProGraph averages 80.1% on MemHop (matching the FullContext reference) and 78.4% on LoCoMo (exceeding FullContext by 11.3pp), outperforming Mem0, A-Mem, HippoRAG, and RAG on both. We release MemHop, ProGraph, and baseline implementations.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Code and MemHop benchmark: https://github.com/ShengtongZhu/ProGraph
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM代理长期记忆中的多跳关联评估不足的问题，提出MemHop基准和ProGraph记忆架构。ProGraph通过轮廓扩展和压缩残差实现跨实体遍历，在MemHop和LoCoMo基准上超过现有方法。
Motivation: 现有长期记忆基准主要评估单跳回忆，缺乏多跳关联的度量。
Method: 提出ProGraph两层记忆架构：轮廓扩展通过子串匹配遍历实体名称，压缩残差以零额外API成本提取日期、数量等精确信息。
Result: 在MemHop上平均80.1%（与FullContext持平），在LoCoMo上78.4%（超过FullContext 11.3个百分点），优于Mem0、A-Mem、HippoRAG和RAG。
Conclusion: 摘要强调跨基准的机制专门化：轮廓扩展驱动多跳推理，压缩残差驱动精确召回，单一架构内交叉效应低于3个百分点。

papers.title: LISA: Linear-Indexed Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in long chain-of-thought reasoning models such as DeepSeek-R1 have led to increasingly longer inference context lengths under the test-time scaling paradigm. However, the O(n^2) computational complexity of standard self-attention causes inference costs to grow sharply with long sequences, limiting the deployment of long-CoT reasoning in production settings. To address this, we propose LISA (Linear-Indexed Sparse Attention), a plug-and-play attention replacement module that requires no pretraining from scratch. LISA integrates two lightweight components in parallel within the original model: (1) a Linear Attention module that provides long-range memory with O(n) time complexity; (2) a Lightning Indexer that selects the top-M important tokens from the full context to feed into a Sparse Self-Attention. The two branches are fused via a gating mechanism, reducing inference complexity from O(n^2) to O(nM) (M << n) for generating n tokens. We design a two-stage training pipeline: Stage 1 initializes the model by integrating the linear attention to capture long-range dependencies, complemented by a sliding-window attention mechanism that is optimized via knowledge distillation to approximate the full self-attention distribution of a frozen teacher model. In Stage 2, we further introduce the Indexer to replace the static sliding-window mechanism, enabling dynamic token selection from broader contexts. The Indexer is trained using a novel per-head KL divergence loss, which aligns its selection behavior with the attention patterns of the teacher model. Experiments on DeepSeek-distilled-Qwen models demonstrate that LISA achieves a 50% inference speedup under 16K-token context, while improving average performance by 5.6% on reasoning benchmarks including AIME and MATH-500.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LISA（Linear-Indexed Sparse Attention），一种即插即用的注意力替换模块，用于高效长上下文推理。它并行集成线性注意力（O(n) 复杂度）和基于 Lightning Indexer 的稀疏自注意力（选择 top-M token），通过门控融合将推理复杂度降至 O(nM)。两阶段训练：第一阶段用线性注意力加滑动窗口注意力，通过知识蒸馏拟合教师模型；第二阶段用索引器替换滑动窗口，并用 per-head KL 散度损失训练。在 DeepSeek-distilled-Qwen 模型上，16K 上下文下推理加速 50%，AIME 和 MATH-500 等推理基准平均性能提升 5.6%。
Motivation: 长链推理模型（如 DeepSeek-R1）的测试时扩展导致推理上下文急剧增长，标准自注意力的 O(n^2) 复杂度使推理成本过高，限制了长上下文推理的部署。
Method: 提出 LISA，包含两个并行轻量组件：线性注意力模块（提供 O(n) 长程记忆）和 Lightning Indexer（从全上下文中选择 top-M 重要 token 输入稀疏自注意力），通过门控机制融合。两阶段训练：第一阶段用线性注意力加滑动窗口注意力，通过知识蒸馏近似冻结教师模型的全自注意力分布；第二阶段引入 Indexer 替换静态滑动窗口，使用 per-head KL 散度损失对齐其选择行为与教师注意力模式。
Result: 在 DeepSeek-distilled-Qwen 模型上，16K token 上下文下实现 50% 推理加速，在 AIME 和 MATH-500 等推理基准上平均性能提升 5.6%。
Conclusion: LISA 实现了高效长上下文推理，无需从头预训练，即插即用，适合部署场景。

papers.title: Stochastic Primal-Dual Decoding for Multiobjective Generative Recommender Systems
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in recommender systems (RS) have shown substantial performance gains through generative modelling. In practice, recommendation often involves constructing slates -- ordered lists of items -- that must satisfy multiple objectives beyond relevance, such as constraints defined over item attributes or fairness constraints. Existing multiobjective approaches either rely on post-processing techniques designed for non-generative settings, or incorporate auxiliary objectives directly into model training. The former does not explicitly account for the sequential nature of generative RS, while the latter is often impractical in large-scale systems. We propose a lightweight, inference-time decoding layer that augments autoregressive generative RS to support multiobjective slate generation without modifying or retraining the underlying model. We formulate decoding as an online constrained optimisation problem, where items are selected sequentially, and trade-offs between relevance and auxiliary objectives are adjusted dynamically based on the remaining constraint slack, i.e., how much of each objective remains to be satisfied. This is implemented via a stochastic primal-dual approximation scheme that balances relevance and auxiliary objectives during generation. We provide theoretical guarantees on constraint violation and regret, and evaluate the proposed approach through extensive offline experiments and a large-scale online A/B experiment in a real-world recommender system. Our results show consistent improvements in multiobjective trade-offs, including a +1.8\% gain in the auxiliary objectives achieved at zero cost to user satisfaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级的推理时解码层，用于增强自回归生成式推荐系统，使其支持多目标推荐列表（slate）生成，而无需修改或重新训练底层模型。该方法将解码过程形式化为在线约束优化问题，通过随机原始-对偶近似方案动态调整相关性和辅助目标之间的权衡。离线实验和在线A/B测试表明，该方法在辅助目标上获得+1.8%的提升，且用户满意度无损失。
Motivation: 现有推荐系统中的多目标方法要么依赖后处理技术（不适用于生成式推荐），要么将辅助目标融入训练（在大规模系统中不实用）。需要一种轻量级、推理时的方法来支持生成式推荐系统的多目标推荐列表生成。
Method: 将解码形式化为在线约束优化问题，顺序选择物品，根据剩余约束松弛动态调整相关性和辅助目标的权衡。采用随机原始-对偶近似方案实现，提供理论上限保证。
Result: 离线实验和大规模在线A/B实验表明，该方法在辅助目标上获得+1.8%的提升，且用户满意度无损失。
Conclusion: 该方法为生成式推荐系统提供了一种有效的推理时多目标解码方案，无需重新训练模型，且理论上有约束违反和遗憾的保证。

papers.title: NEXUS: Structured Runtime Safety for Tool-Using LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using LLM agents increasingly execute high-impact actions, making runtime safety monitoring essential. We present NEXUS (Neural EXecution Utility and Safety), a structured-plan safety monitor that applies a formal intervention policy to select among four actions: allow, block, request confirmation, or request revision. NEXUS combines deterministic safety rules, argument-level inspection, and a calibrated logistic-regression risk score for graded escalation. On a 128-instance synthetic benchmark, NEXUS achieves an F1 score of 0.949 and a 4-class intervention accuracy of 0.6406, outperforming rule-only intervention selection by 27.3 percentage points. It also improves over rule-only on R-Judge (F1 = 0.861 vs. 0.849), matches rule-only on AgentHarm due to threat-model limits, and achieves 0% ASR at 99% control allow on IPI. On the rule-blind NEXUS-Stress benchmark, NEXUS reaches an F1 score of 0.881, highlighting the difficulty of fine-grained intervention routing. With 0.205 ms median latency, NEXUS adds under 0.1% overhead to typical agent loops. Code, benchmarks, and the calibrated risk scorer are publicly released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出结构化计划安全监控器NEXUS，通过形式化干预策略（允许、阻止、请求确认、请求修订）对使用工具的LLM代理进行运行时安全监控。结合确定性安全规则、参数级检查和校准的逻辑回归风险评分进行分级升级。在合成基准上达到0.949的F1分数，干预准确率0.6406，优于纯规则方法。
Motivation: 使用工具的LLM代理执行高风险动作，需要运行时安全监控来防止不安全行为。
Method: 提出NEXUS，结合确定性安全规则、参数级检查和校准的逻辑回归风险评分，实现四种干预动作的选择。
Result: 在128实例合成基准上F1=0.949，4类干预准确率0.6406，提升27.3个百分点；在R-Judge上F1=0.861 vs 0.849；在规则盲NEXUS-Stress上F1=0.881；延迟0.205ms。

papers.title: Information Discernment in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: LLMs are increasingly used with external knowledge sources like the internet. Do they weigh information appropriately -- updating more for reliable sources (source discernment) and more when claims bring priors closer to the truth (truth discernment)? We formalize this as information discernment and introduce Learn2Discern (L2D), an experimental framework and benchmark grounded in three normative axioms with interpretable metrics. To establish external validity, a pre-registered, quota-matched user study (n=299) confirms that real LLM users endorse all three axioms and report that violations reduce their trust and usage intent. Across 13 models and nearly 670K trials, we find consistent failures across both dimensions: models perform near chance on source and truth discernment, rely on source popularity twice as much as source reliability, and update roughly equally whether a claim improves or worsens their position relative to the ground truth. Models integrate external knowledge most effectively on datasets where their priors are already the most accurate. Newer and larger models improve truth discernment but not source discernment, a blind spot that model complexity does not address. We identify simple inference-time interventions that improve both forms of discernment. We release our dataset and survey as a testbed for a core alignment property that scales in importance as LLMs replace traditional search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化了大模型从外部知识源（如互联网）获取信息时的辨别能力，提出实验框架Learn2Discern（L2D）及三个公理化的可解释指标。通过用户研究验证公理的有效性，并在13个模型近67万次试验中发现模型在信源辨别和真相辨别上均接近随机水平，且依赖信源流行度而非可靠性。较新或更大的模型改善了真相辨别，但信源辨别无改进。
Motivation: LLM越来越多地与外部知识源结合使用，但它们在整合信息时是否适当权衡可靠性与真实性尚不清楚。
Method: 提出Learn2Discern框架，包含三个规范性公理（信源辨别、真相辨别等）及相应度量指标，并结合预注册的用户研究和大量模型试验。
Result: 13个模型在信源辨别和真相辨别上表现接近随机；模型对信源流行度的依赖是可靠性的两倍；无论信息是否改善先验，更新幅度大致相同；模型在先验最准确的数据集上整合外部知识最好。
Conclusion: LLM在信息辨别上存在系统性缺陷，尤其是信源辨别不受模型规模或新版本影响；但简单的推理时干预可改善两种辨别能力。

papers.title: FormulaSPIN: Self-Play Fine-Tuning for Natural Language to Spreadsheet Formula Generation
papers.abstract_en: Spreadsheet applications are used by hundreds of millions worldwide, yet writing formulas remains a significant barrier. Existing approaches rely on static supervised data, which quickly saturates on limited annotations. In this paper, we introduce FORMULASPIN, a self-play framework that breaks the ceiling of supervised fine-tuning by enabling iterative self-improvement without any additional data. Vanilla SPIN fails on this task: it uniformly penalizes every non-matching output, so execution-equivalent alternatives are punished as negatives in one example while serving as ground truth in another, producing contradictory gradients. Our framework resolves this by exploiting formula generation's unique advantage: binary executability provides implicit supervision that separates semantic errors from valid stylistic variants. We frame training as a two-player game in which the main player learns to prefer ground-truth formulas over those from its previous version, while execution feedback sorts outputs into distinct granularities-enabling an adaptive curriculum that shifts from semantic correctness to stylistic refinement. To further increase accuracy, we incorporate ExecVote, a semantic-level voting mechanism that naturally handles multiple valid formulations. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that FORMULASPIN achieves state-of-the-art performance, with 74.9% exact match and 87.1% execution accuracy on NL2FORMULA, matching models trained with additional preference annotations while outperforming both traditional SFT and frontier proprietary models. These findings underscore self-play's potential to tackle scarce data tasks and open the door to extending it beyond executable domains.
papers.comment: 15 pages,7 figures, 14 tables. Accepted to ACL 2026 Main Conference Oral
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FORMULASPIN，一种基于自对弈（self-play）的微调框架，用于自然语言到电子表格公式的生成。它通过利用公式执行反馈（binary executability）解决了标准自对弈方法中执行等价变体被错误惩罚的问题，并引入了ExecVote机制处理多个有效公式。实验表明，在NL2FORMULA基准上达到74.9%精确匹配和87.1%执行准确率，超越传统监督微调和前沿专有模型。
Motivation: 现有公式生成方法依赖静态监督数据，性能很快饱和。自对弈方法虽有潜力，但直接应用会因执行等价输出产生矛盾梯度而失败。
Method: 将训练建模为两玩家博弈：主玩家学习偏好真实公式而非之前版本生成的公式，执行反馈将输出按语义正确性和风格精细度分级，形成自适应课程学习。此外，引入ExecVote投票机制处理多个有效公式。
Result: 在多个基准上取得最新最优结果：NL2FORMULA上精确匹配74.9%，执行准确率87.1%，与使用额外偏好标注训练的模型匹配，优于传统SFT和前沿闭源模型。
Conclusion: 自对弈在数据稀缺任务上具有潜力，并有望扩展到其他可执行领域之外的场景。

papers.title: Benchmarking Confidential GPU Inference on NVIDIA H100 under Intel TDX
papers.abstract_en: Confidential computing is becoming a practical deployment requirement for AI inference workloads that process sensitive inputs or protect proprietary model assets. However, the performance cost of enabling confidential execution for GPU-accelerated large language model serving remains workload dependent and operationally important. This paper presents a benchmark study comparing standard non-confidential execution with confidential computing mode on a single NVIDIA H100 80GB GPU hosted in an Intel TDX confidential instance. The evaluation uses two representative language models, Mistral-7B v0.1 and Qwen3-30B-A3B, and measures time to first token, end-to-end request latency, per-request token generation throughput, global token throughput, and closed-loop request throughput under increasing concurrency. In fixed request-rate experiments, confidential mode increases average TTFT by 21.8% for Mistral-7B and 27.8% for Qwen3-30B-A3B, while global token throughput drops by 17.7% and 21.1%, respectively. In closed-loop concurrency experiments, throughput gaps remain in the 11.5-20.2% range, but the larger model reaches its saturation knee earlier under confidential mode. The results suggest that confidential GPU inference can retain usable throughput under load, but capacity planning must account for both the steady throughput penalty and the earlier saturation behavior observed for larger models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在Intel TDX机密计算环境下，对NVIDIA H100 80GB GPU上的大语言模型推理进行基准测试，比较机密模式与非机密模式的性能差异。实验使用Mistral-7B和Qwen3-30B-A3B模型，测量首次令牌时间、端到端延迟、吞吐量等指标。结果显示机密模式导致平均首次令牌时间增加21.8%-27.8%，全局令牌吞吐量下降17.7%-21.1%，并且大模型更早达到饱和拐点。
Motivation: 机密计算成为处理敏感输入或保护模型资产的AI推理部署的实际需求，但启用机密执行对GPU加速的大语言模型服务的性能影响尚不明确，需要量化评估。
Method: 在单张NVIDIA H100 80GB GPU上，基于Intel TDX机密实例，对比标准执行与机密执行模式，使用Mistral-7B和Qwen3-30B-A3B两个代表性模型，进行固定请求率和闭环并发实验，测量多个性能指标。
Result: 机密模式下平均首次令牌时间增加21.8%（Mistral-7B）和27.8%（Qwen3-30B-A3B）；全局令牌吞吐量下降17.7%和21.1%；闭环并发测试中吞吐量差距在11.5%-20.2%之间，且大模型在机密模式下更早达到饱和。
Conclusion: 机密GPU推理在负载下仍能保持可用吞吐量，但容量规划需考虑稳定的吞吐量惩罚以及大模型更早的饱和行为。

papers.title: OpenEvoShield: Dual Non-Stationary Continual Defense for Open-World Multi-Agent System Attacks
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical applications, where adversaries inject malicious instructions through inter-agent communication to propagate harmful behaviors. Unlike static threats, these attacks are doubly dynamic: adversaries refine injection strategies against deployed defenses while normal-agent behavior drifts with system expansion. Existing defenses treat deployment as a closed-world problem and degrade rapidly once either distribution shifts beyond training coverage. We propose OpenEvoShield, a co-evolutionary continual defense framework for LLM-MAS. An asymmetric rate controller (M1) decouples fast attack-side and slow normal-side learning rates from dual drift signals. A normal-boundary updater (M2) maintains a dynamic behavioral boundary at the slow rate, while an EWC-regularized policy ensemble (M3) fast-adapts without catastrophic forgetting. An energy-based multi-granularity detector (M4) fuses node-, subgraph-, and graph-level evidence to classify novel attacks as out-of-distribution. Experiments over 100 deployment rounds across five benchmarks and four MAS topologies show that OpenEvoShield outperforms static and continual baselines, detecting most previously unseen attacks while keeping false positive rates low.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM 多智能体系统在开放世界中遭遇的双重非平稳攻击（攻击策略演变和正常智能体行为漂移），提出协同进化持续防御框架 OpenEvoShield。框架包含非对称速率控制器、动态行为边界、EWC 正则化策略集成和能量基多粒度检测器。在五个基准和四种拓扑上测试 100 轮部署，优于静态和持续基线，能检测大多数未见攻击并保持低假阳性率。
Motivation: 现有防御将部署视为闭世界问题，当分布偏移超出训练覆盖时性能急剧下降，无法应对攻击策略和正常行为同时动态变化的开放世界场景。
Method: OpenEvoShield 包含四个模块：M1 非对称速率控制器，从双重漂移信号解耦快速攻击侧和慢速正常侧学习率；M2 正常边界更新器，以慢速率维护动态行为边界；M3 EWC 正则化策略集成，快速适应而不灾难性遗忘；M4 能量基多粒度检测器，融合节点、子图和图级证据，将新攻击分类为分布外。
Result: 在五个基准和四种多智能体拓扑上 100 轮部署实验中，OpenEvoShield 优于静态和持续基线，能检测大多数以前未见过的攻击，同时保持低假阳性率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架通过协同进化持续防御有效应对开放世界中双重非平稳攻击，提升了 LLM 多智能体系统在安全关键应用中的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Hybrid LSTM-Graph Neural Framework for Robust Financial Fraud Detection and Adversarial Resilience
papers.abstract_en: Financial institutions face significant challenges in detecting sophisticated money laundering patterns, such as smurfing and layering, due to extreme data imbalance (0.13% fraud rate) and evolving adversarial evasion tactics. This paper proposes FraudShield AI, a hybrid framework that integrates Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks with hand-crafted Graph Topological Features to capture both temporal sequences and structural relational context. By engineering network-centric features including PageRank Centrality, In-Degree dynamics, and a custom Flow Ratio, the system shifts the detection paradigm from isolated transaction analysis to network-level forensics. A Focal Loss objective is used to address class imbalance, and a dynamic thresholding mechanism is introduced to improve resilience against low-value smurfing attacks. Experimental evaluation on the PaySim dataset shows that the proposed hybrid model substantially outperforms Logistic Regression and XGBoost baselines in Precision, Recall, and F1-Score, particularly on hard-to-detect micro-transaction fraud patterns. An ablation study confirms the complementary contribution of both the temporal and topological components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FraudShield AI，一个混合LSTM和图拓扑特征的框架，用于检测金融欺诈中的洗钱模式（如smurfing和layering）。在PaySim数据集上，该框架优于逻辑回归和XGBoost，特别是在微量交易欺诈检测上。
Motivation: 金融欺诈检测面临数据极度不平衡（欺诈率0.13%）和对抗性规避策略的挑战，现有方法难以捕捉复杂洗钱模式。
Method: 集成LSTM与手工设计的图拓扑特征（PageRank Centrality, In-Degree动态, Flow Ratio），使用Focal Loss处理类别不平衡，并引入动态阈值机制增强对低价值smurfing攻击的韧性。
Result: 在PaySim数据集上，混合模型在精确率、召回率和F1分数上显著优于逻辑回归和XGBoost基线，消融研究确认时序和拓扑组分的互补贡献。
Conclusion: 该框架将检测范式从孤立交易分析转向网络级取证，提升了对抗性弹性，但摘要未提及其他数据集或实际部署的局限性。

papers.title: FineServe: A Fine-Grained Dataset and Characterization of Global LLM Serving Workloads
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as always-on online services, making efficient LLM serving a critical systems challenge. Achieving low latency and high throughput under volatile demand requires deep understanding of real-world serving workloads, yet existing studies often rely on proxy traces or coarse-grained characterizations that fail to capture the heterogeneity of modern multi-model LLM platforms. We present FineServe, an in-the-wild, multi-model LLM serving workload dataset collected from a global commercial marketplace, enabling fine-grained characterization of real-world serving dynamics across heterogeneous models and tasks. Leveraging FineServe, we conduct a comprehensive analysis of arrival dynamics and token behavior, revealing fundamentally different fluctuation regimes across model architectures, scales and task intents. Building on these insights, we develop the FineServe workload generator, which composes fine-grained model-aware workloads into configurable mixtures tailored for benchmarking multi-model serving platforms. By exposing these fine-grained workload dynamics, FineServe provides a realistic foundation for evaluating routing, scheduling, and capacity-planning strategies in LLM serving systems. FineServe is available at https://github.com/hihiztc1/FineServe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了FineServe，一个从全球商业市场收集的多模型LLM服务负载细粒度数据集。通过对异构模型和任务的实际服务动态进行深入分析，揭示了不同模型架构、规模和任务意图下到达动力学和令牌行为的根本性差异。基于这些洞察，开发了FineServe负载生成器，可组合成可配置的混合负载，用于多模型服务平台的基准测试。
Motivation: 现有研究依赖代理轨迹或粗粒度特征，无法捕捉现代多模型LLM平台的异构性，缺乏对真实世界服务负载的深入理解。
Method: 收集自全球商业市场的多模型LLM服务负载数据集，利用它进行细粒度特征分析，并开发了模型感知的负载生成器，可生成可配置的混合负载。
Result: 揭示了不同模型架构、规模和任务意图下截然不同的波动模式，以及到达动力学和令牌行为的差异。
Conclusion: FineServe为评估LLM服务系统中的路由、调度和容量规划策略提供了真实基础。
